import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { AppearanceProvider, useAppearance } from "./AppearanceProvider";
import { MotionConfig } from "framer-motion";
import { Toaster } from "sonner";
import { TooltipProvider } from "../../components/ui/tooltip";
import { LocaleProvider, useLocale } from "./LocaleProvider";
import { ServicesProvider } from "./ServicesProvider";
import { SavedItemsProvider } from "./SavedItemsProvider";
import { OverlayProvider } from "./OverlayProvider";
import { WorkspaceProvider } from "./WorkspaceProvider";
import { mockServices } from "../../services/mock-services";
import { QUERY_STALE_TIME } from "../../constants/config";
import type { MedClubServices } from "../../services/contracts";
import type { Locale } from "../../types/content";
import { AuthProvider } from "./AuthProvider";
import { StudyChromeProvider } from "./StudyChromeProvider";
function Notifications() {
  const { dir } = useLocale();
  const { resolvedTheme } = useAppearance();
  return (
    <Toaster
      position={dir === "rtl" ? "bottom-left" : "bottom-right"}
      dir={dir}
      theme={resolvedTheme}
    />
  );
}
export function AppProviders({
  children,
  services = mockServices,
  initialLocale,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  services?: MedClubServices;
  initialLocale?: Locale;
}) {
  const [client] = useState(
    () =>
      new QueryClient({
        defaultOptions: {
          queries: {
            staleTime: QUERY_STALE_TIME,
            retry: 1,
            refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
          },
        },
      }),
  );
  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={client}>
      <ServicesProvider services={services}>
        <LocaleProvider initialLocale={initialLocale}>
          <AppearanceProvider>
            <AuthProvider>
              <MotionConfig reducedMotion="user">
                <TooltipProvider delayDuration={350}>
                  <WorkspaceProvider>
                    <SavedItemsProvider>
                      <OverlayProvider>
                        <StudyChromeProvider>
                          {children}
                          <Notifications />
                        </StudyChromeProvider>
                      </OverlayProvider>
                    </SavedItemsProvider>
                  </WorkspaceProvider>
                </TooltipProvider>
              </MotionConfig>
            </AuthProvider>
          </AppearanceProvider>
        </LocaleProvider>
      </ServicesProvider>
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/providers/AuthProvider.tsx
============================================================
import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useAppearance } from "./AppearanceProvider";
import { useServices } from "./ServicesProvider";
import type {
  AuthProfileInput,
  AuthSnapshot,
  RegisterInput,
  SignInInput,
} from "../../types/auth";

interface AuthContextValue {
  snapshot: AuthSnapshot;
  isPending: boolean;
  refresh: () => Promise<AuthSnapshot>;
  signIn: (input: SignInInput) => Promise<AuthSnapshot>;
  register: (input: RegisterInput) => Promise<AuthSnapshot>;
  verifyEmail: (code: string) => Promise<AuthSnapshot>;
  requestPasswordReset: (email: string) => Promise<void>;
  updateProfile: (input: AuthProfileInput) => Promise<AuthSnapshot>;
  signOut: () => Promise<AuthSnapshot>;
}

const initialSnapshot: AuthSnapshot = { status: "anonymous", user: null };
const Context = createContext<AuthContextValue | null>(null);

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const services = useServices();
  const { setAccountAvailable } = useAppearance();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState(initialSnapshot);
  const [isPending, setPending] = useState(true);

  const commit = useCallback(
    async (next: AuthSnapshot) => {
      setSnapshot(next);
      setAccountAvailable(next.status !== "anonymous");
      if (next.user)
        queryClient.setQueryData(["personal", "profile"], next.user.profile);
      else queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: ["personal", "profile"] });
      return next;
    },
    [queryClient, setAccountAvailable],
  );

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    const next = await services.auth.getSnapshot();
    setPending(false);
    return commit(next);
  }, [commit, services.auth]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
    return services.auth.subscribe(() => void refresh());
  }, [refresh, services.auth]);

  const run = useCallback(
    async (action: () => Promise<AuthSnapshot>) => {
      setPending(true);
      try {
        return await commit(await action());
      } finally {
        setPending(false);
      }
    },
    [commit],
  );

  const value = useMemo<AuthContextValue>(
    () => ({
      snapshot,
      isPending,
      refresh,
      signIn: (input) => run(() => services.auth.signIn(input)),
      register: (input) => run(async () => {
        const next = await services.auth.register(input);
        // A newly created account starts with the guest's selected MedClub mode.
        if (next.status !== "anonymous") {
          try {
            const mode = localStorage.getItem("medclub.guest-appearance.v1") === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
            localStorage.setItem("medclub.appearance.v1", JSON.stringify({ navigation: "vertical", sidebarCollapsed: false, palette: "medclub", colorMode: mode }));
            window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent("storage", { key: "medclub.appearance.v1" }));
          } catch { /* Account creation remains available without browser storage. */ }
        }
        return next;
      }),
      verifyEmail: (code) => run(() => services.auth.verifyEmail(code)),
      requestPasswordReset: async (email) => {
        setPending(true);
        try {
          await services.auth.requestPasswordReset(email);
        } finally {
          setPending(false);
        }
      },
      updateProfile: (input) => run(() => services.auth.updateProfile(input)),
      signOut: () => run(() => services.auth.signOut()),
    }),
    [isPending, refresh, run, services.auth, snapshot],
  );

  return <Context.Provider value={value}>{children}</Context.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth() {
  const value = useContext(Context);
  if (!value) throw new Error("AuthProvider required");
  return value;
}

import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import type { Locale, Text } from "../../types/content";
import { messages, type MessageKey } from "../../constants/messages";
import { DEFAULT_LOCALE, STORAGE_KEYS } from "../../constants/config";
interface LocaleContextValue {
  locale: Locale;
  dir: "ltr" | "rtl";
  setLocale: (value: Locale) => void;
  t: (value: Text) => string;
  label: (key: MessageKey) => string;
}
const Context = createContext<LocaleContextValue | null>(null);
export function LocaleProvider({
  children,
  initialLocale = DEFAULT_LOCALE,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  initialLocale?: Locale;
}) {
  const [locale, setValue] = useState<Locale>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.locale);
      return saved === "ar" || saved === "en" ? saved : initialLocale;
    } catch {
      return initialLocale;
    }
  });
  const dir: "ltr" | "rtl" = locale === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr";
  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.lang = locale;
    document.documentElement.dir = dir;
  }, [locale, dir]);
  function setLocale(value: Locale) {
    setValue(value);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.locale, value);
    } catch {
      /* Language still works for this session. */
    }
  }
  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      locale,
      dir,
      setLocale,
      t: (text: Text) => text[locale],
      label: (key: MessageKey) => messages[locale][key],
    }),
    [locale, dir],
  );
  return <Context.Provider value={value}>{children}</Context.Provider>;
}
export function useLocale() {
  const value = useContext(Context);
  if (!value) throw new Error("LocaleProvider required");
  return value;
}

FILE: src/app/providers/OverlayProvider.tsx
============================================================
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
  type MouseEvent,
} from "react";
import type { DetailRecord } from "../../types/content";
import { useWorkspace } from "./WorkspaceProvider";
interface OverlayContextValue {
  searchOpen: boolean;
  detail: DetailRecord | null;
  openSearch: (event?: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => void;
  searchTrigger: HTMLElement | null;
  closeSearch: () => void;
  openDetail: (record: DetailRecord) => void;
  closeDetail: () => void;
}
const Context = createContext<OverlayContextValue | null>(null);
export function OverlayProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const location = useLocation();
  const { send } = useWorkspace();
  useEffect(() => {
    setSearch(false);
    setDetail(null);
  }, [location.pathname]);
  const [searchOpen, setSearch] = useState(false);
  const [searchTrigger, setSearchTrigger] = useState<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<DetailRecord | null>(null);
  function openSearch(event?: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) {
    if (detail) return;
    const trigger =
      event?.currentTarget ??
      Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-search-trigger]"),
      ).find((node) => node.getBoundingClientRect().width > 0);
    setSearchTrigger(trigger ?? null);
    setSearch(true);
  }
  function closeSearch() {
    setSearch(false);
  }
  function openDetail(record: DetailRecord) {
    if (record.kind === "resource")
      void send({ type: "view-resource", id: record.item.id });
    setSearch(false);
    setDetail(record);
  }
  function closeDetail() {
    setDetail(null);
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    function key(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      const target = e.target;
      const editing =
        target instanceof HTMLElement &&
        (target.isContentEditable || target.matches("input,textarea,select"));
      if (editing || document.querySelector('dialog[open], [role="dialog"]'))
        return;
      if (
        ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "k") ||
        e.key === "/"
      ) {
        e.preventDefault();
        openSearch();
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", key);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", key);
  }, [detail]);
  return (
    <Context.Provider
      value={{
        searchOpen,
        searchTrigger,
        detail,
        openSearch,
        closeSearch,
        openDetail,
        closeDetail,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </Context.Provider>
  );
}
export function useOverlays() {
  const value = useContext(Context);
  if (!value) throw new Error("OverlayProvider required");
  return value;
}

import { type ReactNode } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "./LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "./WorkspaceProvider";
/** Compatibility facade: existing V0.1/V0.2 cards keep the same API. */
export function SavedItemsProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return children;
}
export function useSavedItems() {
  const { state, send, isPending, isError } = useWorkspace();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  return {
    saved: state.savedIds,
    isPending: isPending || isError,
    toggle: async (id: string) => {
      const removing = state.savedIds.includes(id);
      if (await send({ type: "toggle-save", id }))
        toast(label(removing ? "removed" : "saved"));
    },
  };
}

FILE: src/app/providers/StudyChromeProvider.tsx
============================================================
import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useLayoutEffect,
  useState,
  useCallback,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";

const Context = createContext({
  focus: false,
  studying: false,
  courseNavigationVisible: false,
  setCourseNavigationVisible: (_value: boolean) => {},
  setFocus: (_value: boolean) => {},
});
export function StudyChromeProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const studying = /^\/(?:learn\/courses|my\/learning)\/[^/]+\/?$/.test(
    pathname,
  );
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!studying) return;
    const previous = document.documentElement.dataset.studyRoute;
    document.documentElement.dataset.studyRoute = "true";
    return () => {
      if (previous === undefined)
        delete document.documentElement.dataset.studyRoute;
      else document.documentElement.dataset.studyRoute = previous;
    };
  }, [studying]);
  const [focusPath, setFocusPath] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [menuPath, setMenuPath] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const focus = focusPath === pathname;
  const setCourseNavigationVisible = useCallback(
    (value: boolean) => {
      setMenuPath(value && !studying ? pathname : null);
    },
    [pathname, studying],
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    setFocusPath(null);
    setMenuPath(null);
  }, [pathname]);
  return (
    <Context.Provider
      value={{
        focus,
        studying,
        courseNavigationVisible: studying && !focus && menuPath === pathname,
        setCourseNavigationVisible,
        setFocus: (value) => {
          setFocusPath(value ? pathname : null);
          if (value) setMenuPath(null);
        },
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </Context.Provider>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/providers/WorkspaceProvider.tsx
============================================================
import { useAuth } from "./AuthProvider";
import {
  workspaceInverse,
  workspaceActionFingerprint,
} from "../../lib/workspace-undo";
import { offerUndo } from "../../components/feedback/undo-action";
import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useServices } from "./ServicesProvider";
import { useLocale } from "./LocaleProvider";
import { useStudentProfile } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { emptyWorkspace } from "../../lib/workspace-state";
import type { PersonalWorkspace, WorkspaceAction } from "../../types/workspace";
const empty = emptyWorkspace();
interface WorkspaceContext {
  state: PersonalWorkspace;
  isPending: boolean;
  isError: boolean;
  persistent: boolean;
  send: (action: WorkspaceAction) => Promise<boolean>;
  retry: () => void;
}
const Context = createContext<WorkspaceContext | null>(null);
export function WorkspaceProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { workspace, auth } = useServices();
  const { snapshot: authSnapshot } = useAuth();
  const account = `${authSnapshot.status}:${authSnapshot.user?.id || "guest"}`;
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const profile = useStudentProfile();
  const id = profile.data?.id;
  const currentId = useRef(id);
  currentId.current = id;
  const client = useQueryClient();
  const queue = useRef<Promise<unknown>>(Promise.resolve());
  const key = ["workspace", id];
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: key,
    queryFn: () => workspace.get(id!),
    enabled: !!id,
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return;
    return workspace.subscribe?.(id, () => {
      void client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["workspace", id] });
    });
  }, [id, workspace, client]);
  async function send(action: WorkspaceAction) {
    if (!id || !query.data) {
      toast.error(label("workspaceNotReady"));
      return false;
    }
    const job = queue.current
      .catch(() => undefined)
      .then(async () => {
        try {
          const before = (await workspace.get(id)).state;
          const snapshot = await workspace.dispatch(id, action);
          const inverse = workspaceInverse(before, action);
          if (inverse) {
            const expected = workspaceActionFingerprint(snapshot.state, action);
            offerUndo({
              message: t(
                action.type.startsWith("delete") ||
                  action.type === "toggle-save"
                  ? { en: "Item removed", ar: "حُذف العنصر" }
                  : { en: "Changes saved", ar: "حُفظت التغييرات" },
              ),
              label: t({ en: "Undo", ar: "تراجع" }),
              restored: t({ en: "Action undone", ar: "تم التراجع" }),
              failed: t({
                en: "Could not undo. This item may have changed.",
                ar: "تعذّر التراجع. ربما تغيّر هذا العنصر.",
              }),
              canRestore: () => currentId.current === id,
              undo: async () => {
                const job = queue.current
                  .catch(() => undefined)
                  .then(async () => {
                    const fresh = await auth.getSnapshot();
                    if (
                      currentId.current !== id ||
                      `${fresh.status}:${fresh.user?.id || "guest"}` !== account
                    )
                      throw new Error("ACCOUNT_CHANGED");
                    const current = await workspace.get(id);
                    if (
                      workspaceActionFingerprint(current.state, action) !==
                      expected
                    )
                      throw new Error("ITEM_CHANGED");
                    const restored = await workspace.dispatch(id, inverse);
                    client.setQueryData(["workspace", id], restored);
                  });
                queue.current = job;
                await job;
              },
            });
          }
          client.setQueryData(["workspace", id], snapshot);
          if (!snapshot.persistent) toast(label("sessionOnly"));
          return true;
        } catch {
          toast.error(label("workspaceSaveFailed"));
          return false;
        }
      });
    queue.current = job;
    return job;
  }
  return (
    <Context.Provider
      value={{
        state: query.data?.state || empty,
        isPending:
          !(profile.isError || query.isError) &&
          (profile.isPending || query.isPending),
        isError: profile.isError || query.isError,
        persistent: query.data?.persistent ?? true,
        send,
        retry: () => {
          void profile.refetch();
          void query.refetch();
        },
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </Context.Provider>
  );
}
export function useWorkspace() {
  const context = useContext(Context);
  if (!context) throw new Error("WorkspaceProvider required");
  return context;
}

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";

export function AcademicTransition({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  return (
    <motion.div
      className="academic-route-transition"
      initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 10, scale: 0.997 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
      transition={{ duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.32, ease: [0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1] }}
    >
      {!reduced && (
        <motion.span
          className="academic-route-thread"
          aria-hidden="true"
          initial={{ scaleX: 0, opacity: 0.7 }}
          animate={{ scaleX: 1, opacity: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.55, ease: "easeOut" }}
        />
      )}
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/router/CapabilityGate.tsx
============================================================
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import type { Capability } from "../../types/governance";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { useLocale } from "../providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useAccess } from "../../admin/governance/useGovernance";

export function CapabilityGate({ capability, children }: { capability: Capability; children: ReactNode }) {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const access = useAccess();
  if (access.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (access.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void access.refetch()} />;
  if (!access.data.capabilities.includes(capability)) {
    return (
      <section className="container governance-forbidden" role="alert">
        <span aria-hidden="true">403</span>
        <h1 data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>{label("governanceForbiddenTitle")}</h1>
        <p>{label("governanceForbiddenBody")}</p>
      </section>
    );
  }
  return <>{children}</>;
}

import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

export function MedicalTransition({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  return (
    <motion.div
      className="medical-route-transition"
      initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.32, ease: [0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1] }}
    >
      {!reduced && (
        <motion.div
          className="medical-scan"
          aria-hidden="true"
          initial={{ scaleX: 0, opacity: 0.9 }}
          animate={{ scaleX: 1, opacity: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.72, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
        >
          <i />
        </motion.div>
      )}
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/router/RequireAuth.tsx
============================================================
import { Navigate, Outlet, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../providers/AuthProvider";
import { routes, signInPath } from "../../constants/routes";
import { useLocale } from "../providers/LocaleProvider";

export function RequireAuth() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const returnTo = `${location.pathname}${location.search}${location.hash}`;

  if (auth.isPending)
    return (
      <div className="auth-gate" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        <span className="auth-gate-pulse" aria-hidden="true" />
        {label("authLoading")}
      </div>
    );
  if (auth.snapshot.status === "verification-required")
    return (
      <Navigate
        replace
        to={`${routes.verify}?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(returnTo)}`}
      />
    );
  if (auth.snapshot.status !== "authenticated")
    return <Navigate replace to={signInPath(returnTo)} />;
  return <Outlet />;
}

FILE: src/app/router/RouteJourney.tsx
============================================================
import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useLayoutEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
  Suspense,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import {
  useLocation,
  useNavigationType,
  type Location,
} from "react-router-dom";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";

type Phase = "idle" | "leaving" | "waiting" | "arriving";
export function courseDeskFamily(path: string) {
  if (/^\/learn\/courses\/[^/]+\/?$/.test(path)) return "public";
  if (/^\/my\/learning\/[^/]+\/?$/.test(path)) return "personal";
  return null;
}
export const RouteJourneyContext = createContext<{
  phase: Phase;
  ready: (location: Location) => void;
}>({ phase: "idle", ready: () => {} });

/** One routed tree: commit immediately, show loading, restore position, then gently arrive. */
export function useRouteJourney(target: Location) {
  const action = useNavigationType();
  const [location, setLocation] = useState(target);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>("idle");
  const visible = useRef(location);
  const destination = useRef(target);
  destination.current = target;
  const currentAction = useRef(action);
  currentAction.current = action;
  const positions = useRef(new Map<string, number>());
  const moved = useRef(false);
  const deskSwitch = useRef(false);
  const completed = useRef("");
  const timers = useRef<number[]>([]);
  const frames = useRef<number[]>([]);
  const hashObserver = useRef<MutationObserver | null>(null);
  const focusAtNavigation = useRef<Element | null>(null);
  const mainHeight = useRef(320);
  const motionOff = () =>
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  useEffect(() => {
    const main = document.getElementById("main");
    const observer = typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined" ? null : new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      const entry = entries[0];
      if (entry) mainHeight.current = Math.max(320, entry.borderBoxSize?.[0]?.blockSize ?? entry.contentRect.height);
    });
    if (main) observer?.observe(main);
    return () => observer?.disconnect();
  }, [location.pathname]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const previous = window.history.scrollRestoration;
    window.history.scrollRestoration = "manual";
    return () => {
      window.history.scrollRestoration = previous;
      timers.current.forEach(clearTimeout);
      frames.current.forEach(cancelAnimationFrame);
      hashObserver.current?.disconnect();
      document.documentElement.style.removeProperty("--route-hold-height");
    };
  }, []);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const old = visible.current;
    if (
      old.key === target.key &&
      old.pathname === target.pathname &&
      old.hash === target.hash
    )
      return;
    timers.current.forEach(clearTimeout);
    frames.current.forEach(cancelAnimationFrame);
    hashObserver.current?.disconnect();
    timers.current = [];
    frames.current = [];
    // Only the keyed reader turns over between courses in the same desk.
    // The surrounding shelf never fades, scrolls to the top or becomes inert.
    if (
      old.pathname !== target.pathname &&
      courseDeskFamily(old.pathname) &&
      courseDeskFamily(old.pathname) === courseDeskFamily(target.pathname)
    ) {
      deskSwitch.current = true;
      moved.current = false;
      visible.current = target;
      setLocation(target);
      setPhase("idle");
      document.documentElement.style.removeProperty("--route-hold-height");
      return;
    }
    deskSwitch.current = false;
    if (old.pathname === target.pathname) {
      visible.current = target;
      setLocation(target);
      setPhase("idle");
      return; // Filters and notebook section switches never reset the document.
    }
    positions.current.set(`entry:${old.key}`, window.scrollY);
    positions.current.set(`path:${old.pathname}`, window.scrollY);
    while (positions.current.size > 120)
      positions.current.delete(positions.current.keys().next().value!);
    moved.current = true;
    focusAtNavigation.current = document.activeElement;
    const main = document.getElementById("main");
    if (document.activeElement?.closest(".route-viewport, .route-footer")) {
      main?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      focusAtNavigation.current = document.activeElement;
    }
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
      "--route-hold-height",
      `${mainHeight.current}px`,
    );
    // Commit immediately. Lazy/query loading has its own visible loading state.
    visible.current = target;
    setLocation(target);
    setPhase("waiting");
  }, [target]);
  const ready = useCallback((arrived: Location) => {
    if (
      arrived.key !== destination.current.key ||
      arrived.pathname !== destination.current.pathname ||
      completed.current === `${arrived.key}:${arrived.hash}`
    )
      return;
    completed.current = `${arrived.key}:${arrived.hash}`;
    if (deskSwitch.current) {
      deskSwitch.current = false;
      setPhase("idle");
      return;
    }
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.style.removeProperty("--route-hold-height");
    if (arrived.hash) {
      let id = arrived.hash.slice(1);
      try {
        id = decodeURIComponent(id);
      } catch {
        /* Keep malformed fragment literal. */
      }
      const revealHash = () => {
        const element = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!element || arrived.key !== destination.current.key) return false;
        element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "instant" });
        hashObserver.current?.disconnect();
        return true;
      };
      if (!revealHash()) {
        hashObserver.current = new MutationObserver(revealHash);
        hashObserver.current.observe(
          document.getElementById("main") ?? document.body,
          { childList: true, subtree: true },
        );
      }
    } else if (moved.current) {
      const key =
        currentAction.current === "POP"
          ? `entry:${arrived.key}`
          : `path:${arrived.pathname}`;
      const top =
        positions.current.get(key) ??
        positions.current.get(`path:${arrived.pathname}`) ??
        0;
      window.scrollTo({ top, behavior: "instant" });
    }
    if (
      moved.current &&
      !document.querySelector('dialog[open], [role="dialog"], [role="menu"]') &&
      (document.activeElement === focusAtNavigation.current ||
        document.activeElement === document.body)
    )
      document.getElementById("main")?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    moved.current = false;
    frames.current.push(
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (arrived.key !== destination.current.key) return;
        setPhase(motionOff() ? "idle" : "arriving");
        timers.current.push(
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (arrived.key === destination.current.key) setPhase("idle");
          }, motionOff() ? 0 : 180),
        );
      }),
    );
  }, []);
  return { location, phase, ready };
}

function Arrival({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const location = useLocation();
  const { ready } = useContext(RouteJourneyContext);
  const content = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const node = content.current;
    if (!node) return;
    const complete = () => {
      if (node.querySelector("[data-route-loading]")) return false;
      ready(location);
      return true;
    };
    if (complete()) return;
    // Query-driven screens can still be loading after their lazy module resolves.
    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
      if (complete()) observer.disconnect();
    });
    observer.observe(node, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [location, ready]);
  return (
    <div className="route-page-content" ref={content}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
export function RouteViewport({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { phase } = useContext(RouteJourneyContext);
  return (
    <div
      className="route-viewport"
      data-route-phase={phase}
      aria-busy={phase === "leaving" || phase === "waiting"}
      aria-hidden={phase === "leaving" || undefined}
      inert={phase === "leaving" || undefined}
    >
      <Suspense fallback={<LoadingState />}>
        <Arrival>{children}</Arrival>
      </Suspense>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Hide outgoing footer destinations from focus/navigation during the short exit. */
export function RouteFooter({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { phase } = useContext(RouteJourneyContext);
  return (
    <div
      className="route-footer"
      data-route-phase={phase}
      aria-hidden={phase === "leaving" || undefined}
      inert={phase === "leaving" || undefined}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
export function RouteTransition({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={reduced ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.18, ease: "easeOut" }}
    >
      {children}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/router/SpaceTransition.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";
import { useLocale } from "../providers/LocaleProvider";

type Space = "personal" | "public" | "auth" | "admin";

/** Cross-fades product worlds without hiding focused content or transforming fixed nav. */
export function SpaceTransition({
  space,
  children,
}: {
  space: Space;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const previous = useRef<Space>(space);
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const from = previous.current;
  const crossing = from !== space;
  useEffect(() => {
    previous.current = space;
  }, [space]);
  const transitionLabel =
    space === "admin"
      ? label("spaceEnteringAdmin")
      : from === "admin"
        ? label("spaceLeavingAdmin")
        : space === "personal"
          ? label("spaceLeavingPublic")
          : label("spaceLeavingPersonal");
  return (
    <motion.div
      key={space}
      className={`space-transition space-transition-${space}`}
      data-workspace={space}
      data-arriving={crossing || undefined}
      initial={crossing && !reduced ? { opacity: 0.08 } : false}
      animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
      transition={{ duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.48, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
    >
      {children}
      {crossing && !reduced && (
        <motion.div
          className="space-flight-gate"
          data-from={from}
          data-to={space}
          aria-hidden="true"
          initial={{ opacity: 1 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.7, ease: "easeOut" }}
        >
          <span className="space-flight-aperture">
            <i />
            <i />
            <i />
          </span>
          <span className="space-flight-streaks">
            <i />
            <i />
            <i />
            <i />
            <i />
            <i />
          </span>
          <small>{transitionLabel}</small>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

    i = i+1
  endloop

FILE: src/components/cards/AcademicPortalCard.tsx
============================================================
import type { CSSProperties, PointerEvent, ReactNode } from "react";
import { ArrowUpRight } from "lucide-react";
import { AppLink } from "../navigation/AppLink";

export function AcademicPortalCard({
  href,
  eyebrow,
  title,
  description,
  action,
  tone,
  children,
}: {
  href: string;
  eyebrow: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  action: string;
  tone: "basic" | "clinical";
  children?: ReactNode;
}) {
  function follow(event: PointerEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) {
    const bounds = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    event.currentTarget.style.setProperty(
      "--spot-x",
      `${event.clientX - bounds.left}px`,
    );
    event.currentTarget.style.setProperty(
      "--spot-y",
      `${event.clientY - bounds.top}px`,
    );
  }
  return (
    <AppLink
      href={href}
      className={`academic-portal portal-${tone}`}
      onPointerMove={follow}
      style={{ "--spot-x": "65%", "--spot-y": "35%" } as CSSProperties}
    >
      <span className="portal-spot" aria-hidden="true" />
      <span className="portal-grid" aria-hidden="true" />
      <span className="portal-copy">
        <span className="academic-kicker">{eyebrow}</span>
        <strong>{title}</strong>
        <span>{description}</span>
      </span>
      {children}
      <span className="portal-action">
        {action}
        <ArrowUpRight size={19} className="directional" />
      </span>
    </AppLink>
  );
}

import { ArrowUpRight, Clock3, UserRound } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { articlePath } from "../../constants/routes";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import type { Article } from "../../types/content";
import { AppLink } from "../navigation/AppLink";
import { SaveButton } from "./SaveButton";

export function ArticleCard({ article }: { article: Article }) {
  const { t, label, locale } = useLocale();
  return (
    <article
      className="journal-story-card"
      data-featured={article.featured || undefined}
    >
      <div className="journal-card-signal" aria-hidden="true">
        <span />
        <i />
      </div>
      <div className="journal-story-topline">
        <span className="eyebrow">{t(article.category)}</span>
        <SaveButton id={article.id} title={t(article.title)} />
      </div>
      <h2>
        <AppLink href={articlePath(article.slug)}>{t(article.title)}</AppLink>
      </h2>
      <p>{t(article.excerpt)}</p>
      <div className="journal-story-meta">
        <span>
          <UserRound size={15} />
          {t(article.author)}
        </span>
        <span>
          <Clock3 size={15} />
          {article.readMinutes} {label("readMinutes")}
        </span>
        <time dateTime={article.publishedAt}>
          {formatDate(article.publishedAt, locale, {
            day: "numeric",
            month: "short",
            year: "numeric",
          })}
        </time>
      </div>
      <div className="journal-story-bottom">
        <div>
          {article.tags.map((tag) => (
            <span key={tag.en}>{t(tag)}</span>
          ))}
        </div>
        <AppLink
          className="text-link"
          href={articlePath(article.slug)}
          aria-label={`${label("readArticle")} ${t(article.title)}`}
        >
          {label("readArticle")}
          <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={17} />
        </AppLink>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

import gate from "../../assets/section-art/batch-gate-1280.webp";
import gateSmall from "../../assets/section-art/batch-gate-640.webp";
import { usePageArtwork } from "../data-display/HeroArtwork";
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { ArrowUpRight, CalendarDays } from "lucide-react";
import type { Batch } from "../../types/content";
import { batchPath } from "../../constants/routes";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../navigation/AppLink";

export function BatchCard({ batch, index }: { batch: Batch; index: number }) {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const artwork = usePageArtwork("batch-gate");
  const current = batch.terms.find((term) => term.current);
  return (
    <AppLink
      href={batchPath(batch.slug)}
      data-batch-tone={batch.accent}
      className={`batch-passport batch-gate batch-${batch.accent}`}
      style={
        {
          "--batch-index": index,
          "--batch-progress": `${batch.progress * 3.6}deg`,
        } as CSSProperties
      }
    >
      <picture className="batch-gate-image" aria-hidden="true">
        {!artwork.data && (
          <source
            srcSet={gateSmall + " 640w, " + gate + " 1280w"}
            sizes="(max-width:767px) 90vw, 30vw"
          />
        )}
        <img
          src={artwork.data?.dataUrl || gate}
          alt=""
          width={1280}
          height={853}
          loading="lazy"
          decoding="async"
        />
      </picture>
      <span className="batch-gate-architecture" aria-hidden="true">
        <i />
        <i />
        <b />
      </span>
      <span className="passport-index" aria-hidden="true">
        0{index + 1}
      </span>
      <span className="passport-stamp" aria-hidden="true">
        <span>{batch.progress}%</span>
      </span>
      <span className="passport-copy">
        <span className="academic-kicker">{t(batch.classLabel)}</span>
        <strong>{t(batch.name)}</strong>
        <em>{t(batch.tagline)}</em>
        <span>{t(batch.description)}</span>
      </span>
      <span className="passport-term">
        <CalendarDays size={16} />
        <span>
          <small>{label("currentSemester")}</small>
          <b>{current ? t(current.label) : "—"}</b>
        </span>
      </span>
      <span className="passport-route-meta">
        <span>
          {label("year")} <b>{batch.studyYear}</b>
        </span>
        <span>
          {label("graduation")} <b>{batch.graduationYear}</b>
        </span>
      </span>
      <span className="passport-action">
        {label("exploreBatch")}
        <ArrowUpRight size={18} className="directional" />
      </span>
    </AppLink>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/cards/EventCard.tsx

import { ArrowRight, MapPin } from "lucide-react";
import type { ClubEvent } from "../../types/content";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import { SaveButton } from "./SaveButton";
import { AppLink } from "../navigation/AppLink";
import { eventAvailability } from "../../lib/discovery";
import { eventPath } from "../../constants/routes";
export function EventCard({ event: e }: { event: ClubEvent }) {
  const { t, label, locale } = useLocale();
  const status = eventAvailability(e);
  const statusKey =
    status === "open"
      ? "eventOpen"
      : status === "upcoming"
        ? "opensSoon"
        : status === "waitlist"
          ? "eventWaitlist"
          : "registrationClosed";
  return (
    <article className="event-card" data-status={status}>
      <div className="event-top">
        <div className="event-date">
          <span>{formatDate(e.startDate, locale, { month: "short" })}</span>
          <b>{formatDate(e.startDate, locale, { day: "2-digit" })}</b>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">{t(e.type)}</span>
          <h3>{t(e.title)}</h3>
        </div>
      </div>
      <span className="event-status" data-status={status}>
        {label(statusKey)}
      </span>
      <p className="event-place">
        <MapPin size={14} />
        {t(e.location)}
      </p>
      <div className="event-actions">
        <AppLink className="text-link" href={eventPath(e.slug)}>
          {label("eventView")}
          <ArrowRight className="directional" size={15} />
        </AppLink>
        <SaveButton id={e.id} title={t(e.title)} />
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/cards/EventTicketCard.tsx
============================================================
import { ArrowUpRight, Clock3, MapPin, UsersRound } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { eventPath } from "../../constants/routes";
import { eventAvailability, eventPlacesLeft } from "../../lib/discovery";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import type { ClubEvent } from "../../types/content";
import { AppLink } from "../navigation/AppLink";
import { SaveButton } from "./SaveButton";

const statusKeys = {
  upcoming: "opensSoon",
  open: "eventOpen",
  waitlist: "eventWaitlist",
  closed: "registrationClosed",
  ended: "registrationClosed",
} as const;

export function EventTicketCard({ event }: { event: ClubEvent }) {
  const { t, label, locale } = useLocale();
  const status = eventAvailability(event);
  const progress = Math.min(
    100,
    (event.registeredCount / event.capacity) * 100,
  );
  return (
    <article className="event-ticket" data-status={status}>
      <div
        className="ticket-date"
        aria-label={formatDate(event.startDate, locale)}
      >
        <span>{formatDate(event.startDate, locale, { month: "short" })}</span>
        <b>{formatDate(event.startDate, locale, { day: "2-digit" })}</b>
        <small>
          {formatDate(event.startDate, locale, { weekday: "short" })}
        </small>
      </div>
      <div className="ticket-body">
        <div className="ticket-topline">
          <span className="eyebrow">{t(event.type)}</span>
          <span className="event-status" data-status={status}>
            {label(statusKeys[status])}
          </span>
        </div>
        <h2>
          <AppLink href={eventPath(event.slug)}>{t(event.title)}</AppLink>
        </h2>
        <p>{t(event.description)}</p>
        <div className="ticket-facts">
          <span>
            <Clock3 size={15} />
            {formatDate(event.startDate, locale, {
              hour: "numeric",
              minute: "2-digit",
            })}
          </span>
          <span>
            <MapPin size={15} />
            {t(event.location)}
          </span>
          <span>
            <UsersRound size={15} />
            {status === "open"
              ? `${eventPlacesLeft(event)} ${label("spotsLeft")}`
              : `${event.registeredCount}/${event.capacity}`}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="capacity-line" aria-hidden="true">
          <i style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} />
        </div>
        <div className="ticket-actions">
          <AppLink className="text-link" href={eventPath(event.slug)}>
            {label("eventView")}
            <ArrowUpRight size={17} className="directional" />
          </AppLink>
          <SaveButton id={event.id} title={t(event.title)} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/cards/MentorCard.tsx
============================================================
import { ArrowUpRight, Languages, MapPin, UsersRound } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { routes } from "../../constants/routes";
import type { Mentor, MentorshipRequest } from "../../types/content";
import { AppLink } from "../navigation/AppLink";
import { Button } from "../ui/button";

export function MentorCard({
  mentor,
  request,
  onRequest,
}: {
  mentor: Mentor;
  request?: MentorshipRequest;
  onRequest: (mentor: Mentor) => void;
}) {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const openPlaces = Math.max(0, mentor.capacity - mentor.activeMentees);
  return (
    <article
      className="mentor-card"
      data-capacity={openPlaces ? "open" : "full"}
    >
      <div className="mentor-card-head">
        <span className="mentor-avatar" aria-hidden="true">
          {t(mentor.initials)}
        </span>
        <div>
          <span>
            {t(mentor.title)} · {label("classOf")} {mentor.graduationYear}
          </span>
          <h2>{t(mentor.name)}</h2>
          <strong>{t(mentor.specialty)}</strong>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p>{t(mentor.bio)}</p>
      <div className="mentor-meta">
        <span>
          <MapPin size={15} /> {label(mentor.format)}
        </span>
        <span>
          <Languages size={15} /> {mentor.languages.map(t).join(" · ")}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="mentor-areas">
        <span>{label("mentoringAreas")}</span>
        <ul>
          {mentor.areas.map((area) => (
            <li key={area.en}>{t(area)}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div
        className="mentor-capacity"
        aria-label={`${openPlaces} ${label("placesAvailable")}`}
      >
        <span>
          <UsersRound size={17} />
        </span>
        <div>
          <i
            style={{
              width: `${(mentor.activeMentees / mentor.capacity) * 100}%`,
            }}
          />
        </div>
        <strong>
          {openPlaces
            ? `${openPlaces} ${label("placesAvailable")}`
            : label("atCapacity")}
        </strong>
      </div>
      {request &&
      request.status !== "cancelled" &&
      request.status !== "declined" ? (
        <AppLink
          href={routes.myMentorship}
          className="button button-secondary mentor-action"
        >
          {label(request.status)}
          <ArrowUpRight size={17} className="directional" />
        </AppLink>
      ) : (
        <Button
          className="button button-primary mentor-action"
          disabled={!openPlaces}
          onClick={() => onRequest(mentor)}
        >
          {label("requestSession")}
          <ArrowUpRight size={17} className="directional" />
        </Button>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/cards/SaveButton.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Bookmark } from "lucide-react";
import { useSavedItems } from "../../app/providers/SavedItemsProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { IconButton } from "../ui/IconButton";
export function SaveButton({ id, title }: { id: string; title: string }) {
  const { saved, toggle, isPending } = useSavedItems();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const active = saved.includes(id);
  const button = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
  const [motion, setMotion] = useState<"saved" | "removed" | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => () => {
    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
  }, []);

  const destination = () =>
    [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-library-destination]")]
      .find((item) => {
        const rect = item.getBoundingClientRect();
        const style = getComputedStyle(item);
        return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0 && style.visibility !== "hidden";
      });

  const sendBookmark = () => {
    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches || !button.current)
      return;
    const start = button.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const target = destination()?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const icon = button.current.querySelector("svg")?.cloneNode(true);
    if (!icon) return;
    const flight = document.createElement("span");
    flight.className = "save-destination-flight";
    flight.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    flight.style.setProperty("--flight-x", `${(target?.left ?? window.innerWidth - 34) - start.left}px`);
    flight.style.setProperty("--flight-y", `${(target?.top ?? 20) - start.top}px`);
    flight.style.left = `${start.left}px`;
    flight.style.top = `${start.top}px`;
    flight.append(icon);
    document.body.append(flight);
    flight.addEventListener("animationend", () => flight.remove(), { once: true });
    window.setTimeout(() => flight.remove(), 800);
  };

  const activate = async () => {
    if (!active) sendBookmark();
    await toggle(id);
    setMotion(active ? "removed" : "saved");
    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = setTimeout(() => setMotion(null), 560);
  };
  return (
    <IconButton
      ref={button}
      className="save-button"
      data-motion-state={motion || undefined}
      label={`${label(active ? "unsave" : "save")} ${title}`}
      aria-pressed={active}
      disabled={isPending}
      onClick={() => void activate()}
    >
      <Bookmark size={18} fill={active ? "currentColor" : "none"} />
    </IconButton>
  );
}

export function usePageArtwork(section: ArtworkSection) {
  const services = useServices();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["page-artwork", section],
    queryFn: () => services.artwork?.get(section) ?? Promise.resolve(null),
  });

export function HeroArtwork({
  section,
  className = "",
}: {
  section: Exclude<ArtworkSection, "home">;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    query = usePageArtwork(section);
  const large = files["../../assets/section-art/" + section + "-1280.webp"],
    small = files["../../assets/section-art/" + section + "-640.webp"];
  return (
    <figure
      className={"hero-artwork " + className}
      data-artwork-section={section}
    >
      <picture>
        {!query.data && (
          <source
            srcSet={small + " 640w, " + large + " 1280w"}
            sizes="(max-width:1280px) 100vw, 1280px"
          />
        )}
        <img
          src={query.data?.dataUrl || large}
          alt={t(query.data?.alt || descriptions[section])}
          width={1280}
          height={853}
          decoding="async"
          onError={(event) => {
            if (!event.currentTarget.dataset.fallback) {
              event.currentTarget.dataset.fallback = "true";
              event.currentTarget.src = large;
            }
          }}
        />
      </picture>
      <ArtworkEditor section={section} />
    </figure>
  );
}
export function ArtworkEditor({ section }: { section: ArtworkSection }) {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    auth = useAuth(),
    access = useAccess(),
    services = useServices(),
    client = useQueryClient(),
    current = usePageArtwork(section);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false),
    [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null),
    [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(null),
    [alt, setAlt] = useState<Text>(descriptions[section]),
    [pending, setPending] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const trigger = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const allowed =
    auth.snapshot.status === "authenticated" &&
    !!services.artwork &&
    !!access.data?.capabilities.some((capability) =>
      ["builder.manage", "content.publish"].includes(capability),
    );
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!allowed) setOpen(false);
  }, [allowed]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!file) {
      setPreview(null);
      return;
    }
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    setPreview(url);
    return () => URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, [file]);
  if (!allowed) return null;
  return (
    <>
      <button
        type="button"
        ref={trigger}
        className="hero-artwork-edit"
        aria-label={t({ en: "Edit hero artwork", ar: "تعديل صورة المقدمة" })}
        onClick={() => {
          setAlt(current.data?.alt || descriptions[section]);
          setFile(null);
          setError(false);
          setOpen(true);
        }}
      >
        <ImagePlus size={16} />
        <span>{t({ en: "Edit image", ar: "تعديل الصورة" })}</span>
      </button>
      <Modal
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        onAfterClose={() => trigger.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true })}
        title={t({ en: "Page artwork", ar: "صورة الصفحة" })}
        description={t({
          en: "Choose a section image. Changes are visible on this device until shared storage is connected.",
          ar: "اختر صورة للقسم. تظهر التغييرات على هذا الجهاز حتى ربط التخزين المشترك.",
        })}
        className="hero-artwork-modal"
      >
        <form
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            if (!file || !services.artwork || pending) return;
            setPending(true);
            setError(false);
            void services.artwork
              .replace(section, file, alt)
              .then(async () => {
                await client.invalidateQueries({
                  queryKey: ["page-artwork", section],
                });
                setOpen(false);
              })
              .catch(() => setError(true))
              .finally(() => setPending(false));
          }}
        >
          {(preview || current.data) && (
            <img
              className="hero-artwork-preview"
              src={preview || current.data!.dataUrl}
              alt={t(alt)}
            />
          )}
          <label className="hero-artwork-upload">
            <ImageUp size={23} />
            <span>
              {t({
                en: "Choose PNG, JPEG or WebP · up to 5 MB",
                ar: "اختر PNG أو JPEG أو WebP · حتى ٥ ميغابايت",
              })}
            </span>
            <input
              type="file"
              accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp"
              disabled={pending}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setFile(event.target.files?.[0] || null);
                setError(false);
              }}
            />
          </label>
          {(["en", "ar"] as const).map((locale) => (
            <label key={locale}>
              {t(
                locale === "en"
                  ? {
                      en: "Image description · English",
                      ar: "وصف الصورة · الإنجليزية",
                    }
                  : {
                      en: "Image description · Arabic",
                      ar: "وصف الصورة · العربية",
                    },
              )}
              <input
                dir={locale === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr"}
                value={alt[locale]}
                required
                maxLength={240}
                disabled={pending}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setAlt({ ...alt, [locale]: event.target.value })
                }
              />
            </label>
          ))}
          {error && (
            <p role="alert">
              {t({
                en: "Could not save the image. Check its type, size and descriptions, or available storage.",
                ar: "تعذّر حفظ الصورة. تحقق من نوعها وحجمها ووصفها أو مساحة التخزين.",
              })}
            </p>
          )}
          <div>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="button button-primary"
              disabled={!file || pending}
            >
              {t(
                pending
                  ? { en: "Saving…", ar: "جارٍ الحفظ…" }
                  : { en: "Use this image", ar: "استخدام هذه الصورة" },
              )}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="button button-outline"
              disabled={pending || !current.data}
              onClick={() => {
                if (!services.artwork) return;
                setPending(true);
                setError(false);
                void services.artwork
                  .reset(section)
                  .then(async () => {
                    await client.invalidateQueries({
                      queryKey: ["page-artwork", section],
                    });
                    setFile(null);
                  })
                  .catch(() => setError(true))
                  .finally(() => setPending(false));
              }}
            >
              <RotateCcw size={16} />
              {t({ en: "Restore original", ar: "استعادة الأصل" })}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

import { useWorkspacePaths } from "../../hooks/useWorkspacePaths";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { AppLink } from "../navigation/AppLink";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
export function PageIntro({
  title,
  description,
  eyebrow,
  children,
  headingLevel = 1,
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  eyebrow?: string;
  children?: ReactNode;
  headingLevel?: 1 | 2;
}) {

  const paths = useWorkspacePaths();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  return (
    <div className="page-intro">
      <nav
        className="breadcrumbs"
        aria-label={label(
          paths.admin ? "adminOverview" : paths.personal ? "mySpace" : "home",
        )}
      >
        <AppLink href={paths.home}>
          {label(
            paths.admin ? "adminOverview" : paths.personal ? "mySpace" : "home",
          )}
        </AppLink>

        <span aria-current="page">{title}</span>
      </nav>

      <Heading
        tabIndex={-1}
        data-page-heading={headingLevel === 1 || undefined}
      >
        {title}
      </Heading>
      <p>{description}</p>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

import {
  BadgeCheck,
  ClipboardPenLine,
  ContactRound,
  MessagesSquare,
  ScanSearch,
  UserRoundCheck,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { applicationStage } from "../../lib/recruitment";
import type { RecruitmentApplicationStatus } from "../../types/recruitment";

const stages = [
  { key: "applyStage", icon: ClipboardPenLine },
  { key: "screeningStage", icon: ScanSearch },
  { key: "interviewStage", icon: MessagesSquare },
  { key: "decisionStage", icon: BadgeCheck },
  { key: "onboardingStage", icon: UserRoundCheck },
  { key: "memberStage", icon: ContactRound },
] as const;

export function RecruitmentPipeline({
  status,
  compact = false,
}: {
  status?: RecruitmentApplicationStatus;
  compact?: boolean;
}) {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const active = status ? applicationStage(status) : -1;
  const stopped = status === "rejected" || status === "withdrawn";
  return (
    <ol
      className={`recruitment-pipeline ${compact ? "recruitment-pipeline-compact" : ""}`}
      aria-label={label("recruitmentPathTitle")}
      data-stopped={stopped || undefined}
    >
      {stages.map(({ key, icon: Icon }, index) => (
        <li
          key={key}
          data-state={
            active < 0
              ? "future"
              : index < active
                ? "complete"
                : index === active
                  ? "active"
                  : "future"
          }
        >
          <span aria-hidden="true">
            <Icon size={compact ? 16 : 19} />
            <i />
          </span>
          <strong>{label(key)}</strong>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/feedback/ActionReceipt.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Check, CheckCircle2, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
export type ActionKind = "saved" | "reviewed" | "unreviewed" | "deleted";
export function useActionReceipt() {
  const [receipt, setReceipt] = useState<{
    kind: ActionKind;
    token: number;
  } | null>(null);
  const token = useRef(0),
    alive = useRef(true),
    timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
    };
  }, []);
  const flash = (kind: ActionKind) => {
    if (!alive.current) return;
    clearTimeout(timer.current);
    setReceipt({ kind, token: ++token.current });
    timer.current = setTimeout(() => setReceipt(null), 700);
  };
  return { receipt, flash };
}
export function ActionReceipt({
  receipt,
}: {
  receipt: ReturnType<typeof useActionReceipt>["receipt"];
}) {
  if (!receipt) return null;
  const Icon =
    receipt.kind === "deleted"
      ? Trash2
      : receipt.kind === "saved"
        ? CheckCircle2
        : Check;
  return (
    <span
      key={receipt.token}
      className="action-receipt-mark"
      data-action={receipt.kind}
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <Icon size={17} />
    </span>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/feedback/AppErrorBoundary.tsx
============================================================
import { Component, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { messages } from "../../constants/messages";
import { STORAGE_KEYS } from "../../constants/config";
export class AppErrorBoundary extends Component<
  { children: ReactNode },
  { failed: boolean }
> {
  state = { failed: false };
  static getDerivedStateFromError() {
    return { failed: true };
  }
  render() {
    if (!this.state.failed) return this.props.children;
    let locale: "en" | "ar" = "en";
    try {
      if (localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.locale) === "ar") locale = "ar";
    } catch {}
    const m = messages[locale];
    return (
      <main
        className="container not-found"
        dir={locale === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr"}
      >
        <h1>{m.errorTitle}</h1>
        <p>{m.errorBody}</p>
        <button
          className="button button-primary"
          onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
        >
          {m.retry}
        </button>
      </main>
    );
  }
}

FILE: src/components/feedback/WelcomeSequence.tsx
============================================================
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { STORAGE_KEYS } from "../../constants/config";
import logo from "../../assets/brand/medclub-logo.png";

// Fallback is per document, so unavailable sessionStorage cannot replay an intro on remount.
const visitedDocuments = new WeakSet<Document>();
export function WelcomeSequence() {
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const [entryPath] = useState(pathname);
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(() => {
    if (
      typeof window === "undefined" ||
      pathname === "/" ||
      /^\/(?:learn\/courses|my\/learning)\/[^/]+\/?$/.test(pathname) ||
      visitedDocuments.has(document)
    )
      return false;
    if (window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches)
      return false;
    try {
      if (window.sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.welcomeSeen) === "yes")
        return false;
      return true;
    } catch {
      return true;
    }
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    visitedDocuments.add(document);
    try {
      window.sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.welcomeSeen, "yes");
    } catch {
      /* Document fallback above. */
    }
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setVisible(false), 1250);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (pathname !== entryPath) setVisible(false);
  }, [pathname, entryPath]);
  if (!visible || pathname !== entryPath || pathname === "/") return null;
  return (
    <div className="welcome-sequence" aria-hidden="true">
      <div className="welcome-ring">
        <img src={logo} alt="" />
        <i />
        <i />
      </div>
      <div className="welcome-copy">
        <strong>{label("welcomeToMedClub")}</strong>
        <span>{label("welcomePromise")}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/navigation/AdaptiveNavigation.tsx
============================================================
import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { ChevronRight, Menu, Pin, PinOff, X } from "lucide-react";
import { advanceHeaderScroll, initialHeaderScroll } from "./header-scroll";
import { useStudyChrome } from "../../app/providers/StudyChromeProvider";
import { useStudyCopy } from "../../features/courses/study-copy";

const pinKey = "medclub:navigation:pinned:v1";
export const isCourseRoute = (path: string) =>
  /^\/(?:learn\/courses|my\/learning)\/[^/]+\/?$/.test(path);
export const hasSectionNavigation = (path: string) =>
  isCourseRoute(path) ||
  /^\/(?:community|journal|mentorship|contribute|store|recruitment|events|opportunities|get-involved)(?:\/|$)/.test(
    path,
  );

export function useAdaptiveNavigation() {
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const { focus, studying, setCourseNavigationVisible } = useStudyChrome();
  const enabled = true;
  const automatic = true;
  const secondary = hasSectionNavigation(pathname);
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(pinKey) === "true";
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  });
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(studying);
  const [manualHidden, setManualHidden] = useState(false);
  const manual = useRef(false);
  const suppressHandleFocus = useRef(false);
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const handle = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
  const hovering = useRef(false);
  const config = useRef({ enabled, pinned, focus, hidden, studying });
  config.current = { enabled, pinned, focus, hidden, studying };
  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
  }, []);
  const locked = useCallback(
    () =>
      hovering.current ||
      !!root.current?.contains(document.activeElement) ||
      !!document.querySelector('dialog[open], [role="dialog"], [role="menu"]'),
    [],
  );
  const reveal = useCallback(
    (_intentional = false) => {
      if (config.current.focus || config.current.studying) return;
      cancel();
      setHidden(false);
    },
    [cancel],
  );
  const retreat = useCallback(() => {
    const state = config.current;
    if (
      state.enabled &&
      (manual.current || state.studying || !state.pinned || state.focus) &&
      !locked()
    ) {
      setHidden(true);
      if (state.studying) setCourseNavigationVisible(false);
    }
  }, [locked, setCourseNavigationVisible]);
  const leave = useCallback(() => {
    hovering.current = false;
    cancel();
    if (
      manual.current ||
      focus ||
      studying ||
      (!studying && (secondary || window.scrollY > 80))
    )
      timer.current = setTimeout(retreat, 650);
  }, [cancel, focus, retreat, secondary, studying]);
  // Course entry removes campus chrome completely, even when pinned elsewhere.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!studying) return;
    cancel();
    manual.current = false;
    setManualHidden(false);
    setHidden(true);
    setCourseNavigationVisible(false);
    hovering.current = false;
    return cancel;
  }, [pathname, studying, focus, cancel, setCourseNavigationVisible]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (studying) return;
    if (!manual.current) reveal();
    hovering.current = false;
    if (automatic && (secondary || focus) && (!pinned || focus))
      timer.current = setTimeout(retreat, focus ? 120 : 1100);
    return cancel;
  }, [
    pathname,
    automatic,
    secondary,
    pinned,
    focus,
    studying,
    reveal,
    retreat,
    cancel,
  ]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!automatic || studying) return;
    let scrollState = initialHeaderScroll(window.scrollY);
    let frame = 0;
    const scroll = () => {
      if (frame) return;
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        frame = 0;
        const next = Math.max(0, window.scrollY);
        if (manual.current) {
          scrollState = initialHeaderScroll(next);
          return;
        }
        scrollState.hidden = config.current.hidden;
        const wasHidden = scrollState.hidden;
        scrollState = advanceHeaderScroll(
          scrollState,
          next,
          locked() || config.current.pinned,
        );
        if (scrollState.hidden && !wasHidden) retreat();
        else if (!scrollState.hidden && (wasHidden || next <= 20)) reveal();
      });
    };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", scroll, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", scroll);
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
  }, [automatic, studying, reveal, retreat, locked]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const storage = (event: StorageEvent) => {
      if (event.key === pinKey) setPinned(event.newValue === "true");
    };
    window.addEventListener("storage", storage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("storage", storage);
  }, []);
  const togglePin = () => {
    const value = !pinned;
    setPinned(value);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(pinKey, String(value));
    } catch {}
    if (value) {
      manual.current = false;
      setManualHidden(false);
      reveal();
    }
  };
  return {
    enabled,
    secondary,
    manualHidden,
    suppressHandleFocus,
    focus,
    studying,
    hidden: enabled && (focus || studying || hidden),
    pinned,
    root,
    handle,
    reveal,
    leave,
    hovering,
    togglePin,
    hide: () => {
      cancel();
      setPinned(false);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(pinKey, "false");
      } catch {
        /* Session-only preference. */
      }
      manual.current = true;
      setManualHidden(true);
      hovering.current = false;
      setHidden(true);
      if (studying) setCourseNavigationVisible(false);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        suppressHandleFocus.current = true;
        handle.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        suppressHandleFocus.current = false;
      });
    },
  };
}

const NavigationContext = createContext<ReturnType<
  typeof useAdaptiveNavigation
> | null>(null);

export function NavigationControls() {
  const state = useContext(NavigationContext);
  const s = useStudyCopy();
  if (!state) return null;
  return (
    <div className="navigation-reveal-actions">
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-pressed={state.pinned}
        aria-label={s(state.pinned ? "unpin" : "pin")}
        title={s(state.pinned ? "unpin" : "pin")}
        onClick={state.togglePin}
      >
        {state.pinned ? <PinOff size={15} /> : <Pin size={15} />}
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label={s("collapse")}
        title={s("collapse")}
        onClick={state.hide}
      >
        <X size={15} />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

export function AdaptiveNavigation({
  children,
  state,
  personal = false,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  state: ReturnType<typeof useAdaptiveNavigation>;
  personal?: boolean;
}) {
  const s = useStudyCopy();
  const id = useId();
  if (state.studying) return null;
  if (!state.enabled) return <>{children}</>;
  return (
    <NavigationContext.Provider value={state}>
      {!state.focus && (
        <div
          className="adaptive-navigation-controls"
          data-open={!state.hidden}
          onPointerEnter={(event) => {
            if (event.pointerType === "mouse") state.reveal(true);
          }}
        >
          <button
            ref={state.handle}
            type="button"
            className="navigation-glance"
            aria-label={s(personal ? "personalMenu" : "menu")}
            aria-expanded={!state.hidden}
            aria-controls={id}
            onClick={() => state.reveal(true)}
            onFocus={() => {
              if (state.hidden && !state.suppressHandleFocus.current)
                state.reveal(true);
            }}
          >
            <svg
              className="navigation-edge-contour"
              viewBox="0 0 12 420"
              preserveAspectRatio="none"
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              <path d="M0 0H2V26C2 48 10 48 10 72V348C10 372 2 372 2 394V420H0Z" />
            </svg>
            <Menu size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>{s(personal ? "personalMenu" : "menu")}</span>
            <ChevronRight
              size={14}
              className="directional"
              aria-hidden="true"
            />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      <div
        hidden={state.focus || undefined}
        id={id}
        ref={state.root}
        className="adaptive-navigation-panel"
        inert={state.hidden || undefined}
        onPointerEnter={(event) => {
          if (event.pointerType === "mouse") {
            state.hovering.current = true;
            state.reveal();
          }
        }}
        onPointerLeave={state.leave}
        onFocusCapture={() => state.reveal()}
        onBlur={(event) => {
          if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)) state.leave();
        }}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    </NavigationContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function AdminNavigation() {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const [moreOpen, setMoreOpen] = useState(false);
  const access = useAccess();
  const requests = useAccessRequests();
  const pending =
    requests.data?.filter((request) => request.status === "pending").length ||
    0;
  const { scrollArea, scrollCues } = useNavigationScrollCues(pathname);
  useEffect(() => setMoreOpen(false), [pathname]);
  const active = (href: string) =>
    href === "/admin"
      ? pathname === href
      : pathname === href || pathname.startsWith(`${href}/`);
  const navItem = ({
    href,
    label: key,
    icon: Icon,
    priority,
    badge,
  }: NavItem) => (
    <NavigationHint label={label(key)} key={href}>
      <AppLink
        href={href}
        className={`navigation-item ${priority ? "admin-priority-item" : ""} ${active(href) ? "active" : ""}`}
        aria-current={active(href) ? "page" : undefined}
      >
        <MorphIcon
          to={
            Icon === FileSearch
              ? FileCheck
              : Icon === ShieldPlus
                ? BadgeCheck
                : undefined
          }
          icon={Icon}
          size={20}
          className="admin-nav-icon"
        />
        <span className="navigation-item-label">{label(key)}</span>
        {badge && pending > 0 && (
          <b
            className="admin-nav-badge"
            aria-label={`${pending} ${label("governancePending")}`}
          >
            {pending}
          </b>
        )}
      </AppLink>
    </NavigationHint>
  );
  const allowed = (item: NavItem) =>
    access.data?.capabilities.includes(item.capability) ?? false;
  const visibleOperations = operations.filter(allowed);
  const visibleInsights = insights.filter(allowed);
  const visibleSafety = safety.filter(allowed);
  const phonePrimary = [
    ...visibleOperations.slice(0, 3),
    ...visibleSafety.filter((item) => item.priority),
  ].slice(0, 4);
  const phoneMore = [
    ...visibleInsights,
    ...visibleSafety.filter((item) => !item.priority),
    ...visibleOperations.slice(3),
  ];
  return (
    <>
      <aside
        className="desktop-navigation admin-navigation"
        aria-label={label("adminNavigation")}
      >
        <NotebookFittings axis="rail" />
        <div className="shell-brand">
          <SidebarToggle controls="admin-sidebar-links" />
          <span className="shell-brand-caption">
            <strong>{label("admin")}</strong>
            <small>{label("adminControlRoom")}</small>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div
          className="navigation-scroll-frame"
          data-scroll-before={scrollCues.before || undefined}
          data-scroll-after={scrollCues.after || undefined}
        >
          <div
            ref={scrollArea}
            className="navigation-scroll"
            id="admin-sidebar-links"
          >
            <NavigationSelection />
            <nav
              className="navigation-primary"
              aria-label={label("adminNavigation")}
            >
              <p className="navigation-label">
                {label("governanceOperationsGroup")}
              </p>
              {visibleOperations.map(navItem)}
              <p className="navigation-label admin-insights-label">
                {label("adminInsightsGroup")}
              </p>
              {visibleInsights.map(navItem)}
              <p className="navigation-label admin-safety-label">
                {label("governanceSafetyGroup")}
              </p>
              {visibleSafety.map(navItem)}
            </nav>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="admin-nav-footer">
          <AppearanceSettings />
          <div className="navigation-version navigation-controls-row">
            <span className="navigation-status-copy"><span className="status-dot" />{label("insightsPreviewShort")}</span>
            <div className="navigation-controls-slot"><NavigationControls /></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>
      <nav
        className="phone-navigation admin-phone-navigation"
        aria-label={label("adminMobileNavigation")}
      >
        <NavigationSelection />
        {phonePrimary.map(({ href, label: key, icon: Icon }) => (
          <AppLink
            href={href}
            key={href}
            className={active(href) ? "active" : ""}
            aria-current={active(href) ? "page" : undefined}
