            <MorphIcon
              to={
                Icon === FileSearch
                  ? FileCheck
                  : Icon === ShieldPlus
                    ? BadgeCheck
                    : undefined
              }
              icon={Icon}
              size={20}
              className="admin-nav-icon"
            />
            <span>{label(key)}</span>
          </AppLink>
        ))}
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`navigation-more-button ${phoneMore.some((item) => active(item.href)) ? "active" : ""}`}
          aria-label={label("governanceMobileMore")}
          onClick={() => setMoreOpen(true)}
        >
          <Menu size={20} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>{label("more")}</span>
          {pending > 0 && <b>{pending}</b>}
        </button>

        open={moreOpen}

        className="admin-mobile-menu-modal"

import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";

export interface AliveTab<T extends string> {
  id: T;
  label: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  count?: number;
}

export function AliveTabs<T extends string>({
  label,
  items,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  items: AliveTab<T>[];
  value: T;
  onChange: (value: T) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="alive-tabs" role="group" aria-label={label}>
      {items.map(({ id, label: tabLabel, icon: Icon, count }) => (
        <button
          key={id}
          aria-label={count === undefined ? tabLabel : `${tabLabel} · ${count}`}
          aria-pressed={value === id}
          onClick={() => onChange(id)}
        >
          <Icon aria-hidden="true" size={18} className="tab-icon" />
          <span>{tabLabel}</span>
          {count !== undefined && <b>{count}</b>}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

import { appearancePreviewColors } from "../../app/providers/appearance-preview-colors";
import {
  appearanceChoices,
  appearanceChoiceId,
} from "../../app/providers/appearance-choices";
import { LanguageMenu } from "./LanguageMenu";
import { ThemePreview } from "./ThemePreview";
import { UtilityGlyph } from "./UtilityGlyph";
import { useWorkspacePaths } from "../../hooks/useWorkspacePaths";
import { NavigationHint } from "./NavigationHint";
import { Check, SlidersHorizontal } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { Modal } from "../ui/Modal";
import {
  useAppearance,
  type NavigationLayout,
} from "../../app/providers/AppearanceProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
export function AppearanceSettings({ compact = false }: { compact?: boolean }) {
  const paths = useWorkspacePaths();
  const {
    accountAvailable,
    navigation,
    setNavigation,
    sidebarCollapsed,
    setSidebarCollapsed,
    persisted,
    palette,
    colorMode,
    setThemeChoice,
    resolvedTheme,
  } = useAppearance();
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const choices = accountAvailable ? appearanceChoices : appearanceChoices.filter((choice) => choice.palette === "medclub" && choice.mode !== "system");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [manualPreview, setManualPreview] = useState(false);
  const closePreview = () => {
    setPreview(null);
    setManualPreview(false);
  };
  const showPreview = (id: string) => {
    if (accountAvailable) setPreview(id);
  };
  const previewChoice = appearanceChoices.find(
    (choice) => choice.id === preview,
  );
  const location = useLocation();
  useEffect(() => {
    setOpen(false);
    closePreview();
  }, [location.key]);
  return (
    <>
      <NavigationHint label={label("appearance")}>
        <button
          className={
            compact
              ? "workspace-icon appearance-shortcut"
              : "navigation-preferences"
          }
          aria-label={label("appearance")}
          aria-haspopup="dialog"
          aria-expanded={open}
          onClick={() => {
            setOpen(true);
            setManualPreview(false);
            setPreview(accountAvailable ? appearanceChoiceId(palette, colorMode) : null);
          }}
        >
          <UtilityGlyph kind="appearance" />
          {!compact && <span>{label("appearance")}</span>}
        </button>
      </NavigationHint>
      <Modal
        open={open}
        onClose={() => {
          setOpen(false);
          closePreview();
        }}
        title={label("appearanceTitle")}
        description={accountAvailable ? label("appearanceDescription") : t({ en: "Choose MedClub Light or Dark.", ar: "اختر ميدكلب الفاتح أو الداكن." })}
        className={`appearance-dialog${accountAvailable ? "" : " appearance-dialog-guest"}`}
        onAfterClose={() => {
          // Switching orientation can hide the trigger that originally opened this dialog.
          if (
            !paths.personal &&
            window.matchMedia("(min-width: 768px)").matches
          ) {
            const selector =
              navigation === "horizontal"
                ? ".workspace-header .appearance-shortcut, .admin-header .appearance-shortcut"
                : ".desktop-navigation .navigation-preferences";
            const target = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(selector);
            if (target) {
              target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }
          }
        }}
      >
        <div className="appearance-heading">
          <span className="settings-symbol">
            <SlidersHorizontal size={25} />
          </span>
        </div>
        <div
          className="appearance-theme-browser"
          onPointerLeave={(event) => {
            if (
              event.pointerType === "mouse" &&
              !event.currentTarget.contains(document.activeElement)
            )
              closePreview();
          }}
          onBlur={(event) => {
            if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget))
              closePreview();
          }}
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            if (event.key === "Escape" && preview) {
              event.stopPropagation();
              closePreview();
            }
          }}
        >
          <div className="appearance-theme-groups">
            {(accountAvailable ? ["light", "dark", "system"] as const : ["light", "dark"] as const).map((mode) => (
              <fieldset className="appearance-palettes" key={mode}>
                <legend>
                  {t(
                    mode === "light"
                      ? { en: "Light themes", ar: "مظاهر فاتحة" }
                      : mode === "dark"
                        ? { en: "Dark themes", ar: "مظاهر داكنة" }
                        : { en: "System appearance", ar: "مظهر الجهاز" },
                  )}
                </legend>
                <div className="appearance-palette-grid">
                  {choices
                    .filter((choice) => choice.mode === mode)
                    .map((choice) => {
                      const colors =
                        appearancePreviewColors[
                          `${choice.palette}-${choice.mode === "system" ? resolvedTheme : choice.mode}`
                        ];
                      return (
                        <label
                          key={choice.id}
                          className="appearance-palette-option"
                          data-selected={
                            appearanceChoiceId(palette, colorMode) ===
                              choice.id || undefined
                          }
                          onPointerEnter={(event) => {
                            if (event.pointerType === "mouse")
                              showPreview(choice.id);
                          }}
                          onFocus={() => showPreview(choice.id)}
                        >
                          <input
                            type="radio"
                            name="appearance-palette"
                            value={choice.id}
                            checked={
                              appearanceChoiceId(palette, colorMode) ===
                              choice.id
                            }
                            onClick={() => {
                              // Legacy profiles can pair System mode with another palette.
                              // Clicking an already-checked radio must still apply this preset.
                              if (
                                choice.mode === "system" &&
                                colorMode === "system" &&
                                palette !== choice.palette
                              ) {
                                setThemeChoice(choice.id);
                                showPreview(choice.id);
                                setManualPreview(true);
                              }
                            }}
                            onChange={() => {
                              setThemeChoice(choice.id);
                              showPreview(choice.id);
                              setManualPreview(true);
                            }}
                          />
                          <span
                            className="theme-choice-swatches"
                            aria-hidden="true"
                            data-mode={mode}
                          >
                            {[
                              colors.background,
                              colors.sidebar,
                              colors.primary,
                            ].map((color, i) => (
                              <i key={i} style={{ backgroundColor: color }} />
                            ))}
                            <b>
                              {mode === "light"
                                ? "☀"
                                : mode === "dark"
                                  ? "☾"
                                  : "◐"}
                            </b>
                          </span>
                          <span>
                            <strong>{t(choice.title)}</strong>
                          </span>
                          {appearanceChoiceId(palette, colorMode) ===
                            choice.id && <Check size={15} aria-hidden="true" />}
                        </label>
                      );
                    })}
                </div>
              </fieldset>
            ))}
          </div>
          {accountAvailable && (previewChoice ? (
            <ThemePreview
              key={preview === null ? "closed" : "open"}
              choice={previewChoice}
              manual={manualPreview}
              onManual={() => setManualPreview(true)}
              onClose={closePreview}
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="theme-preview-idle">
              <SlidersHorizontal size={24} />
              <p>
                {t({
                  en: "Hover or focus a theme to preview four views. Select a view to pause the slideshow.",
                  ar: "مرّر أو ركّز على مظهر لمعاينة أربع صفحات. اختر صفحة لإيقاف العرض التلقائي.",
                })}
              </p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        {accountAvailable && <>
        <section
          className="appearance-workspace-options"
          aria-label={t({ en: "Workspace preferences", ar: "تفضيلات المساحة" })}
        >
          <div>
            <span>
              <strong>{label("sidebarSize")}</strong>
              <small>{label("sidebarSizeBody")}</small>
            </span>
            <button
              className="sidebar-setting-switch"
              role="switch"
              aria-checked={sidebarCollapsed}
              aria-label={label("compactSidebar")}
              onClick={() => setSidebarCollapsed(!sidebarCollapsed)}
            >
              <span />
            </button>
          </div>
          <div>
            <strong>{label("language")}</strong>
            <LanguageMenu />
          </div>
        </section>
        <fieldset className="layout-options">
          <legend>{label("desktopNavigation")}</legend>
          {(["vertical", "horizontal"] as NavigationLayout[]).map((layout) => (
            <label
              className={`layout-option ${navigation === layout ? "selected" : ""}`}
              key={layout}
            >
              <input
                type="radio"
                name="navigation-layout"
                value={layout}
                checked={navigation === layout}
                onChange={() => setNavigation(layout)}
              />
              <span
                className={`layout-miniature miniature-${layout}`}
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <i className="mini-nav">
                  <b />
                  <b />
                  <b />
                </i>
                <i className="mini-page">
                  <b />
                  <span />
                  <span />
                </i>
              </span>
              <span className="layout-option-label">
                {label(layout)}
                {navigation === layout && <Check size={17} />}
              </span>
              <small>
                {label(
                  layout === "vertical"
                    ? "verticalDescription"
                    : "horizontalDescription",
                )}
              </small>
            </label>
          ))}
        </fieldset>
        <p className="settings-note">{label("mobileNavigationNote")}</p>
        </>}
        <p className="settings-saved" role="status">
          {label(persisted ? "preferencesSaved" : "sessionOnly")}
        </p>
        <button
          className="button button-primary appearance-done"
          onClick={() => {
            setOpen(false);
            closePreview();
          }}
        >
          {label("done")}
          <Check size={17} />
        </button>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

import { forwardRef, type AnchorHTMLAttributes } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
type Props = Omit<AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>, "href"> & {
  href: string;
};
export const AppLink = forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement, Props>(function AppLink(
  { href, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <Link ref={ref} to={href} {...props}>
      {children}
    </Link>
  );
});

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
} from "../ui/dropdown-menu";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  Activity,
  Award,
  Camera,
  HeartPulse,
  Landmark,
  Newspaper,
  ShieldCheck,
  Info,
  ChevronDown,
  Medal,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { routes } from "../../constants/routes";
import type { MessageKey } from "../../constants/messages";
import { AppLink } from "./AppLink";

const items = [
  { href: routes.community, label: "communityHub", icon: HeartPulse },
  { href: routes.activities, label: "activities", icon: Activity },
  { href: routes.journal, label: "journal", icon: Newspaper },
  { href: routes.media, label: "media", icon: Camera },
  { href: routes.executiveBodies, label: "leadership", icon: ShieldCheck },
  { href: routes.honorPlate, label: "honorPlate", icon: Award },
  { href: routes.hallOfHonor, label: "hallOfHonor", icon: Landmark },
  { href: routes.about, label: "aboutMedClub", icon: Info },
] satisfies { href: string; label: MessageKey; icon: typeof Activity }[];

const isHonor = (href: string) =>
  href === routes.honorPlate || href === routes.hallOfHonor;

export function CommunityNavigation() {
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const { label, t, dir } = useLocale();
  const [honorsOpen, setHonorsOpen] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => setHonorsOpen(false), [pathname]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const query = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 1150px)");
    const change = () => {
      if (!query.matches) setHonorsOpen(false);
    };
    query.addEventListener?.("change", change);
    return () => query.removeEventListener?.("change", change);
  }, []);
  const active = (href: string) =>
    href === routes.community ? pathname === href : pathname.startsWith(href);
  return (
    <nav
      className="community-navigation"
      aria-label={label("communityNavigation")}
    >
      {items.map(({ href, label: key, icon: Icon }) => (
        <AppLink
          key={href}
          href={href}
          className={`${active(href) ? "active" : ""} ${isHonor(href) ? "community-honor-standalone" : ""}`}
          aria-current={active(href) ? "page" : undefined}
        >
          <Icon aria-hidden="true" size={18} className="community-tab-icon" />
          <span>{label(key)}</span>
        </AppLink>
      ))}
      <div className="community-honors-menu">
        <DropdownMenu
          modal={false}
          dir={dir}
          open={honorsOpen}
          onOpenChange={setHonorsOpen}
        >
          <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`community-honors-trigger ${active(routes.honorPlate) || active(routes.hallOfHonor) ? "active" : ""}`}
              aria-label={t({ en: "Honors", ar: "التكريم" })}
            >
              <Medal size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>{t({ en: "Honors", ar: "التكريم" })}</span>
              <ChevronDown size={13} aria-hidden="true" />
            </button>
          </DropdownMenuTrigger>
          <DropdownMenuContent
            align="end"
            className="community-honors-dropdown"
          >
            {items
              .filter((item) => isHonor(item.href))
              .map(({ href, label: key, icon: Icon }) => (
                <DropdownMenuItem key={href} asChild>
                  <AppLink
                    href={href}
                    aria-current={active(href) ? "page" : undefined}
                  >
                    <Icon size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
                    <span>{label(key)}</span>
                  </AppLink>
                </DropdownMenuItem>
              ))}
          </DropdownMenuContent>
        </DropdownMenu>
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/navigation/DesktopNavigation.tsx

import { NavigationSelection } from "./NavigationSelection";
import { NotebookFittings } from "./NotebookFittings";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  House,
  BookOpen,
  Users,
  ShoppingBag,
  ChevronDown,
  ArrowUpRight,
  UserRound,
  Timer,
  Heart,
  HeartHandshake,
  FileCheck2,
} from "lucide-react";
import { publicMainItems, isInvolvementPath } from "./involvement";
import { NavigationControls } from "./AdaptiveNavigation";
import {
  Route,
  Signpost,
  BadgePlus,
  Ticket,
  Telescope,
  Compass,
} from "lucide-react";
import { SidebarToggle } from "./SidebarToggle";
import { NavigationHint } from "./NavigationHint";
import type { SiteContent } from "../../types/content";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "./AppLink";
import { MegaMenu } from "./MegaMenu";
import { AppearanceSettings } from "./AppearanceSettings";
import { useAppearance } from "../../app/providers/AppearanceProvider";
import { useNavigationScrollCues } from "../../hooks/useNavigationScrollCues";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { signInPath } from "../../constants/routes";
import { MorphIcon } from "../ui/MorphIcon";
const icons = {
  community: Users,
  opportunities: Telescope,
  recruitment: BadgePlus,
  "get-involved": Route,
  events: Ticket,
  store: ShoppingBag,
  mentorship: HeartHandshake,
  contributions: FileCheck2,
};
export function DesktopNavigation({ site }: { site: SiteContent }) {
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const { navigation } = useAppearance();
  const auth = useAuth();
  const signedIn = auth.snapshot.status === "authenticated";
  const location = useLocation();
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const root = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const learnLink = useRef<HTMLAnchorElement>(null);
  const learnArea = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const openTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(
    undefined,
  );
  const closeTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(
    undefined,
  );
  const cancelLearningTimers = () => {
    clearTimeout(openTimer.current);
    clearTimeout(closeTimer.current);
  };
  const closeLearning = () => {
    cancelLearningTimers();
    setExpanded(false);
  };
  const keepLearningOpen = () => {
    cancelLearningTimers();
  };
  const leaveLearning = () => {
    cancelLearningTimers();
    closeTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      const focused = document.activeElement;
      if (
        learnArea.current?.contains(focused) ||
        root.current?.querySelector("#learn-menu")?.contains(focused)
      )
        return;
      setExpanded(false);
    }, 220);
  };
  const { scrollArea, scrollCues } = useNavigationScrollCues(
    `${location.pathname}:${navigation}:${expanded}`,
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    closeLearning();
    return cancelLearningTimers;
  }, [location.key]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const outside = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!root.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) closeLearning();
    };
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
  }, []);
  const active = (href: string) =>
    href === "/"
      ? location.pathname === "/" && !location.hash
      : href === "/community" && location.pathname.startsWith("/journal")
        ? true
        : href === "/get-involved"
          ? isInvolvementPath(location.pathname)
          : href.startsWith("/#")
            ? location.pathname === "/" && location.hash === href.slice(1)
            : location.pathname.startsWith(href);
  return (
    <aside
      className="desktop-navigation"
      ref={root}
      aria-label={label("mainNavigation")}
      onKeyDown={(event) => {
        if (event.key === "Escape" && expanded) {
          closeLearning();
          learnLink.current?.focus();
        }
      }}
      onBlur={(event) => {
        if (
          event.relatedTarget &&
          !event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)
        )
          closeLearning();
      }}
    >
      <NotebookFittings axis="rail" />
      <div className="navigation-brand shell-brand">
        <SidebarToggle controls="public-sidebar-links" />
        <span className="shell-brand-caption">
          <strong>{site.brand.name}</strong>
          <small>{t(site.brand.caption)}</small>
        </span>
      </div>
      <div
        className="navigation-scroll-frame"
        data-scroll-before={scrollCues.before || undefined}
        data-scroll-after={scrollCues.after || undefined}
      >
        <div
          ref={scrollArea}
          className="navigation-scroll"
          id="public-sidebar-links"
        >
          <NavigationSelection />
          <p className="navigation-label">{label("exploreLabel")}</p>
          <nav className="navigation-primary" aria-label={label("discover")}>
            <NavigationHint label={label("home")}>
              <AppLink
                href="/"
                className={`navigation-item ${active("/") ? "active" : ""}`}
                aria-current={active("/") ? "page" : undefined}
              >
                <MorphIcon icon={House} size={20} />
                <span>{label("home")}</span>
              </AppLink>
            </NavigationHint>
            <div
              className="learn-disclosure"
              ref={learnArea}
              onPointerLeave={leaveLearning}
            >
              <NavigationHint label={label("learn")}>
                <AppLink
                  href="/learn"
                  ref={learnLink}
                  className={`navigation-item ${active("/learn") ? "active" : ""}`}
                  aria-current={active("/learn") ? "page" : undefined}
                  aria-controls="learn-menu"
                  aria-expanded={expanded}
                  onPointerEnter={(event) => {
                    if (event.pointerType === "touch") return;
                    cancelLearningTimers();
                    openTimer.current = setTimeout(
                      () => setExpanded(true),
                      140,
                    );
                  }}
                  onClick={closeLearning}
                  onKeyDown={(event) => {
                    if (event.key === "ArrowDown") {
                      event.preventDefault();
                      cancelLearningTimers();
                      setExpanded(true);
                      requestAnimationFrame(() =>
                        root.current
                          ?.querySelector<HTMLAnchorElement>("#learn-menu a")
                          ?.focus(),
                      );
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  <MorphIcon icon={BookOpen} size={20} />
                  <ChevronDown
                    size={12}
                    className="learn-disclosure-indicator"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                  />
                  <span className="learn-destination-label">
                    {label("learn")}
                  </span>
                </AppLink>
              </NavigationHint>
              {expanded && navigation !== "horizontal" && (
                <MegaMenu
                  navigation={site.navigation}
                  onNavigate={closeLearning}
                  onPointerEnter={keepLearningOpen}
                  onPointerLeave={leaveLearning}
                />
              )}
            </div>
            {publicMainItems(site).map((item) => {
              const Icon = icons[item.id as keyof typeof icons] || Compass;
              return (
                <NavigationHint label={t(item.label)} key={item.id}>
                  <AppLink
                    href={item.href}
                    className={`navigation-item ${active(item.href) ? "active" : ""}`}
                    aria-current={
                      active(item.href)
                        ? item.href.startsWith("/#")
                          ? "location"
                          : "page"
                        : undefined
                    }
                  >
                    <MorphIcon
                      icon={Icon}
                      to={item.id === "get-involved" ? Signpost : undefined}
                      size={20}
                    />
                    <span>{t(item.label)}</span>
                  </AppLink>
                </NavigationHint>
              );
            })}
          </nav>
          <div className="navigation-workspace">
            <p className="navigation-label">{label("workspace")}</p>
            <NavigationHint label={label(signedIn ? "myProfile" : "signIn")}>
              <AppLink
                className={`navigation-item workspace-portal-item profile-portal space-portal-link ${active("/my") ? "active" : ""}`}
                href={signedIn ? "/my" : signInPath("/my")}
                aria-current={active("/my") ? "page" : undefined}
              >
                <MorphIcon icon={UserRound} size={20} />
                <span>{label(signedIn ? "myProfile" : "signIn")}</span>
              </AppLink>
            </NavigationHint>
            <NavigationHint label={label("studyToolsShort")}>
              <AppLink
                className={`navigation-item ${active("/utilities") ? "active" : ""}`}
                href="/utilities"
                aria-current={active("/utilities") ? "page" : undefined}
              >
                <MorphIcon icon={Timer} size={20} />
                <span>{label("studyToolsShort")}</span>
              </AppLink>
            </NavigationHint>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {expanded && navigation === "horizontal" && (
        <MegaMenu
          navigation={site.navigation}
          onNavigate={closeLearning}
          onPointerEnter={keepLearningOpen}
          onPointerLeave={leaveLearning}
        />
      )}
      <div className="navigation-bottom">
        <div className="sidebar-note">
          <span className="sidebar-note-icon">
            <Heart size={19} />
          </span>
          <p>{t(site.hero.note)}</p>
          <AppLink href="/community">
            {label("findYourPeople")}
            <ArrowUpRight size={18} className="directional" />
          </AppLink>
        </div>
        <AppearanceSettings />
        <div className="navigation-version navigation-controls-row">
          <span className="navigation-status-copy"><span className="status-dot" />{label("previewShort")}</span>
          <div className="navigation-controls-slot"><NavigationControls /></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/navigation/HeaderNotifications.tsx
============================================================
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowUpRight, X } from "lucide-react";
import { Popover } from "radix-ui";
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { useOverlays } from "../../app/providers/OverlayProvider";
import { useNotifications } from "../../features/notifications/useNotifications";
import { useResources } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import type { StudentNotification } from "../../types/workspace";
import { AppLink } from "./AppLink";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { noticeNotificationArrival, animateNotificationBell, type NotificationArrivalState } from "./notification-arrival";

function NotificationList({
  items,
  close,
}: {
  items: StudentNotification[];
  close: () => void;
}) {
  const { t, label, locale } = useLocale();
  const { state, send } = useWorkspace();
  const { openDetail } = useOverlays();
  const resources = useResources();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const view = (item: StudentNotification) => {
    const resource = resources.data?.find((r) => r.id === item.resourceId);
    if (item.resourceId && !resource && !item.href) {
      toast.error(
        t({
          en: "This material is not available. Try loading it again.",
          ar: "هذه المادة غير متاحة. حاول تحميلها مجددًا.",
        }),
      );
      void resources.refetch();
      return;
    }
    void send({ type: "read-notifications", ids: [item.id], read: true }).catch(
      () =>
        toast.error(
          t({
            en: "Could not update read status",
            ar: "تعذر تحديث حالة القراءة",
          }),
        ),
    );
    close();
    if (resource) openDetail({ kind: "resource", item: resource });
    else if (item.href) navigate(item.href);
  };
  return (
    <div className="notification-preview-list">
      {items.slice(0, 5).map((item) => (
        <button
          type="button"
          key={item.id}
          disabled={!!item.resourceId && resources.isPending}
          aria-busy={(!!item.resourceId && resources.isPending) || undefined}
          data-unread={
            !state.readNotificationIds.includes(item.id) || undefined
          }
          onClick={() => view(item)}
        >
          <span className="notification-preview-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>
            <strong>{t(item.title)}</strong>
            <span>{t(item.body)}</span>
            <time dateTime={item.createdAt}>
              {new Date(item.createdAt).toLocaleDateString(locale)}
            </time>
          </span>
          <ArrowUpRight size={16} className="directional" aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
      ))}
      {!items.length && (
        <p className="notification-preview-empty">{label("noNotifications")}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Bell opens by its trigger in every workspace; entering My Room is an explicit action. */
export function HeaderNotifications() {
  const { label, t, dir } = useLocale();
  const notifications = useNotifications();
  const { snapshot } = useAuth();
  const accountId = snapshot.status === "authenticated" ? snapshot.user?.id || null : null;
  const arrival = useRef<NotificationArrivalState | null>(null);
  const bell = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const bellAnimation = useRef<Animation | null>(null);
  const ringBell = useCallback((action: "hover" | "click" | "arrival") => {
    if (document.hidden || window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches)
      return;
    bellAnimation.current?.cancel();
    bellAnimation.current = animateNotificationBell(bell.current, action);
  }, []);
  const notificationKey = JSON.stringify(notifications.items.map((item) => item.id));
  const ready = !notifications.isPending && !notifications.isError;
  useEffect(() => {
    const previous = arrival.current;
    const result = noticeNotificationArrival(previous, accountId, JSON.parse(notificationKey) as string[], ready);
    arrival.current = result.state;
    if (previous?.accountId !== accountId) {
      bellAnimation.current?.cancel();
    }
    if (result.arrived) ringBell("arrival");
  }, [accountId, notificationKey, ready, ringBell]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const stop = () => { if (reduced.matches) bellAnimation.current?.cancel(); };
    reduced.addEventListener("change", stop);
    return () => {
      reduced.removeEventListener("change", stop);
      bellAnimation.current?.cancel();
    };
  }, []);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const { key } = useLocation();
  useEffect(() => setOpen(false), [key]);
  const unread =
    !notifications.isPending && !notifications.isError
      ? notifications.unread
      : 0;
  return (
    <Popover.Root open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <Popover.Trigger asChild>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="workspace-icon notification-bell"
          aria-label={label("notifications")}
          onMouseEnter={() => ringBell("hover")}
          onPointerDown={() => ringBell("click")}
          onFocus={(event) => {
            if (event.currentTarget.matches(":focus-visible")) ringBell("hover");
          }}
          onClick={() => ringBell("click")}
        >
          <span ref={bell} className="notification-bell-motion" aria-hidden="true">
            <svg className="notification-bell-icon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M18 8a6 6 0 0 0-12 0c0 7-3 7-3 9h18c0-2-3-2-3-9" />
              <path className="notification-bell-clapper" d="M10 21h4" />
              <g className="notification-bell-waves"><path d="M2 5 1 8M22 5l1 3" /></g>
            </svg>
          </span>
          {unread > 0 && (
            <span
              className="notification-badge"
              aria-label={`${unread} ${label("unreadUpdates")}`}
            >
              {unread > 99 ? "99+" : unread}
            </span>
          )}
        </button>
      </Popover.Trigger>
      <Popover.Portal>
        <Popover.Content
          className="notification-preview"
          dir={dir}
          side="bottom"
          align="end"
          sideOffset={8}
          collisionPadding={10}
          aria-label={label("notifications")}
        >
          <header>
            <h2>{label("notifications")}</h2>
            <Popover.Close aria-label={label("close")}>
              <X size={18} />
            </Popover.Close>
          </header>
          {notifications.isPending ? (
            <p role="status">
              {t({ en: "Loading updates…", ar: "جار تحميل المستجدات…" })}
            </p>
          ) : notifications.isError ? (
            <div role="alert">
              <p>
                {t({
                  en: "Updates could not be loaded",
                  ar: "تعذر تحميل المستجدات",
                })}
              </p>
              <button className="button" onClick={notifications.retry}>
                {t({ en: "Try again", ar: "حاول مجددًا" })}
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <NotificationList
              items={notifications.items}
              close={() => setOpen(false)}
            />
          )}
          <AppLink
            href="/my/notifications"
            className="notification-preview-all"
            onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
          >
            {t({ en: "View all notifications", ar: "عرض جميع الإشعارات" })}
            <ArrowUpRight size={16} className="directional" />
          </AppLink>
          <Popover.Arrow className="notification-preview-arrow" />
        </Popover.Content>
      </Popover.Portal>
    </Popover.Root>
  );
}

import { HeaderNotifications } from "./HeaderNotifications";
import { LanguageMenu } from "./LanguageMenu";
import { SearchGlyph } from "./SearchGlyph";
import { useOverlays } from "../../app/providers/OverlayProvider";

/** Shared order keeps public and personal utility controls in the same positions. */
export function HeaderUtilities({
  searchLabel,
  showNotifications = true,
  searchClassName = "workspace-icon",
}: {
  searchLabel: string;
  showNotifications?: boolean;
  searchClassName?: string;
}) {
  const { openSearch } = useOverlays();
  return (
    <>
      <button
        type="button"
        className={searchClassName}
        data-search-trigger
        onClick={openSearch}
        aria-label={searchLabel}
      >
        <SearchGlyph />
      </button>
      {showNotifications && <HeaderNotifications />}
      <LanguageMenu />
    </>
  );

export function InvolvementNavigation() {

import { UtilityGlyph } from "./UtilityGlyph";
import { Button } from "../ui/button";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
export function LanguageMenu({
  nativeTooltip = true,
}: { nativeTooltip?: boolean } = {}) {
  const { locale, setLocale, label } = useLocale();
  const next = locale === "en" ? "ar" : "en";
  const hint = locale === "en" ? "Switch to Arabic" : "التبديل إلى الإنجليزية";
  return (
    <Button
      variant="ghost"
      className="language-button"
      data-locale={locale}
      aria-label={label("language") + ": " + hint}
      title={nativeTooltip ? hint : undefined}
      onClick={() => setLocale(next)}
    >
      <UtilityGlyph kind="language" locale={locale} />
      <span>{locale === "en" ? "EN" : "عربي"}</span>
    </Button>
  );
}

import { involvementItems, involvedLabel } from "./involvement";
const titles: [string, MessageKey][] = [
  ["/my/exams", "exams"],
  ["/admin/exams", "exams"],
  ["/learn/electronic-exams", "exams"],
  ["/my/study/recall", "recallDesk"],
  ["/my/study/offline", "offlinePacks"],
  ["/my/study/rooms", "quietRooms"],
  ["/my/study", "studyDesk"],
  ["/my/portfolio", "campusPortfolio"],
  ["/portfolio", "campusPortfolio"],
  ["/my/learning", "myLearning"],
  ["/my/progress", "myProgress"],
  ["/my/library", "libraryShort"],
  ["/my/calendar", "calendar"],
  ["/my/notifications", "notifications"],
  ["/my/activities", "myActivities"],
  ["/my/events", "myEvents"],
  ["/my/opportunities", "myOpportunities"],
  ["/my/mentorship", "myMentorship"],
  ["/my/contributions", "myContributions"],
  ["/my/orders", "myOrders"],
  ["/my/applications", "myApplications"],
  ["/my/team", "teamProfile"],
  ["/my/focus", "myFocus"],
  ["/my/profile", "myProfile"],
  ["/my/settings", "personalSettings"],
  ["/my", "mySpace"],
  ["/admin/content-health", "adminContentHealth"],
  ["/admin/analytics", "adminAnalytics"],
  ["/admin/governance", "governanceNavigation"],
  ["/admin/approvals", "governanceApprovals"],
  ["/admin/roles", "governanceRoles"],
  ["/admin/users", "governanceUsers"],
  ["/admin/versions", "adminVersions"],
  ["/admin/activity", "adminActivity"],
  ["/admin/content", "adminContent"],
  ["/admin/builder", "builderNavigation"],
  ["/admin", "adminControlRoom"],
  ["/search", "search"],
  ["/my/search", "personalSearch"],
  ["/learn", "learn"],
  ["/community/media", "media"],
  ["/community/activities", "activities"],
  ["/community/executive-bodies", "executiveBodies"],
  ["/community/honor-plate", "honorPlate"],
  ["/community/hall-of-honor", "hallOfHonor"],
  ["/community/about", "aboutMedClub"],
  ["/community", "community"],
  ["/journal", "journal"],
  ["/mentorship", "mentorship"],
  ["/store", "store"],
  ["/recruitment", "recruitment"],
  ["/utilities", "studyToolsShort"],
  ["/", "home"],
];
export function LocationTitle() {
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const involved = involvementItems.find(
    (item) => pathname === item.href || pathname.startsWith(item.href + "/"),
  );
  const match = [...titles]
    .sort((a, b) => b[0].length - a[0].length)
    .find(
      ([path]) =>
        pathname === path || (path !== "/" && pathname.startsWith(path + "/")),
    );
  return (
    <div
      className="shell-location"
      aria-label={t({ en: "Current location", ar: "الموقع الحالي" })}
    >
      <span className="shell-location-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
      {involved ? (
        <>
          <span className="shell-location-parent">{t(involvedLabel)}</span>
          <span className="shell-location-separator" aria-hidden="true">
            /
          </span>
          <strong>{t(involved.label)}</strong>
        </>
      ) : (
        <strong>{match ? label(match[1]) : label("home")}</strong>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { motion, useReducedMotion } from "framer-motion";
export function NavigationBubble({
  active,
  group,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  group: string;
}) {
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  return active ? (
    <motion.i
      aria-hidden="true"
      className="navigation-bubble"
      layoutId={`navigation-bubble-${group}`}
      transition={{ duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.25, ease: [0.22, 0.7, 0.2, 1] }}
    />
  ) : null;
}

import { useState, type ReactElement } from "react";
import { useAppearance } from "../../app/providers/AppearanceProvider";
import { Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent } from "../ui/tooltip";
/** Keep icon-only navigation named for keyboard and pointer users. */
export function NavigationHint({
  label,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  children: ReactElement;
}) {
  const { sidebarCollapsed, navigation } = useAppearance();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Tooltip
      open={sidebarCollapsed && navigation === "vertical" && open}
      onOpenChange={setOpen}
    >
      <TooltipTrigger asChild>{children}</TooltipTrigger>
      <TooltipContent side="right" sideOffset={17}>
        {label}
      </TooltipContent>
    </Tooltip>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/navigation/NavigationSelection.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties } from "react";

export interface SelectionBox {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}
/** Offset geometry stays correct while the containing rail folds in 3D. */
export function selectionBox(
  target: HTMLElement,
  host: HTMLElement,
): SelectionBox {
  let x = 0,
    y = 0,
    node: HTMLElement | null = target;
  while (node && node !== host) {
    x += node.offsetLeft;
    y += node.offsetTop;
    node = node.offsetParent as HTMLElement | null;
  }
  return { x, y, width: target.offsetWidth, height: target.offsetHeight };
}

export function NavigationSelection() {
  const leaf = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const [box, setBox] = useState<SelectionBox | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const host = leaf.current?.parentElement;
    if (!host) return;
    host.classList.add("navigation-selection-host");
    let frame = 0;
    let selected: HTMLElement | null = null;
    const observer =
      typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined" ? null : new ResizeObserver(queue);
    function measure() {
      frame = 0;
      const next = host!.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
        '.navigation-item.active, :scope > [aria-current="page"], :scope > [aria-current="location"]',
      );
      if (next !== selected) {
        if (selected) observer?.unobserve(selected);
        selected = next;
        if (next) observer?.observe(next);
      }
      const nextBox = next ? selectionBox(next, host!) : null;
      host!.toggleAttribute("data-selection-ready", !!nextBox?.width);
      setBox((previous) =>
        nextBox &&
        previous &&
        Object.keys(nextBox).every(
          (key) =>
            nextBox[key as keyof SelectionBox] ===
            previous[key as keyof SelectionBox],
        )
          ? previous
          : nextBox,
      );
    }
    function queue() {
      if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(measure);
    }
    const mutations = new MutationObserver(queue);
    mutations.observe(host, {
      subtree: true,
      childList: true,
      attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: ["class", "aria-current"],
    });
    observer?.observe(host);
    window.addEventListener("resize", queue);
    queue();
    return () => {
      observer?.disconnect();
      mutations.disconnect();
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", queue);
      host.classList.remove("navigation-selection-host");
      host.removeAttribute("data-selection-ready");
    };
  }, []);
  const style = box
    ? {
        transform: "translate3d(" + box.x + "px," + box.y + "px,0)",
        width: box.width,
        height: box.height,
      }
    : {};
  return (
    <span
      ref={leaf}
      className="navigation-travelling-selection"
      style={style as CSSProperties}
      data-visible={!!box?.width || undefined}
      aria-hidden="true"
    />
  );
}

          }`}

      <Modal

        onClose={() => setMoreOpen(false)}
        title={label("my")}
        description={label("ownCorner")}
        className="personal-menu-modal"
      >
        <nav
          className="personal-more-links"
          aria-label={label("personalNavigation")}

          {canOpenAdmin && (

              className="personal-mobile-admin-portal control-room-portal space-portal-link"

                <strong>{label("governancePortalTitle")}</strong>

FILE: src/components/navigation/ScrollHeader.tsx
============================================================
import { useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useOverlays } from "../../app/providers/OverlayProvider";
import { RouteJourneyContext } from "../../app/router/RouteJourney";
import { advanceHeaderScroll, initialHeaderScroll } from "./header-scroll";
import { useStudyChrome } from "../../app/providers/StudyChromeProvider";

/** Only the header leaf transforms. The sidebar and page remain fixed to their own geometry. */
export function ScrollHeader({
  className,
  children,
}: {
  className: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const root = useRef<HTMLElement>(null),
    hover = useRef(false);
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const { studying } = useStudyChrome();
  const { phase } = useContext(RouteJourneyContext);
  const { searchOpen, detail } = useOverlays();
  const [otherOverlay, setOtherOverlay] = useState(false);
  const [requestedHidden, setHidden] = useState(false);
  const state = useRef(initialHeaderScroll());
  const held = searchOpen || !!detail || otherOverlay;
  const config = useRef({ held, phase });
  config.current = { held, phase };
  useEffect(() => {
    const sync = () =>
      setOtherOverlay(
        !!document.querySelector(
          'dialog[open], [role="dialog"], [role="menu"]',
        ),
      );
    const observer = new MutationObserver(sync);
    sync();
    observer.observe(document.body, {
      subtree: true,
      childList: true,
      attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: ["open", "data-state"],
    });
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    state.current = initialHeaderScroll(window.scrollY);
    setHidden(false);
  }, [pathname]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (held || phase !== "idle") {
      state.current = initialHeaderScroll(window.scrollY);
      setHidden(false);
    }
  }, [held, phase]);
  useEffect(() => {
    state.current = initialHeaderScroll(window.scrollY);
    let frame = 0;
    const scroll = () => {
      if (frame) return;
      frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        frame = 0;
        const locked =
          config.current.held ||
          config.current.phase !== "idle" ||
          hover.current ||
          !!root.current?.contains(document.activeElement);
        state.current = advanceHeaderScroll(
          state.current,
          window.scrollY,
          locked,
        );
        setHidden(state.current.hidden);
      });
    };
    const keyboard = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Tab") {
        state.current = initialHeaderScroll(window.scrollY);
        setHidden(false);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", scroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("keydown", keyboard);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", scroll);
      window.removeEventListener("keydown", keyboard);
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
  }, []);
  const hidden = studying || (requestedHidden && !held && phase === "idle");
  return (
    <header
      ref={root}
      className={`${className} scroll-header`}
      data-header-hidden={hidden || undefined}
      data-header-held={held || phase !== "idle" || undefined}
      inert={hidden || undefined}
      aria-hidden={hidden || undefined}
      onPointerEnter={(event) => {
        if (event.pointerType === "mouse") hover.current = true;
      }}
      onPointerLeave={() => {
        hover.current = false;
      }}
      onFocusCapture={() => {
        state.current = initialHeaderScroll(window.scrollY);
        setHidden(false);
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </header>
  );
}

import { PackageCheck, ShoppingBag, ShoppingCart } from "lucide-react";

import { useStoreWorkspace } from "../../hooks/useContent";

export function StoreNavigation() {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const store = useStoreWorkspace();
  const value = pathname.startsWith("/store/cart")
    ? "/store/cart"

            icon: ShoppingCart,
            count: cartQuantity(store.cart),
          },
          {
            id: "/my/orders",
            label: label("myOrders"),
            icon: PackageCheck,
            count: store.orders.filter((order) => order.status !== "cancelled")
              .length,
          },
        ]}
        value={value}
        onChange={navigate}
      />
    </nav>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/navigation/ThemeMenu.tsx

import { Sun, Moon, Monitor } from "lucide-react";
import {
  useAppearance,
  type ColorMode,
} from "../../app/providers/AppearanceProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";

const choices = [
  { value: "light", en: "Light", ar: "فاتح", Icon: Sun },
  { value: "dark", en: "Dark", ar: "داكن", Icon: Moon },
  { value: "system", en: "System", ar: "حسب الجهاز", Icon: Monitor },
] as const;
export function nextColorMode(mode: ColorMode): ColorMode {
  return mode === "light" ? "dark" : mode === "dark" ? "system" : "light";
}
export function ThemeMenu({
  nativeTooltip = true,
}: { nativeTooltip?: boolean } = {}) {
  const { colorMode, setColorMode, persisted } = useAppearance();
  const { locale } = useLocale();
  const current = choices.find((choice) => choice.value === colorMode)!;
  const next = choices.find(
    (choice) => choice.value === nextColorMode(colorMode),
  )!;
  const title = locale === "ar" ? "مظهر الموقع" : "Color mode";
  const action = locale === "ar" ? "التبديل إلى " : "Switch to ";
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className="workspace-icon theme-trigger"
      aria-label={title + ": " + current[locale] + ". " + action + next[locale]}
      title={
        nativeTooltip
          ? action +
            next[locale] +
            (!persisted
              ? locale === "ar"
                ? " · لهذه الجلسة"
                : " · this session"
              : "")
          : undefined
      }
      data-color-mode={colorMode}
      onClick={() => setColorMode(next.value)}
    >
      <span className="utility-mode-glyph" key={colorMode}>
        <current.Icon size={19} aria-hidden="true" />
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}

type Choice = (typeof appearanceChoices)[number];
const scenes = [
  { en: "Home", ar: "الرئيسية" },

  { en: "Study reader", ar: "قارئ الدراسة" },
  { en: "Workspace", ar: "المساحة الشخصية" },
];
export function ThemePreview({
  choice,
  manual,
  onManual,
  onClose,
}: {
  choice: Choice;
  manual: boolean;
  onManual: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {

    if (manual || !playing) return;
    const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;
    const sync = () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      if (!document.hidden && !reduced.matches)
        timer = setInterval(
          () => setFrame((previous) => (previous + 1) % 4),
          2000,
        );
    };
    sync();
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", sync);
    reduced.addEventListener("change", sync);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", sync);
      reduced.removeEventListener("change", sync);
    };
  }, [manual, playing]);

            stroke="var(--preview-border)"
          />
          <text
            x="18"

            fontSize="14"
            fontWeight="700"
            fill="var(--preview-sidebar-foreground)"
          >
            mc
          </text>
          {[48, 73, 98, 123, 148].map((y, i) => (

                width="263"
                height="151"
                rx="5"
                fill="var(--preview-primary)"
              />
              <rect
                x="84"
                y="54"
                width="125"
                height="143"
                fill="var(--preview-card)"
              />
              <rect
                x="213"
                y="54"
                width="126"
                height="143"
                fill="var(--preview-card)"
              />
              {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((i) => (
                <g key={i}>
                  <path
                    d={`M96 ${77 + i * 16}h98m30 0h100`}
                    stroke="var(--preview-muted-foreground)"
                    opacity="0.65"
                  />
                </g>
              ))}
              <rect
                x="74"
                y="70"
                width="24"
                height="12"
                rx="2"
                fill="var(--preview-muted)"
              />
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <text
                x="76"
                y="59"
                fontSize="15"
                fontWeight="700"
                fill="var(--preview-foreground)"
              >
                Your workspace
              </text>
              {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => (
                <g key={i}>
                  <rect
                    x="76"
                    y={73 + i * 43}
                    width="266"
                    height="34"
                    rx="5"
                    fill="var(--preview-card)"
                    stroke="var(--preview-border)"
                  />
                  <circle
                    cx="93"
                    cy={90 + i * 43}
                    r="6"
                    fill="var(--preview-primary)"
                  />
                  <path
                    d={`M108 ${86 + i * 43}h145m-145 9h99`}
                    stroke="var(--preview-muted-foreground)"
                  />
                </g>
              ))}
            </>
          )}
        </svg>
      ))}
      <div
        className="theme-preview-controls"
        role="group"
        aria-label={t({ en: "Preview views", ar: "صفحات المعاينة" })}
      >
        {scenes.map((scene, index) => (
          <button
            key={index}
            type="button"
            aria-label={t(scene) + " " + t({ en: "preview", ar: "معاينة" })}
            aria-pressed={frame === index}
            onClick={() => {
              setFrame(index);
              onManual();
            }}
          >
            {index + 1}
          </button>
        ))}
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={t(
            playing && !manual
              ? { en: "Pause preview", ar: "إيقاف المعاينة" }
              : { en: "Preview paused", ar: "المعاينة متوقفة" },
          )}
          onClick={() => {
            setPlaying(false);
            onManual();
          }}
        >
          <Pause size={14} />
        </button>
      </div>
      <small>
        {t({
          en: "Illustrative layouts using the actual palette tokens.",
          ar: "تخطيطات توضيحية تستخدم ألوان المظهر الفعلية.",
        })}
      </small>
    </aside>
  );
}

/** Parts move inside a stable 20px box; utility labels and hit areas never shift. */
export function UtilityGlyph({ kind, locale = "ar" }: { kind: "language" | "appearance"; locale?: "en" | "ar" }) {
  return (
    <svg
      className={`utility-glyph utility-${kind}`}
      width="20"
      height="20"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth="1.7"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      {kind === "appearance" ? (
        <>
          <path d="M3 6h18M3 12h18M3 18h18" />
          <circle className="utility-knob first" cx="8" cy="6" r="2" />
          <circle className="utility-knob second" cx="16" cy="12" r="2" />
          <circle className="utility-knob third" cx="10" cy="18" r="2" />
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <g className="utility-language-first">
            <text x="6" y="11" textAnchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" fontSize={locale === "en" ? "16" : "13"} fontWeight="750">{locale === "en" ? "ع" : "A"}</text>
          </g>
          <g className="utility-language-second">
            <text x="18" y="21" textAnchor="middle" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" fontSize={locale === "en" ? "13" : "16"} fontWeight="750">{locale === "en" ? "A" : "ع"}</text>
          </g>
        </>
      )}
    </svg>
  );
}

import * as React from "react";

import { Slot } from "radix-ui";

import { cn } from "../../lib/utils";

const badgeVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex w-fit shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full border border-transparent px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-[color,box-shadow] focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&>svg]:pointer-events-none [&>svg]:size-3",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground [a&]:hover:bg-primary/90",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground [a&]:hover:bg-secondary/90",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive text-white focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/60 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40 [a&]:hover:bg-destructive/90",
        outline:
          "border-border text-foreground [a&]:hover:bg-accent [a&]:hover:text-accent-foreground",
        ghost: "[a&]:hover:bg-accent [a&]:hover:text-accent-foreground",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 [a&]:hover:underline",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  },
);

function Badge({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"span"> &
  VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants> & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "span";

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="badge"
      data-variant={variant}
      className={cn(badgeVariants({ variant }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export { Badge, badgeVariants };

        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",

        xs: "h-6 gap-1 rounded-md px-2 text-xs has-[>svg]:px-1.5 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",

        "icon-xs": "size-6 rounded-md [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
        "icon-sm": "size-8",
        "icon-lg": "size-10",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  },
);

function Button({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  asChild = false,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"button"> &
  VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> & {
    asChild?: boolean;
  }) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "button";

  return (
    <Comp
      data-slot="button"
      data-variant={variant}
      data-size={size}
      className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

import {
  BookOpen,
  Stethoscope,
  ClipboardCheck,
  Timer,
  Library,
  HeartPulse,
  Brain,
  FlaskConical,
  Bone,
  Users,
} from "lucide-react";
import type { IconName } from "../../types/content";
import { MorphIcon } from "./MorphIcon";
const icons = {
  book: BookOpen,
  stethoscope: Stethoscope,
  exam: ClipboardCheck,
  timer: Timer,
  library: Library,
  heart: HeartPulse,
  brain: Brain,
  flask: FlaskConical,
  bone: Bone,
  users: Users,
};
export function Icon({
  name,
  className,
  motion = false,
}: {
  name: IconName;
  className?: string;
  motion?: boolean;
}) {
  const Component = icons[name];
  if (motion) return <MorphIcon icon={Component} className={className} />;
  return <Component className={className} aria-hidden="true" />;
}

FILE: src/components/ui/Modal.tsx
============================================================
import {
  useId,
  useLayoutEffect,
  useRef,
  type CSSProperties,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
export function Modal({
  open,
  onClose,
  title,
  description,
  children,
  className = "",
  hideHeading = false,
  hideClose = false,
  onAfterClose,
  initialFocus,
  style,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  hideHeading?: boolean;
  hideClose?: boolean;
  onAfterClose?: () => void;
  initialFocus?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
}) {
  const { dir, label } = useLocale();
  const dialog = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const afterClose = useRef(onAfterClose);
  afterClose.current = onAfterClose;
  const titleId = useId(),
    descriptionId = useId();
  // Native modality moves focus and makes the background inert atomically.
  // Never aria-hide the shell or restore focus before the dialog has closed.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const node = dialog.current;
    if (!open || !node) return;
    node.showModal();
    // Run after native modality, synchronously in the opening gesture, before any animation.
    if (initialFocus)
      node
        .querySelector<HTMLElement>(initialFocus)
        ?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    const overflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      node.close();
      document.body.style.overflow = overflow;
      afterClose.current?.();
    };
  }, [open, initialFocus]);
  return createPortal(
    <dialog
      ref={dialog}
      style={style}
      dir={dir}
      className={`medclub-modal medclub-native-modal ${className}`}
      aria-labelledby={titleId}
      aria-describedby={descriptionId}
      onCancel={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        onClose();
      }}
      onClick={(event) => {
        if (event.target !== event.currentTarget) return;
        const r = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (
          event.clientX < r.left ||
          event.clientX > r.right ||
          event.clientY < r.top ||
          event.clientY > r.bottom
        )
          onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div className={hideHeading ? "sr-only" : "modal-heading"}>
        <h2 id={titleId} data-slot="dialog-title">
          {title}
        </h2>
        <p id={descriptionId} data-slot="dialog-description">
          {description}
        </p>
      </div>
      {open && children}
      {!hideClose && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className="modal-close"
          aria-label={label("close")}
          onClick={onClose}
        >
          <X size={19} />
        </button>
      )}
    </dialog>,
    document.body,
  );
}

FILE: src/components/ui/MorphIcon.tsx
============================================================
import {
  ShieldCheck,
  BadgeCheck,
  BadgeInfo,
  BellRing,
  BookCopy,
  BookmarkCheck,
  BrainCircuit,
  BookOpenCheck,
  BookOpenText,
  BriefcaseMedical,
  Building2,
  CalendarClock,
  CalendarRange,
  ChartSpline,
  CircleCheckBig,
  ClipboardPenLine,
  Crosshair,
  DoorOpen,
  FileCheck,
  Handshake,
  HeartPulse,
  History,
  IdCard,
  Images,
  KeySquare,
  ListChecks,
  ListFilterPlus,
  MessageCircleCheck,
  Microscope,
  PackageOpen,
  PanelTopOpen,
  PanelsTopLeft,
  ReceiptText,
  ScanFace,
  ScanSearch,
  ScanLine,
  SlidersVertical,
  SquareActivity,
  Stethoscope,
  Store,
  Telescope,
  TimerReset,
  TextSelect,
  Trophy,
  UserRoundCog,
  UserRoundCheck,
  UserRoundPlus,
  type LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";

/*
 * Match by Lucide's stable display name instead of importing every source icon.
 * Navigation modules already own their source icons; keeping only the destination
 * shapes here avoids turning the shared app shell into an oversized icon registry.
 */
const pairs: Record<string, LucideIcon> = {
  Activity: SquareActivity,
  Award: Trophy,
  Bell: BellRing,
  Bone: ScanLine,
  Bookmark: BookmarkCheck,
  Brain: BrainCircuit,
  BookOpen: BookOpenCheck,
  BriefcaseBusiness: BriefcaseMedical,
  CalendarCheck: CalendarClock,
  CalendarDays: CalendarRange,
  Camera: Images,
  ChartNoAxesCombined: ChartSpline,
  ClipboardCheck: ClipboardPenLine,
  ClipboardList: ListChecks,
  ContactRound: IdCard,
  FileCheck2: FileCheck,
  FileClock: History,
  Fingerprint: ScanFace,
  FlaskConical: Microscope,
  HeartHandshake: Handshake,
  HeartPulse: Stethoscope,
  House: DoorOpen,
  Info: BadgeInfo,
  KeyRound: KeySquare,
  Landmark: Building2,
  Languages: TextSelect,
  LayoutDashboard: PanelsTopLeft,
  Library: BookCopy,
  MessageCircleQuestion: MessageCircleCheck,
  Newspaper: BookOpenText,
  PackageCheck: PackageOpen,
  PanelsTopLeft: PanelTopOpen,
  Search: ScanSearch,
  ShieldCheck: ShieldCheck,
  ShoppingBag: Store,
  ShoppingCart: ReceiptText,
  SlidersHorizontal: ListFilterPlus,
  Sparkles: Telescope,
  Stethoscope: HeartPulse,
  Telescope: Crosshair,
  Timer: TimerReset,
  UserRound: UserRoundCheck,
  UserRoundCheck: BadgeCheck,
  Users: UserRoundPlus,
  UsersRound: UserRoundCog,
};

export function MorphIcon({
  icon: From,
  to,
  size = 20,
  className = "",
}: {
  icon: LucideIcon;
  to?: LucideIcon;
  size?: number;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const name = From.displayName || From.name || "icon";
  const To = to || pairs[name] || CircleCheckBig;
  return (
    <span
      className={`motion-icon ${className}`.trim()}
      data-morph={name.toLowerCase()}
      aria-hidden="true"
      style={{ "--motion-icon-size": `${size}px` } as CSSProperties}
    >
      <From className="motion-icon-from" size={size} />
      <To className="motion-icon-to" size={size} />
      <i className="motion-icon-trace" />
    </span>
  );
}

import { cn } from "../../lib/utils";

function Separator({

    <SeparatorPrimitive.Root
      data-slot="separator"

import { studyProgressValue } from "./study-progress-value";

/** Native progress carries the real value; the decorative fill transitions on updates. */
export function StudyProgress({ value, max, label }: { value: number; max: number; label: string }) {
  const progress = studyProgressValue(value, max);
  return (
    <span className="study-progress">
      <progress
        className="study-progress-native"
        value={progress.value}
        max={progress.max}
        aria-label={label}
      />
      <span className="study-progress-track" aria-hidden="true">
        <span className="study-progress-fill" style={{ transform: `scaleX(${progress.ratio})` }} />
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}

# MedClub V0.13.21 — Persistent course desk and leather shelf

This release starts from the complete V0.13.20 source. Keep the existing installation and replace its entire src directory with the src directory in this archive. No runtime dependency was added.

## User-facing changes

- Equal-width header shoulders center the course shelf independently of the course title and utility controls. The current course name stays beside the back control on desktop; narrower screens keep compact controls.
- A short beveled ledge, subtle supports and course-colored leather cover edges replace the long divider. Desktop books expose about 10 px at rest (14 px for the selected book), revealing their title on hover or keyboard focus. Touch targets retain a readable 44 px portion without requiring hover.
- Learn retains direct navigation to Explore courses and its hover category panel. A static, separately operable dropdown chevron sits beside the book icon and stays visible in collapsed navigation.
- Fine-grained and smooth leather materials follow the existing course colors. Texture belongs to the cover and binding; the reading paper and PDF remain unchanged.
- Course-to-course navigation in one workspace keeps the desk header, shelf nodes and scroll position mounted. Only the reader and course-scoped tools reset, restoring their saved state. Catalogue navigation and transitions between workspaces keep their existing route transitions.
- The shelf handles 50 courses in a bounded horizontal viewport, with mouse/pen dragging, native touch scrolling, paging arrows and directional keyboard controls. Home/End reach the first/last book. Drag release cannot accidentally open a course; ordinary clicks still navigate.
- The selected book is revealed only if it moves outside the visible shelf. Focus mode continues to show the notebook and study tools while hiding the header.

## Extension points

CourseDeskHeader.tsx separates persistent chrome from the keyed reader in StudyEnvironment.tsx. Reader controls register against the current book, so split view cannot mutate a previous course after switching. The stable context avoids extra reader updates when control registration changes.

CourseShelf.tsx derives all links from the existing course, batch and clinical-year services through shelfCourses; no fixed 50-course limit or sample inventory was added. The viewport, arrow distance and overflow cues respond to its measured size. Resizing keeps the current course reachable, and course/account study storage keys remain unchanged.

For a much larger catalogue, add a searchable course picker and explicit year/term filters through the existing content-service boundary. If inventories grow to hundreds or thousands, add server paging before introducing virtualization; preserve normal links, keyboard access and selection visibility.

## Generated material assets

Built-in image-generation mode was used. Final assets are included at:
- src/assets/materials/leather-pebbled.webp (31,118 bytes)
- src/assets/materials/leather-smooth.webp (13,912 bytes)

Both are shared 384 × 384 WebP material tiles. The background overlay is restrained to 8%; it is removed in forced-color mode.

Pebbled material prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: repeatable material texture for a responsive academic notebook cover. Primary request: create a square seamless fine-pebbled leather texture, photographed perfectly straight-on, covering the entire image edge to edge. Subtle close-grain calfskin, tiny realistic pores, no large creases. Neutral medium gray monochrome, soft uniform diffuse light, low contrast so a CSS course color tint can be applied. No object outline, perspective, vignette, shadows, text, seams, stitching, branding or watermark. All four edges tile seamlessly. The image is a material surface only.

Smooth material prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: subtle seamless material tile for academic book covers. Create a square image entirely filled with smooth lightly burnished bookbinding leather, very fine pores and restrained natural irregularity, quiet realistic material detail. Perfectly flat straight-on macro material photograph with neutral medium gray monochrome, low contrast and perfectly even diffuse illumination suitable for a colored CSS overlay. It must tile seamlessly on all four edges. No creases, broad shine, edge, object outline, perspective, stitching, text, logo, watermark, border or vignette.

## Validation and limits

- 46 DOM checks pass: the inherited V0.13.20 interaction suite plus 10 new checks for 50-book navigation, RTL, touch, drag cancellation, persistent public/personal desk identity, saved state, focus and catalogue route transitions.
- Strict TypeScript verification passes.
- Production build passes. Course code and material assets remain route-split.
- Source CSS audit: 70 geometry scenarios and 20 contrast pairs, including phone target visibility, hidden/revealed cover extents, header centering and utility placement.
- All 674 original source files remain present; seven original files changed. Earlier feature modules and release notes are included.
- The pre-existing large shared entry chunk advisory remains (approximately 1,021 KB before gzip).
- Real browser visual acceptance, animation smoothness and frame rate remain unverified. The Sites workflow requires skipping browser QA in the managed environment when the control-browser skill is unavailable.
- PDF publishing/storage, importer capabilities and device-local preview behavior remain as in V0.13.20; this release does not add a backend.

# MedClub V0.13.22 — Course chrome and comfortable PDF reading

Replace the entire existing src directory with this archive's src directory. This update starts from the complete V0.13.21 source and adds no runtime dependency or media asset.

## Changes

- The persistent course shelf is mounted at the top edge instead of leaving an empty strip above the books. Its shallow recess, beveled rail and inset highlights give it material depth using the existing theme colors and leather assets. Shelf browsing, current-course selection, 50-book navigation and preserved scroll position remain intact.
- Campus navigation and its reveal controls are unmounted throughout public and personal courses. There is no edge glance, contour, hover target, phone navigation or main header in a course. Programmatic reveal is also blocked. Back to courses remains available outside focus; leaving a course restores normal navigation and keeps the user's existing pin preference.
- The unopened PDF card has an in-flow details dropdown with provenance and review controls. Its favorite icon stays on the card. Open PDF readers, including companion readers, omit the metadata/review/favorite footer. Other media retain their details workflow.
- File actions have bounded 44 px targets. Long English/Arabic titles wrap; on small phones the actions occupy their own row instead of hanging beyond the page. Authorized local-PDF deletion appears on pointer hover or keyboard focus; touch users have visible controls. Import and deletion capabilities retain the existing role checks.
- Successful imports show the existing landing/progress/confirmation sequence, then return to the default upload state after 1.4 seconds. The input clears so the same file can be selected again. Errors remain visible; an unavailable device-storage warning is retained.
- PDF deletion has a short erase transition. Durable deletion waits for the IndexedDB transaction to commit. On failure, the card and object URL remain available and an error is announced; session-only PDFs can still be removed. Duplicate delete clicks are guarded.
- Review and private-note saves show a short ink/check receipt only after successful persistence. Failed saves keep the draft and show the existing error. Reduced-motion preferences remove spatial animation.
- PDFs default to softened paper in dark mode: neutral brightness/contrast adjustment, without inversion. Paper comfort can be changed in the existing reader options; original colors are available for diagrams. Light-mode PDFs remain original unless the user chooses otherwise. This is a display preference, not a modification of the PDF.
- Learn's dropdown chevron is a static, non-interactive SVG inside the destination link. Hover still opens categories, Learn still opens Explore, and keyboard ArrowDown/Escape remains supported. There is no separate chevron button.

## Suggested future palettes

Keep light/dark/system as the base preference, then consider Paper (warm cream and ink), Dusk (muted slate with wine accents), and High contrast. Use a shared token model and verify every text/background pair, status color and PDF reading treatment before adding another palette. No additional application theme was introduced in this release.

## Verification and limitations

- 64 DOM/state checks: 46 preserved or intentionally updated navigation/shelf/study checks and 18 focused file/persistence/reading checks.
- Strict TypeScript and production build pass.
- Source CSS cascade audit passes 90 constraint scenarios and 20 text/background contrast pairs, covering narrow phones, desktop, RTL, hover/focus, touch, reduced motion, bounded file actions and the top-mounted shelf.
- All 679 baseline source files remain present; 663 are byte-identical and 16 were modified. Four runtime/style files and this release note were added, for 684 files.
- Course and PDF engine code remain lazy-loaded. The existing large shared entry-chunk advisory remains at approximately 1,021 kB before gzip.
- The DOM harness uses test-force-exit after awaited assertions and cleanup to discard idle query-cache timers; it does not prove rendered browser geometry, animation smoothness or frame rate.
- Live browser visual acceptance remains unverified. The Sites workflow requires skipping browser QA in the managed environment when its control-browser skill is unavailable.
- PDF imports remain device-local, with the existing session fallback. This update does not add shared publishing or server storage.

Browser acceptance should cover the shelf's top contact and title reveal; long English/Arabic file names; deletion hover/focus/touch reachability; opening primary and companion PDFs; dark paper versus original diagram colors; importer reset and retry; and entering/leaving public/personal courses on narrow phones.

FILE: src/features/academics/BatchPage.tsx
