import { NavigationSelection } from "../../components/navigation/NavigationSelection";
import "../../styles/batch-experience.css";
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import {
  ArrowUpRight,
  ArrowLeft,
  Archive,
  BookOpen,
  CalendarDays,
  GraduationCap,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Navigate, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useBatches, useCourses } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { batchPath, routes } from "../../constants/routes";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { CourseCard } from "../../components/cards/CourseCard";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";

export default function BatchPage({ view }: { view: "current" | "archive" }) {
  const { batchSlug } = useParams();
  const batches = useBatches(),
    courses = useCourses();
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  if (batches.isPending || courses.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (batches.isError || courses.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void batches.refetch();
          void courses.refetch();
        }}
      />
    );
  const batch = batches.data.find((item) => item.slug === batchSlug);
  if (!batch)
    return (
      <EmptyState
        title={label("notFound")}
        description={label("notFoundBody")}
        href={routes.basic}
      />
    );
  const current = batch.terms.find((term) => term.current);
  if (view === "current" && !current)
    return <Navigate to={batchPath(batch.slug, "archive")} replace />;
  return (
    <div
      className={`container batch-page batch-page-${batch.accent} batch-studio`}
    >
      <AppLink href={routes.basic} className="batch-back">
        <ArrowLeft size={17} className="directional" />
        {t({ en: "All batches", ar: "كل الدفعات" })}
      </AppLink>
      <div className="batch-arrival" aria-hidden="true">
        <i />
        <i />
      </div>
      <header className="batch-identity-card">
        <div className="batch-identity-copy">
          <span className="academic-kicker">{t(batch.classLabel)}</span>
          <h1 data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>
            {t(batch.name)}
          </h1>
          <strong>{t(batch.tagline)}</strong>
          <p>{t(batch.description)}</p>
        </div>
        <div
          className="batch-progress-seal"
          style={
            { "--progress": `${batch.progress * 3.6}deg` } as CSSProperties
          }
        >
          <span>
            <b>{batch.progress}%</b>
            {label("journeyComplete")}
          </span>
        </div>
        <dl className="batch-meta">
          <div>
            <dt>
              <GraduationCap size={16} />
              {label("graduation")}
            </dt>
            <dd>{batch.graduationYear}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt>
              <BookOpen size={16} />
              {label("yearNumber")}
            </dt>
            <dd>{batch.studyYear}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt>
              <CalendarDays size={16} />
              {label("semester")}
            </dt>
            <dd>{current?.semester ?? "—"}</dd>
          </div>
        </dl>
      </header>
      <nav className="batch-view-switch" aria-label={label("choosePath")}>
        <NavigationSelection />
        <AppLink
          href={batchPath(batch.slug)}
          aria-current={view === "current" ? "page" : undefined}
        >
          <BookOpen size={17} />
          {label("currentSemester")}
        </AppLink>
        <AppLink
          href={batchPath(batch.slug, "archive")}
          aria-current={view === "archive" ? "page" : undefined}
        >
          <Archive size={17} />
          {label("archive")}
        </AppLink>
      </nav>
      {view === "current" && current ? (
        <section className="term-section">
          <div className="academic-section-heading">
            <span>{String(current.semester).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
            <div>
              <small>{current.academicYear}</small>
              <h2>{t(current.label)}</h2>
            </div>
            <i />
          </div>
          <div className="course-grid academic-course-grid">
            {current.courseIds
              .map((id) => courses.data.find((course) => course.id === id))
              .filter(Boolean)
              .map((course) => (
                <CourseCard course={course!} key={course!.id} />
              ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      ) : (
        <section className="archive-section">
          <div className="academic-section-heading">
            <span>
              <Archive size={20} />
            </span>
            <h2>{label("archivedTerms")}</h2>
            <i />
          </div>
          {batch.terms.filter((term) => !term.current).length ? (
            batch.terms
              .filter((term) => !term.current)
              .map((term) => (
                <details className="archive-term" key={term.id}>
                  <summary>
                    <span>
                      <small>
                        {term.academicYear} · {label("semester")}{" "}
                        {term.semester}
                      </small>
                      <b>{t(term.label)}</b>
                    </span>
                    <span>
                      {term.courseIds.length} {label("coursesCount")}
                      <ArrowUpRight size={18} />
                    </span>
                  </summary>
                  <div className="course-grid academic-course-grid">
                    {term.courseIds
                      .map((id) =>
                        courses.data.find((course) => course.id === id),
                      )
                      .filter(Boolean)
                      .map((course) => (
                        <CourseCard course={course!} key={course!.id} />
                      ))}
                  </div>
                </details>
              ))
          ) : (
            <EmptyState description={label("noArchive")} />
          )}
        </section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/academics/CatalogPage.tsx
============================================================
import { useState } from "react";
import type { Track } from "../../types/content";
import { useCourses } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { CourseCard } from "../../components/cards/CourseCard";
import { SearchInput } from "../../components/forms/SearchInput";
import {
  Tabs,
  TabsList,
  TabsTrigger,
  TabsContent,
} from "../../components/ui/tabs";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
export default function CatalogPage({ track }: { track?: Track }) {
  const query = useCourses();
  const { label, dir } = useLocale();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("all");
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  const records = query.data.filter(
    (c) =>
      (!track || c.track === track) &&
      (filter === "all" || c.track === filter) &&
      [c.title.en, c.title.ar, c.batch.en, c.batch.ar, c.code]
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(search.toLowerCase()),
  );
  return (
    <div className="container">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("learnEyebrow")}
        title={label(track || "learnTitle")}
        description={label("learnBody")}
      />
      <Tabs value={filter} onValueChange={setFilter} dir={dir}>
        <div className="catalog-controls">
          <TabsList className="filter-tabs" aria-label={label("course")}>
            {(track ? ["all"] : ["all", "basic", "clinical"]).map((value) => (
              <TabsTrigger value={value} key={value}>
                {label(value === "all" ? "allCourses" : (value as Track))}
              </TabsTrigger>
            ))}
          </TabsList>
          <SearchInput
            value={search}
            onChange={setSearch}
            label={label("courseSearch")}
          />
        </div>
        {["all", "basic", "clinical"].map((value) => (
          <TabsContent key={value} value={value}>
            <div className="course-grid">
              {records.map((course) => (
                <CourseCard key={course.id} course={course} />
              ))}
              {!records.length && (
                <EmptyState
                  title={label("emptyCourses")}
                  description={label("emptyCoursesBody")}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          </TabsContent>
        ))}
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/academics/ClinicalYearPage.tsx
============================================================
import { ArrowUpRight, Compass, Stethoscope } from "lucide-react";
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useClinicalYears, useCourses } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { routes } from "../../constants/routes";
import { CourseCard } from "../../components/cards/CourseCard";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";

export default function ClinicalYearPage() {
  const { yearSlug } = useParams();
  const years = useClinicalYears(),
    courses = useCourses();
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  if (years.isPending || courses.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (years.isError || courses.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void years.refetch();
          void courses.refetch();
        }}
      />
    );
  const year = years.data.find((item) => item.slug === yearSlug);
  if (!year)
    return (
      <EmptyState
        title={label("notFound")}
        description={label("notFoundBody")}
        href={routes.clinical}
      />
    );
  const selected = year.courseIds
    .map((id) => courses.data.find((course) => course.id === id))
    .filter(Boolean);
  return (
    <div
      className={`container clinical-year-page clinical-year-${year.accent}`}
    >
      <header className="clinical-year-hero">
        <span className="clinical-year-huge" aria-hidden="true">
          0{year.year}
        </span>
        <div>
          <span className="academic-kicker">
            <Stethoscope size={14} />
            {t(year.label)}
          </span>
          <h1 data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>
            {t(year.tagline)}
          </h1>
          <p>{t(year.description)}</p>
        </div>
        <aside>
          <small>{label("currentBlock")}</small>
          <strong>{t(year.currentBlock)}</strong>
          <ArrowUpRight size={20} />
        </aside>
      </header>
      <section className="clinical-focus-strip" aria-labelledby="focus-heading">
        <span>
          <Compass size={19} />
          <b id="focus-heading">{label("focusAreas")}</b>
        </span>
        {year.focusAreas.map((focus, index) => (
          <span key={focus.en}>
            <i>0{index + 1}</i>
            {t(focus)}
          </span>
        ))}
      </section>
      <section>
        <div className="academic-section-heading">
          <span>{selected.length}</span>
          <h2>{label("courseCollection")}</h2>
          <i />
        </div>
        <div className="course-grid academic-course-grid">
          {selected.map((course) => (
            <CourseCard course={course!} key={course!.id} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

  useBatches,

FILE: src/features/academics/MyLearningPage.tsx
============================================================
import { lazy, Suspense, useState } from "react";
import { useCourses, useStudentProfile } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { SearchInput } from "../../components/forms/SearchInput";
import { CourseCard } from "../../components/cards/CourseCard";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { BookOpen, ChartNoAxesCombined } from "lucide-react";
const AcademicProgressPage = lazy(
  () => import("../insights/AcademicProgressPage"),
);
export default function MyLearningPage() {
  const courses = useCourses(),
    profile = useStudentProfile();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const insightView = params.get("view") === "insights";
  if (courses.isPending || profile.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (courses.isError || profile.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void courses.refetch();
          void profile.refetch();
        }}
      />
    );
  const selected = courses.data.filter(
    (c) =>
      profile.data.courseIds.includes(c.id) &&
      [c.title.en, c.title.ar, c.code]
        .join(" ")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(search.toLowerCase()),
  );
  return (
    <div className="container">
      <PageIntro
        title={label("myLearning")}
        eyebrow={label("yourOwnPace")}
        description={label("myLearningBody")}
      />
      <nav className="my-learning-views" aria-label={label("myLearning")}>
        <button
          aria-pressed={!insightView}
          onClick={() =>
            setParams(
              (p) => {
                p.delete("view");
                return p;
              },
              { preventScrollReset: true },
            )
          }
        >
          <BookOpen size={18} />
          {label("myLearning")}
        </button>
        <button
          aria-pressed={insightView}
          onClick={() =>
            setParams(
              (p) => {
                p.set("view", "insights");
                return p;
              },
              { preventScrollReset: true },
            )
          }
        >
          <ChartNoAxesCombined size={18} />
          {label("myProgress")}
        </button>
      </nav>
      {insightView ? (
        <Suspense fallback={<LoadingState />}>
          <AcademicProgressPage embedded />
        </Suspense>
      ) : (
        <>
          <SearchInput
            value={search}
            onChange={setSearch}
            label={label("findMyCourse")}
          />
          <div className="course-grid personal-learning-grid">
            {selected.map((course) => (
              <CourseCard course={course} key={course.id} />
            ))}
            {selected.length === 0 && (
              <EmptyState
                title={label("emptyCourses")}
                description={label("myCoursesEmpty")}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useAppearance } from "../../app/providers/AppearanceProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import activeDay from "../../assets/home/auth-plaza-active-day-1672.webp";
import activeNight from "../../assets/home/auth-plaza-active-night-1672.webp";
import awaitingDay from "../../assets/home/auth-plaza-awaiting-day-1672.webp";
import awaitingNight from "../../assets/home/auth-plaza-awaiting-night-1672.webp";
import phoneDay from "../../assets/home/living-campus-1672.webp";
import phoneNight from "../../assets/home/living-campus-night-1672.webp";
import phoneAwaitingDay from "../../assets/home/campus-awaiting-day-1672.webp";
import phoneAwaitingNight from "../../assets/home/campus-awaiting-night-1672.webp";
import { campusDestinations } from "../homepage/living-campus";
import { useCampusLife } from "../homepage/useCampusLife";
import { CampusLights } from "../homepage/CampusLights";
import { authDestinations } from "./auth-constellation";
import { useAuthJourney } from "./AuthJourney";
import { prepareRestorationImage } from "./restoration-art";
import { useCampusRestoration } from "./useCampusRestoration";
import { CampusArrivalBurst } from "./CampusArrivalBurst";
import { authRestorationRegions, phoneRestorationRegions, authArrivalPoints, phoneArrivalPoints } from "./auth-restoration-regions";
import "../homepage/living-campus.css";

export function AuthCampus({ dormant }: { dormant: boolean }) {
  const { resolvedTheme } = useAppearance();
  const { t, dir } = useLocale();
  const journey = useAuthJourney();
  const dark = resolvedTheme === "dark";
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(() => window.matchMedia("(max-width: 700px)").matches);
  useEffect(() => {
    const query = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 700px)");
    const sync = () => setPhone(query.matches);
    query.addEventListener("change", sync);
    return () => query.removeEventListener("change", sync);
  }, []);
  const live = phone ? dark ? phoneNight : phoneDay : dark ? activeNight : activeDay;
  const source = dormant ? phone ? dark ? phoneAwaitingNight : phoneAwaitingDay : dark ? awaitingNight : awaitingDay : live;
  const destinations = phone ? campusDestinations : authDestinations;
  const assets = useMemo(() => Array<string>(6).fill(live), [live]);
  const regions = phone ? phoneRestorationRegions : authRestorationRegions;
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const stage = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const enabled = loaded === source && failed !== source;
  const id = useId().replace(/:/g, "");
  const waitForRoute = useCallback(async (building: string, signal: AbortSignal) => {
    // Let React commit the revealed route and the browser create its transition.
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve())));
    if (signal.aborted) return;
    const route = stage.current?.querySelector<SVGPathElement>(`[data-campus-life-destination="${building}"] .campus-life-route`);
    const drawing = route?.getAnimations().filter((animation) => "transitionProperty" in animation && animation.transitionProperty === "stroke-dashoffset") || [];
    await Promise.all(drawing.map((animation) => animation.finished.catch(() => {})));
  }, []);
  const restoration = useCampusRestoration(dormant ? journey.progress : [], enabled, journey.finalRestoration, assets, waitForRoute);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (enabled && dormant) void prepareRestorationImage(live).catch(() => {});
  }, [enabled, dormant, live]);
  const ambient = useCampusLife(stage, "ambient", enabled && !dormant && !journey.welcoming);
  const welcome = useCampusLife(stage, "welcome", enabled && !dormant && journey.welcoming, journey.welcomeToken);
  const effect = dormant ? restoration : journey.welcoming ? welcome : ambient;
  const full = dormant && restoration.repaired.length === 6;
  return (
    <div className="auth-campus-gallery" ref={stage} data-direction={dir}
      data-campus-running={effect.running || undefined} data-welcome-running={journey.welcoming || undefined}
      data-restoration-finishing={dormant && journey.finalRestoration || undefined} data-campus-variant={dormant ? "awaiting" : "active"} data-campus-lighting={dark ? "night" : "day"}
      data-restoration={dormant ? restoration.repaired.length : undefined} data-portrait={phone || undefined}>
      <div className="auth-campus-window" aria-hidden="true" data-failed={failed === source || undefined}>
        <div className="auth-campus-art">
          <picture>
            <img src={source} width={1672} height={941} alt="" decoding="async" fetchPriority="high"
              onLoad={() => { setLoaded(source); setFailed(null); }} onError={() => setFailed(source)} />
          </picture>
          {dormant && <svg viewBox="0 0 1672 941" className="auth-campus-repair-map" focusable="false">
            <defs>
              <filter id={`${id}-repair-edge`} x="-5%" y="-5%" width="110%" height="110%" colorInterpolationFilters="sRGB">
                <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="7" />
              </filter>
              <mask id={`${id}-repair-mask`} maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x="0" y="0" width="1672" height="941" style={{ maskType: "luminance" }}>
                <rect width="1672" height="941" fill="black" />
                {full ? <rect width="1672" height="941" fill="white" data-restored-campus="true" /> :
                  <g filter={`url(#${id}-repair-edge)`}>{destinations.map((destination) =>
                    <path key={destination.id} d={regions[destination.id]} fill="white"
                      visibility={restoration.repaired.includes(destination.id) ? "visible" : "hidden"} />
                  )}</g>}
              </mask>
            </defs>
            <image href={live} width={1672} height={941} mask={`url(#${id}-repair-mask)`} data-restoration-source="fixed" />
            {restoration.repaired.map((key) => <g key={key} data-restored-building={key} />)}
          </svg>}
          <svg viewBox="0 0 1672 941" className="auth-campus-map" focusable="false">
            <CampusLights lit={effect.lit} revealed={effect.revealed} destinations={destinations} origin={phone ? [1070, 578] : [836, 730]} />
            <CampusArrivalBurst key={source} arrival={dormant ? restoration.arrival : null} points={phone ? phoneArrivalPoints : authArrivalPoints} enabled={dormant && enabled} repaired={restoration.repaired} />
            {destinations.map((destination) => <g key={destination.id}
              transform={dir === "rtl" ? `translate(${destination.labelX * 2} 0) scale(-1 1)` : undefined}>
              <text x={destination.labelX} y={destination.labelY}
                transform={`rotate(${dir === "rtl" ? -destination.rotation : destination.rotation} ${destination.labelX} ${destination.labelY})`}
                textAnchor="middle" dominantBaseline="middle" lang={dir === "rtl" ? "ar" : "en"}>
                {t(destination.label)}
              </text>
            </g>)}
          </svg>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { SignOutGlyph } from "../../components/navigation/SignOutGlyph";
import { CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";

import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";

export function AuthenticatedState() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [search] = useSearchParams();
  const returnTo = safeReturnTo(search.get("returnTo"));

  return (

      <span className="auth-success-icon" aria-hidden="true">
        <CheckCircle2 />

      <h2>{label("continueToMyMedClub")}</h2>
      <p>
        {label("signedInAs")} <strong>{user.email}</strong>
      </p>
      <div className="auth-action-stack">

          type="button"
          className="button button-primary auth-submit"
          onClick={() => navigate(returnTo)}
        >
          {label("continueToMyMedClub")}
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="ghost"

          onClick={() => void auth.signOut()}

          <SignOutGlyph />

        </Button>
      </div>
    </section>
  );

FILE: src/features/auth/AuthJourney.tsx
============================================================
import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";

type Journey = {
  progress: string[];
  finalRestoration: boolean;
  finishRestoration: () => void;
  setProgress: (value: string[]) => void;
  welcomeToken: number;
  welcoming: boolean;
  startWelcome: () => Promise<void>;
  stopWelcome: () => void;
};
const Context = createContext<Journey>({
  progress: [],
  finalRestoration: false,
  finishRestoration: () => {},
  setProgress: () => {},
  welcomeToken: 0,
  welcoming: false,
  startWelcome: async () => {},
  stopWelcome: () => {},
});
export function AuthJourneyProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [finalRestoration, setFinalRestoration] = useState(false);
  const finishRestoration = useCallback(() => setFinalRestoration(true), []);
  const [progress, setProgressState] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [welcomeToken, setWelcomeToken] = useState(0);
  const [welcoming, setWelcoming] = useState(false);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
  const resolve = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
  const setProgress = useCallback(
    (value: string[]) => {
      if (value.length < 6) setFinalRestoration(false);
      setProgressState((current) => current.join("|") === value.join("|") ? current : value);
    },
    [],
  );
  const stopWelcome = useCallback(() => {
    clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = undefined;
    setWelcoming(false);
    resolve.current?.();
    resolve.current = null;
  }, []);
  const startWelcome = useCallback(() => {
    stopWelcome();
    if (
      document.hidden ||
      window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
    )
      return Promise.resolve();
    setWelcoming(true);
    setWelcomeToken((value) => value + 1);
    return new Promise<void>((done) => {
      resolve.current = done;
      timer.current = setTimeout(stopWelcome, 900);
    });
  }, [stopWelcome]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const stop = () => {
      if (document.hidden || reduced.matches) stopWelcome();
    };
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", stop);
    reduced.addEventListener("change", stop);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      resolve.current?.();
      resolve.current = null;
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", stop);
      reduced.removeEventListener("change", stop);
    };
  }, [stopWelcome]);
  return (
    <Context.Provider
      value={{
        progress,
        setProgress,
        finalRestoration,
        finishRestoration,
        welcomeToken,
        welcoming,
        startWelcome,
        stopWelcome,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </Context.Provider>
  );
}
export const useAuthJourney = () => useContext(Context);

FILE: src/features/auth/CampusArrivalBurst.tsx

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties } from "react";
import type { CampusArrival } from "./useCampusRestoration";
import "./campus-arrival-burst.css";

const particles = Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, index) => {
  const angle = (index / 18) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
  const distance = 90 + (index % 4) * 22;
  return { x: Math.cos(angle) * distance, y: Math.sin(angle) * distance, size: index % 3 === 0 ? 1.45 : .95, delay: (index % 3) * 18 };
});
const star = "M0-5L1.5-1.5L5 0L1.5 1.5L0 5L-1.5 1.5L-5 0L-1.5-1.5Z";

/** Finite SVG fireworks: CSS animates only transforms and opacity, never the photograph. */
export function CampusArrivalBurst({ arrival, points, enabled, repaired }: {
  arrival: CampusArrival | null;
  points: Record<string, readonly [number, number]>;
  enabled: boolean;
  repaired: string[];
}) {
  const [bursts, setBursts] = useState<CampusArrival[]>([]);
  const [reduced, setReduced] = useState(() => window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches);
  const timers = useRef(new Map<number, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>());
  const last = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const query = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const sync = () => setReduced(query.matches);
    query.addEventListener("change", sync);
    return () => query.removeEventListener("change", sync);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled || reduced) {
      timers.current.forEach(clearTimeout);
      timers.current.clear();
      setBursts([]);
      return;
    }
    if (!arrival || arrival.token === last.current) return;
    last.current = arrival.token;
    setBursts((current) => [...current, arrival].slice(-3));
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      timers.current.delete(arrival.token);
      setBursts((current) => current.filter((burst) => burst.token !== arrival.token));
    }, 1250);
    timers.current.set(arrival.token, timer);
  }, [arrival, enabled, reduced]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const stop = () => {
      if (!document.hidden) return;
      timers.current.forEach(clearTimeout);
      timers.current.clear();
      setBursts([]);
    };
    const pending = timers.current;
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", stop);
    return () => { pending.forEach(clearTimeout); pending.clear(); document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", stop); };
  }, []);
  if (!enabled || reduced) return null;
  return <g className="campus-arrival-bursts" aria-hidden="true" pointerEvents="none">
    {bursts.filter((burst) => repaired.includes(burst.id)).map((burst) => {
      const point = points[burst.id];
      if (!point) return null;
      return <g key={burst.token} className="campus-arrival-burst" data-arrival-building={burst.id}
        data-arrival-token={burst.token} transform={`translate(${point[0]} ${point[1]})`}>
        <circle className="campus-arrival-ring" r={16} />
        <circle className="campus-arrival-ring campus-arrival-inner-ring" r={9} />
        <path className="campus-arrival-flash" d={star} />
        {particles.map((particle, index) => <g key={index} className="campus-arrival-particle"
          style={{ "--star-x": `${particle.x}px`, "--star-y": `${particle.y}px`, "--star-size": particle.size, animationDelay: `${particle.delay}ms` } as CSSProperties}>
          <path d={star} transform={`rotate(${index * 29})`} />
          {index % 2 === 0 && <path className="campus-arrival-tail" d={`M0 0L${-particle.x * .065} ${-particle.y * .065}`} />}
        </g>)}
      </g>;
    })}
  </g>;
}

FILE: src/features/auth/MedicalFieldCanvas.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

const vertexShader = `
  attribute vec3 aPosition;
  attribute float aSeed;
  uniform float uTime;
  uniform vec2 uPointer;
  uniform float uAspect;
  varying float vSeed;
  varying float vDepth;

  mat2 rotate2d(float angle) {
    float s = sin(angle);
    float c = cos(angle);
    return mat2(c, -s, s, c);
  }

  void main() {
    vec3 point = aPosition;
    float drift = uTime * (0.08 + aSeed * 0.05);
    point.xz = rotate2d(drift + uPointer.x * 0.34) * point.xz;
    point.yz = rotate2d(uPointer.y * 0.2) * point.yz;
    point.x += sin(uTime * 0.35 + aSeed * 18.0) * 0.08;
    float depth = max(2.4, 7.4 - point.z);
    vec2 projected = point.xy / depth * 3.1;
    gl_Position = vec4(projected.x / uAspect, projected.y, 0.0, 1.0);
    gl_PointSize = (2.2 + aSeed * 4.8) * (7.0 / depth);
    vSeed = aSeed;
    vDepth = clamp(1.0 - depth / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0);
  }
`;

const fragmentShader = `
  precision mediump float;
  varying float vSeed;
  varying float vDepth;

  void main() {
    vec2 center = gl_PointCoord - vec2(0.5);
    float distanceToCenter = length(center);
    if (distanceToCenter > 0.5) discard;
    float halo = smoothstep(0.5, 0.04, distanceToCenter);
    vec3 red = vec3(0.98, 0.24, 0.24);
    vec3 coral = vec3(1.0, 0.62, 0.4);
    vec3 pearl = vec3(1.0, 0.92, 0.82);
    vec3 color = mix(red, coral, vSeed);
    color = mix(color, pearl, vDepth * 0.48);
    gl_FragColor = vec4(color, halo * (0.24 + vDepth * 0.76));
  }
`;

function compile(gl: WebGLRenderingContext, type: number, source: string) {
  const shader = gl.createShader(type);
  if (!shader) return null;
  gl.shaderSource(shader, source);
  gl.compileShader(shader);
  if (!gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
    gl.deleteShader(shader);
    return null;
  }
  return shader;
}

function createParticleData() {
  const points: number[] = [];
  const seeds: number[] = [];
  let randomState = 8608;
  const random = () => {
    randomState = (randomState * 16807) % 2147483647;
    return (randomState - 1) / 2147483646;
  };

  for (let strand = 0; strand < 2; strand += 1) {
    for (let index = 0; index < 420; index += 1) {
      const progress = index / 419;
      const angle = progress * Math.PI * 8 + strand * Math.PI;
      const radius = 1.32 + Math.sin(progress * Math.PI * 5) * 0.11;
      points.push(
        Math.cos(angle) * radius,
        (progress - 0.5) * 6.4,
        Math.sin(angle) * radius,
      );
      seeds.push(strand ? 0.78 : 0.28);
    }
  }

  for (let index = 0; index < 520; index += 1) {
    const angle = random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const radius = 1.9 + random() * 3.3;
    points.push(
      Math.cos(angle) * radius,
      (random() - 0.5) * 7.8,
      Math.sin(angle) * radius,
    );
    seeds.push(random());
  }

  return {
    positions: new Float32Array(points),
    seeds: new Float32Array(seeds),
    count: seeds.length,
  };
}

export function MedicalFieldCanvas() {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const [available, setAvailable] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    if (typeof WebGLRenderingContext === "undefined") {
      setAvailable(false);
      return;
    }
    let gl: WebGLRenderingContext | null = null;
    try {
      gl = canvas.getContext("webgl", {
        alpha: true,
        antialias: false,
        powerPreference: "high-performance",
      });
    } catch {
      gl = null;
    }
    if (!gl) {
      setAvailable(false);
      return;
    }

    const vertex = compile(gl, gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vertexShader);
    const fragment = compile(gl, gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragmentShader);
    if (!vertex || !fragment) {
      setAvailable(false);
      return;
    }
    const program = gl.createProgram();
    if (!program) return;
    gl.attachShader(program, vertex);
    gl.attachShader(program, fragment);
    gl.linkProgram(program);
    if (!gl.getProgramParameter(program, gl.LINK_STATUS)) {
      setAvailable(false);
      return;
    }

    const particles = createParticleData();
    const positionBuffer = gl.createBuffer();
    const seedBuffer = gl.createBuffer();
    const positionLocation = gl.getAttribLocation(program, "aPosition");
    const seedLocation = gl.getAttribLocation(program, "aSeed");
    const timeLocation = gl.getUniformLocation(program, "uTime");
    const pointerLocation = gl.getUniformLocation(program, "uPointer");
    const aspectLocation = gl.getUniformLocation(program, "uAspect");
    const pointer = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const target = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const reduced = window.matchMedia(
      "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)",
    ).matches;
    let visible = true;
    let animationFrame = 0;

    gl.useProgram(program);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, positionBuffer);
    gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, particles.positions, gl.STATIC_DRAW);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(positionLocation);
    gl.vertexAttribPointer(positionLocation, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, seedBuffer);
    gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, particles.seeds, gl.STATIC_DRAW);
    gl.enableVertexAttribArray(seedLocation);
    gl.vertexAttribPointer(seedLocation, 1, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
    gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
    gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA, gl.ONE);
    gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0);

    const resize = () => {
      const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const ratio = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1.75);
      canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(bounds.width * ratio));
      canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(bounds.height * ratio));
      gl.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    };
    const onPointerMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      target.x = ((event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width - 0.5) * 2;
      target.y = ((event.clientY - bounds.top) / bounds.height - 0.5) * -2;
    };
    const render = (timestamp: number) => {
      pointer.x += (target.x - pointer.x) * 0.04;
      pointer.y += (target.y - pointer.y) * 0.04;
      gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
      gl.uniform1f(timeLocation, reduced ? 0 : timestamp / 1000);
      gl.uniform2f(pointerLocation, pointer.x, pointer.y);
      gl.uniform1f(aspectLocation, canvas.width / canvas.height);
      gl.drawArrays(gl.POINTS, 0, particles.count);
      if (!reduced && visible) animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(render);
    };
    const observer =
      typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined"
        ? null
        : new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
            visible = entry?.isIntersecting ?? true;
            if (visible && !reduced) {
              cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
              animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(render);
            }
          });
    const resizeObserver =
      typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined"
        ? null
        : new ResizeObserver(() => {
            resize();
            if (reduced) render(0);
          });

    resize();
    resizeObserver?.observe(canvas);
    observer?.observe(canvas);
    if (!resizeObserver) window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
    if (!reduced) canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
    render(0);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
      resizeObserver?.disconnect();
      observer?.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener("resize", resize);
      canvas.removeEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);
      gl.deleteBuffer(positionBuffer);
      gl.deleteBuffer(seedBuffer);
      gl.deleteProgram(program);
      gl.deleteShader(vertex);
      gl.deleteShader(fragment);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      className="auth-medical-field"
      data-webgl={available ? "active" : "fallback"}
      aria-hidden="true"
    />
  );
}

FILE: src/features/auth/README.md
============================================================
# Authentication feature — V0.8

This feature contains the dedicated account experience:

- sign in with safe return-to routing;
- registration and preview email verification;
- non-enumerating recovery state;
- WebGL medical identity field and static fallback;
- already-authenticated handling.

State is provided by `app/providers/AuthProvider.tsx` through the `AuthService` contract. `services/local-auth.service.ts` is a browser-local demonstration adapter. It must be replaced before real student accounts or private data are introduced.

Production requirements include server-issued secure sessions, email ownership verification, expiring recovery tokens, rate limits, lockouts, CSRF defenses, server-side role/capability enforcement, audit records and privacy/account-lifecycle decisions.

import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { CheckCircle2, RotateCcwKey } from "lucide-react";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { routes } from "../../constants/routes";
import { authErrorKey } from "../../lib/auth";

export default function RecoverPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const submit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (auth.isPending) return;
    setError(null);
    if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email)) {
      setError(label("emailInvalid"));
      return;
    }
    try {
      await auth.requestPasswordReset(email.trim());
      setSent(true);
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(label(authErrorKey(caught)));
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="auth-panel">
      <div className="auth-panel-heading">
        <p className="auth-eyebrow">
          <RotateCcwKey />
          {label("forgotPassword")}
        </p>
        <h2>{label("recoverTitle")}</h2>
        <p>{label("recoverBody")}</p>
      </div>
      {sent ? (
        <div className="auth-recovery-result" role="status">
          <CheckCircle2 />
          <p>{label("recoverySent")}</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form
          className="auth-form"
          onSubmit={submit}
          noValidate
          aria-busy={auth.isPending}
        >
          <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="recover-email">
            <span>{label("email")}</span>
            <input
              id="recover-email"
              type="email"
              dir="ltr"
              inputMode="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          {error && (
            <p className="auth-form-error" role="alert">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <Button
            type="submit"
            disabled={auth.isPending}
            className="button button-primary auth-submit"
          >
            {label("sendRecovery")}
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}
      <p className="auth-switch">
        <AppLink href={routes.signIn}>{label("backToSignIn")}</AppLink>
      </p>
      <div className="auth-boundary-note">
        <strong>{label("authPreview")}</strong>
        <span>{label("authPreviewBody")}</span>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { ArrowRight, Eye, EyeOff, UserRoundPlus } from "lucide-react";
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { authErrorKey, safeReturnTo } from "../../lib/auth";
import { routes } from "../../constants/routes";
import { AuthenticatedState } from "./AuthenticatedState";
import { useAuthJourney } from "./AuthJourney";
import { campusDestinations } from "../homepage/living-campus";

export default function RegisterPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const journey = useAuthJourney();
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [search] = useSearchParams();
  const returnTo = safeReturnTo(search.get("returnTo"));
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    fullName: "",
    email: "",
    batch: "Shifaa",
    year: 3,
    password: "",
    confirm: "",
  });
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [touched, setTouched] = useState<
    Partial<Record<keyof typeof form, boolean>>
  >({});
  const lastStep = useRef(0);
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [invalid, setInvalid] = useState<keyof typeof form | null>(null);
  const passwordReady = useMemo(
    () =>
      form.password.length >= 8 &&
      /[A-Za-z]/.test(form.password) &&
      /\d/.test(form.password),
    [form.password],
  );
  const readyIds = useMemo(() => {
    const ready = [
      !!form.fullName.trim(),
      /^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(form.email.trim()),
      !!form.batch.trim(),
      form.year >= 1 && form.year <= 6,
      passwordReady,
      passwordReady && form.password === form.confirm,
    ];
    const keys = [
      "fullName",
      "email",
      "batch",
      "year",
      "password",
      "confirm",
    ] as const;
    return campusDestinations
      .filter((_, index) => ready[index] && touched[keys[index]])
      .map((destination) => destination.id);
  }, [form, touched, passwordReady]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => journey.setProgress(readyIds), 180);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [readyIds, journey.setProgress]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (lastStep.current !== step)
      document
        .getElementById(step === 1 ? "register-password" : "register-name")
        ?.focus();
    lastStep.current = step;
  }, [step]);
  if (auth.snapshot.status === "authenticated") return <AuthenticatedState />;
  const update = (key: keyof typeof form, value: string | number) => {
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
    setTouched((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: true }));
    setInvalid(null);
    setError(null);
  };
  const reject = (key: keyof typeof form, message: string, id: string) => {
    setInvalid(key);
    setError(message);
    document.getElementById(id)?.focus();
  };
  const back = () => {
    setError(null);
    setInvalid(null);
    setStep(0);
  };
  const submit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (auth.isPending) return;
    setError(null);
    setInvalid(null);
    if (!form.fullName.trim())
      return reject("fullName", label("requiredField"), "register-name");
    if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(form.email.trim()))
      return reject("email", label("emailInvalid"), "register-email");
    if (!form.batch.trim())
      return reject("batch", label("requiredField"), "register-batch");
    if (step === 0) {
      setTouched((current) => ({ ...current, batch: true, year: true }));
      setStep(1);
      return;
    }
    if (!passwordReady)
      return reject("password", label("passwordRules"), "register-password");
    if (form.password !== form.confirm)
      return reject("confirm", label("passwordMismatch"), "register-confirm");
    journey.finishRestoration();
    try {
      await auth.register({
        fullName: form.fullName,
        email: form.email.trim(),
        password: form.password,
        year: form.year,
        batch: form.batch,
      });
      navigate(`${routes.verify}?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(returnTo)}`, {
        replace: true,
      });
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(label(authErrorKey(caught)));
    }
  };
  const described = (key: keyof typeof form) =>
    invalid === key ? "register-error" : undefined;
  return (
    <section
      className="auth-panel auth-register-panel"
      data-auth-step={step + 1}
    >
      <div className="auth-panel-heading">
        <p className="auth-eyebrow">
          <UserRoundPlus />
          {label("createAccount")}
        </p>
        <h2>{label("registerTitle")}</h2>
        <p>{label("registerBody")}</p>
      </div>
      <ol
        className="auth-registration-steps"
        aria-label={t({
          en: "Account creation steps",
          ar: "خطوات إنشاء الحساب",
        })}
      >
        <li>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={back}
            disabled={auth.isPending}
            aria-current={step === 0 ? "step" : undefined}
          >
            <b>01</b>
            {t({ en: "Your details", ar: "بياناتك" })}
          </button>
        </li>
        <li>
          <span aria-current={step === 1 ? "step" : undefined}>
            <b>02</b>
            {t({ en: "Your account", ar: "حسابك" })}
          </span>
        </li>
      </ol>
      <form
        className="auth-form"
        onSubmit={submit}
        noValidate
        aria-busy={auth.isPending}
      >
        {step === 0 ? (
          <div className="auth-step-fields" key="details">
            <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="register-name">
              <span>{label("fullName")}</span>
              <input
                id="register-name"
                autoComplete="name"
                value={form.fullName}
                onChange={(event) => update("fullName", event.target.value)}
                required
                aria-invalid={invalid === "fullName" || undefined}
                aria-describedby={described("fullName")}
              />
            </label>
            <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="register-email">
              <span>{label("email")}</span>
              <input
                id="register-email"
                type="email"
                dir="ltr"
                inputMode="email"
                autoComplete="email"
                value={form.email}
                onChange={(event) => update("email", event.target.value)}
                required
                aria-invalid={invalid === "email" || undefined}
                aria-describedby={described("email")}
              />
            </label>
            <div className="auth-field-pair">
              <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="register-batch">
                <span>{label("batchName")}</span>
                <input
                  id="register-batch"
                  value={form.batch}
                  onBlur={() =>
                    setTouched((current) => ({ ...current, batch: true }))
                  }
                  onChange={(event) => update("batch", event.target.value)}
                  required
                  aria-invalid={invalid === "batch" || undefined}
                  aria-describedby={described("batch")}
                />
              </label>
              <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="register-year">
                <span>{label("studyYear")}</span>
                <select
                  id="register-year"
                  value={form.year}
                  onBlur={() =>
                    setTouched((current) => ({ ...current, year: true }))
                  }
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    update("year", Number(event.target.value))
                  }
                >
                  {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((year) => (
                    <option key={year} value={year}>
                      {label("year")} {year}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="auth-step-fields" key="account">
            <div className="auth-account-summary">
              <div>
                <strong>{form.fullName}</strong>
                <small dir="ltr">{form.email}</small>
              </div>
              <button type="button" onClick={back} disabled={auth.isPending}>
                {t({ en: "Edit", ar: "تعديل" })}
              </button>
            </div>
            <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="register-password">
              <span>{label("password")}</span>
              <span className="auth-password-field">
                <input
                  id="register-password"
                  type={visible ? "text" : "password"}
                  dir="ltr"
                  autoComplete="new-password"
                  value={form.password}
                  onChange={(event) => update("password", event.target.value)}
                  required
                  aria-invalid={invalid === "password" || undefined}
                  aria-describedby={
                    invalid === "password"
                      ? "password-rules register-error"
                      : "password-rules"
                  }
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setVisible((value) => !value)}
                  aria-label={label(visible ? "hidePassword" : "showPassword")}
                  aria-pressed={visible}
                >
                  {visible ? <EyeOff /> : <Eye />}
                </button>
              </span>
              <small
                id="password-rules"
                data-ready={passwordReady || undefined}
              >
                {label("passwordRules")}
              </small>
            </label>
            <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="register-confirm">
              <span>{label("confirmPassword")}</span>
              <input
                id="register-confirm"
                type={visible ? "text" : "password"}
                dir="ltr"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                value={form.confirm}
                onChange={(event) => update("confirm", event.target.value)}
                required
                aria-invalid={invalid === "confirm" || undefined}
                aria-describedby={described("confirm")}
              />
            </label>
          </div>
        )}
        {error && (
          <p id="register-error" className="auth-form-error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <Button
          type="submit"
          disabled={auth.isPending}
          className="button button-primary auth-submit"
          onPointerEnter={() => { if (step === 1 && readyIds.length === 6) journey.finishRestoration(); }}
          onFocus={() => { if (step === 1 && readyIds.length === 6) journey.finishRestoration(); }}
        >
          {auth.isPending
            ? label("creatingAccount")
            : step === 0
              ? t({ en: "Continue", ar: "متابعة" })
              : label("createAccount")}
          <ArrowRight size={18} className="directional" />
        </Button>
        {step === 1 && (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="auth-step-back"
            onClick={back}
            disabled={auth.isPending}
          >
            {t({ en: "Back to your details", ar: "العودة إلى بياناتك" })}
          </button>
        )}
      </form>
      <p className="auth-switch">
        {label("alreadyAccount")}{" "}
        <AppLink
          href={`${routes.signIn}?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(returnTo)}`}
        >
          {label("signIn")}
        </AppLink>
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { ArrowRight, Eye, EyeOff, KeyRound, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { PREVIEW_CREDENTIALS } from "../../services/local-auth.service";
import { authErrorKey, safeReturnTo } from "../../lib/auth";
import { routes } from "../../constants/routes";
import { AuthenticatedState } from "./AuthenticatedState";
import { useAuthJourney } from "./AuthJourney";

export default function SignInPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const journey = useAuthJourney();
  const [welcoming, setWelcoming] = useState(false);
  const mounted = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    mounted.current = true;
    return () => {
      mounted.current = false;
    };
  }, []);
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [search] = useSearchParams();
  const returnTo = safeReturnTo(search.get("returnTo"));
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (auth.snapshot.status === "authenticated" && !welcoming)
    return <AuthenticatedState />;

  const submit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (auth.isPending || welcoming) return;
    setError(null);
    if (!email.trim() || !password) {
      setError(label("requiredField"));
      return;
    }
    if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email.trim())) {
      setError(label("emailInvalid"));
      document.getElementById("auth-email")?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setWelcoming(true);
    const welcome = journey.startWelcome();
    try {
      await auth.signIn({ email, password });
      await welcome;
      if (mounted.current) navigate(returnTo, { replace: true });
    } catch (caught) {
      journey.stopWelcome();
      if (mounted.current) setError(label(authErrorKey(caught)));
    } finally {
      if (mounted.current) setWelcoming(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="auth-panel">
      <div className="auth-panel-heading">
        <p className="auth-eyebrow">
          <Sparkles />
          {label("signIn")}
        </p>
        <h2>{label("signInTitle")}</h2>
        <p>{label("signInBody")}</p>
      </div>
      <form
        className="auth-form"
        onSubmit={submit}
        noValidate
        aria-busy={auth.isPending || welcoming}
      >
        <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="auth-email">
          <span>{label("email")}</span>
          <input
            id="auth-email"
            type="email"
            dir="ltr"
            inputMode="email"
            autoComplete="email"
            value={email}
            onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
            required
            aria-describedby={error ? "signin-error" : undefined}
          />
        </label>
        <label className="auth-field" htmlFor="auth-password">
          <span>{label("password")}</span>
          <span className="auth-password-field">
            <input
              id="auth-password"
              type={visible ? "text" : "password"}
              autoComplete="current-password"
              dir="ltr"
              value={password}
              onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
              required
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setVisible((value) => !value)}
              aria-label={label(visible ? "hidePassword" : "showPassword")}
              aria-pressed={visible}
            >
              {visible ? <EyeOff /> : <Eye />}
            </button>
          </span>
        </label>
        <div className="auth-form-between">
          <AppLink href={routes.recover}>{label("forgotPassword")}</AppLink>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="auth-demo-fill"
            onClick={() => {
              setEmail(PREVIEW_CREDENTIALS.email);
              setPassword(PREVIEW_CREDENTIALS.password);
              setError(null);
            }}
          >
            <KeyRound />
            {label("useDemoCredentials")}
          </button>
        </div>
        {error && (
          <p id="signin-error" className="auth-form-error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <Button
          type="submit"
          disabled={auth.isPending || welcoming}
          className="button button-primary auth-submit"
        >
          {auth.isPending || welcoming ? label("signingIn") : label("signIn")}
          <ArrowRight size={18} className="directional" />
        </Button>
      </form>
      <p className="auth-demo-hint">{label("demoCredentialHint")}</p>
      <p className="auth-switch">
        {label("newHere")}{" "}
        <AppLink
          href={`${routes.register}?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(returnTo)}`}
        >
          {label("createAccount")}
        </AppLink>
      </p>
      <details className="auth-boundary-note">
        <summary>{label("authPreview")}</summary>
        <span>{label("authPreviewBody")}</span>
      </details>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/auth/VerifyPage.tsx
============================================================
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { BadgeCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { authErrorKey, safeReturnTo } from "../../lib/auth";
import { routes } from "../../constants/routes";
import { AuthenticatedState } from "./AuthenticatedState";

export default function VerifyPage() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [search] = useSearchParams();
  const returnTo = safeReturnTo(search.get("returnTo"));
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (auth.snapshot.status === "authenticated") return <AuthenticatedState />;

  const submit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (auth.isPending || code.length !== 6) return;
    setError(null);
    try {
      await auth.verifyEmail(code);
      navigate(returnTo, { replace: true });
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(label(authErrorKey(caught)));
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="auth-panel auth-verify-panel">
      <div className="auth-panel-heading">
        <p className="auth-eyebrow">
          <BadgeCheck />
          {label("verificationCode")}
        </p>
        <h2>{label("verifyTitle")}</h2>
        <p>
          {label("verifyBody")}{" "}
          <strong>{auth.snapshot.pendingEmail || "—"}</strong>
        </p>
      </div>
      <form className="auth-form" onSubmit={submit} aria-busy={auth.isPending}>
        <label
          className="auth-field auth-code-field"
          htmlFor="verification-code"
        >
          <span>{label("verificationCode")}</span>
          <input
            id="verification-code"
            aria-label={label("verificationCode")}
            inputMode="numeric"
            dir="ltr"
            autoComplete="one-time-code"
            maxLength={6}
            value={code}
            onChange={(event) => setCode(event.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ""))}
          />
          <small>{label("previewCode")}</small>
        </label>
        {error && (
          <p className="auth-form-error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <Button
          type="submit"
          disabled={auth.isPending || code.length !== 6}
          className="button button-primary auth-submit"
        >
          {auth.isPending ? label("verifying") : label("verifyEmail")}
        </Button>
      </form>
      <p className="auth-switch">
        <AppLink href={routes.register}>{label("createAccount")}</AppLink>
        <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
        <AppLink href={routes.signIn}>{label("backToSignIn")}</AppLink>
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/calendar/CalendarPage.tsx
============================================================
import { useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import {
  CalendarDays,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Plus,
  Clock3,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { SelectField } from "../../components/forms/SelectField";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import {
  calendarDate,
  dateAtNoon,
  monthDays,
  shiftDay,
  shiftMonth,
} from "../../lib/calendar";
import { DEMO_TODAY } from "../../constants/config";
import { useCalendar } from "./useCalendar";
import { StudyEditor } from "./StudyEditor";
import type { CalendarItem, StudyEntry } from "../../types/workspace";
export const calendarKindLabels = {
  study: "studyBlock",
  exam: "examDate",
  event: "savedEvent",
  deadline: "deadlineDate",
  mentorship: "mentorship",
  recruitment: "recruitment",
} as const;
export default function CalendarPage() {
  const { label, t, locale, dir } = useLocale();
  const workspace = useWorkspace(),
    calendar = useCalendar();
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(DEMO_TODAY.slice(0, 7)),
    [day, setDay] = useState<string | null>(DEMO_TODAY);
  const [view, setView] = useState<"month" | "agenda">("month"),
    [kind, setKind] = useState("");
  const [editor, setEditor] = useState<{
      day: string;
      entry?: StudyEntry;
    } | null>(null),
    [detail, setDetail] = useState<CalendarItem | null>(null);
  if (calendar.isError) return <ErrorState retry={calendar.retry} />;
  if (calendar.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  const visible = calendar.items.filter(
    (i) =>
      (!kind || kind === i.kind) && calendarDate(i.startsAt).startsWith(month),
  );
  const selectedItems = visible.filter(
    (i) => !day || calendarDate(i.startsAt) === day,
  );
  const days = monthDays(month);
  const moveMonth = (count: number) => {
    setMonth(shiftMonth(month, count));
    setDay(null);
  };
  function moveFocus(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, date: string) {
    let target: string | undefined;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight") target = shiftDay(date, dir === "rtl" ? -1 : 1);
    if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") target = shiftDay(date, dir === "rtl" ? 1 : -1);
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") target = shiftDay(date, 7);
    if (e.key === "ArrowUp") target = shiftDay(date, -7);
    if (e.key === "Home")
      target = shiftDay(
        date,
        -((new Date(dateAtNoon(date)).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7),
      );
    if (e.key === "End")
      target = shiftDay(
        date,
        6 - ((new Date(dateAtNoon(date)).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7),
      );
    if (!target) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    setDay(target);
    setMonth(target.slice(0, 7));
    requestAnimationFrame(() =>
      document
        .querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(
          `button[data-calendar-date="${target}"]`,
        )
        ?.focus(),
    );
  }
  const openItem = (item: CalendarItem) => {
    if (item.kind === "study")
      setEditor({
        day: calendarDate(item.startsAt),
        entry: workspace.state.studyEntries.find((e) => e.id === item.id),
      });
    else setDetail(item);
  };
  return (
    <div className="container calendar-v3">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("calendarEyebrow")}
        title={label("calendarTitle")}
        description={label("calendarDescription")}
      />
      <div className="calendar-toolbar">
        <div className="calendar-month-controls">
          <button
            className="workspace-icon"
            aria-label={label("previousMonth")}
            onClick={() => moveMonth(-1)}
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="directional" size={20} />
          </button>
          <h2 aria-live="polite">
            {formatDate(dateAtNoon(month + "-01"), locale, {
              month: "long",
              year: "numeric",
            })}
          </h2>
          <button
            className="workspace-icon"
            aria-label={label("nextMonth")}
            onClick={() => moveMonth(1)}
          >
            <ChevronRight className="directional" size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="calendar-toolbar-actions">
          <button
            className="quiet-button"
            onClick={() => {
              setMonth(DEMO_TODAY.slice(0, 7));
              setDay(DEMO_TODAY);
            }}
          >
            {label("today")}
          </button>
          <div className="segmented-pills" aria-label={label("calendar")}>
            {(["month", "agenda"] as const).map((v) => (
              <button
                key={v}
                aria-pressed={view === v}
                onClick={() => {
                  setView(v);
                  setDay(null);
                }}
              >
                {label(v === "agenda" ? "calendarAgenda" : v)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <Button
            className="button button-primary"
            onClick={() => setEditor({ day: day || month + "-01" })}
          >
            <Plus size={17} />
            {label("addStudy")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="calendar-legend">
        <SelectField
          label={label("searchType")}
          value={kind}
          onChange={(e) => setKind(e.target.value)}
        >
          <option value="">{label("allTypes")}</option>
          {Object.entries(calendarKindLabels).map(([key, value]) => (
            <option key={key} value={key}>
              {label(value)}
            </option>
          ))}
        </SelectField>
        <div>
          {Object.entries(calendarKindLabels).map(([key, value]) => (
            <span key={key}>
              <i data-kind={key} />
              {label(value)}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div
        className={
          view === "month"
            ? "calendar-workbench"
            : "calendar-workbench agenda-only"
        }
      >
        {view === "month" && (
          <div className="calendar-board">
            <table className="month-grid">
              <caption className="sr-only">
                {formatDate(dateAtNoon(month + "-01"), locale, {
                  month: "long",
                  year: "numeric",
                })}
              </caption>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  {days.slice(0, 7).map((d) => (
                    <th scope="col" key={d}>
                      {formatDate(dateAtNoon(d), locale, { weekday: "short" })}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, row) => (
                  <tr key={row}>
                    {days.slice(row * 7, row * 7 + 7).map((date) => {
                      const entries = calendar.items.filter(
                        (i) =>
                          (!kind || kind === i.kind) &&
                          calendarDate(i.startsAt) === date,
                      );
                      return (
                        <td key={date}>
                          <button
                            data-calendar-date={date}
                            data-outside={!date.startsWith(month)}
                            data-today={date === DEMO_TODAY}
                            aria-pressed={day === date}
                            tabIndex={date === (day || month + "-01") ? 0 : -1}
                            aria-label={`${formatDate(dateAtNoon(date), locale, { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric" })}, ${entries.length} ${label("calendar")}`}
                            onKeyDown={(e) => moveFocus(e, date)}
                            onClick={() => {
                              setDay(date);
                              setMonth(date.slice(0, 7));
                            }}
                          >
                            <span>
                              {new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(
                                Number(date.slice(-2)),
                              )}
                            </span>
                            <div className="day-markers" aria-hidden="true">
                              {entries.slice(0, 3).map((item) => (
                                <i key={item.id} data-kind={item.kind} />
                              ))}
                              {entries.length > 3 && <small>+</small>}
                            </div>
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
            <p className="workspace-note">{label("timezoneNote")}</p>
          </div>
        )}
        <section className="day-agenda">
          <div className="agenda-heading">
            <CalendarDays size={21} />
            <h3>
              {day
                ? formatDate(dateAtNoon(day), locale, {
                    weekday: "long",
                    day: "numeric",
                    month: "short",
                  })
                : label("calendarAgenda")}
            </h3>
            {day && (
              <button className="quiet-button" onClick={() => setDay(null)}>
                {label("clearDayFilter")}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          {(view === "month" ? selectedItems : visible).map((item) => (
            <button
              key={item.id}
              className="agenda-entry"
              data-kind={item.kind}
              data-study-entry-id={item.id}
              onClick={() => openItem(item)}
            >
              <span className="agenda-date">
                {formatDate(item.startsAt, locale, {
                  day: "numeric",
                  month: "short",
                })}
              </span>
              <span className="agenda-copy">
                <small>{label(calendarKindLabels[item.kind])}</small>
                <strong>{t(item.title)}</strong>
                <span>
                  <Clock3 size={13} />
                  {formatDate(item.startsAt, locale, {
                    hour: "2-digit",
                    minute: "2-digit",
                  })}
                  {item.endsAt &&
                    ` – ${formatDate(item.endsAt, locale, { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}`}
                </span>
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
          {!(view === "month" ? selectedItems : visible).length && (
            <div className="agenda-empty">
              <CalendarDays size={34} />
              <p>{label(day ? "noDayItems" : "noMonthItems")}</p>
              <button
                className="text-link"
                onClick={() => setEditor({ day: day || month + "-01" })}
              >
                {label("addStudy")} <Plus size={15} />
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
      <p className="workspace-note">{label("calendarSampleNote")}</p>
      {editor && (
        <StudyEditor
          day={editor.day}
          entry={editor.entry}
          close={() => setEditor(null)}
        />
      )}
      {detail && (
        <Modal
          open
          onClose={() => setDetail(null)}
          title={t(detail.title)}
          description={t(detail.description)}
        >
          <p>
            {formatDate(detail.startsAt, locale, {
              dateStyle: "full",
              timeStyle: "short",
            })}
          </p>
          <p className="workspace-note">{label("calendarSampleNote")}</p>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/calendar/README.md

# Calendar — V0.3

Implemented at /my/calendar: month/agenda views, illustrative course dates, saved events/deadlines, and personal study block creation, editing and deletion. Keyboard arrows move the date cursor. All displayed times use Amman time.

useCalendar composes service records with workspace state. Data models live in types/workspace.ts; date composition lives in lib/calendar.ts. The stable demo anchor is constants/config.ts. There is no registration engine or background alert delivery.
