FILE: src/features/calendar/StudyEditor.tsx
============================================================
import { throwToTrash } from "../../components/feedback/action-flight";
import { useState } from "react";
import { createRecordId } from "../../lib/record-id";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { useCourses, useStudentProfile } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { SelectField } from "../../components/forms/SelectField";
import { validStudyEntry } from "../../lib/workspace-state";
import type { StudyEntry } from "../../types/workspace";
export function StudyEditor({
  entry,
  day,
  close,
}: {
  entry?: StudyEntry;
  day: string;
  close: () => void;
}) {
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const { send } = useWorkspace();
  const courses = useCourses(),
    profile = useStudentProfile();
  const [form, setForm] = useState<StudyEntry>(
    () =>
      entry || {
        id: createRecordId(),
        title: "",
        date: day,
        time: "16:00",
        durationMinutes: 25,
        notes: "",
      },
  );
  const [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  async function save() {
    if (!validStudyEntry(form)) {
      setError(label("entryInvalid"));
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await send({ type: "upsert-study", entry: form });
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) close();
  }
  return (
    <Modal
      open
      onClose={close}
      title={label(deleting ? "deleteStudy" : entry ? "editStudy" : "addStudy")}
      description={label(deleting ? "deleteStudyBody" : "timezoneNote")}
    >
      {deleting ? (
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDeleting(false)}>
            {label("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={async () => {
              setBusy(true);
              const source =
                [
                  ...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
                    "[data-study-entry-id]",
                  ),
                ].find((row) => row.dataset.studyEntryId === form.id) || null;
              await throwToTrash(source, form.title).finished;
              if (await send({ type: "delete-study", id: form.id })) close();
              setBusy(false);
            }}
          >
            {label("delete")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form
          className="workspace-form"
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            void save();
          }}
        >
          <label className="workspace-field">
            <span>{label("entryTitle")}</span>
            <input
              required
              maxLength={100}
              value={form.title}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })}
            />
          </label>
          <div className="form-pair">
            <label className="workspace-field">
              <span>{label("entryDate")}</span>
              <input
                required
                type="date"
                value={form.date}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, date: e.target.value })}
              />
            </label>
            <label className="workspace-field">
              <span>{label("entryTime")}</span>
              <input
                required
                type="time"
                value={form.time}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, time: e.target.value })}
              />
            </label>
          </div>
          <div className="form-pair">
            <label className="workspace-field">
              <span>{label("entryDuration")}</span>
              <input
                required
                type="number"
                min={5}
                max={480}
                step={1}
                value={form.durationMinutes}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setForm({ ...form, durationMinutes: Number(e.target.value) })
                }
              />
            </label>
            <SelectField
              label={label("courseOptional")}
              value={form.courseId || ""}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setForm({ ...form, courseId: e.target.value || undefined })
              }
            >
              <option value="">{label("noCourse")}</option>
              {courses.data
                ?.filter((c) => profile.data?.courseIds.includes(c.id))
                .map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                    {t(c.title)}
                  </option>
                ))}
            </SelectField>
          </div>
          <label className="workspace-field">
            <span>{label("entryNotes")}</span>
            <textarea
              maxLength={500}
              value={form.notes}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, notes: e.target.value })}
            />
          </label>
          {error && (
            <p className="field-error" role="alert">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="workspace-form-actions">
            {entry && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="quiet-button danger-text"
                onClick={() => setDeleting(true)}
              >
                {label("delete")}
              </button>
            )}
            <Button variant="outline" type="button" onClick={close}>
              {label("cancel")}
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={busy}
              className="button button-primary"
            >
              {label("saveChanges")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/campus/CampusScene.tsx
============================================================
import { useAppearance } from "../../app/providers/AppearanceProvider";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { campusDestinations, type CampusMode } from "./campus-state";
import type { CampusController } from "./campus-renderer";
import activePoster from "../../assets/campus/campus-active.webp";
import dormantPoster from "../../assets/campus/campus-dormant.webp";
import "./campus.css";

export function CampusScene({
  mode = "active",
  links = true,
}: {
  mode?: CampusMode;
  links?: boolean;
}) {
  const { locale } = useLocale();
  const { resolvedTheme } = useAppearance();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const ar = locale === "ar";
  const stage = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const canvas = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const controller = useRef<CampusController | null>(null);
  const inView = useRef(false);
  const [requested, setRequested] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<
    "poster" | "loading" | "ready" | "failed"
  >("poster");
  const [motion, setMotion] = useState(true);
  const [eveningOverride, setEvening] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const evening = resolvedTheme === "dark" || eveningOverride === true;
  const eveningRef = useRef(evening);
  eveningRef.current = evening;
  useEffect(() => setEvening(null), [resolvedTheme]);
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(true);
  const [documentVisible, setDocumentVisible] = useState(true);
  const [view, setView] = useState(0);
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);
  const navigateRef = useRef(navigate);
  navigateRef.current = navigate;
  const linksRef = useRef(links);
  linksRef.current = links;

  useEffect(() => {
    const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const economy = (
      navigator as Navigator & { connection?: { saveData?: boolean } }
    ).connection?.saveData;
    const changeMotion = () => {
      if (reduced.matches) setMotion(false);
    };
    changeMotion();
    reduced.addEventListener("change", changeMotion);
    const memory = (navigator as Navigator & { deviceMemory?: number })
      .deviceMemory;
    const eligible = !economy && !reduced.matches && (!memory || memory >= 4);
    const observe = (visible: boolean) => {
      inView.current = visible;
      setVisible(visible);
      controller.current?.setVisible(visible);
      if (visible && eligible) setRequested(true);
    };
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
      if (typeof WebGLRenderingContext !== "undefined") observe(true);
      return () => reduced.removeEventListener("change", changeMotion);
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => observe(entry.isIntersecting),
      { threshold: 0.05 },
    );
    if (stage.current) observer.observe(stage.current);
    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      reduced.removeEventListener("change", changeMotion);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const changed = () => setDocumentVisible(!document.hidden);
    changed();
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", changed);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", changed);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!requested || !canvas.current) return;
    const abort = new AbortController();
    let instance: CampusController | undefined;
    setStatus("loading");
    import("./campus-renderer")
      .then(({ mountCampus }) => {
        if (abort.signal.aborted || !canvas.current) return;
        return mountCampus(canvas.current, {
          mode,
          signal: abort.signal,
          onChoose: (id) => {
            if (!linksRef.current) return;
            const destination = campusDestinations.find(
              (item) => item.id === id,
            );
            if (destination) navigateRef.current(destination.href);
          },
          onHover: setHovered,
          onFailure: () => {
            if (!abort.signal.aborted) setStatus("failed");
          },
        });
      })
      .then((value) => {
        if (!value) return;
        if (abort.signal.aborted) {
          value.dispose();
          return;
        }
        instance = value;
        controller.current = value;
        value.setEvening(eveningRef.current);
        value.setVisible(inView.current);
        setStatus("ready");
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!abort.signal.aborted) setStatus("failed");
      });
    return () => {
      abort.abort();
      instance?.dispose();
      controller.current = null;
    };
  }, [requested, mode, attempt]);

  useEffect(() => {
    controller.current?.setMotion(motion && mode === "active");
  }, [motion, status, mode]);
  useEffect(() => {
    controller.current?.setView(view);
  }, [view, status]);
  useEffect(() => {
    controller.current?.setEvening(evening);
  }, [evening, status]);
  const selected = campusDestinations.find((item) => item.id === hovered);
  const highlight = (id: string | null) => {
    setHovered(id);
    controller.current?.highlight(id);
  };
  const title =
    mode === "active"
      ? ar
        ? "حرم ميدكلب: ستة مجالات يجمعها مجتمع واحد"
        : "MedClub campus: six spaces, one community"
      : ar
        ? "حرمك في البداية: مبانٍ هادئة تنتظر أولى خطواتك"
        : "Your starting campus: quiet buildings awaiting your first steps";
  return (
    <div
      className="campus-scene"
      data-campus-mode={mode}
      data-campus-status={status}
      data-campus-light={evening ? "evening" : "golden"}
      data-campus-moving={
        mode === "active" && motion && visible && documentVisible
      }
    >
      <div className="campus-stage" ref={stage}>
        <img
          className="campus-poster"
          src={mode === "active" ? activePoster : dormantPoster}
          alt={title}
          width={1600}
          height={900}
          fetchPriority="high"
        />
        {mode === "active" && (
          <div className="campus-atmosphere" aria-hidden="true">
            <i className="campus-sun" />
            <i className="campus-warmth" />
          </div>
        )}
        <canvas
          key={`${mode}-${attempt}`}
          ref={canvas}
          className="campus-canvas"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
        <div
          className="campus-controls"
          role="group"
          aria-label={ar ? "عرض الحرم" : "Campus view"}
        >
          {status !== "ready" ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={status === "loading"}
              onClick={() => {
                setRequested(true);
                setAttempt((a) => a + 1);
              }}
            >
              {status === "loading"
                ? ar
                  ? "جارٍ فتح الحرم…"
                  : "Opening campus…"
                : status === "failed"
                  ? ar
                    ? "إعادة محاولة العرض الثلاثي"
                    : "Retry 3D"
                  : ar
                    ? "استكشف بالعرض الثلاثي"
                    : "Explore in 3D"}
            </button>
          ) : (
            <>
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={ar ? "عرض من اليسار" : "View from the left"}
                disabled={view <= -2}
                onClick={() => setView((v) => v - 1)}
              >
                ←
              </button>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setView(0)}>
                {ar ? "توسيط" : "Center"}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={ar ? "عرض من اليمين" : "View from the right"}
                disabled={view >= 2}
                onClick={() => setView((v) => v + 1)}
              >
                →
              </button>
              {mode === "active" && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-pressed={evening}
                  disabled={resolvedTheme === "dark"}
                  title={
                    resolvedTheme === "dark"
                      ? ar
                        ? "الإضاءة تتبع المظهر الداكن"
                        : "Lighting follows dark mode"
                      : undefined
                  }
                  onClick={() => setEvening(!evening)}
                >
                  {ar ? "أضواء المساء" : "Evening lights"}
                </button>
              )}
            </>
          )}
          {mode === "active" && (
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-pressed={!motion}
              onClick={() => setMotion((value) => !value)}
            >
              {motion
                ? ar
                  ? "إيقاف الحركة"
                  : "Pause motion"
                : ar
                  ? "تشغيل الحركة"
                  : "Play motion"}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        {links && (
          <span className="campus-explore-hint">
            {selected
              ? selected[locale]
              : ar
                ? "اختر مبنى وابدأ الاستكشاف"
                : "Choose a building. Find your place."}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className="campus-state-label">
          {mode === "active"
            ? ar
              ? "حرمك. ينبض بالحياة."
              : "Your campus, brought to life."
            : ar
              ? "مساحة لبدايتك"
              : "Room for your beginning"}
        </span>
        <span className="sr-only" role="status">
          {status === "failed"
            ? ar
              ? "العرض الثلاثي غير متاح. معاينة الحرم ظاهرة."
              : "3D is unavailable. The campus preview remains visible."
            : ""}
        </span>
      </div>
      {links && (
        <nav
          className="campus-destinations"
          aria-label={ar ? "مساحات الحرم" : "Campus destinations"}
        >
          {campusDestinations.map((item, i) => (
            <AppLink
              key={item.id}
              href={item.href}
              data-highlighted={hovered === item.id || undefined}
              onMouseEnter={() => highlight(item.id)}
              onMouseLeave={() => highlight(null)}
              onFocus={() => highlight(item.id)}
              onBlur={() => highlight(null)}
            >
              <span aria-hidden="true">0{i + 1}</span>
              {item[locale]}
              <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
            </AppLink>
          ))}
        </nav>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/community/AboutPage.tsx

import { BookOpenCheck, HeartHandshake, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { CommunityNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/CommunityNavigation";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { Notice } from "../../components/feedback/Notice";
import { useClubValues } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import logo from "../../assets/brand/medclub-logo.png";

const icons = [BookOpenCheck, HeartHandshake, ShieldCheck];

export default function AboutPage() {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const query = useClubValues();
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  return (
    <div className="community-v5 community-index-page about-community-page container">
      <CommunityNavigation />
      <header className="community-page-intro about-intro">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("aboutEyebrow")}</span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {label("aboutTitle")}
          </h1>
          <p>{label("aboutBody")}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="about-logo-orbit" aria-hidden="true">
          <i />
          <i />
          <span>

FILE: src/features/community/ActivitiesPage.tsx

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Activity,
  HeartPulse,
  Search,
  Stethoscope,
  UsersRound,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { CommunityActivityCard } from "../../components/cards/CommunityActivityCard";
import { CommunityNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/CommunityNavigation";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { useCommunityActivities } from "../../hooks/useContent";

type View =
  "all" | "health-campaign" | "peer-learning" | "volunteering" | "student-life";

export default function ActivitiesPage() {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const query = useCommunityActivities();
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const activities = query.data || [];
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    return activities.filter(
      (item) =>
        (view === "all" || item.kind === view) &&
        (!needle ||
          [t(item.title), t(item.summary), t(item.location)].some((value) =>
            value.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle),
          )),
    );
  }, [activities, search, t, view]);
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  const tabs = [
    {
      id: "all",
      label: label("allActivities"),
      icon: Activity,
      count: activities.length,
    },
    {
      id: "health-campaign",
      label: label("healthCampaign"),
      icon: HeartPulse,
      count: activities.filter((item) => item.kind === "health-campaign")
        .length,
    },
    {
      id: "peer-learning",
      label: label("peerLearning"),
      icon: Stethoscope,
      count: activities.filter((item) => item.kind === "peer-learning").length,
    },
    {
      id: "volunteering",
      label: label("volunteering"),
      icon: UsersRound,
      count: activities.filter((item) => item.kind === "volunteering").length,
    },
  ] as const;
  return (
    <div className="community-v5 community-index-page container">
      <CommunityNavigation />
      <header className="community-page-intro">
        <span className="eyebrow">{label("activitiesEyebrow")}</span>
        <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
          {label("activitiesTitle")}
        </h1>
        <p>{label("activitiesBody")}</p>
      </header>
      <section
        className="community-filter-panel"
        aria-label={label("activityFilters")}
      >
        <AliveTabs
          label={label("activityFilters")}
          items={[...tabs]}
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
        />
        <label className="community-search">
          <Search size={18} />
          <span className="sr-only">{label("activityFilters")}</span>
          <input
            value={search}
            onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
            placeholder={label("searchSomething")}
          />
        </label>
      </section>
      <p className="community-results" role="status">
        <strong>{filtered.length}</strong> {label("results")}
      </p>
      {filtered.length ? (
        <div className="community-activity-grid">
          {filtered.map((item) => (
            <CommunityActivityCard key={item.id} activity={item} />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState title={label("noActivityResults")} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { Clock, ShieldCheck, UserRound } from "lucide-react";

FILE: src/features/community/CommunityOverview.tsx

import {
  Activity,
  Newspaper,
  UsersRound,
  CalendarDays,
  ArrowUpRight,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useServices } from "../../app/providers/ServicesProvider";
import {
  useCommunityActivities,
  useJournal,
  useRecruitmentPositions,
  useEvents,
} from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { routes, eventPath } from "../../constants/routes";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import { summarizeCommunity } from "./community-summary";

export function CommunityOverview() {
  const { t, locale, label } = useLocale();
  const { contentSnapshot } = useServices();
  const activities = useCommunityActivities(),
    articles = useJournal(),
    roles = useRecruitmentPositions(),
    events = useEvents();
  const queries = [activities, articles, roles, events];
  const pending = queries.some((q) => q.isPending),
    failed = queries.some((q) => q.isError);
  const supplied = contentSnapshot?.asOf
    ? Date.parse(contentSnapshot.asOf)
    : NaN;
  const at = Number.isFinite(supplied) ? supplied : Date.now();
  const snapshot = summarizeCommunity(
    activities.data ?? [],
    articles.data ?? [],
    roles.data ?? [],
    events.data ?? [],
    at,
  );
  const title = t({ en: "Community at a glance", ar: "المجتمع في لمحة" });
  const stats = [
    {
      key: "activities",
      value: snapshot.activities,
      title: t({ en: "Activities", ar: "أنشطة" }),
      Icon: Activity,
      href: routes.activities,
      tone: "teal",
    },
    {
      key: "publications",
      value: snapshot.publications,
      title: t({ en: "Journal publications", ar: "منشورات المجلة" }),
      Icon: Newspaper,
      href: routes.journal,
      tone: "blue",
    },
    {
      key: "roles",
      value: snapshot.openRoles,
      title: t({ en: "Open team roles", ar: "فرص الانضمام للفريق" }),
      Icon: UsersRound,
      href: routes.recruitment,
      tone: "violet",
    },
  ];
  return (
    <aside
      className="community-overview"
      aria-label={title}
      aria-busy={pending}
    >
      <div className="community-overview-heading">
        <h2>{title}</h2>
        <p>
          {t(
            contentSnapshot?.kind === "sample"
              ? { en: "Preview records", ar: "سجلات توضيحية" }
              : { en: "Available content", ar: "المحتوى المتاح" },
          )}
          {" · "}
          {t({ en: "As of", ar: "بتاريخ" })}{" "}
          <time dateTime={new Date(at).toISOString()}>
            {formatDate(new Date(at).toISOString(), locale, {
              day: "numeric",
              month: "short",
              year: "numeric",
            })}
          </time>
        </p>
      </div>
      {failed ? (
        <div className="community-overview-message" role="alert">
          <p>
            {t({
              en: "The overview could not be loaded. Please try again.",
              ar: "تعذّر تحميل الملخص. يرجى المحاولة مجددًا.",
            })}
          </p>
          <button
            className="text-link"
            onClick={() => queries.forEach((q) => void q.refetch())}
          >
            {label("retry")}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : pending ? (
        <p className="community-overview-message" role="status">
          {label("loading")}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <dl className="community-overview-stats">
            {stats.map(({ key, value, title, Icon, href, tone }) => (
              <div key={key} data-tone={tone}>
                <dt>
                  <Icon size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
                  <AppLink href={href}>{title}</AppLink>
                </dt>
                <dd>{value.toLocaleString(locale)}</dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
          <div className="community-next-event" data-tone="amber">
            <span className="community-next-label">
              <CalendarDays size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
              {t({ en: "Next upcoming event", ar: "الفعالية القادمة" })}
            </span>
            {snapshot.nextEvent ? (
              <>
                <h3>
                  <AppLink href={eventPath(snapshot.nextEvent.slug)}>
                    {t(snapshot.nextEvent.title)}
                    <ArrowUpRight
                      size={18}
                      className="directional"
                      aria-hidden="true"
                    />
                  </AppLink>
                </h3>
                <time dateTime={snapshot.nextEvent.startDate}>
                  {formatDate(snapshot.nextEvent.startDate, locale, {
                    day: "numeric",
                    month: "long",
                    hour: "numeric",
                    minute: "2-digit",
                  })}
                </time>
                <p>{t(snapshot.nextEvent.location)}</p>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <h3>
                  {t({
                    en: "No upcoming event scheduled",
                    ar: "لا توجد فعالية قادمة مجدولة",
                  })}
                </h3>
                <AppLink className="text-link" href={routes.events}>
                  {t({ en: "Explore events", ar: "استعرض الفعاليات" })}
                  <ArrowUpRight size={16} className="directional" />
                </AppLink>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </aside>
  );
}

import { ArrowLeft, Clock3, ShieldCheck, UserRound } from "lucide-react";

import { CommunityNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/CommunityNavigation";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";

import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { useArticle, useJournal } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import { articlePath, routes } from "../../constants/routes";

export default function JournalArticlePage() {
  const { slug } = useParams();
  const { t, label, locale } = useLocale();
  const article = useArticle(slug);
  const journal = useJournal();
  if (article.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (article.isError)
    return <ErrorState retry={() => void article.refetch()} />;
  if (!article.data)
    return (
      <div className="community-v5 container article-not-found">

        <AppLink className="button button-primary" href={routes.journal}>
          {label("backToJournal")}
        </AppLink>
      </div>
    );
  const item = article.data;
  const related = (journal.data || [])
    .filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== item.id)
    .slice(0, 2);
  return (
    <article className="community-v5 journal-article-page container">
      <CommunityNavigation />

        <SaveButton id={item.id} title={t(item.title)} />
      </header>
      <div className="journal-byline">

        </span>

          <ShieldCheck size={17} />

            })}

        </span>

      <div className="journal-reading-layout">
        <aside className="reading-signal" aria-hidden="true">

          ))}
          <div className="editorial-note">

FILE: src/features/community/JournalPage.tsx

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  BookOpen,
  HeartHandshake,
  Microscope,
  Search,
  Stethoscope,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { ArticleCard } from "../../components/cards/ArticleCard";
import { CommunityNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/CommunityNavigation";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { useJournal } from "../../hooks/useContent";

type View = "all" | "student-life" | "research" | "clinical" | "community";

export default function JournalPage() {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const query = useJournal();
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const articles = query.data || [];
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    return articles.filter(
      (article) =>
        (view === "all" || article.categoryId === view) &&
        (!needle ||
          [
            t(article.title),
            t(article.excerpt),
            t(article.author),
            ...article.tags.map(t),
          ].some((value) => value.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle))),
    );
  }, [articles, search, t, view]);
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  const tabs = [
    {
      id: "all",
      label: label("allArticles"),
      icon: BookOpen,
      count: articles.length,
    },
    {
      id: "student-life",
      label: label("studentPerspectives"),
      icon: HeartHandshake,
      count: articles.filter((item) => item.categoryId === "student-life")
        .length,
    },
    {
      id: "research",
      label: label("researchMethods"),
      icon: Microscope,
      count: articles.filter((item) => item.categoryId === "research").length,
    },
    {
      id: "clinical",
      label: label("clinicalLearning"),
      icon: Stethoscope,
      count: articles.filter((item) => item.categoryId === "clinical").length,
    },
  ] as const;
  return (
    <div className="community-v5 journal-page container">

FILE: src/features/contributions/ContributionEditor.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { useCourses } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import type {
  ContributionInput,
  StudentContribution,
} from "../../types/content";

const empty: ContributionInput = {
  kind: "resource",
  title: "",
  topic: "",
  summary: "",
  courseId: undefined,
  sourceUrl: "",
  assetName: "",
  rightsConfirmed: false,
  references: [""],
};
export function ContributionEditor({
  open,
  contribution,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onSave,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  contribution: StudentContribution | null;
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSave: (input: ContributionInput) => Promise<unknown>;
}) {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const courses = useCourses();
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ContributionInput>(empty);
  const [references, setReferences] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    const value = contribution
      ? {
          id: contribution.id,
          kind: contribution.kind,
          title: contribution.title,
          topic: contribution.topic,
          summary: contribution.summary,
          courseId: contribution.courseId,
          sourceUrl: contribution.sourceUrl,
          assetName: contribution.assetName,
          rightsConfirmed: contribution.rightsConfirmed,
          references: contribution.references,
        }
      : empty;
    setForm(value);
    setReferences(value.references.join("\n"));
  }, [contribution, open]);
  const set = <K extends keyof ContributionInput>(
    key: K,
    value: ContributionInput[K],
  ) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
  async function save(event: React.FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const input = {
      ...form,
      references: references
        .split("\n")
        .map((item) => item.trim())
        .filter(Boolean),
    };
    if (
      !input.title.trim() ||
      !input.topic.trim() ||
      !input.summary.trim() ||
      !input.references.length ||
      !input.rightsConfirmed
    ) {
      toast.error(label("contributionIncomplete"));
      return;
    }
    try {
      await onSave(input);
      toast.success(label("draftSaved"));
      onClose();
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("contributionFailed"));
    }
  }
  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={label(contribution ? "editContribution" : "newContribution")}
      description={label("contributionPreviewNotice")}
      className="contribution-editor-modal"
    >
      <form className="contribution-editor" onSubmit={save}>
        <div className="editor-two-column">
          <label>
            <span>{label("contributionKind")}</span>
            <select
              value={form.kind}
              onChange={(event) =>
                set("kind", event.target.value as ContributionInput["kind"])
              }
            >
              <option value="resource">{label("resourceContribution")}</option>
              <option value="article">{label("articleContribution")}</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{label("relatedCourse")}</span>
            <select
              value={form.courseId || ""}
              onChange={(event) =>
                set("courseId", event.target.value || undefined)
              }
            >
              <option value="">{label("noCourse")}</option>
              {courses.data?.map((course) => (
                <option value={course.id} key={course.id}>
                  {t(course.title)}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        <label>
          <span>{label("contributionTitle")}</span>
          <input
            value={form.title}
            onChange={(event) => set("title", event.target.value)}
            required
          />
        </label>
        <label>
          <span>{label("contributionTopic")}</span>
          <input
            value={form.topic}
            onChange={(event) => set("topic", event.target.value)}
            required
          />
        </label>
        <label>
          <span>{label("contributionSummary")}</span>
          <textarea
            value={form.summary}
            onChange={(event) => set("summary", event.target.value)}
            rows={4}
            required
          />
        </label>
        <div className="editor-two-column">
          <label>
            <span>{label("sourceUrl")}</span>
            <input
              type="url"
              value={form.sourceUrl}
              onChange={(event) => set("sourceUrl", event.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{label("assetName")}</span>
            <input
              value={form.assetName}
              onChange={(event) => set("assetName", event.target.value)}
            />
          </label>
        </div>
        <label>
          <span>{label("references")}</span>
          <textarea
            value={references}
            onChange={(event) => setReferences(event.target.value)}
            rows={3}
            placeholder={label("referencePlaceholder")}
            required
          />
        </label>
        <label className="rights-confirmation">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={form.rightsConfirmed}
            onChange={(event) => set("rightsConfirmed", event.target.checked)}
          />
          <span>
            <strong>{label("rightsConfirmed")}</strong>
            <small>{label("rightsBody")}</small>
          </span>
        </label>
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onClose}>
            {label("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button className="button button-primary" disabled={busy}>
            {label("saveDraft")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/contributions/MyContributionsPage.tsx
============================================================
import { throwToTrash } from "../../components/feedback/action-flight";
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock3,
  FileCheck2,
  FilePenLine,
  Plus,
  RotateCcw,
  Send,
  Trash2,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { useContributions } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import type {
  ContributionStatus,
  StudentContribution,
} from "../../types/content";
import { ContributionEditor } from "./ContributionEditor";

type View = "all" | ContributionStatus;
const statusKey = (status: ContributionStatus) =>
  status === "under-review"
    ? ("underReview" as const)
    : status === "changes-requested"
      ? ("changesRequested" as const)
      : status === "published"
        ? ("publishedStatus" as const)
        : status;
export default function MyContributionsPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const contributions = useContributions();
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>("all");
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<StudentContribution | null>(null);
  const [editorOpen, setEditorOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<StudentContribution | null>(null);
  if (contributions.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (contributions.isError) return <ErrorState retry={contributions.retry} />;
  const filtered = contributions.items.filter(
    (item) => view === "all" || item.status === view,
  );
  const tabs = [
    {
      id: "all",
      label: label("allContent"),
      icon: FileCheck2,
      count: contributions.items.length,
    },
    {
      id: "draft",
      label: label("draft"),
      icon: FilePenLine,
      count: contributions.items.filter((item) => item.status === "draft")
        .length,
    },
    {
      id: "under-review",
      label: label("underReview"),
      icon: Clock3,
      count: contributions.items.filter(
        (item) => item.status === "under-review",
      ).length,
    },
    {
      id: "changes-requested",
      label: label("changesRequested"),
      icon: RotateCcw,
      count: contributions.items.filter(
        (item) => item.status === "changes-requested",
      ).length,
    },
    {
      id: "approved",
      label: label("approved"),
      icon: CheckCircle2,
      count: contributions.items.filter((item) => item.status === "approved")
        .length,
    },
  ] as const;
  async function submit(id: string) {
    try {
      await contributions.submit(id);
      toast.success(label("submissionSent"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("contributionFailed"));
    }
  }
  async function remove() {
    if (!deleting) return;
    try {
      const source =
        [
          ...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-contribution-id]"),
        ].find((row) => row.dataset.contributionId === deleting.id) || null;
      await throwToTrash(source, deleting.title).finished;
      await contributions.deleteDraft(deleting.id);
      setDeleting(null);
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("contributionFailed"));
    }
  }
  const openEditor = (item: StudentContribution | null) => {
    setEditing(item);
    setEditorOpen(true);
  };
  return (
    <div className="container contributions-v6 my-contributions-page">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("myContributionsEyebrow")}
        title={label("myContributionsTitle")}
        description={label("myContributionsBody")}
      />
      <div className="contribution-toolbar">
        <AliveTabs
          label={label("status")}
          items={[...tabs]}
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
        />
        <Button
          className="button button-primary"
          onClick={() => openEditor(null)}
        >
          <Plus size={17} />
          {label("newContribution")}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {filtered.length ? (
        <div className="contribution-records">
          {filtered.map((item) => (
            <article
              key={item.id}
              data-status={item.status}
              data-contribution-id={item.id}
            >
              <header>
                <span className="contribution-kind">
                  <FileCheck2 size={17} />
                  {label(
                    item.kind === "resource"
                      ? "resourceContribution"
                      : "articleContribution",
                  )}
                </span>
                <span className="contribution-status">
                  {label(statusKey(item.status))}
                </span>
              </header>
              <h2>{item.title}</h2>
              <p>{item.summary}</p>
              <dl>
                <div>
                  <dt>{label("contributionTopic")}</dt>
                  <dd>{item.topic}</dd>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <dt>{label("updatedOn")}</dt>
                  <dd>{formatDate(item.updatedAt, locale)}</dd>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <dt>{label("references")}</dt>
                  <dd>{item.references.length}</dd>
                </div>
              </dl>
              {item.reviewerFeedback && (
                <aside className="reviewer-feedback">
                  <strong>{label("reviewerFeedback")}</strong>
                  <p>{t(item.reviewerFeedback)}</p>
                  {item.reviewer && <span>{t(item.reviewer)}</span>}
                </aside>
              )}
              <details className="contribution-history">
                <summary>{label("reviewHistory")}</summary>
                <ol>
                  {item.history.map((entry) => (
                    <li key={entry.id} data-status={entry.status}>
                      <i />
                      <div>
                        <strong>{label(statusKey(entry.status))}</strong>
                        <span>
                          {t(entry.note)} · {formatDate(entry.at, locale)}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ol>
              </details>
              <footer>
                {(item.status === "draft" ||
                  item.status === "changes-requested") && (
                  <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => openEditor(item)}>
                    <FilePenLine size={16} />
                    {label(
                      item.status === "changes-requested"
                        ? "editAndResubmit"
                        : "editContribution",
                    )}
                  </Button>
                )}
                {item.status === "draft" && (
                  <>
                    <Button
                      className="button button-primary"
                      disabled={contributions.isMutating}
                      onClick={() => void submit(item.id)}
                    >
                      <Send size={16} />
                      {label("submitForReview")}
                    </Button>
                    <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setDeleting(item)}>
                      <Trash2 size={16} />
                      {label("deleteDraft")}
                    </Button>
                  </>
                )}
              </footer>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          title={label("noContributions")}
          description={label("noContributionsBody")}
        />
      )}
      <p className="v6-boundary-note">{label("contributionPreviewNotice")}</p>
      <ContributionEditor
        open={editorOpen}
        contribution={editing}
        busy={contributions.isMutating}
        onClose={() => setEditorOpen(false)}
        onSave={contributions.saveDraft}
      />
      <Modal
        open={!!deleting}
        onClose={() => setDeleting(null)}
        title={label("deleteDraftTitle")}
        description={label("deleteDraftBody")}
      >
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDeleting(null)}>
            {label("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="destructive" onClick={() => void remove()}>
            {label("deleteDraft")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

Includes student submission, locked review state, requested changes, revision, resubmission and explicit approval/publication separation. Local fixtures demonstrate the workflow; scientific-review authority, immutable history, rights records and publishing permission must be enforced by the production backend.

  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useCallback,
  useMemo,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, Columns2, Focus } from "lucide-react";
import type { Course } from "../../types/content";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useStudyChrome } from "../../app/providers/StudyChromeProvider";
import { useWorkspacePaths } from "../../hooks/useWorkspacePaths";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { AppearanceSettings } from "../../components/navigation/AppearanceSettings";
import { LanguageMenu } from "../../components/navigation/LanguageMenu";
import { CourseShelf } from "./CourseShelf";
import { CourseShelfControls, ShelfPaperControl } from "./ShelfPaperControl";

import { bookMaterial } from "./book-material";
import "../../styles/reader-layout-v1337.css";

export interface CourseDeskControls {
  split: boolean;
  toggleSplit: () => void;
}
const Context = createContext<{
  register: (controls: CourseDeskControls | null) => void;
} | null>(null);
export const useCourseDesk = () => useContext(Context);

/** Chrome survives course changes; the reader and its account/course state do not. */
export function CourseDesk({
  course,
  children,
}: {
  course: Course;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const { dir } = useLocale();
  const { focus } = useStudyChrome();
  const [controls, setControls] = useState<CourseDeskControls | null>(null);
  const register = useCallback(
    (value: CourseDeskControls | null) => setControls(value),
    [],
  );
  const value = useMemo(() => ({ register }), [register]);
  return (
    <Context.Provider value={value}>
      {!focus && (
        <div
          className="study-notebook course-desk-chrome"
          data-course-tone={course.accent}
          data-leather={bookMaterial(course.id)}
          dir={dir}
        >
          <CourseDeskHeader course={course} controls={controls} />
        </div>
      )}
      {children}
    </Context.Provider>
  );
}

import { bookMaterial } from "./book-material";

import { CourseEmptySection } from "./CourseEmptySection";
import "../../styles/course-reading-v1334.css";
import "../../styles/reader-layout-v1337.css";
import { CoursePublisherNotes } from "./CoursePublisherNotes";
import { StudentNotes } from "../utilities/StudentNotes";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { StudyToolsPanel, useStudyTools } from "./StudyTools";
import { SectionTurnPreview } from "./SectionTurnPreview";
import { resourceMediaType } from "./StudyResourceViewer";
import { captureSectionPage, SectionSnapshot } from "./SectionSnapshot";

import type { TurnDirection } from "./page-turn";
import {
  useEffect,

const icons = {
  overview: LayoutDashboard,
  guidance: Lightbulb,
  slides: FileText,
  notes: ClipboardList,
  summary: BookMarked,
  recording: Film,
