export const studySectionKind = (kind: CourseSectionKind): CourseSectionKind =>
  kind === "guidance" || kind === "book" ? "notes" : kind;

export function CourseNotebook({
  course,
  resources,
  storageKey,
  canImportPdfs = false,
  importingPdfs = false,
  pdfImportError = false,
  onImportPdfs,
  onRemoveImportedPdf,
  fileSourcesPending = false,
}: {
  course: Course;
  resources: Resource[];
  storageKey: string;
  canImportPdfs?: boolean;
  importingPdfs?: boolean;
  pdfImportError?: boolean;
  onImportPdfs?: (
    kind: CourseSectionKind,
    files: File[],
    report?: PdfImportReporter,
  ) => Promise<string[]>;
  onRemoveImportedPdf?: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
  fileSourcesPending?: boolean;
}) {
  const { t, label, dir } = useLocale();
  const s = useStudyCopy();
  const paths = useWorkspacePaths();
  const { focus, setFocus, courseNavigationVisible } = useStudyChrome();
  const workspace = useWorkspace();
  const study = useStudyState(storageKey);
  const desk = useCourseDesk();
  const location = useLocation();
  const incomingNote = useRef("");
  const sectionLayout = resolveSectionLayout(
    study.state.sectionLayout,
    focus,
    courseNavigationVisible,
  );
  const ordered = useMemo(() => {
    const sections = course.sections.filter(
      (section) => !["guidance", "book"].includes(section.kind),
    );
    if (!sections.some((section) => section.kind === "notes"))
      sections.push({
        id: "notes",
        kind: "notes",
        title: { en: "Notes", ar: "الملاحظات" },
        description: {
          en: "Publisher and private course notes",
          ar: "ملاحظات الناشر وملاحظاتك الخاصة",
        },
        order: 3,
      });
    return sections.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
  }, [course.sections]);
  const bySection = useMemo(
    () =>
      Object.fromEntries(
        ordered.map((section) => [
          section.kind,
          resources.filter(
            (resource) => studySectionKind(resource.kind) === section.kind,
          ),
        ]),
      ) as Partial<Record<CourseSectionKind, Resource[]>>,
    [ordered, resources],
  );
  const active =
    ordered.find(
      (section) => section.kind === studySectionKind(study.state.active),
    ) || ordered[0];
  useEffect(() => {
    const previousKind = study.current.current.active;
    if (["guidance", "book"].includes(previousKind))
      study.update((previous) => ({
        ...previous,
        active: "notes",
        sections: {
          ...previous.sections,
          notes: previous.sections[previousKind] || previous.sections.notes,
        },
      }));
  }, []);
  const [peek, setPeek] = useState<CourseSectionKind | null>(null);
  const [turn, setTurn] = useState<{ id: number; backwards: boolean } | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [peekTop, setPeekTop] = useState(100);
  const [peekAnchor, setPeekAnchor] = useState(18);
  const [peekInline, setPeekInline] = useState(8);
  const [mobileIndex, setMobileIndex] = useState(false);
  const [railClosed, setRailClosed] = useState(false);
  const rail = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const closingRail = useRef(false);
  const [openingCover, setOpeningCover] = useState(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setOpeningCover(false), 750);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);
  const page = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const primary = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const tools = useStudyTools();
  const book = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const title = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const turnSnapshot = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const handSnapshot = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const initialOpened = useRef(false);
  const peekTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(
    undefined,
  );
  const suppressed = useRef<CourseSectionKind | null>(null);
  const visited = useRef(false);
  const switching = useRef(false);
  const restoring = useRef(false);
  const activeRef = useRef(active?.kind);
  activeRef.current = active?.kind;
  const selected = resources.find(
    (resource) =>
      studySectionKind(resource.kind) === active?.kind &&
      resource.id === study.state.sections[active?.kind]?.resourceId,
  );
  const companion = resources.find(
    (resource) =>
      resource.id === study.state.companionId && resource.id !== selected?.id,
  );
  const lastResource = resources.find(
    (resource) => resource.id === study.state.lastResourceId,
  );
  const visible = bySection[active?.kind] || [];
  const emptySection = !selected && active?.kind !== "overview" && active?.kind !== "notes" && visible.length === 0;
  const peekSection = ordered.find((section) => section.kind === peek);
  const peekResources = peek ? bySection[peek] || [] : [];
  const firstMaterial =
    resources.find((resource) => safeResourceUrl(resource.fileUrl)) ||
    resources[0];
  useEffect(() => {
    tools?.registerNoteOpener((anchor: PageAnchor, ownerCourse: string) => {
      const resource = resources.find((item) => item.id === anchor.resourceId);
      if (ownerCourse !== course.id || !resource || resource.updatedAt !== anchor.resourceRevision || !safeResourceUrl(resource.fileUrl)) return false;
      open(resource, false);
      return true;
    });
    return () => tools?.registerNoteOpener(null);
  }, [tools?.registerNoteOpener, resources, course.id, active?.kind]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const query = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    const id = query.get("pdf");
    if (!id || fileSourcesPending || incomingNote.current === location.search) return;
    const resource = resources.find((item) => item.id === id);
    const requested = Number(query.get("page"));
    const revision = query.get("revision");
    incomingNote.current = location.search;
    if (!resource || !safeResourceUrl(resource.fileUrl) || !Number.isSafeInteger(requested) || requested < 1 || (revision && revision !== resource.updatedAt)) {
      toast.error(t(query.get("resume") === "1" ? { en: "This study file is unavailable or has changed. Open the course materials to choose another.", ar: "ملف الدراسة غير متاح أو تغيّر. افتح مواد المساق لاختيار ملف آخر." } : { en: "The note's PDF page is unavailable or its file has changed. The note is still saved.", ar: "صفحة PDF المرتبطة غير متاحة أو تغيّر الملف. الملاحظة ما زالت محفوظة." })); return;
    }
    study.update((previous) => ({ ...previous, resources: { ...previous.resources, [resource.id]: { scroll: 0, seconds: previous.resources[resource.id]?.seconds || 0, page: requested } } }));
    open(resource, false);
    if (query.get("resume") !== "1") tools?.openNote({ resourceId: resource.id, resourceRevision: resource.updatedAt, page: requested, x: .85, y: .1 }, course.id);
  }, [location.search, resources, fileSourcesPending]);

  const incomingSection = useRef("");
  useEffect(() => {
    const query = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    const kind = query.get("section");
    if (query.has("pdf") || !kind || fileSourcesPending || incomingSection.current === location.search) return;
    if (ordered.some((section) => section.kind === kind)) {
      incomingSection.current = location.search;
      select(kind as CourseSectionKind, false);
    }
  }, [location.search, fileSourcesPending]);

  useEffect(() => {
    closePeek();
    setRailClosed(false);
    setMobileIndex(false);
  }, [sectionLayout]);

  function closePeek() {
    if (peekTimer.current) clearTimeout(peekTimer.current);
    setPeek(null);
  }
  function dismissPeek() {
    const kind = peek;
    suppressed.current = kind;
    const previewHasFocus = book.current
      ?.querySelector(".notebook-peek")
      ?.contains(document.activeElement);
    closePeek();
    if (previewHasFocus && kind)
      book.current
        ?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(`[data-notebook-section="${kind}"]`)
        ?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }
  function preview(kind: CourseSectionKind, element: HTMLButtonElement) {
    if (peekTimer.current) clearTimeout(peekTimer.current);
    if (suppressed.current === kind || kind === active.kind) {
      setPeek(null);
      return;
    }
    suppressed.current = null;
    if (rail.current) {
      const railRect = rail.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const bookmarkRect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
      const origin = railRect.top;
      const bookmarkTop = bookmarkRect.top - origin;
      const height = window.visualViewport?.height || window.innerHeight;
      const previewHeight = Math.min(
        window.innerWidth < 768 ? 260 : 300,
        height - 140,
      );
      const top =
        sectionLayout === "horizontal"
          ? railRect.height + 6
          : Math.max(
              0,
              Math.min(bookmarkTop, height - origin - previewHeight - 12),
            );
      setPeekTop(top);
      if (sectionLayout === "horizontal") {
        const previewWidth = Math.min(280, railRect.width - 16);
        const center =
          dir === "rtl"
            ? railRect.right - bookmarkRect.right + bookmarkRect.width / 2
            : bookmarkRect.left - railRect.left + bookmarkRect.width / 2;
        const start = Math.max(
          8,
          Math.min(
            center - previewWidth / 2,
            railRect.width - previewWidth - 8,
          ),
        );
        setPeekInline(start);
        setPeekAnchor(
          Math.max(14, Math.min(previewWidth - 20, center - start)),
        );
      } else {
        setPeekAnchor(
          Math.max(14, Math.min(previewHeight - 20, bookmarkTop - top + 18)),
        );
      }
    }
    peekTimer.current = setTimeout(() => setPeek(kind), 180);
  }
  function scheduleClosePeek() {
    if (peekTimer.current) clearTimeout(peekTimer.current);
    peekTimer.current = setTimeout(() => setPeek(null), 140);
  }
  function animateTo(kind: CourseSectionKind) {
    closePeek();
    if (kind === active.kind) return;
    const backwards =
      ordered.findIndex((section) => section.kind === kind) <
      ordered.findIndex((section) => section.kind === active.kind);
    if (!window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) {
      turnSnapshot.current = captureSectionPage(page.current, backwards);
      setTurn((previous) => ({ id: (previous?.id || 0) + 1, backwards }));
    }
  }
  function rememberSection() {
    if (!primary.current || !activeRef.current || restoring.current) return;
    const scroll = primary.current.scrollTop;
    const kind = activeRef.current;
    study.update(
      (previous) => ({
        ...previous,
        sections: {
          ...previous.sections,
          [kind]: { ...previous.sections[kind], scroll },
        },
      }),
      false,
    );
  }
  function select(kind: CourseSectionKind, animate = true) {
    const files = (bySection[kind] || []).filter((item) =>
      safeResourceUrl(item.fileUrl),
    );
    if (kind !== "notes" && kind !== active.kind && files.length === 1) {
      open(files[0], animate);
      return;
    }
    rememberSection();
    switching.current = kind !== active.kind;
    if (animate) animateTo(kind);
    suppressed.current = kind;
    if (window.matchMedia("(hover: none), (pointer: coarse)").matches)
      setMobileIndex(false);
    study.update((previous) => ({ ...previous, active: kind }));
  }
  function open(resource: Resource, animate = true) {
    const kind = studySectionKind(resource.kind);
    rememberSection();
    switching.current = kind !== active.kind;
    if (animate) animateTo(kind);
    study.update((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      active: kind,
      lastResourceId: resource.id,
      sections: {
        ...previous.sections,
        [kind]: {
          scroll: previous.sections[kind]?.scroll || 0,
          resourceId: resource.id,
        },
      },
    }));
    if (
      !resource.id.startsWith("personal-pdf-") &&
      !workspace.isPending &&
      !workspace.isError
    )
      void workspace.send({ type: "view-resource", id: resource.id });
    suppressed.current = kind;
    if (window.matchMedia("(hover: none), (pointer: coarse)").matches)
      setMobileIndex(false);
  }
  function canStep(direction: TurnDirection) {
    const files = visible.filter((resource) =>
      safeResourceUrl(resource.fileUrl),
    );
    const fileIndex = files.findIndex(
      (resource) => resource.id === selected?.id,
    );
    return (
      (fileIndex >= 0 && !!files[fileIndex + direction]) ||
      !!ordered[
        ordered.findIndex((section) => section.kind === active.kind) + direction
      ]
    );
  }
  function stepStudy(direction: TurnDirection, animate = true) {
    const files = visible.filter((resource) =>
      safeResourceUrl(resource.fileUrl),
    );
    const fileIndex = files.findIndex(
      (resource) => resource.id === selected?.id,
    );
    if (fileIndex >= 0 && files[fileIndex + direction]) {
      open(files[fileIndex + direction], animate);
      return;
    }
    const next =
      ordered[
        ordered.findIndex((section) => section.kind === active.kind) + direction
      ];
    if (next) select(next.kind, animate);
  }
  const handTurn = usePageTurn({
    rtl: dir === "rtl",
    canTurn: canStep,
    identity: active.kind + ":" + selected?.id,
    onCommit: (direction) => stepStudy(direction, false),
  });
  function upcoming(direction: TurnDirection) {
    const files = visible.filter((resource) =>
      safeResourceUrl(resource.fileUrl),
    );
    const fileIndex = files.findIndex(
      (resource) => resource.id === selected?.id,
    );
    const adjacent = fileIndex >= 0 ? files[fileIndex + direction] : undefined;
    const section = adjacent
      ? active
      : ordered[
          ordered.findIndex((item) => item.kind === active.kind) + direction
        ];
    if (!section) return null;
    const items = bySection[section.kind] || [];
    const available = items.filter((item) => safeResourceUrl(item.fileUrl));
    const resourceId =
      adjacent?.id ||
      study.state.sections[section.kind]?.resourceId ||
      (available.length === 1 ? available[0].id : undefined);
    return {
      section,
      items,
      resourceId,
      page: resourceId ? study.state.resources[resourceId]?.page || 1 : 1,
    };
  }
  function boundaryPreview(direction: TurnDirection) {
    const next = upcoming(direction);
    return next ? (
      <SectionTurnPreview
        course={course}
        section={next.section}
        resources={next.items}
        preferredResourceId={next.resourceId}
        preferredPage={next.page}
      />
    ) : null;
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      initialOpened.current ||
      study.current.current.lastResourceId ||
      study.current.current.active !== "overview"
    )
      return;
    const first = resources.find((resource) =>
      safeResourceUrl(resource.fileUrl),
    );
    if (first) {
      initialOpened.current = true;
      open(first, false);
    }
  }, [resources]);
  function closeResource() {
    study.update((previous) => ({
      ...previous,
      sections: {
        ...previous.sections,
        [active.kind]: {
          ...previous.sections[active.kind],
          scroll: 0,
          resourceId: undefined,
        },
      },
    }));
    requestAnimationFrame(() => title.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true }));
  }
  function savePosition(id: string, position: Partial<StudyPosition>) {
    study.update(
      (previous) => ({
        ...previous,
        resources: {
          ...previous.resources,
          [id]: {
            ...(previous.resources[id] || { scroll: 0, page: 1, seconds: 0 }),
            ...position,
          },
        },
      }),
      false,
    );
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    let frame = 0;
    const scroll = () => {
      if (!frame)
        frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          frame = 0;
          rememberSection();
        });
    };
    const surface = primary.current;
    surface?.addEventListener("scroll", scroll, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      surface?.removeEventListener("scroll", scroll);
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      if (peekTimer.current) clearTimeout(peekTimer.current);
    };
    // This keyed component keeps the same account/course. The ref tracks its active section.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const offset = study.current.current.sections[active.kind]?.scroll || 0;
    const switched = switching.current;
    switching.current = false;
    const shouldRestore = offset > 0;
    visited.current = true;
    if (!shouldRestore) {
      if (primary.current) primary.current.scrollTop = 0;
      return;
    }
    restoring.current = true;
    let second = 0;
    const first = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      second = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (primary.current) {
          primary.current.scrollTop = offset;
        }
        restoring.current = false;
      });
    });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(first);
      cancelAnimationFrame(second);
      restoring.current = false;
    };
  }, [active.kind]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (focus) closePeek();
  }, [focus]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!turn) return;
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => setTurn(null), 560);
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [turn]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const shortcut = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (
        event.key === "Escape" &&
        focus &&
        !document.querySelector('dialog[open], [role="dialog"]') &&
        !event.defaultPrevented
      )
        setFocus(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", shortcut);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", shortcut);
  }, [focus, setFocus]);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!desk) return;
    desk.register({
      split: study.state.split,
      toggleSplit: () => {
        closePeek();
        study.update((previous) => ({ ...previous, split: !previous.split }));
      },
    });
    return () => desk.register(null);
  }, [desk?.register, study.state.split, study.update]);
  if (!active) return <EmptyState />;

  return (
    <div
      ref={book}
      className="study-notebook"
      data-leather={bookMaterial(course.id)}
      data-course-tone={course.accent}
      data-focus={focus || undefined}
      data-section-layout={sectionLayout}
      data-sections-hidden={railClosed || undefined}
      data-split={study.state.split || undefined}
      data-reading={selected ? "resource" : "section"}
      data-empty-section={emptySection || undefined}
      dir={dir}
    >
      {focus && (
        <h1 className="sr-only" data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>
          {t(course.title)}
        </h1>
      )}
      {!focus &&
        (desk ? (
          <div className="notebook-toolbar-space" aria-hidden="true" />
        ) : (
          <CourseDeskHeader
            course={course}
            controls={{
              split: study.state.split,
              toggleSplit: () => {
                closePeek();
                study.update((previous) => ({
                  ...previous,
                  split: !previous.split,
                }));
              },
            }}
          />
        ))}
      {!focus && (
        <h1 className="sr-only" data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>
          {t(course.title)}
        </h1>
      )}
      <div className="notebook-object">
        {openingCover && (
          <div
            className="study-opening-cover"
            aria-hidden="true"
            onAnimationEnd={() => setOpeningCover(false)}
          >
            <span>
              MEDCLUB · <bdi>{course.code}</bdi>
            </span>
            <BookOpen size={44} />
            <strong>{t(course.title)}</strong>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="notebook-back-cover" aria-hidden="true" />
        <div className="notebook-page-stack" aria-hidden="true" />
        <div className="notebook-spread">
          <aside
            ref={rail}
            className="notebook-index"
            tabIndex={railClosed ? -1 : 0}
            aria-label={label("courseSections")}
            inert={railClosed || undefined}
            data-expanded={mobileIndex || undefined}
            data-closed={railClosed || undefined}
            onPointerEnter={(event) => {
              if (event.pointerType === "mouse") {
                setRailClosed(false);
                setMobileIndex(true);
              }
            }}
            onPointerLeave={(event) => {
              if (
                event.pointerType === "mouse" &&
                !rail.current?.contains(document.activeElement)
              )
                setMobileIndex(false);
              scheduleClosePeek();
            }}
            onPointerDown={(event) => {
              if (
                event.pointerType !== "mouse" &&
                event.target === event.currentTarget
              ) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.currentTarget.focus({ preventScroll: true });
                setRailClosed(false);
                setMobileIndex(true);
              }
            }}
            onFocusCapture={(event) => {
              if (closingRail.current) return;
              if (!railClosed || event.target !== event.currentTarget) {
                setRailClosed(false);
                setMobileIndex(true);
              }
            }}
            onBlur={(event) => {
              if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)) {
                setMobileIndex(false);
                scheduleClosePeek();
              }
            }}
            onKeyDown={(event) => {
              if (
                event.target === event.currentTarget &&
                ["Enter", " ", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)
              ) {
                event.preventDefault();
                setRailClosed(false);
                setMobileIndex(true);
                requestAnimationFrame(() =>
                  rail.current
                    ?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(
                      "[data-notebook-section]",
                    )
                    ?.focus(),
                );
              }
            }}
          >
            <div className="notebook-index-heading">
              <BookOpen
                className="notebook-rail-mark"
                size={17}
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
              <span>{s("index")}</span>
              <bdi>{course.code}</bdi>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="notebook-section-close notebook-icon-button"
              aria-label={t({
                en: "Close course sections",
                ar: "إغلاق أقسام المساق",
              })}
              onClick={() => {
                closePeek();
                closingRail.current = true;
                setMobileIndex(false);
                setRailClosed(true);
                page.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                  closingRail.current = false;
                });
              }}
            >
              <X size={16} />
            </button>
            <nav
              id="notebook-bookmarks"
              className="notebook-bookmarks"
              aria-label={label("courseSections")}
              onKeyDown={(event) => {
                if (event.key === "Escape") {
                  event.stopPropagation();
                  dismissPeek();
                }
                const buttons = [
                  ...event.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>(
                    "button",
                  ),
                ];
                const current = buttons.indexOf(
                  document.activeElement as HTMLButtonElement,
                );
                if (current < 0) return;
                const nextKey = dir === "rtl" ? "ArrowLeft" : "ArrowRight";
                const previousKey = dir === "rtl" ? "ArrowRight" : "ArrowLeft";
                let next: number | undefined;
                if (event.key === "ArrowDown" || event.key === nextKey)
                  next = (current + 1) % buttons.length;
                if (event.key === "ArrowUp" || event.key === previousKey)
                  next = (current - 1 + buttons.length) % buttons.length;
                if (event.key === "Home") next = 0;
                if (event.key === "End") next = buttons.length - 1;
                if (next !== undefined) {
                  event.preventDefault();
                  buttons[next].focus();
                }
              }}
            >
              {ordered.map((section, index) => {
                const Icon = icons[section.kind];
                const items = bySection[section.kind] || [];
                const count =
                  section.kind === "overview"
                    ? course.outcomes.length
                    : items.length;
                const hint =
                  section.kind === "overview"
                    ? course.outcomes[0]
                    : items[0]?.title;
                return (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    key={section.id}
                    className="notebook-bookmark"
                    data-notebook-section={section.kind}
                    data-peeking={peek === section.kind || undefined}
                    aria-current={
                      active.kind === section.kind ? "page" : undefined
                    }
                    aria-label={t(section.title)}
                    aria-controls="notebook-reading-page"
                    aria-describedby={
                      peek === section.kind
                        ? "notebook-section-preview"
                        : undefined
                    }
                    onClick={() => select(section.kind)}
                    onPointerEnter={(event) => {
                      if (event.pointerType === "mouse")
                        preview(section.kind, event.currentTarget);
                    }}
                    onPointerLeave={scheduleClosePeek}
                    onFocus={(event) =>
                      preview(section.kind, event.currentTarget)
                    }
                    onBlur={scheduleClosePeek}
                  >
                    <span className="notebook-bookmark-top">
                      <Icon size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
                      <b>{t(section.title)}</b>
                      <small>{count}</small>
                    </span>
                    <span className="notebook-bookmark-glimpse">
                      {hint ? t(hint) : s("noResources")}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className="notebook-bookmark-number"
                      aria-hidden="true"
                    >
                      {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </nav>
            {peekSection && (
              <aside
                id="notebook-section-preview"
                className="notebook-peek"
                data-peek-section={peekSection.kind}
                style={
                  {
                    top: peekTop,
                    "--peek-anchor": `${peekAnchor}px`,
                    ...(sectionLayout === "horizontal"
                      ? { insetInlineStart: peekInline }
                      : {}),
                  } as CSSProperties
                }
                aria-label={s("peek")}
                onPointerEnter={() => {
                  if (peekTimer.current) clearTimeout(peekTimer.current);
                }}
                onPointerLeave={scheduleClosePeek}
                onFocusCapture={() => {
                  if (peekTimer.current) clearTimeout(peekTimer.current);
                }}
                onBlur={scheduleClosePeek}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (event.key === "Escape") {
                    event.stopPropagation();
                    dismissPeek();
                  }
                }}
              >
                <div className="notebook-peek-head">
                  <span>{s("peek")}</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="notebook-icon-button"
                    aria-label={label("close")}
                    onClick={dismissPeek}
                  >
                    <X size={16} />
                  </button>
                </div>
                <h3>{t(peekSection.title)}</h3>
                <p>{t(peekSection.description)}</p>
                {peekResources[0]?.preview?.thumbnailUrl &&
                  safeResourceUrl(peekResources[0].preview.thumbnailUrl) && (
                    <img
                      src={safeResourceUrl(
                        peekResources[0].preview.thumbnailUrl,
                      )}
                      alt={t(peekResources[0].title)}
                      loading="lazy"
                    />
                  )}
                <ul>
                  {peekSection.kind === "overview" ? (
                    course.outcomes
                      .slice(0, 2)
                      .map((outcome) => <li key={outcome.en}>{t(outcome)}</li>)
                  ) : peekResources.length ? (
                    peekResources.slice(0, 2).map((resource) => (
                      <li key={resource.id}>
                        <strong>{t(resource.title)}</strong>
                        <span>
                          {resource.durationMinutes
                            ? `${resource.durationMinutes} ${s("minutes")}`
                            : resource.localFile
                              ? t({ en: "PDF file", ar: "ملف PDF" })
                              : `${resource.pages} ${label("pages")}`}
                        </span>
                      </li>
                    ))
                  ) : (
                    <li>{s("noResources")}</li>
                  )}
                </ul>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="notebook-button notebook-button-primary"
                  onClick={() => select(peekSection.kind)}
                >
                  {label("openSection")}
                  <ArrowUpRight size={16} className="directional" />
                </button>
              </aside>
            )}
          </aside>
          <div className="notebook-binding" aria-hidden="true">
            {Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, index) => (
              <i key={index} />
            ))}
          </div>
          <section
            ref={page}
            tabIndex={-1}
            id="notebook-reading-page"
            className="notebook-reading-page"
            aria-labelledby="notebook-section-heading"
          >
            {!selected && railClosed && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="notebook-sections-reopen"
                aria-label={t({
                  en: "Show course sections",
                  ar: "إظهار أقسام المساق",
                })}
                onClick={() => setRailClosed(false)}
              >
                <BookOpen size={16} />
                {t({ en: "Sections", ar: "الأقسام" })}
              </button>
            )}
            <header
              className={
                selected
                  ? "notebook-section-heading sr-only"
                  : "notebook-section-heading"
              }
            >
              <h2 ref={title} id="notebook-section-heading" tabIndex={-1}>
                {t(active.title)}
              </h2>
            </header>
            <div
              className="notebook-study-layout"
              style={
                { "--reading-width": `${study.state.width}%` } as CSSProperties
              }
            >
              <div className="notebook-primary-pane" ref={primary}>
                {selected ? (
                  <StudyResourceViewer
                    key={`main:${selected.id}`}
                    item={selected}
                    position={study.state.resources[selected.id]}
                    onPosition={(position) =>
                      savePosition(selected.id, position)
                    }
                    onClose={closeResource}
                    onShowSections={
                      railClosed
                        ? () => {
                            setRailClosed(false);
                            requestAnimationFrame(() =>
                              rail.current
                                ?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(
                                  "[data-notebook-section]",
                                )
                                ?.focus({ preventScroll: true }),
                            );
                          }
                        : undefined
                    }
                  />
                ) : active.kind === "overview" ? (
                  <div className="notebook-overview">
                    {(lastResource || firstMaterial) && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="notebook-resume"
                        onClick={() => open((lastResource || firstMaterial)!)}
                      >
                        <BookOpen size={22} />
                        <span>
                          <small>{s(lastResource ? "resume" : "start")}</small>
                          <strong>
                            {t((lastResource || firstMaterial)!.title)}
                          </strong>
                        </span>
                        <ArrowUpRight size={20} className="directional" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                    <details className="notebook-course-details">
                      <summary>{label("learningOutcomes")}</summary>
                      <p>{t(course.description)}</p>
                      <ol className="notebook-outcomes">
                        {course.outcomes.map((outcome, index) => (
                          <li key={outcome.en}>
                            <span>{String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
                            <p>{t(outcome)}</p>
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ol>
                    </details>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    {active.kind === "notes" && (
                      <CoursePublisherNotes
                        courseId={course.id}
                        initial={course.publisherNotes}
                        canEdit={canImportPdfs}
                      />
                    )}
                    {canImportPdfs &&
                      onImportPdfs &&
                      !["recording", "external"].includes(active.kind) && (
                        <CoursePdfImporter
                          section={active.kind}
                          pending={importingPdfs}
                          onImport={(files, report) =>
                            onImportPdfs(active.kind, files, report)
                          }
                        />
                      )}
                    {pdfImportError && (
                      <p className="pdf-import-service-error" role="alert">
                        {s("importError")}
                      </p>
                    )}
                    {visible.length ? (
                      <div className="resource-grid course-material-grid notebook-material-grid">
                        {visible.map((resource) => (
                          <NotebookResourceCard
                            key={resource.id}
                            resource={resource}
                            course={course}
                            seconds={
                              study.state.resources[resource.id]?.seconds
                            }
                            onOpen={() => open(resource)}
                            onRemove={
                              resource.localFile &&
                              canImportPdfs &&
                              onRemoveImportedPdf
                                ? () => onRemoveImportedPdf(resource.id)
                                : undefined
                            }
                          />
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <CourseEmptySection />
                    )}
                    {active.kind === "notes" && (
                      <div className="course-private-notes">
                        <StudentNotes
                          courseId={course.id}
                          legacyKey={storageKey}
                          onlyCourse
                          resources={resources}
                          reader={tools?.reader}
                          onOpenAnchor={tools?.openNote}
                        />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
              {study.state.split && (
                <aside className="notebook-companion">
                  <label className="notebook-companion-picker">
                    <span>{s("companion")}</span>
                    <select
                      value={companion?.id || ""}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        study.update((previous) => ({
                          ...previous,
                          companionId: event.target.value || undefined,
                        }))
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="">{s("choose")}</option>
                      {resources
                        .filter((resource) => resource.id !== selected?.id)
                        .map((resource) => (
                          <option key={resource.id} value={resource.id}>
                            {label(resource.kind)} · {t(resource.title)}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                    </select>
                  </label>
                  {companion ? (
                    <StudyResourceViewer
                      key={`companion:${companion.id}`}
                      item={companion}
                      position={study.state.resources[companion.id]}
                      onPosition={(position) =>
                        savePosition(companion.id, position)
                      }
                      companion
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="notebook-companion-empty">
                      <Columns2 size={30} aria-hidden="true" />
                      <p>{s("choose")}</p>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <label className="notebook-width-control">
                    <span>
                      {s("width")} · {Math.round(study.state.width)}%
                    </span>
                    <input
                      type="range"
                      min={35}
                      max={65}
                      step={1}
                      value={study.state.width}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        study.update((previous) => ({
                          ...previous,
                          width: Number(event.target.value),
                        }))
                      }
                    />
                  </label>
                  <p className="notebook-split-hint">{s("splitHint")}</p>
                </aside>
              )}
            </div>
            {turn && (
              <div
                key={turn.id}
                className="notebook-turn-sheet"
                data-transition="ribbon"
                data-backwards={turn.backwards || undefined}
                aria-hidden="true"
                onAnimationEnd={(event) => {
                  if (event.target === event.currentTarget) setTurn(null);
                }}
              >
                <div className="section-turn-front">
                  <SectionSnapshot snapshot={turnSnapshot.current} />
                </div>
                <i className="section-turn-back">
                  <SectionTurnPreview
                    course={course}
                    section={active}
                    resources={visible}
                    preferredResourceId={selected?.id}
                    preferredPage={
                      selected ? study.state.resources[selected.id]?.page : 1
                    }
                  />
                </i>
                <b />
              </div>
            )}
            {(!selected || resourceMediaType(selected) !== "pdf") && (
              <>
                {handTurn.turn && (
                  <div
                    className="section-turn-underlay"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    inert
                  >
                    {boundaryPreview(handTurn.turn.direction)}
                  </div>
                )}
                {handTurn.turn && (
                  <TurnLeaf
                    turn={handTurn.turn}
                    rtl={dir === "rtl"}
                    twoPages={false}
                    front={<SectionSnapshot snapshot={handSnapshot.current} />}
                    back={boundaryPreview(handTurn.turn.direction)}
                  />
                )}
                <nav
                  className="notebook-section-turn-controls"
                  aria-label={t({ en: "Section navigation", ar: "التنقل بين الأقسام" })}
                >
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="notebook-section-turn-button"
                    disabled={!canStep(-1) || !!handTurn.turn}
                    aria-label={t({
                      en: "Previous section",
                      ar: "القسم السابق",
                    })}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (handTurn.turn) return;
                      handSnapshot.current = captureSectionPage(
                        page.current,
                        true,
                      );
                      handTurn.request(-1);
                    }}
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft className="directional" size={17} />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="notebook-section-turn-button"
                    disabled={!canStep(1) || !!handTurn.turn}
                    aria-label={t({
                      en: "Next section",
                      ar: "القسم التالي",
                    })}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (handTurn.turn) return;
                      handSnapshot.current = captureSectionPage(
                        page.current,
                        false,
                      );
                      handTurn.request(1);
                    }}
                  >
                    <ChevronRight className="directional" size={17} />
                  </button>
                </nav>
              </>
            )}
          </section>
        </div>
      </div>
      <StudyToolsPanel
        courseId={course.id}
        storageKey={storageKey}
        resources={resources}
        sectionLayout={study.state.sectionLayout}
        onSectionLayoutChange={(sectionLayout) => {
          closePeek();
          study.update((previous) => ({ ...previous, sectionLayout }));
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/courses/CoursePage.tsx
============================================================
import { useServices } from "../../app/providers/ServicesProvider";
import { useRef } from "react";
import { offerUndo } from "../../components/feedback/undo-action";
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useWorkspacePaths } from "../../hooks/useWorkspacePaths";
import { useCourses, useResources } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { CourseNotebook } from "./CourseNotebook";
import { studyStorageKey } from "./study-state";
import { useLocalCoursePdfs } from "./useLocalCoursePdfs";
import { useAccess } from "../../admin/governance/useGovernance";

import { StudyEnvironment } from "./StudyEnvironment";
import "../../styles/course-notebook.css";
import "../../styles/notebook-reader.css";

export default function CoursePage() {
  const paths = useWorkspacePaths();
  const services = useServices();
  const { slug } = useParams();
  const courses = useCourses(),
    resources = useResources();
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const { snapshot } = useAuth();
  const course = courses.data?.find((item) => item.slug === slug);
  const localPdfs = useLocalCoursePdfs(course?.id || "");

  const access = useAccess();
  const authorization = useRef({ snapshot, access: access.data });
  authorization.current = { snapshot, access: access.data };
  if (courses.isPending || resources.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (courses.isError || resources.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void courses.refetch();
          void resources.refetch();
        }}
      />
    );
  if (!course)
    return (
      <div className="container section">
        <EmptyState
          title={label("notFound")}
          description={label("notFoundBody")}
          href={paths.learning}
        />
      </div>
    );
  const key = studyStorageKey(
    snapshot.status === "authenticated" ? snapshot.user!.id : "guest",
    course.id,
  );
  const canImport =
    snapshot.status === "authenticated" &&
    !!access.data?.capabilities.some((capability) =>
      ["content.review", "content.publish", "builder.manage"].includes(
        capability,
      ),
    );
  const courseResources = [
    ...resources.data.filter((item) => item.courseId === course.id),
    ...localPdfs.resources,
  ];
  return (
    <div
      className={`container course-atlas course-atlas-${course.accent} course-study-edition`}
    >
      <StudyEnvironment course={course} storageKey={key}>
        <CourseNotebook
          key={key}
          course={course}
          resources={courseResources}
          fileSourcesPending={localPdfs.loading}
          storageKey={key}
          canImportPdfs={canImport}
          importingPdfs={localPdfs.pending}
          pdfImportError={localPdfs.error}
          onImportPdfs={async (kind, files, onProgress) => {
            if (!canImport) return [];
            return localPdfs.importFiles(kind, files, onProgress);
          }}
          onRemoveImportedPdf={async (id) => {
            if (!canImport) throw new Error("COURSE_EDIT_PERMISSION_REQUIRED");
            const owner = snapshot.user!.id;
            const fresh = await services.auth.getSnapshot();
            const freshAccess = await services.governance.getAccess();
            if (
              fresh.status !== "authenticated" ||
              fresh.user?.id !== owner ||
              !freshAccess.capabilities.some((cap) =>
                [
                  "content.review",
                  "content.publish",
                  "builder.manage",
                ].includes(cap),
              )
            )
              throw new Error("COURSE_EDIT_PERMISSION_REQUIRED");
            const restore = await localPdfs.remove(id);
            offerUndo({
              message: t({ en: "PDF removed", ar: "حُذف الملف" }),
              label: t({ en: "Undo", ar: "تراجع" }),
              restored: t({ en: "PDF restored", ar: "استُعيد الملف" }),
              failed: t({
                en: "Could not restore this PDF. Try again while Undo is available.",
                ar: "تعذّرت استعادة الملف. حاول مجدداً أثناء إتاحة التراجع.",
              }),
              canRestore: () =>
                authorization.current.snapshot.user?.id === owner &&
                authorization.current.snapshot.status === "authenticated" &&
                !!authorization.current.access?.capabilities.some((cap) =>
                  [
                    "content.review",
                    "content.publish",
                    "builder.manage",
                  ].includes(cap),
                ),
              undo: async () => {
                const fresh = await services.auth.getSnapshot();
                const access = await services.governance.getAccess();
                if (
                  fresh.status !== "authenticated" ||
                  fresh.user?.id !== owner ||
                  !access.capabilities.some((cap) =>
                    [
                      "content.review",
                      "content.publish",
                      "builder.manage",
                    ].includes(cap),
                  )
                )
                  throw new Error("COURSE_EDIT_PERMISSION_REQUIRED");
                await restore();
              },
            });
          }}
        />
      </StudyEnvironment>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/courses/CoursePdfImporter.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  BookOpen,
  CheckCircle2,
  FileText,
  Upload,
} from "lucide-react";
import type { CourseSectionKind, Text } from "../../types/content";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import {
  validateCoursePdf,
  type ImportCoursePdfs,
  type PdfImportProgress,
} from "./pdf-import";

type State = "idle" | "dragging" | "landing" | "success" | "error";
export function CoursePdfImporter({
  section,
  pending,
  onImport,
  onRead,
  copy,
}: {
  section: CourseSectionKind;
  pending: boolean;
  onImport: ImportCoursePdfs;
  onRead?: (id: string) => void;
  copy?: Partial<
    Record<
      | "title"
      | "idle"
      | "dragging"
      | "working"
      | "success"
      | "boundary"
      | "receipt",
      Text
    >
  >;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    id = useId();
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null),
    depth = useRef(0),
    busy = useRef(false),
    alive = useRef(true);
  const [state, setState] = useState<State>("idle");
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]),
    [added, setAdded] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<PdfImportProgress | null>(null);
  const [sessionOnly, setSessionOnly] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (state !== "success" || pending) return;
    const reset = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setState("idle");
      setFiles([]);
      setAdded([]);
      setProgress(null);
      depth.current = 0;
    }, 1400);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(reset);
  }, [state, pending]);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);
  async function place(list: FileList | File[]) {
    if (busy.current || pending) return;
    busy.current = true;
    const selected = [...list];
    setFiles(selected.slice(0, 8));
    setProgress(null);
    setAdded([]);
    setSessionOnly(false);
    setState("landing");
    try {
      if (!selected.length || selected.length > 8)
        throw new Error("PDF_INVALID");
      for (const file of selected) await validateCoursePdf(file);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      const ids = await onImport(selected, (value) => {
        if (!alive.current) return;
        setProgress(value);
        if (value.storage === "session") setSessionOnly(true);
      });
      if (alive.current) {
        setAdded(ids);
        setState(ids.length === selected.length ? "success" : "error");
      }
    } catch {
      if (alive.current) setState("error");
    } finally {
      busy.current = false;
      if (input.current) input.current.value = "";
    }
  }
  const working = state === "landing" || pending;
  return (
    <section
      className="course-pdf-importer"
      data-state={state}
      data-section={section}
      aria-labelledby={id}
      aria-busy={working}
      onDragEnter={(event) => {
        if (!event.dataTransfer.types?.includes("Files") || working) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        depth.current++;
        setState("dragging");
      }}
      onDragOver={(event) => {
        if (!event.dataTransfer.types?.includes("Files")) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = working ? "none" : "copy";
      }}
      onDragLeave={() => {
        depth.current = Math.max(0, depth.current - 1);
        if (!depth.current && state === "dragging") setState("idle");
      }}
      onDrop={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        depth.current = 0;
        void place(event.dataTransfer.files);
      }}
    >
      <div className="pdf-import-object" aria-hidden="true">
        <span className="pdf-import-book">
          <BookOpen size={28} />
          <i />
        </span>
        <span className="pdf-import-paper">
          <FileText size={25} />
          <b>PDF</b>
        </span>
        <span className="pdf-import-check">
          <CheckCircle2 size={24} />
        </span>
        <span className="pdf-import-error">
          <AlertTriangle size={24} />
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="pdf-import-copy">
        <h3 id={id}>
          {t(copy?.title || { en: "Place PDF material", ar: "إضافة مادة PDF" })}
        </h3>
        <p role={state === "error" ? "alert" : "status"}>
          {t(
            state === "dragging"
              ? copy?.dragging || {
                  en: "Release to place the PDF into this section",
                  ar: "أفلت الملف لإضافته إلى هذا القسم",
                }
              : working
                ? copy?.working || {
                    en: "Checking and saving your PDFs…",
                    ar: "جارٍ التحقق من ملفاتك وحفظها…",
                  }
                : state === "success"
                  ? copy?.success || {
                      en: "PDF material added",
                      ar: "أضيفت مادة PDF",
                    }
                  : state === "error"
                    ? {
                        en: "Import failed. Choose valid PDFs under 30 MB, up to 8 at once, and try again.",
                        ar: "تعذّر الاستيراد. اختر ملفات PDF صالحة أصغر من ٣٠ ميجابايت، حتى ٨ ملفات، وحاول مجددًا.",
                      }
                    : copy?.idle || {
                        en: "Drop course PDFs here or choose them from your device.",
                        ar: "أسقط ملفات المساق هنا أو اخترها من جهازك.",
                      },
          )}
        </p>
        <small>
          {t({
            en: "PDF only · up to 30 MB each · maximum 8 at once",
            ar: "PDF فقط · حتى ٣٠ ميجابايت للملف · ٨ ملفات كحد أقصى",
          })}
        </small>
      </div>
      <input
        ref={input}
        type="file"
        accept="application/pdf,.pdf"
        multiple
        aria-label={t({ en: "Choose PDF files", ar: "اختر ملفات PDF" })}
        onChange={(event) =>
          event.target.files && void place(event.target.files)
        }
      />
      <button
        type="button"
        className="notebook-button notebook-button-primary"
        disabled={working}
        onClick={() => input.current?.click()}
      >
        <Upload size={17} />
        {t({ en: "Choose PDF files", ar: "اختر ملفات PDF" })}
      </button>
      {!!files.length && state !== "idle" && state !== "dragging" && (
        <div className="pdf-import-receipt">
          <ul
            aria-label={t({
              en: "Selected PDF files",
              ar: "ملفات PDF المختارة",
            })}
          >
            {files.map((file, index) => (
              <li key={index}>
                <FileText size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
                <span>{file.name}</span>
                <small>
                  <bdi>{(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)} MB</bdi>
                </small>
                {index < (progress?.completed || added.length) && (
                  <CheckCircle2 size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <progress
            max={files.length}
            {...(progress || state === "success"
              ? { value: progress?.completed || added.length }
              : {})}
            aria-label={t({
              en: "PDF import progress",
              ar: "تقدّم استيراد PDF",
            })}
          />
          <small>
            {progress?.completed || added.length} / {files.length}{" "}
            {t(copy?.receipt || { en: "saved", ar: "محفوظ" })}
          </small>
          {state === "success" && onRead && added[0] && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="notebook-button notebook-button-primary"
              onClick={() => onRead(added[0])}
            >
              <BookOpen size={17} />
              {t({ en: "Read PDF", ar: "قراءة PDF" })}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      <p className="pdf-import-boundary">
        {t(
          copy?.boundary ||
            (sessionOnly
              ? {
                  en: "Available for this session only: device storage is unavailable. Keep your original files.",
                  ar: "متاح للجلسة الحالية فقط: تخزين الجهاز غير متاح. احتفظ بملفاتك الأصلية.",
                }
              : {
                  en: "Device-local course preview. Shared publishing requires the course API.",
                  ar: "معاينة للمساق على جهازك. النشر المشترك يحتاج إلى واجهة المساق البرمجية.",
                }),
        )}
      </p>
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/courses/CoursePublisherNotes.tsx
============================================================
import { offerUndo } from "../../components/feedback/undo-action";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { useServices } from "../../app/providers/ServicesProvider";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Pencil, Save } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import {
  ActionReceipt,
  useActionReceipt,
} from "../../components/feedback/ActionReceipt";
import type { Text } from "../../types/content";

const empty: Text = { en: "", ar: "" };
export const publisherNotesKey = (id: string) =>
  "medclub:publisher-course-notes:v1:" + encodeURIComponent(id);
export function readPublisherNotes(id: string, fallback: Text = empty): Text {
  try {
    const raw = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(publisherNotesKey(id)) || "null",
    );
    return raw && typeof raw.en === "string" && typeof raw.ar === "string"
      ? { en: raw.en.slice(0, 25000), ar: raw.ar.slice(0, 25000) }
      : fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}
export function writePublisherNotes(
  id: string,
  notes: Text,
  authorized: boolean,
) {
  if (!authorized) throw new Error("COURSE_EDIT_PERMISSION_REQUIRED");
  if (
    !id ||
    id.length > 200 ||
    typeof notes.en !== "string" ||
    typeof notes.ar !== "string"
  )
    throw new Error("INVALID_COURSE_NOTES");
  localStorage.setItem(
    publisherNotesKey(id),
    JSON.stringify({
      en: notes.en.slice(0, 25000),
      ar: notes.ar.slice(0, 25000),
    }),
  );
  window.dispatchEvent(
    new CustomEvent("medclub:publisher-notes-updated", {
      detail: publisherNotesKey(id),
    }),
  );
}
export function CoursePublisherNotes({
  courseId,
  initial,
  canEdit,
}: {
  courseId: string;
  initial?: Text;
  canEdit: boolean;
}) {
  const { t, locale } = useLocale(),
    feedback = useActionReceipt();
  const services = useServices(),
    { snapshot } = useAuth();
  const owner = `${snapshot.status}:${snapshot.user?.id || "guest"}`;
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState(() =>
      readPublisherNotes(courseId, initial),
    ),
    [draft, setDraft] = useState(notes),
    [editing, setEditing] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const authorization = useRef(canEdit);
  authorization.current = canEdit;
  useEffect(() => {
    authorization.current = canEdit;
    return () => {
      authorization.current = false;
    };
  }, [canEdit]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const refresh = (event: Event) => {
      if (
        event.type === "storage"
          ? (event as StorageEvent).key === publisherNotesKey(courseId)
          : (event as CustomEvent).detail === publisherNotesKey(courseId)
      )
        setNotes(readPublisherNotes(courseId, initial));
    };
    window.addEventListener("storage", refresh);
    window.addEventListener("medclub:publisher-notes-updated", refresh);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("storage", refresh);
      window.removeEventListener("medclub:publisher-notes-updated", refresh);
    };
  }, [courseId, initial]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!canEdit) setEditing(false);
  }, [canEdit]);
  return (
    <section
      className="course-publisher-notes"
      aria-label={t({ en: "Publisher notes", ar: "ملاحظات الناشر" })}
    >
      <header>
        <h3>{t({ en: "Publisher notes", ar: "ملاحظات الناشر" })}</h3>
        <ActionReceipt receipt={feedback.receipt} />
        {canEdit && !editing && (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="notebook-icon-button publisher-notes-edit"
            aria-label={t({
              en: "Edit publisher notes",
              ar: "تعديل ملاحظات الناشر",
            })}
            onClick={() => {
              setDraft(notes);
              setEditing(true);
              setError(false);
            }}
          >
            <Pencil size={16} />
          </button>
        )}
      </header>
      {editing ? (
        <form
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            try {
              const before = readPublisherNotes(courseId, initial),
                after = { ...draft };
              writePublisherNotes(courseId, after, canEdit);
              offerUndo({
                message: t({
                  en: "Publisher notes saved",
                  ar: "حُفظت ملاحظات الناشر",
                }),
                label: t({ en: "Undo", ar: "تراجع" }),
                restored: t({
                  en: "Previous notes restored",
                  ar: "استُعيدت الملاحظات السابقة",
                }),
                failed: t({
                  en: "Could not undo. These notes may have changed.",
                  ar: "تعذّر التراجع. ربما تغيّرت هذه الملاحظات.",
                }),
                canRestore: () => authorization.current,
                undo: async () => {
                  const fresh = await services.auth.getSnapshot();
                  if (`${fresh.status}:${fresh.user?.id || "guest"}` !== owner)
                    throw new Error("ACCOUNT_CHANGED");
                  if (
                    JSON.stringify(readPublisherNotes(courseId, initial)) !==
                    JSON.stringify(after)
                  )
                    throw new Error("COURSE_NOTES_CHANGED");
                  writePublisherNotes(courseId, before, authorization.current);
                  setNotes(before);
                  setDraft(before);
                },
              });
              setNotes(draft);
              setEditing(false);
              setError(false);
              feedback.flash("saved");
            } catch {
              setError(true);
            }
          }}
        >
          {(["en", "ar"] as const).map((language) => (
            <label key={language}>
              {t(
                language === "en"
                  ? { en: "English notes", ar: "الملاحظات بالإنجليزية" }
                  : { en: "Arabic notes", ar: "الملاحظات بالعربية" },
              )}
              <textarea
                autoFocus={language === locale}
                dir={language === "ar" ? "rtl" : "ltr"}
                value={draft[language]}
                maxLength={25000}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setDraft((previous) => ({
                    ...previous,
                    [language]: event.target.value,
                  }))
                }
              />
            </label>
          ))}
          <div>
            <button type="submit" className="notebook-button">
              <Save size={16} />
              {t({ en: "Save publisher notes", ar: "حفظ ملاحظات الناشر" })}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="notebook-button"
              onClick={() => setEditing(false)}
            >
              {t({ en: "Cancel", ar: "إلغاء" })}
            </button>
          </div>
          {error && (
            <p role="alert">
              {t({
                en: "Could not save. Your draft is still here.",
                ar: "تعذّر الحفظ. مسودتك ما زالت هنا.",
              })}
            </p>
          )}
        </form>
      ) : notes[locale].trim() ? (
        <p className="publisher-note-text">{notes[locale]}</p>
      ) : (
        <p className="publisher-note-empty">
          {t({
            en: "No publisher notes yet.",
            ar: "لا توجد ملاحظات من الناشر بعد.",
          })}
        </p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/courses/CourseShelf.tsx

import { bookMaterial } from "./book-material";
import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties } from "react";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import {
  useBatches,
  useClinicalYears,
  useCourses,
} from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useWorkspacePaths } from "../../hooks/useWorkspacePaths";
import type { Course } from "../../types/content";
import { shelfCourses } from "./course-shelf";

/** A bounded shelf: native touch scrolling, mouse dragging, arrows and link keys. */
export function CourseShelf({
  course,
  showCaption = true,
}: {
  course: Course;
  showCaption?: boolean;
}) {
  const { t, dir } = useLocale(),
    paths = useWorkspacePaths();
  const courses = useCourses(),
    batches = useBatches(),
    years = useClinicalYears();
  const available = shelfCourses(
    course,
    courses.data || [course],
    batches.data || [],
    years.data || [],
  );
  const viewport = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const gesture = useRef<{
    pointer: number;
    x: number;
    y: number;
    scroll: number;
    dragging: boolean;
  } | null>(null);
  const suppressClickUntil = useRef(0);
  const [edges, setEdges] = useState({ before: false, after: false });
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const measure = () => {
    const node = viewport.current;
    if (!node) return;
    const position = Math.max(
      0,
      dir === "rtl" ? -node.scrollLeft : node.scrollLeft,
    );
    const next = {
      before: position > 2,
      after: position < node.scrollWidth - node.clientWidth - 2,
    };
    setEdges((previous) =>
      previous.before === next.before && previous.after === next.after
        ? previous
        : next,
    );
  };
  const reveal = (item: HTMLElement | null) => {
    const node = viewport.current;
    if (!node || !item) return;
    const area = node.getBoundingClientRect(),
      bounds = item.getBoundingClientRect();
    const delta =
      bounds.left < area.left
        ? bounds.left - area.left
        : bounds.right > area.right
          ? bounds.right - area.right
          : 0;
    if (delta) node.scrollLeft += delta;
    measure();
  };
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const node = viewport.current;
    if (!node) return;
    reveal(node.querySelector('[aria-current="page"]'));
    const resized = () => {
      reveal(node.querySelector('[aria-current="page"]'));
      measure();
    };
    const observer =
      typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined"
        ? new ResizeObserver(resized)
        : null;
    observer?.observe(node);
    window.addEventListener("resize", resized);
    return () => {
      observer?.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener("resize", resized);
    };
  }, [course.id, available.map((item) => item.id).join("|"), dir]);
  const browse = (forward: boolean) => {
    const node = viewport.current;
    if (!node) return;
    const max = Math.max(0, node.scrollWidth - node.clientWidth);
    const current = dir === "rtl" ? -node.scrollLeft : node.scrollLeft;
    const next = Math.max(
      0,
      Math.min(
        max,
        current + (forward ? 1 : -1) * Math.max(84, node.clientWidth * 0.8),
      ),
    );
    const left = dir === "rtl" ? -next : next;
    if (typeof node.scrollTo === "function")
      node.scrollTo({
        left,
        behavior: window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
          ? "instant"
          : "smooth",
      });
    else node.scrollLeft = left;
    measure();
  };
  const finish = (pointer: number) => {
    if (gesture.current?.pointer !== pointer) return;
    if (gesture.current.dragging)
      suppressClickUntil.current = performance.now() + 450;
    gesture.current = null;
    setDragging(false);
    if (viewport.current?.hasPointerCapture?.(pointer))
      viewport.current.releasePointerCapture(pointer);
    measure();
  };
  return (
    <nav
      className="course-shelf"
      data-dragging={dragging || undefined}
      data-overflow={edges.before || edges.after || undefined}
      style={
        {
          "--shelf-content-width": `${Math.max(84, available.length * 92 - 8)}px`,
        } as CSSProperties
      }
      aria-label={t({ en: "Courses on this shelf", ar: "مساقات هذا الرف" })}
    >
      {showCaption && (
        <div className="course-shelf-caption">
          <bdi>{course.code}</bdi>
          <strong>{t(course.title)}</strong>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="course-shelf-window">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="shelf-browse shelf-browse-before"
          disabled={!edges.before}
          aria-label={t({ en: "Previous books", ar: "الكتب السابقة" })}
          onClick={() => browse(false)}
        >
          {dir === "rtl" ? (
            <ChevronRight size={16} />
          ) : (
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
          )}
        </button>
        <div
          ref={viewport}
          className="course-shelf-scroll"
          onScroll={measure}
          onPointerDown={(event) => {
            if (event.pointerType === "touch" || event.button !== 0) return;
            gesture.current = {
              pointer: event.pointerId,
              x: event.clientX,
              y: event.clientY,
              scroll: event.currentTarget.scrollLeft,
              dragging: false,
            };
          }}
          onPointerMove={(event) => {
            const start = gesture.current;
            if (!start || start.pointer !== event.pointerId) return;
            const delta = event.clientX - start.x;
            if (!start.dragging) {
              if (
                Math.abs(delta) < 6 ||
                Math.abs(delta) < Math.abs(event.clientY - start.y)
              )
                return;
              start.dragging = true;
              setDragging(true);
              event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);
            }
            event.preventDefault();
            event.currentTarget.scrollLeft = start.scroll - delta;
            measure();
          }}
          onPointerUp={(event) => finish(event.pointerId)}
          onPointerCancel={(event) => finish(event.pointerId)}
          onLostPointerCapture={(event) => finish(event.pointerId)}
          onClickCapture={(event) => {
            if (
              event.detail > 0 &&
              performance.now() < suppressClickUntil.current
            ) {
              event.preventDefault();
              event.stopPropagation();
            }
          }}
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            const links = [
              ...event.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLAnchorElement>(
                ".shelf-book",
              ),
            ];
            const index = links.indexOf(
              document.activeElement as HTMLAnchorElement,
            );
            if (index < 0) return;
            const forward = dir === "rtl" ? "ArrowLeft" : "ArrowRight",
              back = dir === "rtl" ? "ArrowRight" : "ArrowLeft";
            const next =
              event.key === "Home"
                ? 0
                : event.key === "End"
                  ? links.length - 1
                  : event.key === forward
                    ? Math.min(index + 1, links.length - 1)
                    : event.key === back
                      ? Math.max(index - 1, 0)
                      : undefined;
            if (next !== undefined) {
              event.preventDefault();
              links[next]?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
              reveal(links[next]);
            }
          }}
        >
          <div className="course-shelf-books">
            {available.map((item) => (
              <AppLink
                key={item.id}
                href={paths.course(item.slug)}
                className={`shelf-book shelf-book-${item.accent}`}
                data-leather={bookMaterial(item.id)}
                data-course-id={item.id}
                aria-label={`${t(item.title)} · ${item.code}`}
                title={t(item.title)}
                aria-current={item.id === course.id ? "page" : undefined}
                draggable={false}
                onDragStart={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
                onFocus={(event) => reveal(event.currentTarget)}
                onClick={(event) => {
                  if (item.id === course.id) event.preventDefault();
                }}
              >
                <span className="shelf-book-cover" aria-hidden="true">
                  <bdi>{item.code}</bdi>
                  <strong>{t(item.title)}</strong>
                  <i />
                </span>
              </AppLink>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="shelf-browse shelf-browse-after"
          disabled={!edges.after}
          aria-label={t({ en: "Next books", ar: "الكتب التالية" })}
          onClick={() => browse(true)}
        >
          {dir === "rtl" ? (
            <ChevronLeft size={16} />
          ) : (
            <ChevronRight size={16} />
          )}
        </button>

          <i />
          <i />
        </span>
