import { Pause, Play, RotateCcw, Timer, Leaf } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { StudyClockFace } from "./StudyClockFace";
import "../../styles/physical-study-tools.css";
import { timerRemaining, type StudyTimer } from "./study-tools-state";
export type TimerAction =
  "configured" | "started" | "paused" | "reset" | "completed";
export function StudyTimerControls({
  timer,
  remaining,
  onChange,
}: {
  timer: StudyTimer;
  remaining: number;
  onChange: (timer: StudyTimer, action: TimerAction) => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const [sessionInput, setSessionInput] = useState(String(timer.minutes)),
    [restInput, setRestInput] = useState(String(timer.restMinutes));
  useEffect(() => {
    setSessionInput(String(timer.minutes));
    setRestInput(String(timer.restMinutes));
  }, [timer.minutes, timer.restMinutes]);
  const invalid =
    !sessionInput ||
    !Number.isInteger(Number(sessionInput)) ||
    Number(sessionInput) < 1 ||
    Number(sessionInput) > 180 ||
    !restInput ||
    !Number.isInteger(Number(restInput)) ||
    Number(restInput) < 0 ||
    Number(restInput) > 60;
  return (
    <section className="study-focus-timer" data-timer-phase={timer.phase}>
      <div
        className="study-timer-modes"
        role="group"
        aria-label={t({ en: "Timer type", ar: "نوع المؤقّت" })}
      >
        {(["focus", "relax"] as const).map((mode) => (
          <button
            key={mode}
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={timer.mode === mode}
            onClick={() => {
              const minutes = mode === "focus" ? 25 : 10;
              onChange(
                {
                  ...timer,
                  mode,
                  phase: mode,
                  minutes,
                  remaining: minutes * 60,
                  startedAt: null,
                },
                "configured",
              );
            }}
          >
            {mode === "focus" ? <Timer size={16} /> : <Leaf size={16} />}{" "}
            {t(
              mode === "focus"
                ? { en: "Focus", ar: "تركيز" }
                : { en: "Relaxation", ar: "استرخاء" },
            )}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="study-timer-durations">
        <label>
          {t({ en: "Session minutes", ar: "دقائق الجلسة" })}
          <input
            type="number"
            min={1}
            max={180}
            value={sessionInput}
            aria-invalid={
              !sessionInput ||
              Number(sessionInput) < 1 ||
              Number(sessionInput) > 180 ||
              !Number.isInteger(Number(sessionInput))
            }
            onBlur={() => setSessionInput(String(timer.minutes))}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setSessionInput(event.target.value);
              const minutes = Number(event.target.value);
              if (Number.isInteger(minutes) && minutes >= 1 && minutes <= 180)
                onChange(
                  {
                    ...timer,
                    minutes,
                    phase: timer.mode,
                    remaining: minutes * 60,
                    startedAt: null,
                  },
                  "configured",
                );
            }}
          />
        </label>
        <label>
          {t({ en: "Rest minutes", ar: "دقائق الاستراحة" })}
          <input
            type="number"
            min={0}
            max={60}
            value={restInput}
            aria-invalid={
              !restInput ||
              Number(restInput) < 0 ||
              Number(restInput) > 60 ||
              !Number.isInteger(Number(restInput))
            }
            onBlur={() => setRestInput(String(timer.restMinutes))}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setRestInput(event.target.value);
              if (!event.target.value) return;
              const restMinutes = Number(event.target.value);
              if (
                Number.isInteger(restMinutes) &&
                restMinutes >= 0 &&
                restMinutes <= 60
              )
                onChange(
                  {
                    ...timer,
                    restMinutes,
                    phase: timer.mode,
                    remaining: timer.minutes * 60,
                    startedAt: null,
                  },
                  "configured",
                );
            }}
          />
        </label>
      </div>
      {invalid && (
        <small role="status">
          {t({
            en: "Session: 1–180 minutes. Rest: 0–60 minutes.",
            ar: "الجلسة: ١–١٨٠ دقيقة. الاستراحة: ٠–٦٠ دقيقة.",
          })}
        </small>
      )}
      <p className="study-timer-phase-label">
        {t(
          timer.phase === "rest"
            ? {
                en: "Rest · start when you are ready",
                ar: "استراحة · ابدأ عندما تكون مستعداً",
              }
            : timer.mode === "relax"
              ? { en: "Relaxation session", ar: "جلسة استرخاء" }
              : { en: "Focus session", ar: "جلسة تركيز" },
        )}
      </p>
      <StudyClockFace
        remaining={remaining}
        duration={
          (timer.phase === "rest" ? timer.restMinutes : timer.minutes) * 60
        }
        running={timer.startedAt !== null}
      />
      <div className="study-timer-actions">
        <button
          type="button"
          disabled={invalid}
          onClick={() => {
            const at = Date.now();
            const running = timer.startedAt !== null;
            onChange(
              {
                ...timer,
                remaining: running
                  ? timerRemaining(timer, at)
                  : timer.remaining ||
                    (timer.phase === "rest"
                      ? timer.restMinutes
                      : timer.minutes) * 60,
                startedAt: running ? null : at,
              },
              running ? "paused" : "started",
            );
          }}
        >
          {timer.startedAt ? <Pause size={16} /> : <Play size={16} />}{" "}
          {t(
            timer.startedAt
              ? { en: "Pause", ar: "إيقاف مؤقت" }
              : { en: "Start", ar: "ابدأ" },
          )}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={t({ en: "Reset timer", ar: "إعادة ضبط المؤقّت" })}
          onClick={() =>
            onChange(
              {
                ...timer,
                phase: timer.mode,
                remaining: timer.minutes * 60,
                startedAt: null,
              },
              "reset",
            )
          }
        >
          <RotateCcw size={16} />
        </button>
      </div>
      {remaining === 0 && (
        <p role="status">
          {t({ en: "Session complete.", ar: "اكتملت الجلسة." })}
        </p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

import { StudyTimerControls, type TimerAction } from "./StudyTimerControls";
import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { NotebookPen, Timer, X, Calculator, Maximize2 } from "lucide-react";
import { StudentNotes } from "../utilities/StudentNotes";
import { GpaCalculator } from "../utilities/GpaCalculator";
import { useStudyChrome } from "../../app/providers/StudyChromeProvider";
import { useMovableDock } from "./useMovableDock";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import type { SectionLayout } from "./study-state";
import type { Resource } from "../../types/content";
import type { PageAnchor } from "../../types/study-hub";
import type { CourseNoteRequest, NotesReader } from "../utilities/course-note-model";
import {
  finishStudyTimer,
  emptyStudyTools,
  normalizeStudyTools,
  timerRemaining,
  togglePageBookmark,
  type StudyToolState,
} from "./study-tools-state";

interface StudyToolsValue {
  tool: "timer" | "notes" | "gpa";
  setTool: (tool: "timer" | "notes" | "gpa") => void;
  state: StudyToolState;
  update: (change: (previous: StudyToolState) => StudyToolState) => void;
  persistent: boolean;
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  reader: NotesReader | null;
  setReader: (
    reader: NotesReader | null,
  ) => void;
  noteRequest: CourseNoteRequest | null;
  addNote: (request: Omit<CourseNoteRequest, "token">) => void;
  noteJump: { token: number; anchor: PageAnchor } | null;
  openNote: (anchor: PageAnchor, courseId: string) => boolean;
  registerNoteOpener: (opener: ((anchor: PageAnchor, courseId: string) => boolean) | null) => void;
  toggleBookmark: (id: string, page: number) => void;
}
const Context = createContext<StudyToolsValue | null>(null);
export const useStudyTools = () => useContext(Context);
export function StudyToolsProvider({
  storageKey,
  children,
}: {
  storageKey: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const key = storageKey + ":tools:v1";
  const [state, setState] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return normalizeStudyTools(
        JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "null"),
      );
    } catch {
      return emptyStudyTools();
    }
  });
  const current = useRef(state),
    dirty = useRef(false),
    debounce = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
  const [persistent, setPersistent] = useState(true),
    [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [tool, setTool] = useState<StudyToolsValue["tool"]>("timer");
  const [reader, setReader] = useState<StudyToolsValue["reader"]>(null);
  const [noteRequest, setNoteRequest] = useState<CourseNoteRequest | null>(null);
  const [noteJump, setNoteJump] = useState<StudyToolsValue["noteJump"]>(null);
  const noteSequence = useRef(0);
  const noteOpener = useRef<((anchor: PageAnchor, courseId: string) => boolean) | null>(null);
  const registerNoteOpener = useCallback((opener: typeof noteOpener.current) => { noteOpener.current = opener; }, []);
  const openNote = useCallback((anchor: PageAnchor, courseId: string) => {
    if (!noteOpener.current?.(anchor, courseId)) return false;
    setNoteJump({ token: ++noteSequence.current, anchor });
    setOpen(false);
    return true;
  }, []);
  const flush = useCallback(() => {
    if (!dirty.current) return;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(current.current));
      dirty.current = false;
      setPersistent(true);
    } catch {
      setPersistent(false);
    }
  }, [key]);
  const update = useCallback((change: (previous: StudyToolState) => StudyToolState) => {
    current.current = change(current.current);
    dirty.current = true;
    setState(current.current);
    clearTimeout(debounce.current);
    debounce.current = setTimeout(flush, 400);
  }, [flush]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const storage = (event: StorageEvent) => {
      if (event.key === key && !dirty.current) {
        try {
          current.current = normalizeStudyTools(
            JSON.parse(event.newValue || "null"),
          );
          setState(current.current);
        } catch {}
      }
    };
    const visibility = () => {
      if (document.hidden) flush();
    };
    window.addEventListener("pagehide", flush);
    window.addEventListener("storage", storage);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(debounce.current);
      if (dirty.current) {
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(current.current));
        } catch {}
      }
      window.removeEventListener("pagehide", flush);
      window.removeEventListener("storage", storage);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);
    };
  }, [key, flush]);
  const addNote = useCallback((request: Omit<CourseNoteRequest, "token">) => {
    setNoteRequest({ ...request, token: ++noteSequence.current });
    setTool("notes"); setOpen(true);
  }, []);
  const toggleBookmark = useCallback((id: string, page: number) =>
    update((previous) => togglePageBookmark(previous, id, page)), [update]);
  const value = useMemo(() => ({ state, tool, setTool, update, persistent, open,
    setOpen, reader, setReader, noteRequest, noteJump, openNote, registerNoteOpener,
    addNote, toggleBookmark }), [state, tool, update, persistent, open, reader,
      noteRequest, noteJump, openNote, registerNoteOpener, addNote, toggleBookmark]);
  return (
    <Context.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </Context.Provider>
  );
}
export function StudyToolsButton() {
  const tools = useStudyTools(),
    { t } = useLocale();
  if (!tools) return null;
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className="notebook-button study-tools-trigger"
      aria-expanded={tools.open}
      aria-controls="study-tools-panel"
      onClick={() => tools.setOpen(!tools.open)}
      aria-label={t({ en: "Study tools", ar: "أدوات الدراسة" })}
      title={t({ en: "Study tools", ar: "أدوات الدراسة" })}
    >
      <NotebookPen size={18} />
      <span>{t({ en: "Tools", ar: "الأدوات" })}</span>
    </button>
  );
}
export function StudyToolsPanel({
  courseId,
  storageKey,
  sectionLayout,
  onSectionLayoutChange,
  resources = [],
}: {
  courseId: string;
  storageKey: string;
  sectionLayout: SectionLayout;
  onSectionLayoutChange: (layout: SectionLayout) => void;
  resources?: Resource[];
}) {
  const tools = useStudyTools(),
    { t } = useLocale();
  const { focus, setFocus, courseNavigationVisible } = useStudyChrome();
  const dock = useMovableDock(
    storageKey,
    courseNavigationVisible,
    !!tools?.open,
  );
  const [now, setNow] = useState(Date.now());
  const [timerNotice, setTimerNotice] = useState<{
    kind: TimerAction;
    token: number;
    text: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const noticeSequence = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!timerNotice || timerNotice.kind === "completed") return;
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => setTimerNotice(null), 1600);
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [timerNotice]);
  const panel = useRef<HTMLElement>(null),
    lastTrigger = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const timer = tools?.state.timer;
  const remaining = timer ? timerRemaining(timer, now) : 0;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!timer?.startedAt) return;
    setNow(Date.now());
    let interval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;
    const resume = () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      if (!document.hidden) {
        setNow(Date.now());
        interval = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000);
      }
    };
    resume();
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", resume);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", resume);
    };
  }, [timer?.startedAt]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!timer || !tools) return;
    const completed = finishStudyTimer(timer, now);
    if (completed) {
      tools.update((previous) => ({ ...previous, timer: completed.timer }));
      const text = t(
        completed.ended !== "rest" && completed.timer.phase !== "rest"
          ? { en: "Session complete", ar: "اكتملت الجلسة" }
          : completed.ended === "rest"
            ? { en: "Rest complete", ar: "اكتملت الاستراحة" }
            : completed.ended === "relax"
              ? {
                  en: "Relaxation complete. Rest is ready.",
                  ar: "اكتمل الاسترخاء. الاستراحة جاهزة.",
                }
              : {
                  en: "Focus complete. Rest is ready.",
                  ar: "اكتمل التركيز. الاستراحة جاهزة.",
                },
      );
      setTimerNotice({
        kind: "completed",
        token: ++noticeSequence.current,
        text,
      });
    }
  }, [remaining, timer?.startedAt]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tools?.open) return;
    lastTrigger.current = document.activeElement as HTMLElement;
    requestAnimationFrame(() =>
      panel.current
        ?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("button")
        ?.focus({ preventScroll: true }),
    );
  }, [tools?.open]);
  if (!tools) return null;
  function close() {
    tools!.setOpen(false);
    lastTrigger.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }
  return (
    <div
      className="study-tool-dock"
      ref={dock.root}
      style={dock.style}
      data-movable
      data-timer-notice={timerNotice?.kind}
      data-dragging={dock.dragging || undefined}
      data-edge={dock.edge || undefined}
      data-tucked={dock.tucked || undefined}
      {...dock.surface}
    >
      <span className="sr-only" role="status">
        {timerNotice?.text}
      </span>
      {timerNotice && (
        <span
          key={timerNotice.token}
          className="study-timer-action-ring"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      )}
      {timerNotice?.kind === "completed" && !dock.tucked && (
        <div className="study-timer-complete-note">
          {timerNotice.text}
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label={t({
              en: "Dismiss timer notice",
              ar: "إغلاق إشعار المؤقّت",
            })}
            onClick={() => setTimerNotice(null)}
          >
            <X size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {dock.edge && (
        <button
          ref={dock.handle}
          type="button"
          className="study-dock-handle"
          aria-label={t({
            en: "Reveal study tools",
            ar: "إظهار أدوات الدراسة",
          })}
          aria-expanded={!dock.tucked}
          aria-controls="study-tool-strip"
          {...dock.handleGrip}
          onClick={dock.handleAction}
          title={t({
            en: "Hover or click to open · Drag to move · Arrow keys to adjust",
            ar: "مرّر أو اضغط للفتح · اسحب للتحريك · الأسهم للضبط",
          })}
        >
          <span className="study-dock-tab" aria-hidden="true">
            <i className="study-dock-dots" />
          </span>
          {timerNotice?.kind === "completed" && (
            <span className="study-dock-alert" aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
        </button>
      )}
      <div
        className="study-tool-content"
        inert={dock.tucked || undefined}
        aria-hidden={dock.tucked || undefined}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          className="study-tool-grip"
          {...dock.grip}
          aria-label={t({ en: "Move study tools", ar: "تحريك أدوات الدراسة" })}
          title={t({
            en: "Drag to move · Arrow keys to adjust · Home to reset",
            ar: "اسحب للتحريك · الأسهم للضبط · Home لإعادة الموضع",
          })}
        >
          <span aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
        <div
          className="study-tool-strip"
          id="study-tool-strip"
          role="toolbar"
          aria-label={t({
            en: "Study tools",
            ar: "أدوات الدراسة",
          })}
        >
          {(["timer", "notes", "gpa"] as const).map((tool) => {
            const Icon =
              tool === "timer"
                ? Timer
                : tool === "notes"
                  ? NotebookPen
                  : Calculator;
            const name = t(
              tool === "timer"
                ? { en: "Focus timer", ar: "مؤقّت التركيز" }
                : tool === "notes"
                  ? { en: "Private notes", ar: "ملاحظات خاصة" }
                  : { en: "GPA calculator", ar: "حاسبة المعدّل" },
            );
            return (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={tool}
                title={name}
                aria-label={name}
                aria-pressed={tools.open && tools.tool === tool}
                aria-controls="study-tools-panel"
                onClick={() => {
                  tools.setTool(tool);
                  tools.setOpen(!(tools.open && tools.tool === tool));
                }}
              >
                <Icon size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
                {tool === "timer" &&
                  !dock.tucked &&
                  (!tools.open || tools.tool !== "timer") &&
                  (timer!.startedAt ||
                    timer!.remaining < timer!.minutes * 60) && (
                    <output
                      className="study-timer-badge"
                      role="timer"
                      aria-live="off"
                      data-below={Number(dock.style.top) < 65 || undefined}
                      data-running={!!timer!.startedAt}
                      aria-label={t({
                        en: "Time remaining",
                        ar: "الوقت المتبقّي",
                      })}
                    >
                      {Math.floor(remaining / 60)}:
                      {String(remaining % 60).padStart(2, "0")}
                    </output>
                  )}
                <span>
                  {t(
                    tool === "timer"
                      ? { en: "Timer", ar: "مؤقّت" }
                      : tool === "notes"
                        ? { en: "Notes", ar: "ملاحظات" }
                        : { en: "GPA", ar: "المعدّل" },
                  )}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
          {focus && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="study-exit-focus"
              aria-label={t({
                en: "Exit study focus",
                ar: "الخروج من تركيز الدراسة",
              })}
              title={t({
                en: "Exit study focus",
                ar: "الخروج من تركيز الدراسة",
              })}
              onClick={() => {
                close();
                setFocus(false);
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                  const mobile = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(
                    ".shelf-mobile-control button",
                  );
                  const target = mobile?.getBoundingClientRect().height
                    ? mobile
                    : document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(
                        '.notebook-tools button[aria-pressed="false"]',
                      );
                  target?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
                });
              }}
            >
              <Maximize2 size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>{t({ en: "Exit", ar: "خروج" })}</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <aside
        ref={panel}
        id="study-tools-panel"
        className="study-tools-panel"
        style={dock.panelStyle}
        data-open={tools.open || undefined}
        hidden={!tools.open}
        aria-label={t({ en: "Study tools", ar: "أدوات الدراسة" })}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === "Escape") {
            event.stopPropagation();
            close();
          }
        }}
      >
        <header>
          <strong>
            {t(
              tools.tool === "timer"
                ? { en: "Your study desk", ar: "مكتب دراستك" }
                : tools.tool === "notes"
                  ? { en: "Your private notebook", ar: "دفتر ملاحظاتك الخاص" }
                  : { en: "Grade planning", ar: "تخطيط الدرجات" },
            )}
          </strong>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="notebook-icon-button"
            aria-label={t({
              en: "Close study tools",
              ar: "إغلاق أدوات الدراسة",
            })}
            onClick={close}
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </header>
        {tools.tool === "timer" && (
          <StudyTimerControls
            timer={timer!}
            remaining={remaining}
            onChange={(next, kind) => {
              setNow(Date.now());
              tools.update((previous) => ({ ...previous, timer: next }));
              setTimerNotice({
                kind,
                token: ++noticeSequence.current,
                text: t(
                  kind === "configured"
                    ? { en: "Timer configured", ar: "تم ضبط المؤقّت" }
                    : kind === "started"
                      ? { en: "Timer started", ar: "بدأ المؤقّت" }
                      : kind === "paused"
                        ? { en: "Timer paused", ar: "تم إيقاف المؤقّت مؤقتاً" }
                        : { en: "Timer reset", ar: "تمت إعادة ضبط المؤقّت" },
                ),
              });
            }}
          />
        )}
        {tools.tool === "notes" && (
          <div className="study-notes-book">
            <StudentNotes
              courseId={courseId}
              legacyKey={storageKey}
              resources={resources}
              reader={tools.reader}
              request={tools.noteRequest}
              onOpenAnchor={tools.openNote}
              reference={
                tools.reader
                  ? tools.reader.title +
                    " · " +
                    t({ en: "Page", ar: "صفحة" }) +
                    " " +
                    tools.reader.page
                  : undefined
              }
            />
          </div>
        )}
        {tools.tool === "gpa" && <GpaCalculator />}
      </aside>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/courses/usePageTurn.tsx
============================================================
import {
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
  useSyncExternalStore,
  type PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent,
  type ReactNode,
  type CSSProperties,
} from "react";
import {
  dragProgress,
  shouldCommitTurn,
  type TurnDirection,
} from "./page-turn";
import { createTurnMotion, turnStageChanged, type TurnMotion } from "./page-turn-motion";

export interface TurnState {
  direction: TurnDirection;
  progress: number;
  settling: boolean;
  motion?: TurnMotion;
}
export function usePageTurn({
  rtl,
  canTurn,
  onCommit,
  identity,
}: {
  rtl: boolean;
  canTurn: (direction: TurnDirection) => boolean;
  onCommit: (direction: TurnDirection) => void;
  identity?: string;
}) {
  const [turn, setTurn] = useState<TurnState | null>(null);
  const current = useRef<TurnState | null>(null);
  const published = useRef<TurnState | null>(null);
  const motion = useRef(createTurnMotion());
  const callbacks = useRef({ canTurn, onCommit, rtl });
  callbacks.current = { canTurn, onCommit, rtl };
  const gesture = useRef<{
    id: number;
    start: number;
    startY: number;
    last: number;
    time: number;
    width: number;
    velocity: number;
  } | null>(null);
  const frame = useRef(0),
    suppressClick = useRef(false);
  const update = (next: TurnState | null) => {
    if (next) next = { ...next, motion: motion.current };
    current.current = next;
    motion.current.setProgress(next?.progress ?? 0);
    if (turnStageChanged(published.current, next)) {
      published.current = next;
      setTurn(next);
    }
  };
  function settle(commit: boolean) {
    const state = current.current;
    if (!state) return;
    cancelAnimationFrame(frame.current);
    const from = state.progress,
      to = commit ? 1 : 0,
      start = performance.now();
    const duration = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")
      .matches
      ? 0
      : Math.max(160, Math.abs(to - from) * 460);
    const animate = (now: number) => {
      const elapsed = duration ? Math.min(1, (now - start) / duration) : 1;
      const progress =
        from + (to - from) * (0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * elapsed));
      update({ ...state, progress, settling: true });
      if (elapsed < 1) frame.current = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      else {
        if (commit) callbacks.current.onCommit(state.direction);
        update(null);
      }
    };
    frame.current = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }
  function request(direction: TurnDirection) {
    if (current.current || !callbacks.current.canTurn(direction)) return;
    update({ direction, progress: 0, settling: true });
    settle(true);
  }
  function edge(direction: TurnDirection) {
    return {
      onPointerDown(event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) {
        if (
          !event.isPrimary ||
          event.button !== 0 ||
          current.current ||
          !callbacks.current.canTurn(direction)
        )
          return;
        event.stopPropagation();
        suppressClick.current = true;
        const width =
          event.currentTarget.parentElement?.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
        gesture.current = {
          id: event.pointerId,
          start: event.clientX,
          startY: event.clientY,
          last: event.clientX,
          time: performance.now(),
          width,
          velocity: 0,
        };
        event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);
        update({ direction, progress: 0, settling: false });
      },
      onPointerMove(event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) {
        const point = gesture.current,
          state = current.current;
        if (!point || point.id !== event.pointerId || !state || state.settling)
          return;
        const now = performance.now();
        point.velocity =
          ((point.last - event.clientX) *
            direction *
            (callbacks.current.rtl ? -1 : 1)) /
          Math.max(1, now - point.time);
        point.last = event.clientX;
        point.time = now;
        update({
          ...state,
          progress: dragProgress(
            point.start,
            event.clientX,
            point.width,
            direction,
            callbacks.current.rtl,
          ),
        });
      },
      onPointerUp(event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) {
        const point = gesture.current,
          state = current.current;
        if (!point || point.id !== event.pointerId || !state) return;
        gesture.current = null;
        event.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);
        settle(
          Math.hypot(
            point.start - event.clientX,
            point.startY - event.clientY,
          ) < 5 || shouldCommitTurn(state.progress, point.velocity),
        );
      },
      onPointerCancel() {
        gesture.current = null;
        suppressClick.current = false;
        settle(false);
      },
      onClick() {
        if (suppressClick.current) {
          suppressClick.current = false;
          return;
        }
        request(direction);
      },
    };
  }
  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame.current);
      gesture.current = null;
    },
    [],
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    cancelAnimationFrame(frame.current);
    gesture.current = null;
    current.current = null;
    published.current = null;
    motion.current.setProgress(0);
    setTurn(null);
  }, [identity, rtl]);
  return {
    turn,
    request,
    edge,
    cancel: () => {
      gesture.current = null;
      settle(false);
    },
  };
}
export function TurnLeaf({
  turn,
  rtl,
  twoPages = true,
  front,
  back,
}: {
  turn: TurnState;
  rtl: boolean;
  twoPages?: boolean;
  front: ReactNode;
  back: ReactNode;
}) {
  const progress = useSyncExternalStore(
    turn.motion?.subscribe ?? noSubscription,
    turn.motion?.getSnapshot ?? (() => turn.progress),
  );
  const forward = turn.direction === 1;
  const physicalRight = forward !== rtl;
  return (
    <div
      className="hand-turn-leaf"
      data-transition="ribbon"
      data-side={physicalRight ? "right" : "left"}
      data-single={!twoPages || undefined}
      aria-hidden="true"
      inert
      style={
        {
          "--turn-progress": progress,
          "--turn-cut": `${progress * 100}%`,
          "--turn-position": `${(physicalRight ? 1 - progress : progress) * 100}%`,
          "--turn-lift": Math.sin(progress * Math.PI),
        } as CSSProperties
      }
    >
      <div className="hand-turn-back">{back}</div>
      <div className="hand-turn-front">{front}</div>
      <div className="hand-ribbon-track">
        <i className="magic-paper-ribbon">
          <b />
          <b />
          <b />
        </i>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
const noSubscription = () => () => {};

FILE: src/features/events/EventRegistrationAction.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Check, TicketCheck, UsersRound, X } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { eventAvailability } from "../../lib/discovery";
import { useEventRegistrations } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import type { ClubEvent } from "../../types/content";

export function EventRegistrationAction({ event }: { event: ClubEvent }) {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const registrations = useEventRegistrations();
  const [confirmCancel, setConfirmCancel] = useState(false);
  const [justConfirmed, setJustConfirmed] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!justConfirmed) return;
    const timeout = window.setTimeout(() => setJustConfirmed(false), 500);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [justConfirmed]);
  const registration = registrations.registrations.find(
    (item) => item.eventId === event.id,
  );
  const availability = eventAvailability(event);
  const canJoin = availability === "open" || availability === "waitlist";

  async function join() {
    try {
      const result = await registrations.register(event.id);
      setJustConfirmed(true);
      toast.success(
        label(
          result.status === "registered"
            ? "registrationConfirmed"
            : "waitlistConfirmed",
        ),
      );
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("registrationFailed"));
    }
  }
  async function cancel() {
    try {
      await registrations.cancel(event.id);
      setConfirmCancel(false);
      setJustConfirmed(false);
      toast.success(label("registrationCancelled"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("registrationFailed"));
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="registration-action">
      {registration ? (
        <>
          <div
            className="registration-confirmed"
            data-just-confirmed={justConfirmed || undefined}
            onAnimationEnd={() => setJustConfirmed(false)}
            data-status={registration.status}
            role="status"
          >
            <span>
              {registration.status === "registered" ? (
                <Check size={20} />
              ) : (
                <UsersRound size={20} />
              )}
            </span>
            <div>
              <small>{label("registrationStatus")}</small>
              <strong>{label(registration.status)}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            className="button"
            onClick={() => setConfirmCancel(true)}
          >
            <X size={17} />
            {label("cancelRegistration")}
          </Button>
        </>
      ) : (
        <Button
          className="button button-primary registration-button"
          disabled={
            !canJoin || registrations.isMutating || registrations.isPending
          }
          onClick={() => void join()}
        >
          {availability === "waitlist" ? (
            <UsersRound size={18} />
          ) : (
            <TicketCheck size={18} />
          )}
          {label(
            availability === "waitlist"
              ? "joinWaitlist"
              : availability === "upcoming"
                ? "opensSoon"
                : availability === "closed" || availability === "ended"
                  ? "registrationClosed"
                  : "registerEvent",
          )}
        </Button>
      )}
      <Modal
        open={confirmCancel}
        onClose={() => setConfirmCancel(false)}
        title={label("cancelRegistrationTitle")}
        description={label("cancelRegistrationBody")}
      >
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setConfirmCancel(false)}>
            {label("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="destructive"
            disabled={registrations.isMutating}
            onClick={() => void cancel()}
          >
            {label("cancelRegistration")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

type View = "all" | "upcoming" | "open" | "waitlist";
export default function EventsPage() {

      const status = eventAvailability(event);

        view === "all" ||
        (view === "upcoming" ? status !== "ended" : status === view);

        !needle ||

          t(event.title),
          t(event.description),
          t(event.location),
          t(event.type),
        ].some((value) => value.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle));
      return (
        tabMatch &&
        textMatch &&
        (!category || event.category === category) &&
        (!format || event.format === format)
      );
    });

      id: "waitlist",
      label: label("eventWaitlist"),
      icon: UsersRound,
      count: events.filter((event) => eventAvailability(event) === "waitlist")
        .length,
    },
    {
      id: "all",
      label: label("eventAll"),
      icon: CalendarDays,
      count: events.length,
    },
  ] as const;
  return (

      <section className="discovery-hero event-discovery-hero artwork-scene">

          </h1>
          <p>{label("eventsHubBody")}</p>
        </div>
        <HeroArtwork section="involved" />
      </section>
      <section
        className="discovery-controls"
        aria-label={label("eventFilters")}
      >
        <AliveTabs
          label={label("eventFilters")}
          items={[...tabs]}
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
        />
        <div className="discovery-filter-row">
          <label className="discovery-search">
            <Search size={18} />
            <input
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={label("eventSearch")}
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{label("category")}</span>
            <select

                "training",
              ].map((value) => (

                  {label(value as "workshop")}

              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{label("format")}</span>
            <select value={format} onChange={(e) => setFormat(e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">{label("allTypes")}</option>
              {["onsite", "hybrid", "online"].map((value) => (
                <option value={value} key={value}>
                  {label(value as "onsite")}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
      </section>
      <div className="results-line">
        <strong>{filtered.length}</strong> {label("results")}
      </div>
      {filtered.length ? (
        <div className="event-ticket-grid">

      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          title={label("noEventPlans")}
          description={label("noEventPlansBody")}
          href="/events"
        />
      )}
      {saved.length > 0 && (
        <section className="saved-discovery-section">
          <div className="personal-section-heading">
            <div>
              <span className="eyebrow">
                <PartyPopper size={14} /> {label("discoverSavedEvents")}
              </span>
              <h2>{label("savedShort")}</h2>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="event-ticket-grid">
            {saved.map((event) => (
              <EventTicketCard event={event} key={event.id} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

  const catalog = useExamQuery("catalog", (signal) => service.catalog(signal)),

    );
  const selected = catalog.data?.sets.find((s) => s.id === params.get("set")),
    questions = useExamQuery(
      "questions",
      (signal) => service.questions(selected!.id, signal),
      selected?.id || "",
      !!selected,
    );
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("sets"),
    [query, setQuery] = useState(""),
    [setDialog, setSetDialog] = useState<ExamSet | "new" | null>(null),
    [editor, setEditor] = useState<ExamQuestion | "new" | null>(null),
    [importing, setImporting] = useState(false),
    [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<ExamSet | null>(null),
    [pending, setPending] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [limit, setLimit] = useState(25);
  const sets = (catalog.data?.sets || []).filter(
    (s) =>
      s.version !== "preview-1" &&
      !s.ownerId &&
      `${s.title.en} ${s.title.ar}`.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()),
  );
  async function remove() {
    if (!deleting) return;
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await service.admin.deleteSet(deleting.id, deleting.version);
      setDeleting(null);
      if (selected?.id === deleting.id) setParams({});
      await refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }
  async function resolve(id: string) {
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await service.admin.resolveReport(id);
      await refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <section className="container exam-platform exam-admin">
      <div className="exam-preview-note">
        <FileQuestion size={16} />
        <span>
          {t(
            service.source === "preview"

                }
              : { en: "Exam content workspace", ar: "مساحة محتوى الامتحانات" },

        eyebrow={t({ en: "Question bank management", ar: "إدارة بنك الأسئلة" })}
        title={
          selected
            ? t(selected.title)
            : t({
                en: "Give good questions\na clear home.",
                ar: "امنح الأسئلة الجيدة\nمساحة واضحة.",
              })
        }
        body={t({
          en: "Manage question sets, review explanations and resolve reported issues.",
          ar: "أدر مجموعات الأسئلة وراجع الشرح والبلاغات.",
        })}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          className="button button-primary"
          onClick={() => setSetDialog("new")}
        >

          {t({ en: "New question set", ar: "مجموعة أسئلة جديدة" })}

      {catalog.isPending ? (

function SetEditor({
  existing,
  courses,
  close,
  saved,
}: {
  existing?: ExamSet;
  courses: import("../../types/content").Course[];
  close: () => void;
  saved: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    { service, refresh } = useExams(),
    errorText = useExamError();
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(existing?.title.en || ""),
    [arabic, setArabic] = useState(
      existing?.title.ar === existing?.title.en ? "" : existing?.title.ar || "",
    ),
    [course, setCourse] = useState(existing?.courseId || courses[0]?.id || ""),
    [batch, setBatch] = useState(existing?.batch.en || ""),
    [kind, setKind] = useState<ExamSet["kind"]>(existing?.kind || "practice"),
    [year, setYear] = useState(existing?.year || new Date().getFullYear()),
    [published, setPublished] = useState(existing?.published || false),
    [pending, setPending] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const set = await service.admin.saveSet(
        {
          id: existing?.id || "",
          courseId: course,
          title: { en: title.trim(), ar: arabic.trim() || title.trim() },
          description: existing?.description || bilingual(""),
          batch: bilingual(batch.trim() || "General"),
          kind,
          year,
          suggestedMinutes:
            existing?.suggestedMinutes ||
            Math.max(1, existing?.questionIds.length || 1),
          published,
          questionIds: existing?.questionIds || [],
          version: existing?.version || "new",
        },
        existing?.version,
      );
      await refresh();
      saved(set.id);
      close();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
      setPending(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <Modal
      open
      onClose={() => !pending && close()}
      title={t(
        existing
          ? { en: "Edit question set", ar: "تعديل المجموعة" }
          : { en: "New question set", ar: "مجموعة جديدة" },
      )}
      description={t({
        en: "Save as a draft while you prepare the questions.",
        ar: "احفظها مسودة أثناء تجهيز الأسئلة.",
      })}
      className="exam-set-dialog"
      initialFocus="#exam-set-title"
    >
      <form className="exam-form" onSubmit={submit}>
        <label>
          <span>{t({ en: "Set title", ar: "اسم المجموعة" })}</span>
          <input
            id="exam-set-title"
            required
            maxLength={150}
            value={title}
            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
          />
        </label>
        <label>
          <span>
            {t({
              en: "Arabic title (optional)",
              ar: "الاسم بالعربية (اختياري)",
            })}
          </span>
          <input
            value={arabic}
            maxLength={150}
            dir="auto"
            onChange={(e) => setArabic(e.target.value)}
          />
        </label>
        <label>
          <span>{t({ en: "Course", ar: "المساق" })}</span>
          <select
            value={course}
            required
            onChange={(e) => setCourse(e.target.value)}
            disabled={!!existing?.questionIds.length}
          >
            {courses.map((c) => (
              <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                {t(c.title)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <div className="exam-form-pair">
          <label>
            <span>{t({ en: "Batch", ar: "الدفعة" })}</span>
            <input
              value={batch}
              onChange={(e) => setBatch(e.target.value)}
              maxLength={100}
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{t({ en: "Calendar year", ar: "السنة" })}</span>
            <input
              type="number"
              min={2000}
              max={2100}
              value={year}
              onChange={(e) => setYear(Number(e.target.value))}
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{t({ en: "Type", ar: "النوع" })}</span>
            <select
              value={kind}
              onChange={(e) => setKind(e.target.value as ExamSet["kind"])}
            >
              {(["practice", "midterm", "final"] as const).map((k) => (
                <option key={k} value={k}>
                  {t({
                    en: k,
                    ar: { practice: "تدريب", midterm: "نصفي", final: "نهائي" }[
                      k
                    ],
                  })}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        <label className="exam-check">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={published}
            disabled={!existing?.questionIds.length}
            onChange={(e) => setPublished(e.target.checked)}
          />
          <span>{t({ en: "Publish this set", ar: "نشر المجموعة" })}</span>
        </label>
        {error && (
          <p className="exam-error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <footer>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="button button-secondary"
            disabled={pending}
            onClick={close}
          >
            {t({ en: "Cancel", ar: "إلغاء" })}
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="button button-primary"
            disabled={pending}
          >
            {t(
              pending
                ? { en: "Saving…", ar: "جارٍ الحفظ…" }
                : { en: "Save set", ar: "حفظ المجموعة" },
            )}
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/exams/CustomExamBuilder.tsx

import { useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import type { Course } from "../../types/content";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useExamQuery, useExams, useExamError } from "./useExams";
export function CustomExamBuilder({
  course,
  close,
}: {
  course: Course;
  close: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    { base, service, refresh } = useExams(),
    navigate = useNavigate(),
    errorText = useExamError();
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(
      t({ en: "My focused practice", ar: "تدريبي المركز" }),
    ),
    [count, setCount] = useState(1),
    [shuffle, setShuffle] = useState(true),
    [batch, setBatch] = useState("");
  const [chapters, setChapters] = useState<string[]>([]),
    [lectures, setLectures] = useState<string[]>([]),
    [doctors, setDoctors] = useState<string[]>([]),
    [pending, setPending] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  const filters = { batch, chapters, lectures, doctors };
  const pool = useExamQuery(
    "custom-options",
    (signal) => service.customOptions(course.id, filters, signal),
    `${course.id}:${JSON.stringify(filters)}`,
  );
  const total = pool.data?.matchedCount || 0;
  const choices = [
    {
      label: { en: "Chapters", ar: "الفصول" },
      values: pool.data?.chapters || [],
      selected: chapters,
      set: setChapters,
    },
    {
      label: { en: "Lectures", ar: "المحاضرات" },
      values: pool.data?.lectures || [],
      selected: lectures,
      set: setLectures,
    },
    {
      label: { en: "Doctors", ar: "المحاضرون" },
      values: pool.data?.doctors || [],
      selected: doctors,
      set: setDoctors,
    },
  ];
  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!title.trim() || count < 1 || count > Math.min(total, 100)) {
      setError(
        t({
          en: "Choose a title and a question count within the matching pool.",
          ar: "اختر اسماً وعدد أسئلة ضمن المجموعة المطابقة.",
        }),
      );
      return;
    }
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const set = await service.custom({
        courseId: course.id,
        count,
        chapters,
        lectures,
        doctors,
        batch,
        shuffle,
        title,
      });
      await refresh();
      close();
      navigate(`${base}/set/${set.id}`);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
      setPending(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <Modal
      open
      onClose={close}
      title={t({ en: "Build a focused session", ar: "إنشاء جلسة مركزة" })}
      description={t(course.title)}
      className="exam-builder-dialog"
      initialFocus="#exam-custom-title"
    >
      <form className="exam-form" onSubmit={submit}>
        <label>
          <span>{t({ en: "Session title", ar: "اسم الجلسة" })}</span>
          <input
            id="exam-custom-title"
            maxLength={100}
            value={title}
            onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
            required
          />
        </label>
        <div className="exam-form-pair">
          <label>
            <span>{t({ en: "Questions", ar: "عدد الأسئلة" })}</span>
            <input
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={Math.min(total, 100)}
              value={count}
              onChange={(e) => setCount(Number(e.target.value))}
              required
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{t({ en: "Batch", ar: "الدفعة" })}</span>
            <select value={batch} onChange={(e) => setBatch(e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">
                {t({ en: "All batches", ar: "كل الدفعات" })}
              </option>
              {pool.data?.batches.map((b) => (
                <option key={b.en} value={b.en}>
                  {t(b)}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        <p className="exam-pool-count" role="status">
          {pool.isPending
            ? t({
                en: "Finding matching questions…",
                ar: "جارٍ البحث عن الأسئلة المطابقة…",
              })
            : `${total} ${t({ en: "questions match your filters", ar: "سؤالاً يطابق مرشحاتك" })}`}
        </p>
        {choices
          .filter((group) => group.values.length)
          .map((group) => (
            <details key={group.label.en} className="exam-filter-group">
              <summary>
                {t(group.label)} ·{" "}
                {group.selected.length || t({ en: "All", ar: "الكل" })}
              </summary>
              <div>
                {group.values.map(({ value, label }) => (
                  <label key={value}>
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={group.selected.includes(value)}
                      onChange={() =>
                        group.set((previous) =>
                          previous.includes(value)
                            ? previous.filter((v) => v !== value)
                            : [...previous, value],
                        )
                      }
                    />
                    <span>{t(label)}</span>
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
            </details>
          ))}
        <label className="exam-check">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={shuffle}
            onChange={(e) => setShuffle(e.target.checked)}
          />
          <span>
            {t({ en: "Shuffle the questions", ar: "ترتيب الأسئلة عشوائياً" })}
          </span>
        </label>
        {(error || pool.isError) && (
          <p className="exam-error" role="alert">
            {error || errorText(pool.error)}
          </p>
        )}
        <footer>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="button button-secondary"
            onClick={close}
          >
            {t({ en: "Cancel", ar: "إلغاء" })}
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="button button-primary"
            disabled={pending || pool.isPending || !total || count > total}
          >
            {t(
              pending
                ? { en: "Preparing…", ar: "جارٍ التجهيز…" }
                : { en: "Prepare my session", ar: "تجهيز جلستي" },
            )}
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import {
  ArrowUpRight,
  BookOpen,
  Bookmark,
  History,
  Search,
  Layers,
  FileQuestion,
} from "lucide-react";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useExams } from "./useExams";
import "./exams.css";
export function ExamFrame({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    { base, service } = useExams(),
    { pathname } = useLocation();
  const playing =
    pathname.includes("/attempt/") && !pathname.endsWith("/results");
  const [toolsOpen, setToolsOpen] = useState(false);
  const links = [
    { path: "", label: { en: "Browse", ar: "تصفح" }, icon: BookOpen },
    {
      path: "/history",
      label: { en: "My attempts", ar: "محاولاتي" },
      icon: History,
    },
    {
      path: "/notebook",
      label: { en: "Saved questions", ar: "الأسئلة المحفوظة" },
      icon: Bookmark,
    },
    {
      path: "/wrong",
      label: { en: "Revisit mistakes", ar: "مراجعة الأخطاء" },
      icon: Layers,
    },
    { path: "/search", label: { en: "Search", ar: "بحث" }, icon: Search },
  ];
  return (
    <section
      className={`container exam-platform${playing ? " exam-platform-playing" : ""}`}
      data-exam-source={service.source}
    >
      {!playing && (
        <nav
          className="exam-navigation"
          aria-label={t({ en: "Exam navigation", ar: "تنقل الامتحانات" })}
        >
          {links.map(({ path, label, icon: Icon }) => (
            <AppLink
              href={base + path}
              key={path}
              className={
                path === "" || path === "/search"
                  ? "exam-nav-primary"
                  : "exam-nav-secondary"
              }
              aria-current={pathname === base + path ? "page" : undefined}
            >
              <Icon size={17} />
              <span>{t(label)}</span>
            </AppLink>
          ))}
          <button
            type="button"
            className="exam-nav-tools"
            onClick={() => setToolsOpen(true)}
          >
            <Layers size={17} />
            <span>{t({ en: "Exam tools", ar: "أدوات الامتحانات" })}</span>
          </button>
        </nav>
      )}
      {service.source === "preview" && (
        <div className="exam-preview-note">
          <FileQuestion size={15} />
          <span>
            {t({
              en: "Interface preview · Sample questions · Saved on this device",
              ar: "معاينة الواجهة · أسئلة توضيحية · تحفظ على هذا الجهاز",
            })}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
      {service.persistent === false && (
        <p className="exam-error" role="status">
          {t({
            en: "Device storage is full or unavailable. Changes are available for this session only.",
            ar: "تخزين الجهاز ممتلئ أو غير متاح. التغييرات متاحة لهذه الجلسة فقط.",
          })}
        </p>
      )}
      {children}
      {toolsOpen && (
        <Modal
          open
          onClose={() => setToolsOpen(false)}
          title={t({ en: "Your exam tools", ar: "أدوات امتحاناتك" })}
          description=""
          className="exam-tools-dialog"
        >
          <nav>
            {links
              .filter((item) => item.path !== "" && item.path !== "/search")
              .map(({ path, label, icon: Icon }) => (
                <AppLink
                  href={base + path}
                  key={path}
                  onClick={() => setToolsOpen(false)}
                >
                  <Icon size={20} />
                  {t(label)}
                </AppLink>
              ))}
          </nav>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
export function ExamHeading({
  eyebrow,
  title,
  body,
  children,
  heading = "h1",
}: {
  eyebrow: string;
  title: string;
  body?: string;
  children?: ReactNode;
  heading?: "h1" | "h2";
}) {
  const Heading = heading;
  return (
    <header className="exam-page-heading">
      <div>
        <span className="exam-kicker">{eyebrow}</span>
        <Heading
          data-page-heading={heading === "h1" ? "" : undefined}
          tabIndex={-1}
        >
          {title}
        </Heading>
        {body && <p>{body}</p>}
      </div>
      {children}
    </header>
  );
}
export function ExamEmpty({
  title,
  body,
  href,
  action,
}: {
  title: string;
  body: string;
  href?: string;
  action?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="exam-empty">
      <BookOpen size={38} strokeWidth={1} />
      <h2>{title}</h2>
      <p>{body}</p>
      {href && (
        <AppLink className="button button-secondary" href={href}>
          {action}
          <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={17} />
        </AppLink>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
export function ExamFailure({
  message,
  retry,
}: {
  message: string;
  retry?: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  return (
    <div className="exam-empty" role="alert">
      <p>{message}</p>
      {retry && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className="button button-secondary"
          onClick={retry}
        >
          {t({ en: "Try again", ar: "حاول مجدداً" })}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/exams/ExamHistory.tsx
============================================================
import { useState } from "react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Play, ArrowUpRight, Clock3 } from "lucide-react";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { APP_TIMEZONE } from "../../constants/config";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { useExams, useExamQuery, useExamError } from "./useExams";
import { ExamHeading, ExamEmpty, ExamFailure } from "./ExamFrame";
import type { ExamAttempt } from "../../types/exams";
import { durationLabel } from "./exam-model";
export default function ExamHistory() {
  const { t, locale } = useLocale(),
    { service, base, refresh, owner } = useExams(),
    errorText = useExamError(),
    client = useQueryClient();
  const attempts = useExamQuery("attempts", (signal) =>
      service.attempts(signal),
    ),
    catalog = useExamQuery("catalog", (signal) => service.catalog(signal));
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("active"),
    [limit, setLimit] = useState(20),
    [ending, setEnding] = useState<ExamAttempt | null>(null),
    [pending, setPending] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  const filtered =
    attempts.data?.filter((a) => filter === "all" || a.status === filter) || [];
  async function end() {
    if (!ending) return;
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await service.abandon(ending.id, ending.version);
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem(
          `medclub.exam-draft.${encodeURIComponent(owner)}.${ending.id}`,
        );
      } catch {}
      client.removeQueries({
        queryKey: ["exams", owner, "attempt", ending.id],
      });
      setEnding(null);
      await refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <>
      <ExamHeading
        eyebrow={t({
          en: "Your personal practice record",
          ar: "سجل تدريبك الشخصي",
        })}
        title={t({
          en: "Pick up a session.\nReflect on the last one.",
          ar: "تابع جلسة.\nوراجع ما أنجزته.",
        })}
      />
      <div
        className="exam-filter-tabs"
        aria-label={t({ en: "Attempt status", ar: "حالة المحاولة" })}
      >
        {["active", "finished", "all"].map((value) => (
          <button
            key={value}
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={filter === value}
            onClick={() => {
              setFilter(value);
              setLimit(20);
            }}
          >
            {t({
              en:
                value === "active"
                  ? "In progress"
                  : value === "finished"
                    ? "Finished"
                    : "All attempts",
              ar:
                value === "active"
                  ? "جارية"
                  : value === "finished"
                    ? "مكتملة"
                    : "كل المحاولات",
            })}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {attempts.isPending ? (
        <LoadingState />
      ) : attempts.isError ? (
        <ExamFailure
          message={errorText(attempts.error)}
          retry={() => void attempts.refetch()}
        />
      ) : filtered.length ? (
        <div className="exam-attempt-list">
          {filtered.slice(0, limit).map((a) => {
            const set = catalog.data?.sets.find((e) => e.id === a.examId),
              course =
                set && catalog.data?.courses.find((c) => c.id === set.courseId);
            return (
              <article key={a.id} className="exam-attempt-card">
                <div>
                  <span className="exam-kicker">
                    {course
                      ? t(course.title)
                      : t({ en: "Saved session", ar: "جلسة محفوظة" })}
                  </span>
                  <h2>
                    {set
                      ? t(set.title)
                      : t({
                          en: "Previous question set",
                          ar: "مجموعة أسئلة سابقة",
                        })}
                  </h2>
                  <p>
                    {new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
                      locale === "ar" ? "ar-JO" : "en-GB",
                      { timeZone: APP_TIMEZONE, dateStyle: "medium" },
                    ).format(new Date(a.updatedAt))}{" "}
                    ·{" "}
                    {t(
                      a.mode === "practice"
                        ? { en: "Practice", ar: "تدريب" }
                        : { en: "Self test", ar: "اختبار ذاتي" },
                    )}
                  </p>
                  <small>
                    <Clock3 size={14} />
                    {durationLabel(a.progress.elapsedSeconds)} ·{" "}
                    {Object.keys(a.progress.answers).length}/
                    {a.questions.length} {t({ en: "answered", ar: "مجابة" })}
                    {a.status === "finished" &&
                    a.summary &&
                    a.summary.percentage !== null
                      ? ` · ${a.summary.percentage}%`
                      : ""}
                  </small>
                </div>
                <div className="exam-attempt-actions">
                  {a.status !== "abandoned" && (
                    <AppLink
                      href={`${base}/attempt/${a.id}${a.status === "finished" ? "/results" : ""}`}
                      className="button button-secondary"
                    >
                      {a.status === "active" ? (
                        <Play size={16} />
                      ) : (
                        <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={16} />
                      )}
                      {t(
                        a.status === "active"
                          ? { en: "Continue", ar: "متابعة" }
                          : { en: "Review", ar: "مراجعة" },
                      )}
                    </AppLink>
                  )}
                  {a.status === "active" && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="text-link"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setEnding(a);
                        setError("");
                      }}
                    >
                      {t({ en: "End session", ar: "إنهاء الجلسة" })}
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {a.status === "abandoned" && (
                    <span>{t({ en: "Ended", ar: "منتهية" })}</span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </article>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ExamEmpty
          title={t({
            en: "A fresh page in your practice record",
            ar: "صفحة جديدة في سجل تدريبك",
          })}
          body={t({
            en: "Your sessions will appear here when you start a question set.",
            ar: "تظهر جلساتك هنا عندما تبدأ مجموعة أسئلة.",
          })}
          href={base}
          action={t({ en: "Choose a course", ar: "اختيار مساق" })}
        />
      )}
      {filtered.length > limit && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className="button button-secondary"
          onClick={() => setLimit((n) => n + 20)}
        >
          {t({ en: "Show more", ar: "عرض المزيد" })}
        </button>
      )}
      {ending && (
        <Modal
          open
          onClose={() => !pending && setEnding(null)}
          title={t({
            en: "End this saved session?",
            ar: "إنهاء الجلسة المحفوظة؟",
          })}
          description={t({
            en: "It will leave your in-progress list. Your other attempts and saved questions stay available.",
            ar: "ستُزال من قائمة الجلسات الجارية. تبقى محاولاتك الأخرى والأسئلة المحفوظة متاحة.",
          })}
          className="exam-finish-dialog"
        >
          {error && (
            <p className="exam-error" role="alert">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="exam-dialog-actions">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="button button-secondary"
              onClick={() => setEnding(null)}
              disabled={pending}
            >
              {t({ en: "Keep session", ar: "الاحتفاظ بالجلسة" })}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="button button-primary"
              onClick={() => void end()}
              disabled={pending}
            >
              {t({ en: "End session", ar: "إنهاء الجلسة" })}
            </button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  ArrowUpRight,
  ArrowLeft,
  BookOpen,
  Check,
  Compass,
  Layers,
  Search,
  Sparkles,
} from "lucide-react";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useExams, useExamQuery, useExamError } from "./useExams";
import { ExamHeading, ExamEmpty, ExamFailure } from "./ExamFrame";
import { useState } from "react";
import { CustomExamBuilder } from "./CustomExamBuilder";
import { useStudentProfile } from "../../hooks/useContent";

export default function ExamHub() {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    { service, base } = useExams(),
    error = useExamError();
  const catalog = useExamQuery("catalog", (signal) => service.catalog(signal));
  const profile = useStudentProfile();
  const attempts = useExamQuery("attempts", (signal) =>
    service.attempts(signal),
  );
  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams(),
    [builder, setBuilder] = useState(false);
  const courseId = params.get("course") || "",
    year = params.get("year") || "",
    track = params.get("track") || "",
    semester = params.get("semester") || "",
    query = params.get("q") || "";
  const course = catalog.data?.courses.find((c) => c.id === courseId);
  const courses = (catalog.data?.courses || []).filter(
    (c) =>
      (!year || String(c.year) === year) &&
      (!track || c.track === track) &&
      (!semester || String(((c.semester - 1) % 2) + 1) === semester) &&
      `${c.title.en} ${c.title.ar} ${c.code}`
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(query.toLowerCase()),
  );
  if (base === "/my/exams")
    courses.sort(
      (a, b) =>
        Number(profile.data?.courseIds.includes(b.id)) -
        Number(profile.data?.courseIds.includes(a.id)),
    );
  const sets =
    catalog.data?.sets.filter(
      (e) =>
        e.courseId === courseId &&
        (!params.get("batch") || e.batch.en === params.get("batch")) &&
        (!params.get("kind") || e.kind === params.get("kind")),
    ) || [];
  const active = attempts.data?.find((a) => a.status === "active");
  function filter(name: string, value: string) {
    const next = new URLSearchParams(params);
    value ? next.set(name, value) : next.delete(name);
    if (name === "track" && value === "clinical") next.delete("semester");
    setParams(next, { replace: true });
  }
  if (catalog.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (catalog.isError)
    return (
      <ExamFailure
        message={error(catalog.error)}
        retry={() => void catalog.refetch()}
      />
    );
  return (
    <>
      {!course ? (
        <>
          <section className="exam-hub-hero">
            <div>
              <span className="exam-kicker">
                <Compass size={17} />
                {t({
                  en: "Your practice, with purpose",
                  ar: "تدريبك بخطوة واضحة",
                })}
              </span>
              <h1 data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>
                {t({
                  en: "One question closer\nto understanding.",
                  ar: "كل سؤال يقربك\nمن الفهم.",
                })}
              </h1>
              <p>
                {t({
                  en: "Choose your course, build a focused session, and keep the questions that need another look close.",
                  ar: "اختر مساقك وأنشئ جلسة مركزة. احتفظ بالأسئلة التي تحتاج مراجعة بالقرب منك.",
                })}
              </p>
              <div className="exam-hero-actions">
                <a href="#exam-courses" className="button button-primary">
                  {t({ en: "Find my course", ar: "اختيار مساقي" })}
                  <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={18} />
                </a>
                <AppLink href={base + "/history"} className="text-link">
                  {t({ en: "My attempts", ar: "محاولاتي" })}
                </AppLink>
              </div>
            </div>
            <aside className="exam-hero-ledger">
              <span className="exam-kicker">
                {t({ en: "A clear way forward", ar: "طريق واضح" })}
              </span>
              <div className="exam-ledger-mark">
                <Layers size={38} strokeWidth={1.25} />
              </div>
              {active ? (
                <>
                  <h2>
                    {t({
                      en: "Your session is waiting.",
                      ar: "جلستك بانتظارك.",
                    })}
                  </h2>
                  <p>
                    {Object.keys(active.progress.answers).length}/
                    {active.questions.length}{" "}
                    {t({ en: "answered", ar: "تمت الإجابة عنها" })}
                  </p>
                  <AppLink
                    className="button button-secondary"
                    href={`${base}/attempt/${active.id}`}
                  >
                    {t({ en: "Continue my session", ar: "متابعة جلستي" })}
                    <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={17} />
                  </AppLink>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <h2>
                    {t({
                      en: "A little focus.\nA useful next step.",
                      ar: "تركيز بسيط.\nوخطوة مفيدة.",
                    })}
                  </h2>
                  <ol>
                    <li>
                      <Check size={16} />
                      {t({ en: "Choose a course", ar: "اختر مساقاً" })}
                    </li>
                    <li>
                      <Check size={16} />
                      {t({
                        en: "Practice or test yourself",
                        ar: "تدرب أو اختبر نفسك",
                      })}
                    </li>
                    <li>
                      <Check size={16} />
                      {t({
                        en: "Review the reasoning",
                        ar: "راجع أسباب الإجابات",
                      })}
                    </li>
                  </ol>
                </>
              )}
            </aside>
          </section>
          <section id="exam-courses" className="exam-catalog">
            <ExamHeading
              eyebrow={t({ en: "Your question shelves", ar: "رفوف أسئلتك" })}
              title={t({ en: "Choose your course", ar: "اختر مساقك" })}
              heading="h2"
            />
            <div className="exam-filters">
              <label className="exam-search-field">
                <Search size={18} />
                <input
                  aria-label={t({ en: "Find a course", ar: "البحث عن مساق" })}
                  placeholder={t({
                    en: "Course name or code",
                    ar: "اسم المساق أو رمزه",
                  })}
                  value={query}
                  onChange={(e) => filter("q", e.target.value)}
                />
              </label>
              <select
                aria-label={t({ en: "Academic year", ar: "السنة الدراسية" })}
                value={year}
                onChange={(e) => filter("year", e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">
                  {t({ en: "All years", ar: "كل السنوات" })}
                </option>
                {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((n) => (
                  <option value={n} key={n}>
                    {t({ en: "Year", ar: "السنة" })} {n}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <select
                aria-label={t({ en: "Track", ar: "المسار" })}
                value={track}
                onChange={(e) => filter("track", e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">

                          : t({

              <Sparkles size={18} />

            </button>

              <option value="">

              </option>
              {["practice", "midterm", "final", "custom"].map((kind) => (

                    en: kind,

                      {
                        practice: "تدريب",
                        midterm: "نصفي",
                        final: "نهائي",
                        custom: "مخصص",
                      } as Record<string, string>
                    )[kind],
                  })}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="exam-set-grid">
            {sets.map((set) => (
              <AppLink
                className="exam-set-card"
                key={set.id}
                href={`${base}/set/${encodeURIComponent(set.id)}`}
              >
                <span className="exam-kicker">
                  {t(set.batch)}
                  {set.year ? ` · ${set.year}` : ""}
                </span>
                <h2>{t(set.title)}</h2>

                <footer>
                  <span>
                    {set.questionIds.length}{" "}
                    {t({ en: "questions", ar: "سؤال" })} ·{" "}
                    {set.suggestedMinutes}{" "}
                    {t({ en: "min suggested", ar: "دقيقة مقترحة" })}
                  </span>
                  <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={18} />
                </footer>
              </AppLink>
            ))}
          </div>
          {!sets.length && (

              title={t({

            />

              close={() => setBuilder(false)}
