FILE: src/features/exams/ExamImport.tsx
============================================================
import { useState } from "react";
import type { ExamSet, ExamQuestion } from "../../types/exams";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useExams, useExamError } from "./useExams";
import { parseBulkImport, type ParseResult } from "./portable/bulk-import";
import { bilingual, choiceKeys } from "./exam-model";
const example =
  "1. Example question?\nA. First choice\nB. Correct choice *\nC. Third choice\nD. Fourth choice\nChapter: Chapter name\nLecture: Lecture name\nExplanation: Explain the reasoning here.";
export function ExamImport({
  exam,
  close,
}: {
  exam: ExamSet;
  close: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    { service, refresh } = useExams(),
    errorText = useExamError();
  const [text, setText] = useState(""),
    [parsed, setParsed] = useState<ParseResult | null>(null),
    [pending, setPending] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  async function validate() {
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
    setParsed(parseBulkImport(text));
    setPending(false);
  }
  async function save() {
    if (!parsed?.questions.length || parsed.errors.length) return;
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    const questions: ExamQuestion[] = parsed.questions.map((q) => ({
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      courseId: exam.courseId,
      stem: bilingual(q.questionText),
      choices: choiceKeys
        .filter((key) => q.choices[key]?.trim())
        .map((key) => ({
          key,
          text: bilingual(q.choices[key]!),
          ...(q.wrongExplanations?.[key]
            ? { explanation: bilingual(q.wrongExplanations[key]!) }
            : {}),
        })),
      correct: q.correctAnswer,
      chapter: bilingual(q.chapterName || "General"),
      lecture: q.lectureName ? bilingual(q.lectureName) : undefined,
      doctor: q.doctorName,
      explanation: q.explanation ? bilingual(q.explanation) : undefined,
      version: "new",
    }));
    try {
      await service.admin.saveQuestions(exam.id, questions, exam.version);
      await refresh();
      close();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
      setPending(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <Modal
      open
      onClose={() => !pending && close()}
      title={t({ en: "Import questions", ar: "استيراد الأسئلة" })}
      description={t(exam.title)}
      className="exam-import-dialog"
    >
      <div className="exam-form">
        <details>
          <summary>
            {t({ en: "See the expected format", ar: "عرض صيغة الاستيراد" })}
          </summary>
          <pre dir="ltr">{example}</pre>
        </details>
        <label>
          <span>
            {t({ en: "Paste up to 500 questions", ar: "ألصق حتى ٥٠٠ سؤال" })}
          </span>
          <textarea
            rows={12}
            value={text}
            maxLength={200000}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setText(e.target.value);
              setParsed(null);
            }}
            aria-label={t({
              en: "Questions to import",
              ar: "الأسئلة المراد استيرادها",
            })}
          />
        </label>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="button button-secondary"
          disabled={pending || !text.trim()}
          onClick={() => void validate()}
        >
          {t({ en: "Validate and preview", ar: "التحقق والمعاينة" })}
        </button>
        {parsed && (
          <section className="exam-import-result" role="status">
            <strong>
              {parsed.questions.length}{" "}
              {t({ en: "valid questions", ar: "أسئلة صالحة" })} ·{" "}
              {parsed.errors.length} {t({ en: "errors", ar: "أخطاء" })}
            </strong>
            {parsed.errors.slice(0, 20).map((e, i) => (
              <p key={i} className="exam-error">
                {e.questionNumber ? `${e.questionNumber}: ` : ""}
                {e.message}
              </p>
            ))}
            {parsed.warnings.map((w) => (
              <p key={w}>{w}</p>
            ))}
            <ol>
              {parsed.questions.slice(0, 5).map((q) => (
                <li key={q.questionNumber}>
                  {q.questionText}{" "}
                  <small>({q.correctAnswer.toUpperCase()})</small>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ol>
            <p>
              {t({
                en: "All errors must be fixed before import. Questions are added only when saving succeeds.",
                ar: "يجب تصحيح كل الأخطاء قبل الاستيراد. تُضاف الأسئلة بعد نجاح الحفظ.",
              })}
            </p>
          </section>
        )}
        {error && (
          <p className="exam-error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <footer>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="button button-secondary"
            disabled={pending}
            onClick={close}
          >
            {t({ en: "Cancel", ar: "إلغاء" })}
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="button button-primary"
            disabled={
              pending || !parsed?.questions.length || !!parsed.errors.length
            }
            onClick={() => void save()}
          >
            {t(
              pending
                ? { en: "Importing…", ar: "جارٍ الاستيراد…" }
                : {
                    en: "Import validated questions",
                    ar: "استيراد الأسئلة الصالحة",
                  },
            )}
          </button>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";

import { useExams, useExamQuery, useExamError } from "./useExams";
import { ExamHeading, ExamEmpty, ExamFailure } from "./ExamFrame";

export default function ExamNotebook({
  wrong = false,
  review = false,
}: {
  wrong?: boolean;
  review?: boolean;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    { service, base } = useExams(),
    { examId = "" } = useParams(),
    errorText = useExamError();
  const [course, setCourse] = useState(""),
    [query, setQuery] = useState(""),
    [settledQuery, setSettledQuery] = useState(""),
    [reveal, setReveal] = useState(true),
    [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setSettledQuery(query);
      setPage(0);
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [query]);
  const request = {
    wrong,
    courseId: course || undefined,
    query: settledQuery,
    page,
    pageSize: 10,
  };
  const bank = useExamQuery(
    "notebook-page",
    (signal) => service.notebookQuestions(request, signal),
    JSON.stringify(request),
    !review,
  );
  const full = useExamQuery(
    "questions",
    (signal) => service.questions(examId, signal),
    examId,
    review,
  );
  const catalog = useExamQuery("catalog", (signal) => service.catalog(signal));
  const all = review
    ? (full.data || []).filter(
        (q) =>
          (!course || q.courseId === course) &&
          `${q.stem.en} ${q.stem.ar}`
            .toLowerCase()
            .includes(settledQuery.toLowerCase()),
      )
    : [];
  const questions = review
      ? all.slice(page * 10, (page + 1) * 10)
      : bank.data?.items || [],
    total = review ? all.length : bank.data?.total || 0;
  const loading = review ? full.isPending : bank.isPending,
    failed = review ? full.isError : bank.isError;
  return (
    <>
      <ExamHeading
        eyebrow={t({
          en: "Keep useful questions close",
          ar: "احتفظ بالأسئلة المفيدة بالقرب منك",
        })}
        title={t(
          review
            ? { en: "Read. Connect. Understand.", ar: "اقرأ واربط وافهم." }
            : wrong
              ? {
                  en: "Give a missed question\nanother chance.",
                  ar: "امنح السؤال الذي أخطأت فيه\nفرصة أخرى.",
                }
              : { en: "Your question notebook.", ar: "دفتر أسئلتك." },
        )}
        body={t(
          wrong
            ? {
                en: "Questions missed in your finished sessions appear here. Review their reasoning at your own pace.",
                ar: "تظهر هنا الأسئلة التي أخطأت فيها في جلساتك المكتملة. راجع أسبابها بالوقت المناسب لك.",
              }
            : {
                en: "Browse a few questions at a time, and open explanations when you need them.",
                ar: "تصفح عدداً قليلاً من الأسئلة وافتح الشرح عندما تحتاجه.",
              },
        )}
      />
      <div className="exam-filters">
        <input
          aria-label={t({ en: "Filter questions", ar: "ترشيح الأسئلة" })}
          value={query}
          onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={t({ en: "Find a question", ar: "ابحث عن سؤال" })}
        />
        <select
          aria-label={t({ en: "Course filter", ar: "مرشح المساق" })}
          value={course}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setCourse(e.target.value);
            setPage(0);
          }}
        >
          <option value="">
            {t({ en: "All courses", ar: "كل المساقات" })}
          </option>
          {catalog.data?.courses.map((c) => (
            <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
              {t(c.title)}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <label className="exam-check">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={reveal}
            onChange={(e) => setReveal(e.target.checked)}
          />
          <span>{t({ en: "Show answers", ar: "عرض الإجابات" })}</span>
        </label>
      </div>
      {loading ? (
        <LoadingState />
      ) : failed ? (
        <ExamFailure
          message={errorText(full.error || bank.error)}
          retry={() => void (review ? full : bank).refetch()}
        />
      ) : questions.length ? (
        <>
          <p className="exam-search-count" role="status">
            {Math.min(total, page * 10 + 1)}–
            {Math.min(total, page * 10 + questions.length)} / {total}
          </p>
          <div className="exam-review-list">
            {questions.map((q, i) => (
              <article key={q.id} className="exam-review-card">
                <QuestionView
                  question={q}
                  reveal={reveal}
                  locked
                  number={page * 10 + i + 1}
                />
                <QuestionTools questionId={q.id} />
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <ExamEmpty
          title={t({ en: "A quiet shelf for now", ar: "رف هادئ الآن" })}
          body={t(
            wrong
              ? {
                  en: "No missed questions match this view. Finish a session to build your review list.",
                  ar: "لا توجد أسئلة خاطئة تطابق العرض. أكمل جلسة لتكوين قائمة المراجعة.",
                }
              : {
                  en: "Save a useful question during a session, or clear the current filters.",
                  ar: "احفظ سؤالاً مفيداً أثناء الجلسة أو امسح المرشحات الحالية.",
                },
          )}
          href={base}
          action={t({ en: "Browse courses", ar: "تصفح المساقات" })}
        />
      )}
      {total > 10 && (
        <div className="exam-question-navigation">

            type="button"
            className="button button-secondary"
            disabled={page === 0}

          >
            {t({ en: "Next page", ar: "الصفحة التالية" })}

        </div>

}

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, useId } from "react";
import { useParams, useNavigate, Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  ArrowRight,
  Flag,
  Grid2X2,
  Save,
  CheckCheck,
  Clock3,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { useExams, useExamError } from "./useExams";
import { ExamEmpty, ExamFailure } from "./ExamFrame";
import { QuestionView } from "./QuestionView";
import { QuestionTools } from "./QuestionTools";
import { useAttemptSession } from "./useAttemptSession";
import type { ExamAttempt, ChoiceKey } from "../../types/exams";
import { durationLabel } from "./exam-model";
function SessionClock({ elapsed }: { elapsed: () => number }) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(elapsed);
  const { t } = useLocale();
  useEffect(() => {
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;
    const sync = () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      setValue(elapsed());
      if (!document.hidden)
        timer = setInterval(() => setValue(elapsed()), 1000);
    };
    sync();
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", sync);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", sync);
    };
  }, [elapsed]);
  return (
    <span
      className="exam-clock"
      aria-label={t({ en: "Session time", ar: "وقت الجلسة" })}
    >
      <Clock3 size={16} />
      <time>{durationLabel(value)}</time>
    </span>
  );
}
export default function ExamPlay() {
  const { attemptId = "" } = useParams(),
    { service, owner, base } = useExams(),
    { t } = useLocale(),
    errorText = useExamError();
  const attempt = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["exams", owner, "attempt", attemptId],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => service.attempt(attemptId, signal),
    retry: false,
    staleTime: Infinity,
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
  });
  if (attempt.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (attempt.isError)
    return (
      <ExamFailure
        message={errorText(attempt.error)}
        retry={() => void attempt.refetch()}
      />
    );
  if (!attempt.data)
    return (
      <ExamEmpty
        title={t({
          en: "This attempt is unavailable",
          ar: "هذه المحاولة غير متاحة",
        })}
        body={t({
          en: "Return to your attempts or choose another set.",
          ar: "عد إلى محاولاتك أو اختر مجموعة أخرى.",
        })}
        href={base + "/history"}
        action={t({ en: "My attempts", ar: "محاولاتي" })}
      />
    );
  if (attempt.data.status === "finished")
    return <Navigate replace to={`${base}/attempt/${attemptId}/results`} />;
  if (attempt.data.status === "abandoned")
    return <Navigate replace to={base + "/history"} />;
  if (!attempt.data.questions.length)
    return (
      <ExamEmpty
        title={t({
          en: "No questions are available in this attempt",
          ar: "لا توجد أسئلة متاحة في المحاولة",
        })}
        body={t({
          en: "Return to the question sets to start another session.",
          ar: "عد إلى مجموعات الأسئلة لبدء جلسة أخرى.",
        })}
        href={base}
        action={t({ en: "Browse courses", ar: "تصفح المساقات" })}
      />
    );
  return (
    <Session
      key={`${attempt.data.id}:${attempt.data.version}`}
      initial={attempt.data}
      reload={() => void attempt.refetch()}
    />
  );
}
function Session({
  initial,
  reload,
}: {
  initial: ExamAttempt;
  reload: () => void;
}) {
  const { service, base, refresh } = useExams(),
    { t, dir } = useLocale(),
    navigate = useNavigate(),
    errorText = useExamError();
  const session = useAttemptSession(initial, service),
    { progress } = session;
  const [mapOpen, setMapOpen] = useState(false),
    [confirm, setConfirm] = useState(false),
    [pending, setPending] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  const current = Math.min(progress.current, initial.questions.length - 1),
    question = initial.questions[current];
  const answered = Object.keys(progress.answers).length,
    flagged = progress.flagged.includes(question.id),
    reveal = initial.mode === "practice" && !!progress.answers[question.id];
  const go = useCallback(
    (index: number) => {
      if (pending) return;
      const next = Math.max(0, Math.min(initial.questions.length - 1, index));
      const q = initial.questions[next];
      session.commit((p) => ({
        ...p,
        current: next,
        viewed: [...new Set([...p.viewed, q.id])],
      }));
      setMapOpen(false);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const heading = document.getElementById("exam-question-stem");
        heading?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        heading?.scrollIntoView({
          block: "start",
          behavior: window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")
            .matches
            ? "instant"
            : "smooth",
        });
      });
    },
    [session.commit, initial.questions, pending],
  );
  const select = useCallback(
    (key: ChoiceKey) => {
      if (
        pending ||
        (initial.mode === "practice" && progress.answers[question.id])
      )
        return;
      session.commit((p) => ({
        ...p,
        answers: { ...p.answers, [question.id]: key },
        viewed: [...new Set([...p.viewed, question.id])],
      }));
    },
    [session.commit, question.id, initial.mode, progress.answers, pending],
  );
  const flag = useCallback(
    () =>
      session.commit((p) => ({
        ...p,
        flagged: p.flagged.includes(question.id)
          ? p.flagged.filter((id) => id !== question.id)
          : [...p.flagged, question.id],
      })),
    [session.commit, question.id],
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    const keyboard = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (
        pending ||
        e.defaultPrevented ||
        document.querySelector("dialog[open]") ||
        (e.target as HTMLElement)?.closest(
          "input, textarea, select, [contenteditable=true]",
        )
      )
        return;
      if (e.altKey && e.key === "ArrowRight") {
        e.preventDefault();
        go(current + (dir === "rtl" ? -1 : 1));
      } else if (e.altKey && e.key === "ArrowLeft") {
        e.preventDefault();
        go(current + (dir === "rtl" ? 1 : -1));
      } else if (
        !e.ctrlKey &&
        !e.metaKey &&
        !e.altKey &&
        /^[1-5]$/.test(e.key)
      ) {
        const choice = question.choices[Number(e.key) - 1];
        if (choice) {
          e.preventDefault();
          select(choice.key);
        }
      } else if (!e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === "f") {
        e.preventDefault();
        flag();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", keyboard);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", keyboard);
  }, [pending, current, question, go, select, flag, dir]);
  async function exit() {
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await session.flush();
      await refresh();
      navigate(base + "/history");
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
      setPending(false);
    }
  }
  async function finish() {
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await session.finish();
      navigate(`${base}/attempt/${initial.id}/results`);
      void refresh();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
      setPending(false);
    }
  }
  const map = (
    <QuestionMap
      attempt={initial}
      progress={progress}
      current={current}
      go={go}
    />
  );
  return (
    <div className="exam-session" data-exam-mode={initial.mode}>
      <header className="exam-session-heading">
        <div>
          <span className="exam-kicker">
            {t(
              initial.mode === "practice"
                ? { en: "Practice session", ar: "جلسة تدريب" }
                : { en: "Self-test session", ar: "جلسة اختبار ذاتي" },
            )}
          </span>
          <h1 data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>
            {t({ en: "Stay with this question.", ar: "ركّز على هذا السؤال." })}
          </h1>
        </div>
        <SessionClock elapsed={session.elapsed} />
        <button
          type="button"
          className="button button-secondary"
          disabled={pending}
          onClick={() => void exit()}
        >
          <Save size={18} />
          <span>{t({ en: "Save and exit", ar: "حفظ وخروج" })}</span>
        </button>
      </header>
      <div className="exam-progress-row">
        <span>
          {answered}/{initial.questions.length}{" "}
          {t({ en: "answered", ar: "تمت الإجابة عنها" })}
        </span>
        <progress
          value={answered}
          max={initial.questions.length}
          aria-label={t({
            en: "Answered questions",
            ar: "الأسئلة المجاب عنها",
          })}
        />
        <span className="exam-save-status" role="status">
          {t(
            session.status === "saving"
              ? { en: "Saving…", ar: "جارٍ الحفظ…" }
              : session.status === "saved"
                ? { en: "Saved", ar: "محفوظ" }
                : { en: "Unsaved changes", ar: "تغييرات غير محفوظة" },
          )}
        </span>
      </div>
      {Boolean(error || session.error) && (
        <div className="exam-error" role="alert">
          {error || errorText(session.error)}
          <button
            className="text-link"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => void session.flush().catch(() => {})}
          >
            {t({ en: "Retry save", ar: "إعادة الحفظ" })}
          </button>
          <button type="button" className="text-link" onClick={reload}>
            {t({
              en: "Reload saved attempt",
              ar: "إعادة تحميل المحاولة المحفوظة",
            })}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {!session.draftPersistent && (
        <p className="exam-error" role="status">
          {t({
            en: "The recovery draft could not be stored on this device. Save successfully before leaving.",
            ar: "تعذر تخزين نسخة الاستعادة على الجهاز. تأكد من نجاح الحفظ قبل المغادرة.",
          })}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="exam-session-grid">
        <article className="exam-question-panel">
          <header>
            <strong>
              {t({ en: "Question", ar: "السؤال" })} {current + 1}/
              {initial.questions.length}
            </strong>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="exam-flag-button"
              aria-pressed={flagged}
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={flag}
            >
              <Flag size={17} fill={flagged ? "currentColor" : "none"} />
              <span>
                {t(
                  flagged
                    ? { en: "Flagged", ar: "عليه علامة" }
                    : { en: "Flag for review", ar: "علامة للمراجعة" },
                )}
              </span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="exam-mobile-map-button"
              onClick={() => setMapOpen(true)}
            >
              <Grid2X2 size={18} />
              <span>{t({ en: "Question map", ar: "خريطة الأسئلة" })}</span>
            </button>
          </header>
          <QuestionView
            key={question.id}
            question={question}
            chosen={progress.answers[question.id]}
            reveal={reveal}
            locked={pending || reveal}
            select={select}
            number={current + 1}
          />
          <QuestionTools questionId={question.id} />
          <footer className="exam-question-navigation">
            <button
              type="button"
              className="button button-secondary"
              disabled={current === 0 || pending}
              onClick={() => go(current - 1)}
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="directional" size={18} />
              {t({ en: "Previous", ar: "السابق" })}
            </button>
            {current === initial.questions.length - 1 ? (
              <button
                className="button button-primary"
                disabled={pending}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setConfirm(true)}
              >
                {t({ en: "Finish & review", ar: "إنهاء ومراجعة" })}
                <CheckCheck size={18} />
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                className="button button-primary"
                disabled={pending}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => go(current + 1)}
              >
                {t({ en: "Next question", ar: "السؤال التالي" })}
                <ArrowRight className="directional" size={18} />
              </button>
            )}
          </footer>
        </article>
        <aside className="exam-desktop-map">
          {map}
          <button
            type="button"
            className="button button-secondary"
            disabled={pending}
            onClick={() => setConfirm(true)}
          >
            {t({ en: "Finish this session", ar: "إنهاء الجلسة" })}
          </button>
          <small>
            {t({
              en: "1–5: answer · Alt + arrows: navigate · F: flag",
              ar: "١–٥: إجابة · Alt والأسهم: تنقل · F: علامة",
            })}
          </small>
        </aside>
      </div>
      {mapOpen && (
        <Modal
          open
          onClose={() => setMapOpen(false)}
          title={t({ en: "Your question map", ar: "خريطة أسئلتك" })}
          description={`${answered}/${initial.questions.length}`}
          className="exam-map-dialog"
        >
          {map}
          <button
            type="button"
            className="button button-primary"
            onClick={() => {
              setMapOpen(false);
              setConfirm(true);
            }}
          >
            {t({ en: "Finish this session", ar: "إنهاء الجلسة" })}
          </button>
        </Modal>
      )}
      {confirm && (
        <Modal
          open
          onClose={() => !pending && setConfirm(false)}
          title={t({ en: "Finish and review?", ar: "إنهاء ومراجعة؟" })}
          description={t({
            en: "Your answers will be saved, then you can review the reasoning.",
            ar: "ستُحفظ إجاباتك ثم يمكنك مراجعة أسبابها.",
          })}
          className="exam-finish-dialog"
        >
          <p>
            {initial.questions.length - answered}{" "}
            {t({ en: "questions are unanswered.", ar: "أسئلة دون إجابة." })}
          </p>
          {error && (
            <p role="alert" className="exam-error">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="exam-dialog-actions">
            <button
              className="button button-secondary"
              type="button"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={() => setConfirm(false)}
            >
              {t({ en: "Keep studying", ar: "متابعة الدراسة" })}
            </button>
            <button
              className="button button-primary"
              type="button"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={() => void finish()}
            >
              {t(
                pending
                  ? { en: "Saving results…", ar: "جارٍ حفظ النتائج…" }
                  : { en: "Finish session", ar: "إنهاء الجلسة" },
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
function QuestionMap({
  attempt,
  progress,
  current,
  go,
}: {
  attempt: ExamAttempt;
  progress: ExamAttempt["progress"];
  current: number;
  go: (n: number) => void;
}) {
  const jumpId = useId();
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    [page, setPage] = useState(Math.floor(current / 50)),
    [filter, setFilter] = useState("all"),
    [jump, setJump] = useState("");
  const questions = attempt.questions
    .map((q, i) => ({ q, i }))
    .filter(
      ({ q }) =>
        filter === "all" ||
        (filter === "unanswered"
          ? !progress.answers[q.id]
          : progress.flagged.includes(q.id)),
    );
  const maxPage = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(questions.length / 50) - 1),
    shown = questions.slice(
      Math.min(page, maxPage) * 50,
      (Math.min(page, maxPage) + 1) * 50,
    );
  return (
    <div className="exam-question-map">
      <header>
        <h2>{t({ en: "Question map", ar: "خريطة الأسئلة" })}</h2>
        <span>
          {progress.flagged.length} {t({ en: "flagged", ar: "عليها علامة" })}
        </span>
      </header>
      <select
        aria-label={t({ en: "Filter question map", ar: "ترشيح خريطة الأسئلة" })}
        value={filter}
        onChange={(e) => {
          setFilter(e.target.value);
          setPage(0);
        }}
      >
        <option value="all">
          {t({ en: "All questions", ar: "كل الأسئلة" })}
        </option>
        <option value="unanswered">
          {t({ en: "Unanswered", ar: "دون إجابة" })}
        </option>
        <option value="flagged">
          {t({ en: "Flagged", ar: "عليها علامة" })}
        </option>
      </select>
      <div className="exam-map-numbers">
        {shown.map(({ q, i }) => (
          <button
            type="button"
            key={q.id}
            aria-current={current === i ? "step" : undefined}
            data-answered={!!progress.answers[q.id] || undefined}
            data-flagged={progress.flagged.includes(q.id) || undefined}
            onClick={() => go(i)}
            aria-label={`${t({ en: "Question", ar: "السؤال" })} ${i + 1}${progress.answers[q.id] ? ` · ${t({ en: "Answered", ar: "مجابة" })}` : ""}${progress.flagged.includes(q.id) ? ` · ${t({ en: "Flagged", ar: "عليها علامة" })}` : ""}`}
          >
            {i + 1}
            {progress.flagged.includes(q.id) && <Flag size={10} />}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {!shown.length && (
        <p>
          {t({
            en: "No questions in this filter.",
            ar: "لا توجد أسئلة تطابق المرشح.",
          })}
        </p>
      )}
      {maxPage > 0 && (
        <div className="exam-map-pages">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={page === 0}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)}
          >
            {t({ en: "Previous", ar: "السابق" })}
          </button>
          <span>
            {Math.min(page, maxPage) + 1}/{maxPage + 1}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={page >= maxPage}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
          >
            {t({ en: "Next", ar: "التالي" })}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      <form
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          const n = Number(jump);
          if (Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0 && n <= attempt.questions.length)
            go(n - 1);
        }}
        className="exam-question-jump"
      >
        <label htmlFor={jumpId}>{t({ en: "Go to", ar: "انتقل إلى" })}</label>
        <input
          id={jumpId}
          type="number"
          min={1}
          max={attempt.questions.length}
          value={jump}
          onChange={(e) => setJump(e.target.value)}
        />
        <button type="submit">{t({ en: "Go", ar: "انتقل" })}</button>
      </form>
      <div className="exam-map-legend">
        <span>{t({ en: "Filled = answered", ar: "ممتلئة = مجابة" })}</span>
        <span>
          <Flag size={12} />
          {t({ en: "Review later", ar: "راجع لاحقاً" })}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { ArrowLeft, Printer } from "lucide-react";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { useExams, useExamQuery, useExamError } from "./useExams";
import { ExamFailure, ExamEmpty } from "./ExamFrame";
import { QuestionView } from "./QuestionView";
export default function ExamPrint() {
  const { examId = "" } = useParams(),
    { t } = useLocale(),
    { service, base } = useExams(),
    errorText = useExamError();
  const exam = useExamQuery(
      "set",
      (signal) => service.getExam(examId, signal),
      examId,
    ),
    questions = useExamQuery(
      "questions",
      (signal) => service.questions(examId, signal),
      examId,
    );
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState(false);
  if (exam.isPending || questions.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (exam.isError || questions.isError)
    return <ExamFailure message={errorText(exam.error || questions.error)} />;
  if (!exam.data)
    return (
      <ExamEmpty
        title={t({ en: "Set unavailable", ar: "المجموعة غير متاحة" })}
        body=""
        href={base}
        action={t({ en: "Browse", ar: "تصفح" })}
      />
    );
  return (
    <div className="exam-print-page">
      <div className="exam-print-controls">
        <AppLink href={`${base}/set/${examId}`} className="text-link">
          <ArrowLeft className="directional" size={17} />
          {t({ en: "Back to session", ar: "العودة للجلسة" })}
        </AppLink>
        <label className="exam-check">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={answers}
            onChange={(e) => setAnswers(e.target.checked)}
          />
          <span>
            {t({
              en: "Include answers and explanations",
              ar: "تضمين الإجابات والشرح",
            })}
          </span>
        </label>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="button button-primary"
          onClick={() => window.print()}
        >
          <Printer size={18} />
          {t({ en: "Print / save as PDF", ar: "طباعة / حفظ PDF" })}
        </button>
      </div>
      <header>
        <span className="exam-kicker">MedClub · {t(exam.data.batch)}</span>
        <h1 data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>
          {t(exam.data.title)}
        </h1>
        <p>
          {questions.data?.length} {t({ en: "questions", ar: "سؤال" })}
        </p>
      </header>
      {questions.data?.map((q, i) => (
        <article className="exam-review-card" key={q.id}>
          <QuestionView
            question={answers ? q : { ...q, explanation: undefined }}
            reveal={answers}
            locked
            number={i + 1}
          />
        </article>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { useParams, Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { ArrowUpRight, Check, X, Minus, RotateCcw, Clock3 } from "lucide-react";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { useExams, useExamQuery, useExamError } from "./useExams";
import { ExamHeading, ExamEmpty, ExamFailure } from "./ExamFrame";
import { QuestionView } from "./QuestionView";
import { QuestionTools } from "./QuestionTools";
import { durationLabel } from "./exam-model";
export default function ExamResults() {
  const { attemptId = "" } = useParams(),
    { service, base } = useExams(),
    { t } = useLocale(),
    errorText = useExamError();
  const attempt = useExamQuery(
      "attempt",
      (signal) => service.attempt(attemptId, signal),
      attemptId,
    ),
    [filter, setFilter] = useState("all"),
    [limit, setLimit] = useState(10);
  if (attempt.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (attempt.isError)
    return (
      <ExamFailure
        message={errorText(attempt.error)}
        retry={() => void attempt.refetch()}
      />
    );
  if (!attempt.data)
    return (
      <ExamEmpty
        title={t({ en: "No results here yet", ar: "لا توجد نتائج هنا بعد" })}
        body={t({
          en: "Open a finished session from your attempts.",
          ar: "افتح جلسة مكتملة من محاولاتك.",
        })}
        href={base + "/history"}
        action={t({ en: "My attempts", ar: "محاولاتي" })}
      />
    );
  const a = attempt.data;
  if (a.status === "active")
    return <Navigate replace to={`${base}/attempt/${a.id}`} />;
  if (a.status === "abandoned")
    return <Navigate replace to={`${base}/history`} />;
  const summary = a.summary,
    filtered = a.questions.filter(
      (q) =>
        filter === "all" ||
        (filter === "correct"
          ? !!q.correct && a.progress.answers[q.id] === q.correct
          : filter === "incorrect"
            ? !!q.correct &&
              !!a.progress.answers[q.id] &&
              a.progress.answers[q.id] !== q.correct
            : filter === "skipped"
              ? !a.progress.answers[q.id]
              : a.progress.flagged.includes(q.id)),
    );
  return (
    <>
      <ExamHeading
        eyebrow={t({
          en: "A session worth learning from",
          ar: "جلسة تستحق أن تتعلم منها",
        })}
        title={t({
          en: "Keep the reasoning.\nTake the next step.",
          ar: "احتفظ بالأسباب.\nوانتقل للخطوة التالية.",
        })}
        body={t({
          en: "This result describes this question set. Use the review to find what deserves another look.",
          ar: "تصف هذه النتيجة مجموعة الأسئلة الحالية. راجع ما يستحق العودة إليه.",
        })}
      />
      <section className="exam-results-summary">
        <div className="exam-result-score">
          <span>{t({ en: "This session", ar: "هذه الجلسة" })}</span>
          <strong>
            {summary?.percentage === null || !summary
              ? "—"
              : `${summary.percentage}%`}
          </strong>
          <p>
            {summary
              ? `${summary.correct}/${summary.total} ${t({ en: "correct", ar: "صحيحة" })}`
              : t({
                  en: "Results are not available.",
                  ar: "النتائج غير متاحة.",
                })}
          </p>
          <AppLink
            className="button button-primary"
            href={`${base}/set/${a.examId}`}
          >
            <RotateCcw size={17} />
            {t({ en: "Practice again", ar: "تدرب مجدداً" })}
          </AppLink>
        </div>
        <div className="exam-result-stats">
          {[
            {
              icon: Check,
              number: summary?.correct ?? "—",
              label: { en: "Correct", ar: "صحيحة" },
              state: "correct",
            },
            {
              icon: X,
              number: summary?.incorrect ?? "—",
              label: { en: "Incorrect", ar: "خاطئة" },
              state: "incorrect",
            },
            {
              icon: Minus,
              number: summary?.skipped ?? "—",
              label: { en: "Skipped", ar: "متروكة" },
              state: "skipped",
            },
            {
              icon: Clock3,
              number: durationLabel(
                summary?.timeSeconds ?? a.progress.elapsedSeconds,
              ),
              label: { en: "Session time", ar: "وقت الجلسة" },
              state: "time",
            },
          ].map(({ icon: Icon, number, label, state }) => (
            <div key={state} data-result-state={state}>
              <Icon size={21} />
              <strong>{number}</strong>
              <span>{t(label)}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
          <div
            className="exam-result-split"
            aria-label={t({ en: "Answer distribution", ar: "توزيع الإجابات" })}
          >
            {summary &&
              [summary.correct, summary.incorrect, summary.skipped].map(
                (n, i) => (
                  <i
                    key={i}
                    data-kind={i}
                    style={{
                      flexGrow: n || 0,
                      display: n ? undefined : "none",
                    }}
                  />
                ),
              )}
          </div>
          <AppLink href={base + "/wrong"} className="text-link">
            {t({ en: "Keep revisiting mistakes", ar: "تابع مراجعة أخطائك" })}
            <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={16} />
          </AppLink>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section className="exam-results-review">
        <header>
          <h2>
            {t({
              en: "Review with a little intention",
              ar: "مراجعة بخطوة واضحة",
            })}
          </h2>
          <select
            aria-label={t({ en: "Review filter", ar: "مرشح المراجعة" })}
            value={filter}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setFilter(e.target.value);
              setLimit(10);
            }}
          >
            {(
              ["all", "incorrect", "skipped", "flagged", "correct"] as const
            ).map((value) => (
              <option key={value} value={value}>
                {t({
                  en: value === "all" ? "All questions" : value,
                  ar: {
                    all: "كل الأسئلة",
                    incorrect: "الخاطئة",
                    skipped: "المتروكة",
                    flagged: "عليها علامة",
                    correct: "الصحيحة",
                  }[value],
                })}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </header>
        {filtered.slice(0, limit).map((q) => (
          <article key={q.id} className="exam-review-card">
            <QuestionView
              question={q}
              chosen={a.progress.answers[q.id]}
              reveal
              locked
              number={a.questions.findIndex((item) => item.id === q.id) + 1}
            />
            <QuestionTools questionId={q.id} />
          </article>
        ))}
        {!filtered.length && (
          <ExamEmpty
            title={t({
              en: "Nothing in this filter",
              ar: "لا توجد أسئلة في هذا المرشح",
            })}
            body={t({
              en: "Choose another review filter to see your questions.",
              ar: "اختر مرشحاً آخر لعرض أسئلتك.",
            })}
          />
        )}
        {filtered.length > limit && (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="button button-secondary"
            onClick={() => setLimit((n) => n + 10)}
          >
            {t({ en: "Show more questions", ar: "عرض أسئلة أخرى" })}
          </button>
        )}
      </section>
    </>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/exams/ExamRoutes.tsx
============================================================
import { lazy, Suspense } from "react";
import { Routes, Route } from "react-router-dom";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ExamFrame } from "./ExamFrame";
const Hub = lazy(() => import("./ExamHub"));
const Setup = lazy(() => import("./ExamSetup"));
const Play = lazy(() => import("./ExamPlay"));
const Results = lazy(() => import("./ExamResults"));
const Notebook = lazy(() => import("./ExamNotebook"));
const History = lazy(() => import("./ExamHistory"));
const Search = lazy(() => import("./ExamSearch"));
const Print = lazy(() => import("./ExamPrint"));
export default function ExamRoutes() {
  return (
    <ExamFrame>
      <Suspense fallback={<LoadingState />}>
        <Routes>
          <Route index element={<Hub />} />
          <Route path="set/:examId" element={<Setup />} />
          <Route path="set/:examId/review" element={<Notebook review />} />
          <Route path="set/:examId/print" element={<Print />} />
          <Route path="attempt/:attemptId" element={<Play />} />
          <Route path="attempt/:attemptId/results" element={<Results />} />
          <Route path="history" element={<History />} />
          <Route path="notebook" element={<Notebook />} />
          <Route path="wrong" element={<Notebook wrong />} />
          <Route path="search" element={<Search />} />
          <Route path="*" element={<Hub />} />
        </Routes>
      </Suspense>
    </ExamFrame>
  );
}

import { useDeferredValue, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { useExams, useExamQuery, useExamError } from "./useExams";
import { ExamHeading, ExamEmpty, ExamFailure } from "./ExamFrame";
import { QuestionView } from "./QuestionView";
import { QuestionTools } from "./QuestionTools";
export default function ExamSearch() {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    { service } = useExams(),
    errorText = useExamError(),
    [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
  const [input, setInput] = useState(params.get("q") || ""),
    [course, setCourse] = useState(params.get("course") || ""),
    [limit, setLimit] = useState(10);
  const query = useDeferredValue(params.get("q") || ""),
    catalog = useExamQuery("catalog", (signal) => service.catalog(signal));
  const results = useExamQuery(
    "search",
    (signal) => service.search(query, course || undefined, signal),
    `${query}:${course}`,
    query.trim().length >= 2,
  );
  function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setParams({ q: input.trim(), ...(course ? { course } : {}) });
    setLimit(10);
  }
  return (
    <>
      <ExamHeading
        eyebrow={t({
          en: "Less hunting. More understanding.",
          ar: "بحث أقل وفهم أكثر",
        })}
        title={t({
          en: "Find the question\nyou came for.",
          ar: "ابحث عن السؤال\nالذي تحتاجه.",
        })}
        body={t({
          en: "Search question text, chapters or lecturer names. Your language can be English or Arabic.",
          ar: "ابحث في نص السؤال أو الفصل أو اسم المحاضر بالعربية أو الإنجليزية.",
        })}
      />
      <form className="exam-search-form" onSubmit={submit}>
        <label className="exam-search-field">
          <Search size={19} />
          <input
            value={input}
            minLength={2}
            maxLength={200}
            onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
            aria-label={t({ en: "Search questions", ar: "البحث في الأسئلة" })}
            placeholder={t({
              en: "A topic, phrase or chapter…",
              ar: "موضوع أو عبارة أو فصل…",
            })}
            required
          />
        </label>
        <select
          value={course}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setCourse(e.target.value);
            setLimit(10);
          }}
          aria-label={t({ en: "Search course", ar: "مساق البحث" })}
        >
          <option value="">
            {t({ en: "All courses", ar: "كل المساقات" })}
          </option>
          {catalog.data?.courses.map((c) => (
            <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
              {t(c.title)}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <button type="submit" className="button button-primary">
          {t({ en: "Search", ar: "بحث" })}
        </button>
      </form>
      {query.trim().length < 2 ? (
        <ExamEmpty
          title={t({
            en: "Start with a little detail",
            ar: "ابدأ بتفصيل صغير",
          })}
          body={t({
            en: "Enter at least two characters to search the question bank.",
            ar: "أدخل حرفين على الأقل للبحث في بنك الأسئلة.",
          })}
        />
      ) : results.isPending ? (
        <LoadingState />
      ) : results.isError ? (
        <ExamFailure
          message={errorText(results.error)}
          retry={() => void results.refetch()}
        />
      ) : results.data?.length ? (
        <>
          <p className="exam-search-count" role="status">
            {results.data.length}{" "}
            {t({ en: "matching questions", ar: "أسئلة مطابقة" })}
          </p>
          {results.data.slice(0, limit).map((q, i) => (
            <article key={q.id} className="exam-review-card">
              <QuestionView question={q} reveal locked number={i + 1} />
              <QuestionTools questionId={q.id} />
            </article>
          ))}
          {results.data.length > limit && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="button button-secondary"
              onClick={() => setLimit((n) => n + 10)}
            >
              {t({ en: "Show more", ar: "عرض المزيد" })}
            </button>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        <ExamEmpty
          title={t({ en: "No matching questions", ar: "لا توجد أسئلة مطابقة" })}
          body={t({
            en: "Try a shorter phrase or another course.",
            ar: "جرّب عبارة أقصر أو مساقاً آخر.",
          })}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export default function ExamSetup() {

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ExamMode>("practice"),
    [pending, setPending] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  if (exam.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (exam.isError)
    return (
      <ExamFailure
        message={errorText(exam.error)}
        retry={() => void exam.refetch()}
      />
    );
  if (!exam.data)
    return (
      <ExamEmpty

      />
    );

    course = catalog.data?.courses.find((c) => c.id === set.courseId),
    active = attempts.data?.find(
      (a) => a.examId === set.id && a.mode === mode && a.status === "active",
    );
  async function start(resume: boolean) {
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const a = await service.start(examId, mode, resume);
      await refresh();
      navigate(`${base}/attempt/${a.id}`);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
      setPending(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <>
      <AppLink
        href={`${base}?course=${encodeURIComponent(set.courseId)}`}
        className="text-link"
      >
        <ArrowLeft className="directional" size={17} />
        {course
          ? t(course.title)
          : t({ en: "Back to sets", ar: "العودة للمجموعات" })}
      </AppLink>

        eyebrow={t(set.batch)}
        title={t(set.title)}
        body={t(set.description)}
      />
      <div className="exam-prep-layout">
        <section className="exam-prep-panel">
          <span className="exam-kicker">
            {t({ en: "Make the session yours", ar: "اجعل الجلسة مناسبة لك" })}
          </span>
          <h2>
            {t({ en: "How do you want to review?", ar: "كيف تريد أن تراجع؟" })}
          </h2>
          <div className="exam-mode-options">
            {(["practice", "self-test"] as ExamMode[]).map((value) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={value}
                aria-pressed={mode === value}
                onClick={() => setMode(value)}
              >
                {value === "practice" ? (
                  <BookOpen size={25} />
                ) : (
                  <Brain size={25} />
                )}
                <strong>
                  {t(
                    value === "practice"
                      ? { en: "Practice", ar: "تدريب" }
                      : { en: "Self test", ar: "اختبار ذاتي" },

                <span>
                  {t(
                    value === "practice"
                      ? {
                          en: "Immediate feedback and explanations. Each answer stays once selected.",
                          ar: "شرح وإجابة مباشرة. تثبت الإجابة بعد اختيارها.",

                        },
                  )}
                </span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          {active && (
            <div className="exam-resume-callout">
              <RotateCcw size={20} />
              <span>
                {Object.keys(active.progress.answers).length}/

              <button

          <dl>
            <div>
              <dt>{t({ en: "Questions", ar: "الأسئلة" })}</dt>

FILE: src/features/exams/Explanation.tsx
============================================================
import { memo, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import {
  parseInline,
  parseMnSyntax,
  type MnInlineToken,
} from "./portable/mn-syntax";
import { safeExamImage } from "./exam-model";
function Inline({
  tokens,
  depth = 0,
}: {
  tokens: MnInlineToken[];
  depth?: number;
}) {
  return (
    <>
      {tokens.map((token, i) =>
        token.type === "bold" ? (
          <strong key={i}>
            {depth < 4 ? (
              <Inline tokens={parseInline(token.value)} depth={depth + 1} />
            ) : (
              token.value
            )}
          </strong>
        ) : token.type === "italic" ? (
          <em key={i}>{token.value}</em>
        ) : token.type === "underline" ? (
          <u key={i}>{token.value}</u>
        ) : (
          <span key={i} className={`mn-${token.type}`}>
            {token.value}
          </span>
        ),
      )}
    </>
  );
}
export const Explanation = memo(function Explanation({
  content,
  images = {},
}: {
  content: string;
  images?: Partial<Record<1 | 2 | 3, string>>;
}) {
  const tokens = useMemo(
    () => parseMnSyntax(content.slice(0, 30000)),
    [content],
  );
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<string | null>(null);
  return (
    <div className="exam-explanation" dir="auto">
      {tokens.map((token, i) => {
        if (token.type === "paragraph")
          return (
            <p key={i}>
              <Inline tokens={token.children} />
            </p>
          );
        if (token.type === "list")
          return (
            <ul key={i}>
              {token.items.map((row, j) => (
                <li key={j}>
                  <Inline tokens={row} />
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          );
        if (token.type === "callout")
          return (
            <aside className="exam-callout" key={i}>
              <Inline tokens={token.children} />
            </aside>
          );
        if (token.type === "table")
          return (
            <div className="exam-table-scroll" key={i} tabIndex={0}>
              <table>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    {token.headers.map((row, j) => (
                      <th key={j}>
                        <Inline tokens={row} />
                      </th>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {token.rows.map((row, j) => (
                    <tr key={j}>
                      {row.map((cell, n) => (
                        <td key={n}>
                          <Inline tokens={cell} />
                        </td>
                      ))}
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          );
        const source =
          images[token.slotNumber] && safeExamImage(images[token.slotNumber]!);
        return source ? (
          <button
            key={i}
            type="button"
            className="exam-image"
            onClick={() => setExpanded(source)}
            aria-label={t({
              en: "Expand explanation image",
              ar: "تكبير صورة الشرح",
            })}
          >
            <img
              src={source}
              alt={t({ en: "Explanation image", ar: "صورة توضيحية" })}
              loading="lazy"
              decoding="async"
            />
          </button>
        ) : null;
      })}
      {expanded && (
        <Modal
          open
          onClose={() => setExpanded(null)}
          title={t({ en: "Explanation image", ar: "صورة الشرح" })}
          description=""
          className="exam-image-dialog"
        >
          <img
            src={expanded}
            alt={t({ en: "Explanation image", ar: "صورة توضيحية" })}
          />
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

FILE: src/features/exams/QuestionEditor.tsx
============================================================
import { useState } from "react";
import type { ChoiceKey, ExamQuestion, ExamSet } from "../../types/exams";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useExams, useExamError } from "./useExams";
import {
  bilingual,
  choiceKeys,
  validateQuestion,
  safeExamImage,
} from "./exam-model";
import { Explanation } from "./Explanation";
export function QuestionEditor({
  exam,
  existing,
  close,
}: {
  exam: ExamSet;
  existing?: ExamQuestion;
  close: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    { service, refresh } = useExams(),
    errorText = useExamError();
  const [stem, setStem] = useState(existing?.stem.en || ""),
    [arabic, setArabic] = useState(
      existing?.stem.ar === existing?.stem.en ? "" : existing?.stem.ar || "",
    ),
    [choices, setChoices] = useState(() =>
      Object.fromEntries(
        choiceKeys.map((key) => [
          key,
          existing?.choices.find((c) => c.key === key)?.text.en || "",
        ]),
      ),
    ),
    [wrong, setWrong] = useState(() =>
      Object.fromEntries(
        choiceKeys.map((key) => [
          key,
          existing?.choices.find((c) => c.key === key)?.explanation?.en || "",
        ]),
      ),
    );
  const [correct, setCorrect] = useState<ChoiceKey>(existing?.correct || "a"),
    [chapter, setChapter] = useState(existing?.chapter.en || "General"),
    [lecture, setLecture] = useState(existing?.lecture?.en || ""),
    [doctor, setDoctor] = useState(existing?.doctor || ""),
    [explanation, setExplanation] = useState(existing?.explanation?.en || ""),
    [images, setImages] = useState(existing?.explanationImages || {}),
    [questionImage, setQuestionImage] = useState(
      existing?.images?.[0]?.url || "",
    );
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [arabicChoices, setArabicChoices] = useState(() =>
    Object.fromEntries(
      choiceKeys.map((key) => {
        const c = existing?.choices.find((c) => c.key === key);
        return [key, c?.text.ar !== c?.text.en ? c?.text.ar || "" : ""];
      }),
    ),
  );
  const [arabicExplanation, setArabicExplanation] = useState(
      existing?.explanation?.ar !== existing?.explanation?.en
        ? existing?.explanation?.ar || ""
        : "",
    ),
    [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState(false);
  async function remove() {
    if (!existing) return;
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await service.admin.deleteQuestion(exam.id, existing.id, exam.version);
      await refresh();
      close();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
      setPending(false);
    }
  }
  async function upload(file: File, slot: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3) {
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const url = await service.admin.uploadImage(file);
      slot === 0
        ? setQuestionImage(url)
        : setImages((current) => ({ ...current, [slot]: url }));
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }
  async function save(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    const question: ExamQuestion = {
      ...existing,
      id: existing?.id || crypto.randomUUID(),
      courseId: exam.courseId,
      stem: { en: stem.trim(), ar: arabic.trim() || stem.trim() },
      choices: choiceKeys
        .filter((key) => choices[key]?.trim())
        .map((key) => ({
          key,
          text: {
            en: choices[key].trim(),
            ar: arabicChoices[key]?.trim() || choices[key].trim(),
          },
          ...(wrong[key]?.trim()
            ? { explanation: bilingual(wrong[key].trim()) }
            : {}),
        })),
      correct,
      chapter: bilingual(chapter.trim() || "General"),
      lecture: lecture.trim() ? bilingual(lecture.trim()) : undefined,
      doctor: doctor.trim() || undefined,
      explanation: explanation.trim()
        ? {
            en: explanation.trim(),
            ar: arabicExplanation.trim() || explanation.trim(),
          }
        : undefined,
      images: questionImage.trim()
        ? [
            {
              url: questionImage.trim(),
              alt: bilingual("Question illustration"),
            },
          ]
        : [],
      explanationImages: images,
      version: existing?.version || "new",
    };
    question.images = [
      ...(question.images || []),
      ...(existing?.images?.slice(1) || []),
    ];
    try {
      validateQuestion(question);
      if (
        [questionImage, ...Object.values(images)].some(
          (url) => url && !safeExamImage(url),
        )
      )
        throw new Error("image");
    } catch {
      setError(
        t({
          en: "Add the question, at least two choices, one valid correct answer and valid image URLs.",
          ar: "أضف السؤال وخيارين على الأقل وإجابة صحيحة وروابط صور صالحة.",
        }),
      );
      return;
    }
    setPending(true);
    try {
      await service.admin.saveQuestions(exam.id, [question], exam.version);
      await refresh();
      close();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
      setPending(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <Modal
      open
      onClose={() => !pending && close()}
      title={t(
        existing
          ? { en: "Edit question", ar: "تعديل السؤال" }
          : { en: "Add a question", ar: "إضافة سؤال" },
      )}
      description={t(exam.title)}
      className="exam-question-editor"
      initialFocus="#exam-edit-stem"
    >
      <form className="exam-form" onSubmit={save}>
        <label>
          <span>{t({ en: "Question text", ar: "نص السؤال" })}</span>
          <textarea
            id="exam-edit-stem"
            value={stem}
            onChange={(e) => setStem(e.target.value)}
            rows={4}
            maxLength={10000}
            required
          />
        </label>
        <details>
          <summary>
            {t({
              en: "Arabic wording (optional)",
              ar: "صياغة عربية (اختياري)",
            })}
          </summary>
          <textarea
            value={arabic}
            onChange={(e) => setArabic(e.target.value)}
            rows={3}
            maxLength={10000}
            aria-label={t({
              en: "Arabic question text",
              ar: "نص السؤال بالعربية",
            })}
            dir="auto"
          />
        </details>
        <div className="exam-editor-choices">
          {choiceKeys.map((key) => (
            <label key={key}>
              <span>
                {t({ en: "Choice", ar: "الخيار" })} {key.toUpperCase()}
                {key === "e"
                  ? ` · ${t({ en: "Optional", ar: "اختياري" })}`
                  : ""}
              </span>
              <input
                value={choices[key]}
                maxLength={3000}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setChoices((current) => ({
                    ...current,
                    [key]: e.target.value,
                  }))
                }
              />
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
        <details>
          <summary>
            {t({
              en: "Arabic choices (optional)",
              ar: "خيارات بالعربية (اختياري)",
            })}
          </summary>
          {choiceKeys
            .filter((key) => choices[key]?.trim())
            .map((key) => (
              <label key={key}>
                <span>{key.toUpperCase()}</span>
                <input
                  value={arabicChoices[key]}
                  dir="auto"
                  maxLength={3000}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setArabicChoices((values) => ({
                      ...values,
                      [key]: e.target.value,
                    }))
                  }
                />
              </label>
            ))}
        </details>
        <div className="exam-form-pair">
          <label>
            <span>{t({ en: "Correct choice", ar: "الخيار الصحيح" })}</span>
            <select
              value={correct}
              onChange={(e) => setCorrect(e.target.value as ChoiceKey)}
            >
              {choiceKeys
                .filter((key) => choices[key]?.trim() || key === correct)
                .map((key) => (
                  <option key={key} value={key}>
                    {key.toUpperCase()}
                  </option>
                ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{t({ en: "Chapter", ar: "الفصل" })}</span>
            <input
              value={chapter}
              onChange={(e) => setChapter(e.target.value)}
              maxLength={100}
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{t({ en: "Lecture", ar: "المحاضرة" })}</span>
            <input
              value={lecture}
              onChange={(e) => setLecture(e.target.value)}
              maxLength={100}
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{t({ en: "Doctor", ar: "المحاضر" })}</span>
            <input
              value={doctor}
              onChange={(e) => setDoctor(e.target.value)}
              maxLength={100}
            />
          </label>
        </div>
        <label>
          <span>{t({ en: "Explanation", ar: "الشرح" })}</span>
          <textarea
            value={explanation}
            onChange={(e) => setExplanation(e.target.value)}
            rows={6}
            maxLength={30000}
          />
        </label>
        <small>
          {t({
            en: "Formatting: **bold**, ==highlight==, !!callout!!, ~~green~~, ::blue::, [TABLE]…[/TABLE], [Image Slot 1].",
            ar: "تنسيق: **عريض**، ==تمييز==، !!تنبيه!!، ~~أخضر~~، ::أزرق::، [TABLE]…[/TABLE]، [Image Slot 1].",
          })}

            {t({
              en: "Arabic explanation (optional)",
              ar: "شرح بالعربية (اختياري)",
            })}
          </summary>
          <textarea
            value={arabicExplanation}
            onChange={(e) => setArabicExplanation(e.target.value)}
            rows={5}
            maxLength={30000}
            dir="auto"
          />
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>
            {t({ en: "Preview the explanation", ar: "معاينة الشرح" })}
          </summary>
          <Explanation content={explanation} images={images} />
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>
            {t({ en: "Explain incorrect choices", ar: "شرح الخيارات الخاطئة" })}
          </summary>
          {choiceKeys
            .filter((key) => key !== correct && choices[key]?.trim())
            .map((key) => (
              <label key={key}>
                <span>{key.toUpperCase()}</span>
                <textarea
                  rows={2}
                  value={wrong[key]}
                  maxLength={3000}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setWrong((current) => ({
                      ...current,
                      [key]: e.target.value,
                    }))
                  }
                />
              </label>
            ))}
        </details>
        <details>
          <summary>
            {t({
              en: "Question and explanation images",
              ar: "صور السؤال والشرح",
            })}
          </summary>
          <p className="exam-field-hint">
            {t({
              en: "Upload PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 512KiB, or use a secure image URL.",
              ar: "ارفع PNG أو JPEG أو WebP أو GIF حتى 512KiB أو استخدم رابط صورة آمناً.",
            })}
          </p>
          {([0, 1, 2, 3] as const).map((slot) => (
            <label key={slot}>
              <span>
                {t(
                  slot === 0
                    ? { en: "Question image", ar: "صورة السؤال" }
                    : {
                        en: `Explanation slot ${slot}`,
                        ar: `صورة الشرح ${slot}`,
                      },
                )}
              </span>
              <input
                aria-label={t({
                  en: `Image URL ${slot}`,
                  ar: `رابط الصورة ${slot}`,
                })}
                value={slot === 0 ? questionImage : images[slot] || ""}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  slot === 0
                    ? setQuestionImage(e.target.value)
                    : setImages((current) => ({
                        ...current,
                        [slot]: e.target.value,
                      }))
                }
              />
              <input
                type="file"
                accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp,image/gif"
                disabled={pending}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const file = e.target.files?.[0];
                  if (file) void upload(file, slot);
                  e.target.value = "";
                }}
              />
            </label>
          ))}
        </details>
        {error && (
          <p className="exam-error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        {deleteConfirm && (
          <div className="exam-delete-confirm" role="alert">
            <p>
              {t({
                en: "Delete this question from the set? Finished attempts keep their saved question snapshot.",
                ar: "حذف السؤال من المجموعة؟ تحتفظ المحاولات المكتملة بنسخة السؤال المحفوظة.",
              })}
            </p>
            <div className="exam-dialog-actions">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="button button-secondary"
                disabled={pending}
                onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(false)}
              >
                {t({ en: "Keep question", ar: "الاحتفاظ بالسؤال" })}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="button button-primary"
                disabled={pending}
                onClick={() => void remove()}
              >
                {t({ en: "Confirm deletion", ar: "تأكيد الحذف" })}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        <footer>
          {existing && !deleteConfirm && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="text-link"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(true)}
            >
              {t({ en: "Delete question", ar: "حذف السؤال" })}
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            className="button button-secondary"
            disabled={pending}
            onClick={close}
          >
            {t({ en: "Cancel", ar: "إلغاء" })}
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="button button-primary"
            disabled={pending || deleteConfirm}
          >
            {t(
              pending
                ? { en: "Saving…", ar: "جارٍ الحفظ…" }
                : { en: "Save question", ar: "حفظ السؤال" },
            )}
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/exams/QuestionTools.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Bookmark, Flag } from "lucide-react";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useExams, useExamQuery, useExamError } from "./useExams";
import type { ExamNotebook, ExamReport } from "../../types/exams";
export function QuestionTools({ questionId }: { questionId: string }) {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    { service, owner } = useExams(),
    client = useQueryClient(),
    errorText = useExamError();
  const notebook = useExamQuery("notebook", (signal) =>
    service.notebook(signal),
  );
  const saved = notebook.data?.bookmarkedIds.includes(questionId) || false;
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false),
    [reportOpen, setReportOpen] = useState(false),
    [category, setCategory] = useState<ExamReport["category"]>("answer"),
    [body, setBody] = useState(""),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    setBody("");
    setCategory("answer");
    setError("");
    setSent(false);
    setReportOpen(false);
  }, [questionId]);
  async function toggle() {
    if (pending || !notebook.data) return;
    const before = notebook.data;
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    client.setQueryData<ExamNotebook>(["exams", owner, "notebook", ""], {
      ...before,
      bookmarkedIds: saved
        ? before.bookmarkedIds.filter((id) => id !== questionId)
        : [...before.bookmarkedIds, questionId],
    });
    try {
      const next = await service.bookmark(questionId, !saved);
      client.setQueryData(["exams", owner, "notebook", ""], next);
    } catch (e) {
      client.setQueryData(["exams", owner, "notebook", ""], before);
      setError(errorText(e));
      toast.error(errorText(e));
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }
  async function report(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!body.trim()) {
      setError(
        t({
          en: "Describe the issue before sending.",
          ar: "صف المشكلة قبل الإرسال.",
        }),
      );
      return;
    }
    setPending(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await service.report({ questionId, category, body });
      setSent(true);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(errorText(e));
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  }
  return (
    <div className="exam-question-tools">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => void toggle()}
        disabled={pending || !notebook.data}
        aria-pressed={saved}
        aria-label={t(
          saved
            ? { en: "Remove saved question", ar: "إزالة السؤال المحفوظ" }
            : { en: "Save question", ar: "حفظ السؤال" },
        )}
      >
        <Bookmark size={18} fill={saved ? "currentColor" : "none"} />
        <span>
          {t(saved ? { en: "Saved", ar: "محفوظ" } : { en: "Save", ar: "حفظ" })}
        </span>
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => {
          setReportOpen(true);
          setError("");
          setSent(false);
        }}
      >
        <Flag size={17} />
        <span>{t({ en: "Report an issue", ar: "الإبلاغ عن مشكلة" })}</span>
      </button>
      {error && !reportOpen && (
        <p role="alert" className="exam-error">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      {reportOpen && (
        <Modal
          open
          onClose={() => setReportOpen(false)}
          title={t({
            en: "Help improve this question",
            ar: "ساعد في تحسين السؤال",
          })}
          description={t({
            en: "Describe what needs attention so a reviewer can check it.",
            ar: "صف ما يحتاج اهتماماً ليتحقق منه المراجع.",
          })}
          className="exam-report-dialog"
        >
          {sent ? (
            <div className="exam-report-sent" role="status">
              <p>
                {t(
                  service.source === "preview"
                    ? {
                        en: "Your report is saved in this device's preview.",
                        ar: "حُفظ البلاغ في معاينة هذا الجهاز.",
                      }
                    : {
                        en: "Your report has been sent for review.",
                        ar: "أُرسل البلاغ للمراجعة.",
                      },
                )}
              </p>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="button button-primary"
                onClick={() => setReportOpen(false)}
              >
                {t({ en: "Done", ar: "تم" })}
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <form className="exam-form" onSubmit={report}>
              <label>
                <span>{t({ en: "Category", ar: "الفئة" })}</span>
                <select
                  value={category}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setCategory(e.target.value as ExamReport["category"])
                  }
                >
                  {(
                    [
                      "answer",
                      "wording",
                      "explanation",
                      "image",
                      "other",
                    ] as const
                  ).map((c) => (
                    <option key={c} value={c}>
                      {t({
                        en: c,
                        ar: {
                          answer: "الإجابة",
                          wording: "الصياغة",
                          explanation: "الشرح",
                          image: "الصورة",
                          other: "أخرى",
                        }[c],
                      })}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </label>
              <label>
                <span>
                  {t({
                    en: "What needs attention?",
                    ar: "ما الذي يحتاج مراجعة؟",
                  })}
                </span>
                <textarea
                  value={body}
                  onChange={(e) => setBody(e.target.value)}
                  maxLength={2000}
                  rows={5}
                  required
                />
              </label>
              {error && (
                <p className="exam-error" role="alert">
                  {error}
                </p>
              )}
              <footer>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="button button-secondary"
                  onClick={() => setReportOpen(false)}
                >
                  {t({ en: "Cancel", ar: "إلغاء" })}
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="button button-primary"
                  disabled={pending}
                >
                  {t(
                    pending
                      ? { en: "Saving…", ar: "جارٍ الحفظ…" }
                      : { en: "Send report", ar: "إرسال البلاغ" },
                  )}
                </button>
              </footer>
            </form>
          )}
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
