FILE: src/features/exams/QuestionView.tsx
============================================================
import { memo, useState } from "react";
import { Check, X } from "lucide-react";
import type { ChoiceKey, ExamQuestion } from "../../types/exams";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Explanation } from "./Explanation";
import { safeExamImage } from "./exam-model";
export const QuestionView = memo(function QuestionView({
  question,
  chosen,
  reveal,
  locked,
  select,
  number,
}: {
  question: ExamQuestion;
  chosen?: ChoiceKey;
  reveal: boolean;
  locked: boolean;
  select?: (key: ChoiceKey) => void;
  number: number;
}) {
  const { t, locale } = useLocale(),
    [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const correct = question.choices.find((c) => c.key === question.correct);
  const keyLabel = (key: ChoiceKey) =>
    locale === "ar"
      ? { a: "أ", b: "ب", c: "ج", d: "د", e: "هـ" }[key]
      : key.toUpperCase();
  return (
    <div className="exam-question-content">
      <div className="exam-question-meta">
        <span>{t(question.chapter)}</span>
        {question.lecture && <span>{t(question.lecture)}</span>}
        {question.doctor && <span>{question.doctor}</span>}
      </div>
      <h2
        className="exam-question-stem"
        id="exam-question-stem"
        tabIndex={-1}
        dir="auto"
      >
        <span className="exam-question-number">{number}</span>
        {t(question.stem)}
      </h2>
      {question.images?.map((image, i) => {
        const source = safeExamImage(image.url);
        return source ? (
          <button
            className="exam-image"
            type="button"
            key={i}
            aria-label={t(image.alt)}
            onClick={() => setExpanded(source)}
          >
            <img
              src={source}
              alt={t(image.alt)}
              loading="lazy"
              decoding="async"
            />
          </button>
        ) : null;
      })}
      <fieldset className="exam-answer-options">
        <legend className="sr-only">
          {t({ en: "Answer choices", ar: "خيارات الإجابة" })}
        </legend>
        {question.choices.map((choice, i) => {
          const right = reveal && question.correct === choice.key,
            wrong = reveal && chosen === choice.key && !right;
          return (
            <button
              type="button"
              key={choice.key}
              className="exam-choice"
              data-choice={choice.key}
              data-selected={chosen === choice.key || undefined}
              data-correct={right || undefined}
              data-wrong={wrong || undefined}
              aria-pressed={chosen === choice.key}
              disabled={locked || !select}
              onClick={() => select?.(choice.key)}
            >
              <span className="exam-choice-letter">{keyLabel(choice.key)}</span>
              <span dir="auto">{t(choice.text)}</span>
              {right ? (
                <>
                  <Check size={19} />
                  <span className="sr-only">
                    {t({ en: "Correct answer", ar: "الإجابة الصحيحة" })}
                  </span>
                </>
              ) : wrong ? (
                <>
                  <X size={19} />
                  <span className="sr-only">
                    {t({ en: "Incorrect answer", ar: "إجابة خاطئة" })}
                  </span>
                </>
              ) : null}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </fieldset>
      {reveal && correct && (
        <div
          className="exam-feedback"
          role={select ? "status" : undefined}
          data-correct={chosen === correct.key || undefined}
        >
          <strong>
            {chosen
              ? t(
                  chosen === correct.key
                    ? {
                        en: "Correct. Keep the reasoning close.",
                        ar: "إجابة صحيحة. احتفظ بالسبب.",
                      }
                    : {
                        en: "A useful question to revisit.",
                        ar: "سؤال مفيد للعودة إليه.",
                      },
                )
              : t({ en: "Answer", ar: "الإجابة" })}
          </strong>
          <span>
            {keyLabel(correct.key)} · {t(correct.text)}
          </span>
          {chosen &&
            question.choices.find((c) => c.key === chosen)?.explanation && (
              <p>
                {t(
                  question.choices.find((c) => c.key === chosen)!.explanation!,
                )}
              </p>
            )}
        </div>
      )}
      {reveal && question.explanation && (
        <details className="exam-reasoning" open={!!select}>
          <summary>{t({ en: "The explanation", ar: "الشرح" })}</summary>
          <Explanation
            content={t(question.explanation)}
            images={question.explanationImages}
          />
        </details>
      )}
      {expanded && (
        <Modal
          open
          onClose={() => setExpanded(null)}
          title={t({ en: "Question image", ar: "صورة السؤال" })}
          description=""
          className="exam-image-dialog"
        >
          <img
            src={expanded}
            alt={t({ en: "Question image", ar: "صورة السؤال" })}
          />
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

import { ArrowRight, Megaphone } from "lucide-react";
import type { SiteContent } from "../../../types/content";
import { useLocale } from "../../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useOverlays } from "../../../app/providers/OverlayProvider";
import { useEvents } from "../../../hooks/useContent";
export function Announcement({ site }: { site: SiteContent }) {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const { openDetail } = useOverlays();
  const events = useEvents();
  const event = events.data?.find((e) => e.id === site.announcement.eventId);
  return (
    <div className="home-signal">
      <span className="home-signal-badge">
        <Megaphone size={19} />
        <span>{t(site.announcement.label)}</span>
      </span>
      <p>
        {t(site.announcement.title)}
        <span>{t(site.announcement.description)}</span>
      </p>
      {event && (
        <button
          className="text-link"
          onClick={() => openDetail({ kind: "event", item: event })}
        >
          {label("upcoming")}
          <ArrowRight className="directional" size={16} />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { ArrowDown, ArrowRight, Search } from "lucide-react";
import {
  ArtworkEditor,
  usePageArtwork,
} from "../../../components/data-display/HeroArtwork";
import { useLocale } from "../../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useAppearance } from "../../../app/providers/AppearanceProvider";
import { useOverlays } from "../../../app/providers/OverlayProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import type { SiteContent } from "../../../types/content";
import campus from "../../../assets/home/living-campus-1672.webp";
import campusSmall from "../../../assets/home/living-campus-960.webp";
import campusNight from "../../../assets/home/living-campus-night-1672.webp";

import { campusDestinations, type CampusDestination } from "../living-campus";
import { useCampusLife } from "../useCampusLife";
import { CampusLights } from "../CampusLights";
import "../living-campus.css";

/** Real links share the artwork's coordinates, including the responsive crop. */
export function Hero({
  hero,
  brand,
  nextSectionId,
}: {
  hero: SiteContent["hero"];
  brand: SiteContent["brand"];
  nextSectionId?: string;
}) {
  const { t, dir } = useLocale();
  const { resolvedTheme } = useAppearance();
  const { openSearch } = useOverlays();
  const artwork = usePageArtwork("home");
  const [active, setActive] = useState<CampusDestination | null>(null);
  const [failedSource, setFailedSource] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loadedSource, setLoadedSource] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const stage = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const id = useId().replace(/:/g, "");
  const custom = !!artwork.data;
  const night = resolvedTheme === "dark";
  const imageSource = artwork.data?.dataUrl || (night ? campusNight : campus);
  const failed = failedSource === imageSource;
  const mapped = !custom && !failed;
  const life = useCampusLife(
    stage,
    "entrance",
    mapped && loadedSource === imageSource,
  );
  return (
    <section
      className="campus-hero"
      aria-labelledby="home-welcome-heading"
      data-direction={dir}
      data-campus-lighting={night ? "night" : "day"}
      data-campus-running={life.running || undefined}
      data-custom-artwork={custom || undefined}
      data-artwork-failed={failed || undefined}
    >
      <div className="campus-hero-layout">
        <div className="campus-hero-copy" dir={dir}>
          <span className="campus-wordmark" lang="en">
            {brand.name}
          </span>
          <h1 id="home-welcome-heading" data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>
            <span>{t(hero.title).replace(/\n/g, " ")}</span>
            <span className="campus-hero-accent">{t(hero.accent)}</span>
          </h1>
          <p>{t(hero.description)}</p>
          <div className="campus-hero-actions">
            <AppLink href={hero.primary.href} className="campus-primary-action">
              {t(hero.primary.label)}
              <ArrowRight size={20} className="directional" />
            </AppLink>
            <AppLink
              href={hero.secondary.href}
              className="campus-secondary-action"
            >
              {t(hero.secondary.label)}
            </AppLink>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="campus-scene" ref={stage}>
          <div className="campus-scene-inner">
            <picture className="campus-picture">
              {!custom && (
                <source
                  srcSet={`${night ? campusNightSmall : campusSmall} 960w, ${night ? campusNight : campus} 1672w`}
                  sizes="(max-width: 900px) 145vw, 100vw"
                />
              )}
              <img
                key={imageSource}
                src={imageSource}
                width={1672}
                height={941}
                fetchPriority="high"
                decoding="async"
                alt={custom ? t(artwork.data!.alt) : ""}
                onLoad={() => {
                  setFailedSource(null);
                  setLoadedSource(imageSource);
                }}
                onError={() => setFailedSource(imageSource)}
              />
            </picture>
            {mapped && (
              <svg
                className="campus-map"
                role="group"
                viewBox="0 0 1672 941"
                aria-label={t({
                  en: "Explore the MedClub campus",
                  ar: "استكشف حرم ميدكلب",
                })}
              >
                <defs>
                  <linearGradient
                    id={`${id}-light`}
                    x1="0"
                    y1="1"
                    x2="1"
                    y2="0"
                  >
                    <stop
                      offset="0"
                      stopColor="var(--campus-path-color)"
                      stopOpacity=".25"
                    />
                    <stop offset="1" stopColor="var(--campus-path-color)" />
                  </linearGradient>
                </defs>
                <CampusLights lit={life.lit} revealed={life.revealed} />
                <g className="campus-routes" aria-hidden="true">
                  {campusDestinations.map((destination) => (
                    <path
                      key={destination.id}
                      className="campus-light-route"
                      d={destination.route}
                      pathLength={1}
                      stroke={`url(#${id}-light)`}
                      data-active={active?.id === destination.id || undefined}
                    />
                  ))}
                </g>
                {campusDestinations.map((destination) => (
                  <AppLink
                    key={destination.id}
                    href={destination.href}
                    className="campus-building"
                    data-campus-destination={destination.id}
                    data-active={active?.id === destination.id || undefined}
                    aria-label={t(destination.label)}
                    tabIndex={0}
                    onPointerEnter={() => setActive(destination)}
                    onPointerLeave={(event) => {
                      if (!event.currentTarget.contains(document.activeElement))
                        setActive(null);
                    }}
                    onFocus={() => setActive(destination)}
                    onBlur={() => setActive(null)}
                  >
                    <polygon
                      className="campus-building-hit"
                      points={destination.polygon}
                      vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke"
                    />
                    {/* The scene mirrors in Arabic; counter-mirror only the labels so they stay readable. */}
                    <g
                      transform={
                        dir === "rtl"
                          ? `translate(${destination.labelX * 2} 0) scale(-1 1)`
                          : undefined
                      }
                    >
                      <text
                        className="campus-building-label"
                        x={destination.labelX}
                        y={destination.labelY}
                        transform={`rotate(${dir === "rtl" ? -destination.rotation : destination.rotation} ${destination.labelX} ${destination.labelY})`}
                        textAnchor="middle"
                        dominantBaseline="middle"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                        lang={dir === "rtl" ? "ar" : "en"}
                      >
                        {t(destination.label)}
                      </text>
                    </g>
                  </AppLink>
                ))}
              </svg>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="campus-hero-footer" dir={dir}>
        <p className="campus-destination-caption">
          <span className="campus-caption-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
          {active && mapped ? (
            <>
              <strong>{t(active.label)}</strong>
              <span>{t(active.description)}</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <span>
              {t({
                en: "Choose your next destination.",
                ar: "اختر وجهتك التالية.",
              })}
            </span>
          )}
        </p>
        <div className="campus-footer-actions">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="campus-search"
            data-search-trigger
            onClick={openSearch}
            aria-label={t(hero.searchTitle)}
          >
            <Search size={17} />
            <span>{t(hero.searchTitle)}</span>
            <kbd aria-hidden="true">/</kbd>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      {nextSectionId && (
        <a className="campus-scroll-cue" href={`#${nextSectionId}`}>
          <span>{t({ en: "Keep exploring", ar: "واصل الاستكشاف" })}</span>
          <ArrowDown size={16} />
        </a>
      )}
      <nav
        className="campus-destination-links"
        aria-label={t({ en: "Campus destinations", ar: "وجهات الحرم" })}
        dir={dir}
      >
        {campusDestinations.map((destination) => (
          <AppLink
            key={destination.id}
            href={destination.href}
            data-campus-link={destination.id}
          >
            <span>{t(destination.label)}</span>
            <ArrowRight className="directional" size={15} />
          </AppLink>
        ))}
      </nav>
      <ArtworkEditor section="home" />
    </section>
  );
}

import { ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";
import { useJournal } from "../../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { LoadingState } from "../../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { AppLink } from "../../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { articlePath } from "../../../constants/routes";
export function Journal() {
  const query = useJournal();
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  const article = query.data[0];
  if (!article) return <EmptyState />;
  return (
    <article className="home-journal-spread" data-home-reveal="unfold">
      <div className="home-journal-cover" aria-hidden="true">
        <span>{t(article.category)}</span>
        <strong>{Array.from(t(article.title).trim())[0]}</strong>
        <span>MedClub Journal</span>
        <i />
        <i />
        <i />
      </div>
      <div className="home-journal-story">
        <span className="eyebrow">
          {t(article.category)} · {article.readMinutes} {label("readMinutes")}
        </span>
        <h3>{t(article.title)}</h3>
        <p>{t(article.excerpt)}</p>
        <div className="home-journal-byline">
          <span>{t(article.author)}</span>
          <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
        </div>
        <AppLink className="text-link" href={articlePath(article.slug)}>
          {label("story")}
          <ArrowRight className="directional" size={18} />
        </AppLink>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/homepage/sections/LatestResources.tsx
============================================================
import { useCourses, useResources } from "../../../hooks/useContent";
import { ResourceCollection } from "../../resources/ResourceCollection";
import { LoadingState } from "../../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { CourseCard } from "../../../components/cards/CourseCard";
import {
  Tabs,
  TabsContent,
  TabsList,
  TabsTrigger,
} from "../../../components/ui/tabs";
import { useLocale } from "../../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
export function LatestResources() {
  const { label, t, dir } = useLocale();
  const courses = useCourses();
  const resources = useResources();
  if (courses.isPending || resources.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (courses.isError || resources.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void courses.refetch();
          void resources.refetch();
        }}
      />
    );
  return (
    <div className="home-resource-desk" data-home-reveal="unfold">
      <Tabs defaultValue="courses" dir={dir} className="home-study-tabs">
        <TabsList
          aria-label={t({
            en: "Explore study materials",
            ar: "استكشف المواد الدراسية",
          })}
        >
          <TabsTrigger value="courses">
            {t({ en: "Courses", ar: "المساقات" })}
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="resources">{label("resources")}</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>
        <TabsContent value="courses">
          <div className="home-course-shelf">
            {courses.data.slice(0, 4).map((course) => (
              <CourseCard key={course.id} course={course} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="resources">
          <ResourceCollection
            courses={courses.data}
            resources={resources.data}
            limit={4}
          />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { useOpportunities } from "../../../hooks/useContent";
import { OpportunityCard } from "../../../components/cards/OpportunityCard";
import { LoadingState } from "../../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
export function Opportunities() {
  const query = useOpportunities();
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  if (query.data.length === 0) return <EmptyState />;
  return (
    <div className="home-opportunity-board">
      {query.data.slice(0, 2).map((item, index) => (
        <div
          className="home-opportunity-note"
          key={item.id}
          data-home-reveal="unfold"
          style={{ "--home-stagger": `${index * 130}ms` } as CSSProperties}
        >
          <span className="home-note-pin" aria-hidden="true" />
          <OpportunityCard opportunity={item} />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { ArrowUpRight } from "lucide-react";
import type { SiteContent } from "../../../types/content";
import { useLocale } from "../../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { Icon } from "../../../components/ui/Icon";
export function QuickAccess({ site }: { site: SiteContent }) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  return (
    <div className="home-gateways">
      {site.pathways.map((item, index) => (
        <div
          className="home-gateway-wrap"
          key={item.id}
          data-home-reveal="unfold"
          style={
            {
              "--home-stagger": `${Math.min(index, 4) * 90}ms`,
            } as CSSProperties
          }
        >
          <AppLink href={item.href} className="home-gateway">
            <div className="home-gateway-art" aria-hidden="true">
              <span className="home-gateway-arch" />
              <span className="home-gateway-emblem">
                <Icon name={item.icon || "book"} />
              </span>
              <span className="home-gateway-orbit" />
            </div>
            <div className="home-gateway-caption">
              <span aria-hidden="true">
                {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
              </span>
              <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={21} />
            </div>
            <h3>{t(item.label)}</h3>
            {item.description && <p>{t(item.description)}</p>}
          </AppLink>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { useEvents } from "../../../hooks/useContent";
import { EventCard } from "../../../components/cards/EventCard";
import { LoadingState } from "../../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { EmptyState } from "../../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
export function UpcomingEvents() {
  const query = useEvents();
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  if (query.data.length === 0) return <EmptyState />;
  return (
    <div className="home-event-timeline">
      {query.data.slice(0, 3).map((event, index) => (
        <div
          className="home-event-stop"
          key={event.id}
          data-home-reveal={index === 0 ? "left" : "right"}
          style={{ "--home-stagger": `${index * 90}ms` } as CSSProperties}
        >
          <span className="home-event-marker" aria-hidden="true">
            {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
          </span>
          <EventCard event={event} />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/homepage/CampusLights.tsx
============================================================
import { useId } from "react";
import { campusDestinations } from "./living-campus";
import "./campus-lights.css";

const centers: Record<string, [number, number]> = {
  learning: [740, 265],
  media: [1065, 170],
  community: [1330, 235],
  mentorship: [1490, 465],
  contribution: [1300, 680],
  journals: [770, 665],
};
export function CampusLights({
  lit,
  revealed,
  destinations = campusDestinations,
  origin = [1070, 578],
}: {
  lit: string | null;
  revealed: string[];
  destinations?: Array<{
    id: string;
    polygon: string;
    route: string;
    lightX?: number;
    lightY?: number;
  }>;
  origin?: [number, number];
}) {
  const id = useId().replace(/:/g, "");
  return (
    <g className="campus-life" aria-hidden="true" pointerEvents="none">
      <defs>
        <radialGradient id={`${id}-glow`}>
          <stop
            stopColor="var(--campus-path-color, var(--ring))"
            stopOpacity=".24"
          />
          <stop
            offset="1"
            stopColor="var(--campus-path-color, var(--ring))"
            stopOpacity="0"
          />
        </radialGradient>
        {destinations.map((destination) => (
          <clipPath id={`${id}-${destination.id}`} key={destination.id}>
            <polygon points={destination.polygon} />
          </clipPath>
        ))}
      </defs>
      <ellipse
        className="campus-life-core"
        cx={origin[0]}
        cy={origin[1]}
        rx={166}
        ry={61}
      />
      {destinations.map((destination) => {
        const [x, y] =
          destination.lightX !== undefined && destination.lightY !== undefined
            ? [destination.lightX, destination.lightY]
            : centers[destination.id];
        return (
          <g
            key={destination.id}
            data-campus-life-destination={destination.id}
            data-lit={lit === destination.id || undefined}
            className="campus-life-destination"
          >
            <path
              className="campus-life-route"
              d={destination.route}
              pathLength={1}
              data-revealed={revealed.includes(destination.id) || undefined}
            />
            <circle
              className="campus-life-glow"
              cx={x}
              cy={y}
              r={96}
              fill={`url(#${id}-glow)`}
              clipPath={`url(#${id}-${destination.id})`}
            />
            <g className="campus-life-sparks">
              <path d={`M${x - 9} ${y}h18M${x} ${y - 9}v18`} />
              <circle cx={x - 28} cy={y + 16} r={2.5} />
              <circle cx={x + 25} cy={y - 22} r={2} />
            </g>
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </g>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/homepage/Homepage.tsx
============================================================
import { useRef } from "react";
import type { SiteContent, HomeSection } from "../../types/content";
import { useSiteContent } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { visibleSections } from "../../lib/home-sections";
import { SectionHeading } from "../../components/data-display/SectionHeading";
import { Hero } from "./sections/Hero";
import { Announcement } from "./sections/Announcement";
import { QuickAccess } from "./sections/QuickAccess";
import { LatestResources } from "./sections/LatestResources";
import { UpcomingEvents } from "./sections/UpcomingEvents";
import { Opportunities } from "./sections/Opportunities";
import { Journal } from "./sections/Journal";
import { Community } from "./sections/Community";
import { useHomeReveal } from "./useHomeReveal";
import "./home-atlas.css";

const registry = {
  pathways: QuickAccess,
  resources: LatestResources,
  events: UpcomingEvents,
  opportunities: Opportunities,
  journal: Journal,
};
function Section({
  section,
  site,
  chapter,
}: {
  section: HomeSection;
  site: SiteContent;
  chapter: number;
}) {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  if (section.type === "announcement")
    return (
      <section
        id={section.id}
        className="home-signal-section"
        data-home-reveal="rise"
      >
        <Announcement site={site} />
      </section>
    );
  if (section.type === "community")
    return (
      <section
        id={section.id}
        className="home-chapter home-community"
        data-home-section={section.type}
      >
        <Community site={site} />
      </section>
    );
  const Component = registry[section.type];
  const href =
    section.type === "resources"
      ? "/learn"
      : section.type === "events"
        ? "/events"
        : section.type === "opportunities"
          ? "/opportunities"
          : section.type === "journal"
            ? "/journal"
            : undefined;
  return (
    <section
      id={section.id}
      className={`home-chapter home-${section.type}`}
      data-home-section={section.type}
    >
      <div
        className="home-chapter-heading"
        data-home-reveal={section.type === "resources" ? "left" : "rise"}
      >
        <span className="home-chapter-number" aria-hidden="true">
          {String(chapter).padStart(2, "0")}
        </span>
        <SectionHeading
          heading={site.headings[section.type]}
          href={href}
          linkLabel={label(
            section.type === "events"
              ? "exploreAllEvents"
              : section.type === "opportunities"
                ? "exploreAllOpportunities"
                : section.type === "journal"
                  ? "allArticles"
                  : "browse",
          )}
        />
      </div>
      <div className="home-chapter-content">
        <Component site={site} />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
export default function Homepage() {
  const { data: site } = useSiteContent();
  const { dir } = useLocale();
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useHomeReveal(root, !!site);
  if (!site) return null;
  const sections = visibleSections(site.sections, new Date());
  let chapter = 0;
  return (
    <div className="home-atlas" dir={dir} ref={root}>
      <Hero
        hero={site.hero}
        brand={site.brand}
        nextSectionId={
          sections.find((section) => section.type !== "announcement")?.id
        }
      />
      {sections.map((section) => (
        <Section
          key={section.id}
          section={section}
          site={site}
          chapter={section.type === "announcement" ? 0 : ++chapter}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

import { throwToTrash } from "../../components/feedback/action-flight";
import { useMemo, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import {
  ArrowUpRight,
  BookOpenCheck,
  BrainCircuit,
  Download,
  LockKeyhole,
  Sparkles,
  Trash2,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { useCourses, useResources } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { downloadCsv } from "../../lib/csv";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import { assessmentPercent, consecutiveStudyDays } from "../../lib/insights";
import { coursePath } from "../../constants/routes";
import { AttemptBars } from "./InsightCharts";
import { useAcademicInsights } from "./useInsights";

export default function AcademicProgressPage({
  embedded = false,
}: {
  embedded?: boolean;
}) {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const courses = useCourses();
  const resources = useResources();
  const insights = useAcademicInsights();
  const workspace = useWorkspace();
  const [formOpen, setFormOpen] = useState(false);
  const [courseId, setCourseId] = useState("");
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [correct, setCorrect] = useState("");
  const [total, setTotal] = useState("");
  const [completedAt, setCompletedAt] = useState("2026-09-08");

  const selectedCourses = useMemo(
    () =>
      courses.data?.filter((course) =>
        insights.profile.data?.courseIds.includes(course.id),
      ) || [],
    [courses.data, insights.profile.data?.courseIds],
  );
  const courseNames = useMemo(
    () =>
      new Map(selectedCourses.map((course) => [course.id, t(course.title)])),
    [selectedCourses, t],
  );
  if (
    courses.isPending ||
    resources.isPending ||
    insights.isPending ||
    workspace.isPending
  )
    return <LoadingState />;
  if (
    courses.isError ||
    resources.isError ||
    insights.isError ||
    workspace.isError ||
    !insights.record
  )
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void courses.refetch();
          void resources.refetch();
          insights.retry();
          workspace.retry();
        }}
      />
    );

  const record = insights.record;
  const reviewed = workspace.state.reviewedResourceIds.length;
  const average = record.attempts.length
    ? Math.round(
        record.attempts.reduce(
          (sum, attempt) => sum + assessmentPercent(attempt),
          0,
        ) / record.attempts.length,
      )
    : 0;
  const streak = consecutiveStudyDays([
    ...record.attempts.map((attempt) => attempt.completedAt),
    ...workspace.state.studyEntries.map((entry) => entry.date),
  ]);
  const courseSignals = selectedCourses.map((course) => {
    const courseResources = resources.data.filter(
      (resource) => resource.courseId === course.id,
    );
    const ids = new Set(courseResources.map((resource) => resource.id));
    const confidence = record.confidence.find(
      (item) => item.courseId === course.id,
    )?.value;
    return {
      course,
      resources: courseResources.length,
      reviewed: workspace.state.reviewedResourceIds.filter((id) => ids.has(id))
        .length,
      viewed: new Set(
        workspace.state.recentResources
          .filter((item) => ids.has(item.resourceId))
          .map((item) => item.resourceId),
      ).size,
      saved: workspace.state.savedIds.filter((id) => ids.has(id)).length,
      confidence,
    };
  });
  const next = [...courseSignals].sort(
    (a, b) =>
      (a.confidence || 0) - (b.confidence || 0) || a.reviewed - b.reviewed,
  )[0];

  const setConfidence = async (id: string, value: number) => {
    try {
      await insights.setConfidence({ courseId: id, value });
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("progressSaveFailed"));
    }
  };
  const submit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    try {
      await insights.recordAssessment({
        courseId,
        title,
        correct: Number(correct),
        total: Number(total),
        completedAt,
      });
      setTitle("");
      setCorrect("");
      setTotal("");
      setFormOpen(false);
      toast.success(label("progressAttemptSaved"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("progressSaveFailed"));
    }
  };
  const remove = async (id: string) => {
    try {
      const source =
        [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-attempt-id]")].find(
          (row) => row.dataset.attemptId === id,
        ) || null;
      await throwToTrash(
        source,
        record.attempts.find((attempt) => attempt.id === id)?.title ||
          label("progressAttemptDeleted"),
      ).finished;
      await insights.deleteAssessment(id);
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("progressSaveFailed"));
    }
  };
  const exportProgress = () => {
    downloadCsv("my-medclub-study-insights.csv", [
      [
        "course_id",
        "course",
        "confidence",
        "practice_title",
        "correct",
        "total",
        "completed_at",
      ],
      ...record.attempts.map((attempt) => [
        attempt.courseId,
        courseNames.get(attempt.courseId) || attempt.courseId,
        record.confidence.find((item) => item.courseId === attempt.courseId)
          ?.value || "",
        attempt.title,
        attempt.correct,
        attempt.total,
        attempt.completedAt,
      ]),
    ]);
    toast.success(label("insightsExported"));
  };
  return (
    <div
      className={`${embedded ? "learning-insights" : "container"} academic-progress-page`}
    >
      <section className="progress-hero">
        <PageIntro
          headingLevel={embedded ? 2 : 1}
          eyebrow={label("progressEyebrow")}
          title={label("progressTitle")}
          description={label("progressBody")}
        />
        <div className="progress-hero-visual" aria-hidden="true">
          <BrainCircuit size={30} />
          <i />
          <b />
          <span />
        </div>
      </section>
      {!record.persistent && (
        <p className="workspace-warning" role="status">
          {label("progressPersistenceWarning")}
        </p>
      )}
      <section className="progress-metrics" aria-label={label("myProgress")}>
        <article>
          <span className="progress-metric-mark">
            <Sparkles size={19} />
          </span>
          <strong>{streak}</strong>
          <p>{label("progressStudyDays")}</p>
          <small>{label("progressRecorded")}</small>
        </article>
        <article>
          <span className="progress-metric-mark">
            <BookOpenCheck size={19} />
          </span>
          <strong>{reviewed}</strong>
          <p>{label("progressResourcesReviewed")}</p>
          <small>{label("progressRecorded")}</small>
        </article>
        <article>
          <span className="progress-metric-mark">
            <BrainCircuit size={19} />
          </span>
          <strong>{record.attempts.length ? `${average}%` : "—"}</strong>
          <p>{label("progressPracticeAverage")}</p>
          <small>{label("progressSelfRated")}</small>
        </article>
      </section>
      {next && (
        <AppLink
          href={coursePath(next.course.slug)}
          className="progress-next-step"
        >
          <span>
            <small>{label("progressNextStep")}</small>
            <strong>{t(next.course.title)}</strong>
            <p>{label("progressNextStepBody")}</p>
          </span>
          <ArrowUpRight size={21} className="directional" />
        </AppLink>
      )}
      <section className="progress-section">
        <header className="progress-section-heading">
          <div>
            <h2>{label("progressCourseSignals")}</h2>
            <p>{label("progressCourseSignalsBody")}</p>
          </div>
          <button
            className="button button-secondary"
            type="button"
            onClick={exportProgress}
          >
            <Download size={17} />
            {label("insightsExport")}
          </button>
        </header>
        <div className="course-signal-grid">
          {courseSignals.map((signal) => (
            <article
              key={signal.course.id}
              className="course-signal-card"
              data-accent={signal.course.accent}
            >
              <header>
                <span>{signal.course.code}</span>
                <h3>{t(signal.course.title)}</h3>
              </header>
              <dl>
                <div>
                  <dt>{label("progressReviewed")}</dt>
                  <dd>
                    {signal.reviewed}/{signal.resources}
                  </dd>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <dt>{label("progressViewed")}</dt>
                  <dd>{signal.viewed}</dd>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <dt>{label("progressSaved")}</dt>
                  <dd>{signal.saved}</dd>
                </div>
              </dl>
              <fieldset>
                <legend>
                  {label("progressConfidence")}{" "}
                  <small>{label("progressSelfRated")}</small>
                </legend>
                <div className="confidence-scale">
                  {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((value) => (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      key={value}
                      aria-pressed={signal.confidence === value}
                      aria-label={`${label("progressConfidence")}: ${label(`progressConfidence${value}` as "progressConfidence1")}`}
                      onClick={() =>
                        void setConfidence(signal.course.id, value)
                      }
                      disabled={insights.isMutating}
                    >
                      {value}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <p>
                  {signal.confidence
                    ? label(
                        `progressConfidence${signal.confidence}` as "progressConfidence1",
                      )
                    : label("progressConfidence1")}
                </p>
              </fieldset>
              <AppLink href={coursePath(signal.course.slug)}>
                {label("courseHome")}
                <ArrowUpRight size={16} className="directional" />
              </AppLink>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>
      <section className="progress-practice progress-section">
        <header className="progress-section-heading">
          <div>
            <h2>{label("progressPracticeHistory")}</h2>
            <p>{label("progressPracticeBody")}</p>
          </div>
          <button
            className="button"
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setCourseId(courseId || selectedCourses[0]?.id || "");
              setFormOpen((open) => !open);
            }}
          >
            {label("progressAddAttempt")}
          </button>
        </header>
        {formOpen && (
          <form className="practice-form" onSubmit={submit}>
            <label>
              <span>{label("progressCourse")}</span>
              <select
                required
                value={courseId}
                onChange={(event) => setCourseId(event.target.value)}
              >
                {selectedCourses.map((course) => (
                  <option key={course.id} value={course.id}>
                    {t(course.title)}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <label>
              <span>{label("progressAssessmentTitle")}</span>
              <input
                required
                maxLength={80}
                value={title}
                onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)}
              />
            </label>
            <label>
              <span>{label("progressCorrect")}</span>
              <input
                required
                type="number"
                min="0"
                max="300"
                value={correct}
                onChange={(event) => setCorrect(event.target.value)}
              />
            </label>
            <label>
              <span>{label("progressTotal")}</span>
              <input
                required
                type="number"
                min="1"
                max="300"
                value={total}
                onChange={(event) => setTotal(event.target.value)}
              />
            </label>
            <label>
              <span>{label("progressCompleted")}</span>
              <input
                required
                type="date"
                max="2026-09-08"
                value={completedAt}
                onChange={(event) => setCompletedAt(event.target.value)}
              />
            </label>
            <button
              className="button"
              type="submit"
              disabled={insights.isMutating}
            >
              {label("progressSaveAttempt")}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
        {record.attempts.length ? (
          <>
            <AttemptBars attempts={record.attempts} courseNames={courseNames} />

              {[...record.attempts]

                .map((attempt) => (
                  <article key={attempt.id} data-attempt-id={attempt.id}>
                    <span>
                      <strong>{attempt.title}</strong>
                      <small>

import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import type { AnalyticsPoint, AssessmentAttempt } from "../../types/insights";
import { assessmentPercent } from "../../lib/insights";

function pathFor(values: number[]) {
  if (!values.length) return "";
  const min = Math.min(...values);
  const max = Math.max(...values);
  const spread = Math.max(1, max - min);
  return values
    .map((value, index) => {
      const x = values.length === 1 ? 50 : (index / (values.length - 1)) * 100;
      const y = 88 - ((value - min) / spread) * 72;
      return `${index ? "L" : "M"}${x.toFixed(2)} ${y.toFixed(2)}`;
    })
    .join(" ");
}

export function EngagementTrend({
  points,
  labels,
}: {
  points: AnalyticsPoint[];
  labels: { opens: string; searches: string; saves: string; accessible: string };
}) {
  const series = [
    { id: "opens", label: labels.opens, values: points.map((point) => point.resourceOpens) },
    { id: "searches", label: labels.searches, values: points.map((point) => point.searches) },
    { id: "saves", label: labels.saves, values: points.map((point) => point.saves) },
  ];
  return (
    <div className="insight-trend" role="img" aria-label={labels.accessible}>
      <div className="insight-chart-legend" aria-hidden="true">
        {series.map((item) => <span key={item.id} data-series={item.id}><i />{item.label}</span>)}
      </div>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
        <g className="insight-grid-lines"><path d="M0 16H100M0 40H100M0 64H100M0 88H100" /></g>
        {series.map((item) => <path key={item.id} data-series={item.id} d={pathFor(item.values)} vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" />)}
      </svg>
      <div className="insight-chart-dates" aria-hidden="true"><span>{points[0]?.date}</span><span>{points.at(-1)?.date}</span></div>
      <ul className="sr-only">
        {points.map((point) => <li key={point.date}>{point.date}: {labels.opens} {point.resourceOpens}, {labels.searches} {point.searches}, {labels.saves} {point.saves}</li>)}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

export function AttemptBars({ attempts, courseNames }: { attempts: AssessmentAttempt[]; courseNames: Map<string, string> }) {
  const visible = [...attempts].sort((a, b) => a.completedAt.localeCompare(b.completedAt)).slice(-8);
  return (
    <div className="attempt-bars" aria-label="Practice result chart">
      {visible.map((attempt) => {
        const score = assessmentPercent(attempt);
        return (
          <div className="attempt-bar" key={attempt.id} title={`${attempt.title}: ${score}%`}>
            <span className="attempt-bar-fill" style={{ "--score": score } as CSSProperties} />
            <strong>{score}%</strong>
            <small>{courseNames.get(attempt.courseId) || attempt.courseId}</small>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

import { toast } from "sonner";
import { UsersRound } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { MentorshipSessionCard } from "../../components/cards/MentorshipSessionCard";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { MentorshipNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/MentorshipNavigation";
import {
  useMentors,
  useMentorshipSessions,
  useMentorshipWorkspace,
} from "../../hooks/useContent";

export default function GroupSessionsPage() {
  const { label } = useLocale();
  const mentors = useMentors();
  const sessions = useMentorshipSessions();
  const workspace = useMentorshipWorkspace();
  const pending =
    mentors.isPending || sessions.isPending || workspace.isPending;
  const failed = mentors.isError || sessions.isError || workspace.isError;
  if (pending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (failed)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void mentors.refetch();
          void sessions.refetch();
          workspace.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  async function toggle(sessionId: string, joined: boolean) {
    try {
      if (joined) await workspace.cancelSession(sessionId);
      else await workspace.registerSession(sessionId);
      toast.success(label(joined ? "sessionLeft" : "sessionJoined"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("sessionActionFailed"));
    }
  }
  return (
    <div className="mentorship-v6 group-sessions-page container">
      <MentorshipNavigation />
      <header className="v6-page-intro">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("groupSessionsEyebrow")}</span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {label("groupSessionsTitle")}
          </h1>
          <p>{label("groupSessionsBody")}</p>
        </div>
        <span className="v6-intro-icon" aria-hidden="true">
          <UsersRound size={38} />
          <i />
        </span>
      </header>
      <div className="mentor-session-list">
        {sessions.data?.map((session) => {
          const joined = workspace.registrations.some(
            (item) => item.sessionId === session.id,
          );
          return (
            <MentorshipSessionCard
              key={session.id}
              session={session}
              mentor={mentors.data?.find(
                (item) => item.id === session.mentorId,
              )}
              joined={joined}
              busy={workspace.isMutating}
              onToggle={() => void toggle(session.id, joined)}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <p className="v6-boundary-note">{label("mentorPreviewNotice")}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/mentorship/MentorRequestDialog.tsx

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import type {
  Mentor,
  MentorshipFormat,
  MentorshipRequestInput,
} from "../../types/content";

export function MentorRequestDialog({
  mentor,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  mentor: Mentor | null;
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSubmit: (input: MentorshipRequestInput) => Promise<unknown>;
}) {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const [area, setArea] = useState("");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  const [format, setFormat] = useState<MentorshipFormat>("hybrid");
  useEffect(() => {
    setArea(mentor?.areas[0]?.en || "");
    setFormat(mentor?.format || "hybrid");
    setNote("");
  }, [mentor]);
  async function submit(event: React.FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!mentor || !area || !note.trim()) {
      toast.error(label("requestFailed"));
      return;
    }
    try {
      await onSubmit({
        mentorId: mentor.id,
        area,
        note,
        preferredFormat: format,
      });
      toast.success(label("requestSent"));
      onClose();
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("requestFailed"));
    }
  }
  return (
    <Modal
      open={!!mentor}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={label("requestMentorship")}
      description={label("requestMentorshipBody")}
      className="mentor-request-modal"
    >
      {mentor && (
        <form className="mentor-request-form" onSubmit={submit}>
          <div className="request-mentor-identity">
            <span>{t(mentor.initials)}</span>
            <div>
              <strong>{t(mentor.name)}</strong>
              <small>{t(mentor.specialty)}</small>
            </div>
          </div>
          <label>
            <span>{label("mentorshipArea")}</span>
            <select
              value={area}
              onChange={(event) => setArea(event.target.value)}
            >
              {mentor.areas.map((item) => (
                <option value={item.en} key={item.en}>
                  {t(item)}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{label("preferredFormat")}</span>
            <select
              value={format}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setFormat(event.target.value as MentorshipFormat)
              }
            >
              {(["onsite", "online", "hybrid"] as const).map((value) => (
                <option value={value} key={value}>
                  {label(value)}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{label("noteForMentor")}</span>
            <textarea
              value={note}
              onChange={(event) => setNote(event.target.value)}
              rows={4}
              required
            />
          </label>
          <div className="workspace-form-actions">
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onClose}>
              {label("cancel")}
            </Button>
            <Button
              className="button button-primary"
              disabled={busy || !note.trim()}
            >
              {label("sendRequest")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/mentorship/MentorshipPage.tsx
============================================================
import { HeroArtwork } from "../../components/data-display/HeroArtwork";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { HeartHandshake, Search, ShieldCheck, Stethoscope } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { MentorCard } from "../../components/cards/MentorCard";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { MentorshipNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/MentorshipNavigation";
import { useMentors, useMentorshipWorkspace } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import type { Mentor } from "../../types/content";
import { MentorRequestDialog } from "./MentorRequestDialog";

export default function MentorshipPage() {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const mentors = useMentors();
  const workspace = useMentorshipWorkspace();
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [specialty, setSpecialty] = useState("");
  const [format, setFormat] = useState("");
  const [available, setAvailable] = useState(false);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Mentor | null>(null);
  const rows = mentors.data || [];
  useEffect(() => {
    const slug = params.get("mentor");
    const requested = rows.find((item) => item.slug === slug);
    if (requested) setSearch(t(requested.name));
  }, [params, rows, t]);
  const specialties = [
    ...new Map(
      rows.map((item) => [item.specialty.en, item.specialty]),
    ).values(),
  ];
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    return rows.filter(
      (mentor) =>
        (!needle ||
          [
            t(mentor.name),
            t(mentor.specialty),
            t(mentor.bio),
            ...mentor.areas.map(t),
          ].some((value) => value.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle))) &&
        (!specialty || mentor.specialty.en === specialty) &&
        (!format || mentor.format === format) &&
        (!available || mentor.activeMentees < mentor.capacity),
    );
  }, [available, format, rows, search, specialty, t]);
  if (mentors.isPending || workspace.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (mentors.isError || workspace.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void mentors.refetch();
          workspace.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  return (
    <div className="mentorship-v6 mentorship-page container">
      <MentorshipNavigation />
      <header className="mentorship-hero artwork-scene">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("mentorshipEyebrow")}</span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {label("mentorshipTitle")}
          </h1>
          <p>{label("mentorshipBody")}</p>
        </div>
        <HeroArtwork section="mentorship" />
      </header>
      <section className="mentor-controls" aria-label={label("mentorFilters")}>
        <label className="mentor-search">
          <Search size={18} />
          <span className="sr-only">{label("mentorSearch")}</span>
          <input
            value={search}
            onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
            placeholder={label("mentorSearch")}
          />
        </label>
        <label>
          <span>{label("allSpecialties")}</span>
          <select
            value={specialty}
            onChange={(event) => setSpecialty(event.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">{label("allSpecialties")}</option>
            {specialties.map((item) => (
              <option key={item.en} value={item.en}>
                {t(item)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>
          <span>{label("preferredFormat")}</span>
          <select
            value={format}
            onChange={(event) => setFormat(event.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">{label("allFormats")}</option>
            {(["onsite", "online", "hybrid"] as const).map((value) => (
              <option key={value} value={value}>
                {label(value)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label className="available-toggle">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={available}
            onChange={(event) => setAvailable(event.target.checked)}
          />
          <span>
            <HeartHandshake size={17} />
            {label("availableOnly")}
          </span>
        </label>
      </section>
      <p className="community-results" role="status">
        <strong>{filtered.length}</strong> {label("results")}
      </p>
      {filtered.length ? (
        <div className="mentor-grid">
          {filtered.map((mentor) => (
            <MentorCard
              key={mentor.id}
              mentor={mentor}
              request={workspace.requests.find(
                (item) => item.mentorId === mentor.id,
              )}
              onRequest={setSelected}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState />
      )}
      <p className="v6-boundary-note">
        <ShieldCheck size={17} /> {label("mentorPreviewNotice")}
      </p>
      <MentorRequestDialog
        mentor={selected}
        busy={workspace.isMutating}
        onClose={() => setSelected(null)}
        onSubmit={workspace.request}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  BriefcaseMedical,
  HeartHandshake,
  Microscope,
  Stethoscope,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { MentorshipNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/MentorshipNavigation";
import { useMentorshipQuestions } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";

type View =
  "all" | "career" | "research" | "clinical-learning" | "student-life";
export default function MentorshipQAPage() {
  const { t, label, locale } = useLocale();
  const query = useMentorshipQuestions();
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>("all");
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  const questions = query.data || [];
  const filtered = questions.filter(
    (item) => view === "all" || item.category === view,
  );
  const tabs = [
    {
      id: "all",
      label: label("allQuestions"),
      icon: HeartHandshake,
      count: questions.length,
    },
    {
      id: "career",
      label: label("career"),
      icon: BriefcaseMedical,
      count: questions.filter((item) => item.category === "career").length,
    },
    {
      id: "research",
      label: label("research"),
      icon: Microscope,
      count: questions.filter((item) => item.category === "research").length,
    },
    {
      id: "clinical-learning",
      label: label("clinicalLearning"),
      icon: Stethoscope,
      count: questions.filter((item) => item.category === "clinical-learning")
        .length,
    },
  ] as const;
  return (
    <div className="mentorship-v6 mentorship-qa-page container">
      <MentorshipNavigation />
      <header className="v6-page-intro">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("questionsEyebrow")}</span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {label("questionsTitle")}
          </h1>
          <p>{label("questionsBody")}</p>
        </div>
      </header>
      <AliveTabs
        label={label("questionFilters")}
        items={[...tabs]}
        value={view}
        onChange={setView}
      />
      {filtered.length ? (
        <div className="mentor-question-list">
          {filtered.map((item, index) => (
            <article key={item.id}>
              <span className="question-number">
                {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
              </span>
              <div>
                <h2>{t(item.question)}</h2>
                <p>{t(item.answer)}</p>
                <footer>
                  <strong>
                    {label("answeredBy")}: {t(item.answeredBy)}
                  </strong>
                  <span>{formatDate(item.answeredAt, locale)}</span>
                </footer>
              </div>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState title={label("noQuestions")} />
      )}
      <p className="v6-boundary-note">{label("mentorshipBoundaries")}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

import {
  CalendarCheck,
  Clock3,
  HeartHandshake,
  MessageSquareText,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { MentorshipSessionCard } from "../../components/cards/MentorshipSessionCard";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import {
  useMentors,
  useMentorshipSessions,
  useMentorshipWorkspace,
} from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";

export default function MyMentorshipPage() {
  const { t, label, locale } = useLocale();
  const mentors = useMentors();
  const sessions = useMentorshipSessions();
  const workspace = useMentorshipWorkspace();
  if (mentors.isPending || sessions.isPending || workspace.isPending)
    return <LoadingState />;
  if (mentors.isError || sessions.isError || workspace.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void mentors.refetch();
          void sessions.refetch();
          workspace.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  const plannedSessions = (sessions.data || []).filter((session) =>
    workspace.registrations.some((item) => item.sessionId === session.id),
  );
  async function cancelRequest(id: string) {
    try {
      await workspace.cancelRequest(id);
      toast.success(label("cancelled"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("requestFailed"));
    }
  }
  async function leaveSession(id: string) {
    try {
      await workspace.cancelSession(id);
      toast.success(label("sessionLeft"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("sessionActionFailed"));
    }
  }
  const statusLabel = (
    status: "pending" | "accepted" | "declined" | "cancelled",
  ) => label(status);
  return (
    <div className="container personal-mentorship mentorship-v6">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("myMentorshipEyebrow")}
        title={label("myMentorshipTitle")}
        description={label("myMentorshipBody")}
      />
      <section>
        <div className="personal-section-heading">
          <div>
            <span className="eyebrow">
              <HeartHandshake size={14} /> {label("mentorshipRequests")}
            </span>
            <h2>{label("mentors")}</h2>
          </div>
        </div>
        {workspace.requests.length ? (
          <div className="mentorship-request-list">
            {workspace.requests.map((request) => {
              const mentor = mentors.data?.find(
                (item) => item.id === request.mentorId,
              );
              return (
                <article key={request.id} data-status={request.status}>
                  <span className="request-status-mark">
                    <i />
                    {statusLabel(request.status)}
                  </span>
                  <div className="request-main">
                    <div className="request-person">
                      <span>{mentor ? t(mentor.initials) : "—"}</span>
                      <div>
                        <h3>{mentor ? t(mentor.name) : "—"}</h3>
                        <p>{mentor ? t(mentor.specialty) : ""}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <dl>
                      <div>
                        <dt>{label("mentorshipArea")}</dt>
                        <dd>{request.area}</dd>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <dt>{label("requestedOn")}</dt>
                        <dd>{formatDate(request.requestedAt, locale)}</dd>
                      </div>
                      {request.scheduledAt && (
                        <div>
                          <dt>{label("scheduledFor")}</dt>
                          <dd>
                            {formatDate(request.scheduledAt, locale, {
                              day: "numeric",
                              month: "short",
                              hour: "2-digit",
                              minute: "2-digit",
                            })}
                          </dd>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </dl>
                    <blockquote>
                      <MessageSquareText size={16} />
                      {request.response ? t(request.response) : request.note}
                    </blockquote>
                  </div>
                  {request.status === "pending" && (
                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      disabled={workspace.isMutating}
                      onClick={() => void cancelRequest(request.id)}
                    >
                      <X size={16} />
                      {label("cancelRequest")}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </article>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <EmptyState
            title={label("noMentorshipRequests")}
            description={label("noMentorshipRequestsBody")}
            href="/mentorship"
          />
        )}
      </section>
      <section className="personal-group-plans">
        <div className="personal-section-heading">
          <div>
            <span className="eyebrow">
              <CalendarCheck size={14} /> {label("groupSessions")}
            </span>
            <h2>{label("scheduledFor")}</h2>
          </div>
        </div>
        {plannedSessions.length ? (
          <div className="mentor-session-list">
            {plannedSessions.map((session) => (
              <MentorshipSessionCard
                key={session.id}
                session={session}
                mentor={mentors.data?.find(
                  (item) => item.id === session.mentorId,
                )}
                joined
                busy={workspace.isMutating}
                onToggle={() => void leaveSession(session.id)}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <EmptyState
            title={label("noGroupPlans")}
            description={label("noGroupPlansBody")}
            href="/mentorship/sessions"
          />
        )}
      </section>
      <p className="v6-boundary-note">
        <Clock3 size={16} /> {label("mentorshipBoundaries")}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/notifications/NotificationsPage.tsx
============================================================
import { useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  Bell,
  BookOpen,
  Clock3,
  Sparkles,
  ArrowUpRight,
  CheckCheck,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { useOverlays } from "../../app/providers/OverlayProvider";
import { useResources } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useNotifications } from "./useNotifications";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import type { StudentNotification } from "../../types/workspace";
export default function NotificationsPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale(),
    { state, send } = useWorkspace();
  const notifications = useNotifications(),
    resources = useResources();
  const { openDetail } = useOverlays(),
    navigate = useNavigate();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<"all" | "unread" | "read">("all");
  if (notifications.isError || resources.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          notifications.retry();
          void resources.refetch();
        }}
      />
    );
  if (notifications.isPending || resources.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  const items = notifications.items.filter(
    (n) =>
      filter === "all" ||
      (filter === "read") === state.readNotificationIds.includes(n.id),
  );
  const firstUnreadId = items.find(
    (item) => !state.readNotificationIds.includes(item.id),
  )?.id;
  const view = (n: StudentNotification) => {
    void send({ type: "read-notifications", ids: [n.id], read: true });
    const resource = resources.data?.find((r) => r.id === n.resourceId);
    if (resource) openDetail({ kind: "resource", item: resource });
    else if (n.href) navigate(n.href);
  };
  return (
    <div className="container notifications-v3">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("notificationEyebrow")}
        title={label("notificationTitle")}
        description={label("notificationBody")}
      />
      <div className="notifications-toolbar">
        <div className="segmented-pills">
          {(["all", "unread", "read"] as const).map((key) => (
            <button
              key={key}
              aria-label={
                label(key === "all" ? "allNotifications" : key) +
                (key === "unread" ? " " + notifications.unread : "")
              }
              aria-pressed={filter === key}
              onClick={() => setFilter(key)}
            >
              {label(key === "all" ? "allNotifications" : key)}
              {key === "unread" && <b>{notifications.unread}</b>}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          disabled={!notifications.unread}
          onClick={() =>
            void send({
              type: "read-notifications",
              ids: notifications.items.map((n) => n.id),
              read: true,
            })
          }
        >
          <CheckCheck size={17} />
          {label("markAllRead")}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div className="notification-stream">
        {items.map((n) => {
          const read = state.readNotificationIds.includes(n.id);
          const Icon =
            n.kind === "course"
              ? BookOpen
              : n.kind === "reminder"
                ? Clock3
                : Sparkles;
          return (
            <article
              className="notification-entry"
              data-read={read}
              data-motion-state={read ? "settled" : "unread"}
              data-primary-unread={!read && n.id === firstUnreadId ? "true" : undefined}
              key={n.id}
            >
              <span className="notification-icon">
                <Icon size={22} />
              </span>
              <div className="notification-copy">
                <span className="notification-date">
                  {formatDate(n.createdAt, locale, {
                    day: "numeric",
                    month: "short",
                    hour: "2-digit",
                    minute: "2-digit",
                  })}
                  {!read && (
                    <span className="unread-dot" aria-label={label("unread")} />
                  )}
                </span>
                <h2>{t(n.title)}</h2>
                <p>{t(n.body)}</p>
                <div className="notification-actions">
                  {(n.href || n.resourceId) && (
                    <button className="text-link" onClick={() => view(n)}>
                      {label("notificationAction")}
                      <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={16} />
                    </button>
                  )}
                  <button
                    className="quiet-button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      void send({
                        type: "read-notifications",
                        ids: [n.id],
                        read: !read,
                      })
                    }
                  >
                    {label(read ? "markUnread" : "markRead")}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </article>
          );
        })}
        {!items.length && (
          <div className="notifications-empty">
            <Bell size={40} />
            <h2>{label("noNotifications")}</h2>
            <p>{label("noNotificationsBody")}</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <p className="workspace-note">{label("notificationNote")}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

# Notifications — V0.3

Implemented at /my/notifications: course updates, derived saved-plan reminders, all/read/unread filters, bulk mark-read, resource/page actions and header unread counts.

The mock registry provides notifications.list; the workspace service persists readNotificationIds. The demo reminder horizon is fourteen days from the configured demo date. These are in-app records, not push, email or operating-system notifications.
