import { HeroArtwork } from "../../components/data-display/HeroArtwork";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Bookmark,
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  Clock3,
  Search,
  Sparkles,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { OpportunityExplorerCard } from "../../components/cards/OpportunityExplorerCard";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { useOpportunities } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { daysFromDemo, opportunityIsOpen } from "../../lib/discovery";

type View = "open" | "soon" | "saved" | "all";
export default function OpportunitiesPage() {
  const { t, label } = useLocale();
  const query = useOpportunities();
  const workspace = useWorkspace();
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>("open");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("");
  const [field, setField] = useState("");
  const [location, setLocation] = useState("");
  const [year, setYear] = useState("");
  const opportunities = query.data || [];
  const fields = [...new Set(opportunities.map((item) => t(item.field)))];
  const locations = [...new Set(opportunities.map((item) => t(item.location)))];
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    return opportunities.filter((item) => {
      const open = opportunityIsOpen(item);
      const days = daysFromDemo(item.deadline);
      const tabMatch =
        view === "all" ||
        (view === "open" && open) ||
        (view === "soon" && open && days <= 14) ||
        (view === "saved" && workspace.state.savedIds.includes(item.id));
      const textMatch =
        !needle ||
        [
          t(item.title),
          t(item.organization),
          t(item.description),
          t(item.field),
        ].some((value) => value.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle));
      return (
        tabMatch &&
        textMatch &&
        (!category || item.category === category) &&
        (!field || t(item.field) === field) &&
        (!location || t(item.location) === location) &&
        (!year || item.yearEligibility.includes(Number(year)))
      );
    });
  }, [
    opportunities,
    view,
    search,
    category,
    field,
    location,
    year,
    t,
    workspace.state.savedIds,
  ]);
  if (query.isPending || workspace.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError || workspace.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void query.refetch();
          workspace.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  const tabs = [
    {
      id: "open",
      label: label("open"),
      icon: Sparkles,
      count: opportunities.filter(opportunityIsOpen).length,
    },
    {
      id: "soon",
      label: label("deadlineSoon"),
      icon: Clock3,
      count: opportunities.filter(
        (item) => opportunityIsOpen(item) && daysFromDemo(item.deadline) <= 14,
      ).length,
    },
    {
      id: "saved",
      label: label("savedOnly"),
      icon: Bookmark,
      count: opportunities.filter((item) =>
        workspace.state.savedIds.includes(item.id),
      ).length,
    },
    {
      id: "all",
      label: label("allContent"),
      icon: BriefcaseBusiness,
      count: opportunities.length,
    },
  ] as const;
  return (
    <div className="discovery-page opportunity-hub container">
      <section className="discovery-hero opportunity-discovery-hero artwork-scene">
        <div className="discovery-hero-copy">
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("opportunitiesHubEyebrow")}</span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {label("opportunitiesHubTitle")}
          </h1>
          <p>{label("opportunitiesHubBody")}</p>
        </div>
        <HeroArtwork section="involved" />
      </section>
      <section
        className="discovery-controls"
        aria-label={label("opportunityFilters")}
      >
        <AliveTabs
          label={label("opportunityFilters")}
          items={[...tabs]}
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
        />
        <div className="discovery-filter-row opportunity-filter-row">
          <label className="discovery-search">
            <Search size={18} />
            <input
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={label("opportunitySearch")}
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{label("category")}</span>
            <select
              value={category}
              onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="">{label("allCategories")}</option>
              {[
                "research",
                "training",
                "conference",
                "exchange",
                "volunteering",
              ].map((value) => (
                <option value={value} key={value}>
                  {label(value as "research")}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{label("field")}</span>
            <select value={field} onChange={(e) => setField(e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">{label("allFields")}</option>
              {fields.map((value) => (
                <option value={value} key={value}>
                  {value}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{label("location")}</span>
            <select
              value={location}
              onChange={(e) => setLocation(e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="">{label("allLocations")}</option>
              {locations.map((value) => (
                <option value={value} key={value}>
                  {value}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>
            <span>{label("eligibilityYear")}</span>
            <select value={year} onChange={(e) => setYear(e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">{label("allYears")}</option>
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((value) => (
                <option value={value} key={value}>
                  {label("year")} {value}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
      </section>
      <div className="results-line">
        <strong>{filtered.length}</strong> {label("results")}
      </div>
      {filtered.length ? (
        <div className="opportunity-explorer-grid">
          {filtered.map((item) => (
            <OpportunityExplorerCard opportunity={item} key={item.id} />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

  CalendarClock,
  MapPin,
  ShieldCheck,
  Sparkles,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { SaveButton } from "../../components/cards/SaveButton";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { Notice } from "../../components/feedback/Notice";
import { useOpportunity } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { daysFromDemo, opportunityIsOpen } from "../../lib/discovery";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";

export default function OpportunityPage() {
  const { slug } = useParams();
  const query = useOpportunity(slug);
  const { t, label, locale } = useLocale();
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  const opportunity = query.data;
  if (!opportunity) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  const open = opportunityIsOpen(opportunity);
  const days = daysFromDemo(opportunity.deadline);
  return (

          <strong>
            {open ? `${days} ${label("daysLeft")}` : label("deadlinePassed")}

FILE: src/features/profile/ProfilePage.tsx
============================================================
import { SignOutGlyph } from "../../components/navigation/SignOutGlyph";
import { useServices } from "../../app/providers/ServicesProvider";
import { useUndoNotice } from "../../components/feedback/useUndoNotice";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import {
  ArrowUpRight,
  BookOpen,
  CheckCircle2,
  GraduationCap,
  PencilLine,
  ShieldCheck,
  UserRound,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useStudentProfile } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import type { AuthProfileInput } from "../../types/auth";
import { routes } from "../../constants/routes";

export default function ProfilePage() {
  const profile = useStudentProfile();
  const auth = useAuth();
  const undoNotice = useUndoNotice();
  const services = useServices();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<AuthProfileInput | null>(null);

  if (profile.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (profile.isError)
    return <ErrorState retry={() => void profile.refetch()} />;
  const student = profile.data;
  const beginEditing = () => {
    setForm({
      fullName: t(student.name),
      year: student.year,
      batch: t(student.batch),
      focusMinutes: student.focusMinutes,
      bio: t(student.bio),
    });
    setEditing(true);
  };
  const update = <Key extends keyof AuthProfileInput>(
    key: Key,
    value: AuthProfileInput[Key],
  ) => setForm((current) => (current ? { ...current, [key]: value } : current));
  const submit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!form?.fullName.trim() || !form.batch.trim() || !form.bio.trim())
      return;
    try {
      const before: AuthProfileInput = {
        fullName: t(student.name),
        year: student.year,
        batch: t(student.batch),
        focusMinutes: student.focusMinutes,
        bio: t(student.bio),
      };
      const beforeProfile = structuredClone(student);
      const after = { ...form };
      const updated = await auth.updateProfile(after);
      undoNotice(label("profileSaved"), async () => {
        const current = (await services.auth.getSnapshot()).user?.profile;
        // The auth service enforces the signed-in account; do not undo another edit.
        if (
          current &&
          updated.user?.profile &&
          JSON.stringify(current) !== JSON.stringify(updated.user.profile)
        )
          throw new Error("PROFILE_CHANGED");
        if (services.auth.restoreProfile && updated.user?.profile) {
          await services.auth.restoreProfile(
            beforeProfile,
            updated.user.profile,
          );
          await auth.refresh();
        } else await auth.updateProfile(before);
      });
      setEditing(false);
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("profileSaveFailed"));
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="container">
      <PageIntro
        title={label("myProfile")}
        description={label("profileIntro")}
        eyebrow={label("ownCorner")}
      />
      <div className="profile-grid profile-grid-v08">
        <section className="profile-identity">
          <span className="personal-avatar">{t(student.initials)}</span>
          <h2>{t(student.name)}</h2>
          <span className="profile-sample profile-verified">
            <CheckCircle2 />
            {label("verifiedAccount")}
          </span>
          <p>{t(student.bio)}</p>
          <div className="profile-primary-actions">
            <Button
              type="button"
              className="button button-primary"
              onClick={beginEditing}
            >
              <PencilLine />
              {label("editProfile")}
            </Button>
            <AppLink href="/my/learning" className="text-link">
              {label("openMyLearning")}
              <ArrowUpRight size={17} className="directional" />
            </AppLink>
          </div>
        </section>
        <section className="profile-details">
          <h2>{label("academicProfile")}</h2>
          <dl>
            <div>
              <dt>
                <GraduationCap size={20} />
                {label("program")}
              </dt>
              <dd>{t(student.program)}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>
                <BookOpen size={20} />
                {label("studyYear")}
              </dt>
              <dd>
                {label("year")} {student.year}
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>
                <UserRound size={20} />
                {label("batch")}
              </dt>
              <dd>{t(student.batch)}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>
                <ShieldCheck size={20} />
                {label("accountEmail")}
              </dt>
              <dd>{auth.snapshot.user?.email}</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
        </section>
      </div>

      {editing && form && (
        <section className="profile-editor-card">
          <div>
            <p className="eyebrow">{label("makeItYours")}</p>
            <h2>{label("editProfile")}</h2>
          </div>
          <form className="profile-edit-form" onSubmit={submit}>
            <label>
              <span>{label("fullName")}</span>
              <input
                value={form.fullName}
                onChange={(event) => update("fullName", event.target.value)}
              />
            </label>
            <label>
              <span>{label("batchName")}</span>
              <input
                value={form.batch}
                onChange={(event) => update("batch", event.target.value)}
              />
            </label>
            <label>
              <span>{label("studyYear")}</span>
              <select
                value={form.year}
                onChange={(event) => update("year", Number(event.target.value))}
              >
                {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((year) => (
                  <option key={year} value={year}>
                    {label("year")} {year}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <label>
              <span>{label("focusLength")}</span>
              <select
                value={form.focusMinutes}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  update("focusMinutes", Number(event.target.value))
                }
              >
                {[20, 25, 30, 40, 50].map((minutes) => (
                  <option key={minutes} value={minutes}>
                    {minutes} {label("minutesValue")}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <label className="profile-bio-field">
              <span>{label("bio")}</span>
              <textarea
                rows={4}
                value={form.bio}
                onChange={(event) => update("bio", event.target.value)}
              />
            </label>
            <div className="profile-editor-actions">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                onClick={() => setEditing(false)}
              >
                {label("cancelEditing")}
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                disabled={auth.isPending}
                className="button button-primary"
              >
                {label("saveProfile")}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </section>
      )}

      <section className="profile-security-card">
        <span>
          <ShieldCheck />
        </span>
        <div>
          <h2>{label("accountSecurityTitle")}</h2>
          <p>{label("accountSecurityBody")}</p>
        </div>
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="outline"
          className="sign-out-action"
          disabled={auth.isPending}
          onClick={async () => {
            await auth.signOut();
            navigate(routes.signIn, { replace: true });
          }}
        >
          <SignOutGlyph />
          {label("signOut")}
        </Button>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useMemo, useState, type CSSProperties } from "react";
import {
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  CalendarClock,
  ClipboardCheck,
  Clock3,
  FilePenLine,
  History,
  RotateCcw,
  ShieldCheck,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { RecruitmentPipeline } from "../../components/data-display/RecruitmentPipeline";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { routes, positionPath } from "../../constants/routes";
import {
  useRecruitmentPositions,
  useRecruitmentWorkspace,
} from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import {
  activeApplication,
  applicationStatusKey,
  teamKey,
} from "../../lib/recruitment";
import type { RecruitmentApplication } from "../../types/recruitment";
import { RecruitmentApplicationDialog } from "./RecruitmentApplicationDialog";

type ApplicationView = "all" | "active" | "onboarding" | "past";

export default function MyApplicationsPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const positions = useRecruitmentPositions();
  const workspace = useRecruitmentWorkspace();
  const [view, setView] = useState<ApplicationView>("all");
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<RecruitmentApplication | null>(null);
  const [withdrawing, setWithdrawing] = useState<RecruitmentApplication | null>(
    null,
  );
  const rows = useMemo(
    () =>
      workspace.applications.filter((application) => {
        if (view === "active") return activeApplication(application.status);
        if (view === "onboarding")
          return ["accepted", "onboarding", "completed"].includes(
            application.status,
          );
        if (view === "past")
          return ["rejected", "withdrawn", "completed"].includes(
            application.status,
          );
        return true;
      }),
    [view, workspace.applications],
  );
  if (positions.isPending || workspace.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (positions.isError || workspace.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void positions.refetch();
          workspace.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  const count = (target: ApplicationView) =>
    workspace.applications.filter((application) => {
      if (target === "active") return activeApplication(application.status);
      if (target === "onboarding")
        return ["accepted", "onboarding", "completed"].includes(
          application.status,
        );
      if (target === "past")
        return ["rejected", "withdrawn", "completed"].includes(
          application.status,
        );
      return true;
    }).length;
  const tabs = [
    {
      id: "all",
      label: label("allApplications"),
      icon: BriefcaseBusiness,
      count: count("all"),
    },
    {
      id: "active",
      label: label("activeApplications"),
      icon: Clock3,
      count: count("active"),
    },
    {
      id: "onboarding",
      label: label("onboardingApplications"),
      icon: ClipboardCheck,
      count: count("onboarding"),
    },
    {
      id: "past",
      label: label("pastApplications"),
      icon: History,
      count: count("past"),
    },
  ] as const;
  async function withdraw() {
    if (!withdrawing) return;
    try {
      await workspace.withdraw(withdrawing.id);
      setWithdrawing(null);
      toast.success(label("applicationWithdrawnToast"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("applicationFailed"));
    }
  }
  async function toggleTask(applicationId: string, taskId: string) {
    try {
      await workspace.toggleOnboardingTask({ applicationId, taskId });
      toast.success(label("onboardingTaskUpdated"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("applicationFailed"));
    }
  }
  const editingPosition = editing
    ? positions.data?.find((position) => position.id === editing.positionId)
    : undefined;
  return (
    <div className="container recruitment-v9 my-applications-page">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("myApplicationsEyebrow")}
        title={label("myApplicationsTitle")}
        description={label("myApplicationsBody")}
      />
      <div className="application-toolbar">
        <AliveTabs
          label={label("currentStage")}
          items={[...tabs]}
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
        />
        <AppLink href={routes.recruitment} className="button button-secondary">
          {label("browseRecruitment")}
        </AppLink>
      </div>
      {rows.length ? (
        <div className="application-list">
          {rows.map((application) => {
            const position = positions.data?.find(
              (item) => item.id === application.positionId,
            );
            if (!position) return null;
            const completedTasks = application.onboarding.filter(
              (task) => task.completed,
            ).length;
            return (
              <article
                key={application.id}
                className="application-record"
                data-status={application.status}
              >
                <header>
                  <div>
                    <span className="position-team">
                      {label(teamKey(position.team))}
                    </span>
                    <h2>{t(position.title)}</h2>
                  </div>
                  <span className="application-status">
                    <i aria-hidden="true" />
                    {label(applicationStatusKey(application.status))}
                  </span>
                </header>
                <RecruitmentPipeline status={application.status} compact />
                <dl className="application-facts">
                  <div>
                    <dt>{label("currentStage")}</dt>
                    <dd>{label(applicationStatusKey(application.status))}</dd>
                  </div>
                  {application.submittedAt && (
                    <div>
                      <dt>{label("submittedOn")}</dt>
                      <dd>{formatDate(application.submittedAt, locale)}</dd>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <div>
                    <dt>{label("updatedOn")}</dt>
                    <dd>{formatDate(application.updatedAt, locale)}</dd>
                  </div>
                </dl>
                {application.interviewAt &&
                  ["interview", "accepted", "onboarding", "completed"].includes(
                    application.status,
                  ) && (
                    <aside className="application-interview">
                      <CalendarClock size={18} />
                      <div>
                        <strong>{label("interviewDetails")}</strong>
                        <span>
                          {formatDate(application.interviewAt, locale, {
                            day: "numeric",
                            month: "short",
                            hour: "2-digit",
                            minute: "2-digit",
                          })}
                          {application.interviewLocation
                            ? ` · ${t(application.interviewLocation)}`
                            : ""}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </aside>
                  )}
                {application.reviewerNote && (
                  <blockquote className="application-reviewer-note">
                    <strong>{label("reviewerUpdate")}</strong>
                    <p>{t(application.reviewerNote)}</p>
                  </blockquote>
                )}
                {application.status === "onboarding" &&
                  application.onboarding.length > 0 && (
                    <section className="application-onboarding">
                      <header>
                        <div>
                          <span>{label("onboardingChecklist")}</span>
                          <strong>
                            {completedTasks} / {application.onboarding.length}{" "}
                            {label("onboardingProgress")}
                          </strong>
                        </div>
                        <span
                          className="onboarding-progress-ring"
                          style={
                            {
                              "--progress": `${Math.round((completedTasks / application.onboarding.length) * 100)}%`,
                            } as CSSProperties
                          }
                          aria-hidden="true"
                        />
                      </header>
                      <div className="onboarding-task-list">
                        {application.onboarding.map((task) => (
                          <label key={task.id}>
                            <input
                              type="checkbox"
                              checked={task.completed}
                              disabled={workspace.isMutating}
                              onChange={() =>
                                void toggleTask(application.id, task.id)
                              }
                            />
                            <span>
                              <strong>{t(task.title)}</strong>
                              <small>{t(task.description)}</small>
                            </span>
                          </label>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                      <p>
                        <ShieldCheck size={16} />
                        {label("onboardingBoundary")}
                      </p>
                    </section>
                  )}
                <details className="application-history">
                  <summary>
                    <History size={16} /> {label("applicationTimeline")}
                  </summary>
                  <ol>
                    {application.history
                      .slice()
                      .reverse()
                      .map((entry) => (
                        <li key={entry.id}>
                          <i />
                          <div>
                            <strong>
                              {label(applicationStatusKey(entry.status))}
                            </strong>
                            <span>
                              {t(entry.note)} · {formatDate(entry.at, locale)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                  </ol>
                </details>
                <footer>
                  <AppLink href={positionPath(position.slug)}>
                    {label("viewPosition")}
                  </AppLink>
                  {application.status === "draft" && (
                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={() => setEditing(application)}
                    >
                      <FilePenLine size={16} />
                      {label("continueApplication")}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  {["draft", "submitted"].includes(application.status) && (
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      onClick={() => setWithdrawing(application)}
                    >
                      <X size={16} /> {label("withdrawApplication")}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </footer>
              </article>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          title={label("noApplications")}
          description={label("noApplicationsBody")}
          href={routes.recruitment}
          actionLabel={label("browseRecruitment")}
        />
      )}
      <p className="v9-preview-note">{label("recruitmentPreviewNotice")}</p>
      {editingPosition && editing && (
        <RecruitmentApplicationDialog
          open
          position={editingPosition}
          application={editing}
          busy={workspace.isMutating}
          onClose={() => setEditing(null)}
          onSave={workspace.saveDraft}
          onSubmit={workspace.submit}
        />
      )}
      <Modal
        open={!!withdrawing}
        onClose={() => setWithdrawing(null)}
        title={label("withdrawApplicationTitle")}
        description={label("withdrawApplicationBody")}
      >
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setWithdrawing(null)}>
            {label("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="destructive"
            disabled={workspace.isMutating}
            onClick={() => void withdraw()}
          >
            <RotateCcw size={16} /> {label("withdrawApplication")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/recruitment/README.md
============================================================
# Recruitment feature

V0.9 implements public role discovery, position detail, explicit draft/submission, personal tracking, interviews, onboarding, team membership and volunteer hours.

Data flow:

`pages → useContent hooks → MedClubServices.recruitment → local preview adapter`

The feature also contributes public position records to global search, interview entries to the calendar and application updates to notifications.

Important: `ClubMembershipProfile` is organizational data only. It must never be used as an authorization source. Production permissions belong to a separately enforced capability system.

FILE: src/features/recruitment/RecruitmentApplicationDialog.tsx
============================================================
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Send, Save } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import type {
  RecruitmentApplication,
  RecruitmentApplicationInput,
  RecruitmentPosition,
} from "../../types/recruitment";

const blank = (positionId: string): RecruitmentApplicationInput => ({
  positionId,
  motivation: "",
  experience: "",
  availability: "",
  consentConfirmed: false,
});

export function RecruitmentApplicationDialog({
  open,
  position,
  application,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onSave,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  position: RecruitmentPosition;
  application?: RecruitmentApplication;
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSave: (
    input: RecruitmentApplicationInput,
  ) => Promise<RecruitmentApplication>;
  onSubmit: (id: string) => Promise<RecruitmentApplication>;
}) {
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const [form, setForm] = useState<RecruitmentApplicationInput>(
    blank(position.id),
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    setForm(
      application
        ? {
            id: application.id,
            positionId: application.positionId,
            motivation: application.motivation,
            experience: application.experience,
            availability: application.availability,
            consentConfirmed: application.consentConfirmed,
          }
        : blank(position.id),
    );
  }, [application, open, position.id]);
  const set = <K extends keyof RecruitmentApplicationInput>(
    key: K,
    value: RecruitmentApplicationInput[K],
  ) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
  const errorLabel = (error: unknown) =>
    error instanceof Error && error.message === "recruitment-duplicate"
      ? label("duplicateApplication")
      : label("applicationFailed");
  async function saveDraft() {
    try {
      await onSave(form);
      toast.success(label("applicationSaved"));
      onClose();
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(errorLabel(error));
    }
  }
  async function submit() {
    if (
      form.motivation.trim().length < 40 ||
      !form.experience.trim() ||
      !form.availability.trim() ||
      !form.consentConfirmed
    ) {
      toast.error(label("applicationIncomplete"));
      return;
    }
    try {
      const saved = await onSave(form);
      await onSubmit(saved.id);
      toast.success(label("applicationSubmitted"));
      onClose();
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(errorLabel(error));
    }
  }
  return (
    <Modal
      open={open}
      onClose={onClose}
      title={label("applicationEditorTitle")}
      description={label("applicationEditorBody")}
      className="recruitment-application-modal"
    >
      <form
        className="recruitment-application-form"
        onSubmit={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
      >
        <div className="application-position-chip">
          <span>{label("position")}</span>
          <strong>{t(position.title)}</strong>
        </div>
        <label htmlFor="recruitment-motivation">
          <span>{label("motivation")}</span>
          <textarea
            id="recruitment-motivation"
            aria-label={label("motivation")}
            rows={5}
            value={form.motivation}
            onChange={(event) => set("motivation", event.target.value)}
            placeholder={label("motivationHint")}
            autoFocus
          />
          <small>{form.motivation.trim().length} / 40+</small>
        </label>
        <label htmlFor="recruitment-experience">
          <span>{label("relevantExperience")}</span>
          <textarea
            id="recruitment-experience"
            aria-label={label("relevantExperience")}
            rows={4}
            value={form.experience}
            onChange={(event) => set("experience", event.target.value)}
            placeholder={label("experienceHint")}
          />
        </label>
        <label htmlFor="recruitment-availability">
          <span>{label("weeklyAvailability")}</span>
          <input
            id="recruitment-availability"
            aria-label={label("weeklyAvailability")}
            value={form.availability}
            onChange={(event) => set("availability", event.target.value)}
            placeholder={label("availabilityHint")}
          />
        </label>
        <label className="recruitment-consent" htmlFor="recruitment-consent">
          <input
            id="recruitment-consent"
            aria-label={label("applicationConsent")}
            type="checkbox"
            checked={form.consentConfirmed}
            onChange={(event) => set("consentConfirmed", event.target.checked)}
          />
          <span>
            <strong>{label("applicationConsent")}</strong>
            <small>{label("applicationConsentBody")}</small>
          </span>
        </label>
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onClose}>
            {label("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => void saveDraft()}
          >
            <Save size={16} /> {label("saveApplicationDraft")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            className="button button-primary"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() => void submit()}
          >
            <Send size={16} /> {label("saveAndSubmit")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { HeroArtwork } from "../../components/data-display/HeroArtwork";
import { useMemo, useState, type CSSProperties } from "react";
import {
  Activity,
  Aperture,
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  CalendarRange,
  Code2,
  Microscope,
  Network,
  ShieldCheck,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { RecruitmentPositionCard } from "../../components/cards/RecruitmentPositionCard";
import { RecruitmentPipeline } from "../../components/data-display/RecruitmentPipeline";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { SearchInput } from "../../components/forms/SearchInput";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { RecruitmentNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/RecruitmentNavigation";
import { useRecruitmentPositions } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { teamKey } from "../../lib/recruitment";
import type { RecruitmentTeam } from "../../types/recruitment";

type TeamView = "all" | RecruitmentTeam;
const teamIcons = {
  scientific: Microscope,
  technical: Code2,
  media: Aperture,
  activities: CalendarRange,
  operations: Network,
};

export default function RecruitmentPage() {
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const positions = useRecruitmentPositions();
  const [team, setTeam] = useState<TeamView>("all");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [includeClosed, setIncludeClosed] = useState(false);
  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    return (positions.data || []).filter((position) => {
      const haystack = [
        t(position.title),
        t(position.summary),
        t(position.description),
        ...position.skills.map(t),
      ]
        .join(" ")
        .toLocaleLowerCase();
      return (
        (team === "all" || position.team === team) &&
        (includeClosed || position.status !== "closed") &&
        (!needle || haystack.includes(needle))
      );
    });
  }, [includeClosed, positions.data, query, t, team]);
  if (positions.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (positions.isError)
    return <ErrorState retry={() => void positions.refetch()} />;
  const teams: RecruitmentTeam[] = [
    "scientific",
    "technical",
    "media",
    "activities",
    "operations",
  ];
  const tabs = [
    {
      id: "all" as const,
      label: label("allTeams"),
      icon: BriefcaseBusiness,
      count: (positions.data || []).filter(
        (position) => includeClosed || position.status !== "closed",
      ).length,
    },
    ...teams.map((item) => ({
      id: item,
      label: label(teamKey(item)),
      icon: teamIcons[item],
      count: (positions.data || []).filter(
        (position) =>
          position.team === item &&
          (includeClosed || position.status !== "closed"),
      ).length,
    })),
  ];
  return (
    <div className="recruitment-v9 recruitment-page">
      <div className="container">
        <RecruitmentNavigation />
        <section className="recruitment-hero artwork-scene">
          <div className="recruitment-hero-copy">
            <span className="eyebrow">{label("recruitmentEyebrow")}</span>
            <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
              {label("recruitmentTitle")}
            </h1>
            <p>{label("recruitmentBody")}</p>
            <div className="recruitment-hero-facts">
              <span>
                <BriefcaseBusiness size={17} />
                <strong>
                  {
                    (positions.data || []).filter(
                      (position) => position.status !== "closed",
                    ).length
                  }
                </strong>
                {label("openPositions")}
              </span>
              <span>
                <ShieldCheck size={17} />
                {label("membershipNotPermission")}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <HeroArtwork section="team" />
        </section>

        <section className="recruitment-openings" id="open-positions">
          <div className="recruitment-section-heading">
            <div>
              <span className="eyebrow">{label("recruitmentPulse")}</span>
              <h2>{label("openPositions")}</h2>
            </div>
            <label className="include-closed-control">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={includeClosed}
                onChange={(event) => setIncludeClosed(event.target.checked)}
              />
              <span>{label("includeClosed")}</span>
            </label>
          </div>
          <div className="recruitment-filter-panel">
            <SearchInput
              value={query}
              onChange={setQuery}
              label={label("findPosition")}
            />
            <AliveTabs
              label={label("recruitmentFilters")}
              items={tabs}
              value={team}
              onChange={setTeam}
            />
          </div>
          {rows.length ? (
            <div className="recruitment-position-grid">
              {rows.map((position) => (
                <RecruitmentPositionCard
                  key={position.id}
                  position={position}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <EmptyState
              title={label("noRecruitmentPositions")}
              description={label("noRecruitmentPositionsBody")}
            />
          )}
        </section>

        <section className="recruitment-path-section">
          <div>
            <span className="eyebrow">{label("recruitmentPathTitle")}</span>
            <h2>{label("recruitmentPathTitle")}</h2>
            <p>{label("recruitmentPathBody")}</p>
          </div>
          <RecruitmentPipeline />
        </section>
        <aside className="recruitment-boundary">
          <ShieldCheck size={20} />
          <div>
            <strong>{label("membershipNotPermission")}</strong>
            <p>{label("membershipNotPermissionBody")}</p>
          </div>
        </aside>
        <p className="v9-preview-note">{label("recruitmentPreviewNotice")}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  CalendarClock,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock3,
  GraduationCap,
  Layers3,
  Sparkles,
  UsersRound,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { RecruitmentPipeline } from "../../components/data-display/RecruitmentPipeline";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { Notice } from "../../components/feedback/Notice";
import { RecruitmentNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/RecruitmentNavigation";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { routes, signInPath } from "../../constants/routes";
import {
  useRecruitmentPosition,
  useRecruitmentWorkspace,
} from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import {
  activeApplication,
  applicationStatusKey,
  positionStatusKey,
  teamKey,
} from "../../lib/recruitment";
import { RecruitmentApplicationDialog } from "./RecruitmentApplicationDialog";

export default function RecruitmentPositionPage() {
  const { slug } = useParams();
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const auth = useAuth();
  const position = useRecruitmentPosition(slug);
  const workspace = useRecruitmentWorkspace();
  const [editorOpen, setEditorOpen] = useState(false);
  if (position.isPending || workspace.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (position.isError || workspace.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void position.refetch();
          workspace.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  if (!position.data)
    return (
      <div className="container not-found">
        <h1>{label("notFound")}</h1>
        <AppLink href={routes.recruitment}>
          {label("backToRecruitment")}
        </AppLink>
      </div>
    );
  const role = position.data;
  const existing = workspace.applications.find(
    (item) =>
      item.positionId === role.id &&
      item.status !== "withdrawn" &&
      item.status !== "rejected",
  );
  const signedIn = auth.snapshot.status === "authenticated";
  const action = () => {
    if (role.status === "closed")
      return (
        <div className="position-closed-message">
          <strong>{label("roleClosed")}</strong>
          <p>{label("roleClosedBody")}</p>
        </div>
      );
    if (!signedIn)
      return (
        <AppLink
          href={signInPath(`/recruitment/${encodeURIComponent(role.slug)}`)}
          className="button button-primary"
        >
          {label("signInToApply")}
        </AppLink>
      );
    if (existing && activeApplication(existing.status)) {
      if (existing.status === "draft")
        return (
          <Button
            className="button button-primary"
            onClick={() => setEditorOpen(true)}
          >
            {label("continueApplication")}
          </Button>
        );
      return (
        <AppLink href={routes.myApplications} className="button button-primary">
          {label("trackApplication")}
        </AppLink>
      );
    }
    return (
      <Button
        className="button button-primary"
        onClick={() => setEditorOpen(true)}
      >
        {label("applyForPosition")}
      </Button>
    );
  };
  return (
    <div className="recruitment-v9 position-detail-page">
      <div className="container">
        <RecruitmentNavigation />
        <AppLink href={routes.recruitment} className="position-back-link">
          <ArrowLeft size={17} className="directional" />
          {label("backToRecruitment")}
        </AppLink>
        <header className="position-detail-hero" data-accent={role.accent}>
          <div>
            <span className="position-team">
              <Layers3 size={15} /> {label(teamKey(role.team))}
            </span>
            <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
              {t(role.title)}
            </h1>
            <p>{t(role.description)}</p>
            <div className="position-detail-skills">
              {role.skills.map((skill) => (
                <span key={skill.en}>{t(skill)}</span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <aside className="position-action-panel">
            <span className="position-status">
              {label(positionStatusKey(role.status))}
            </span>
            {existing && activeApplication(existing.status) && (
              <div className="existing-application-state">
                <span>{label("currentStage")}</span>
                <strong>{label(applicationStatusKey(existing.status))}</strong>
              </div>
            )}
            <dl>
              <div>
                <dt>
                  <Clock3 size={16} /> {label("timeCommitment")}
                </dt>
                <dd>
                  {role.commitmentHoursPerWeek} {label("hoursPerWeek")}
                </dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt>
                  <UsersRound size={16} /> {label("openings")}
                </dt>
                <dd>{role.openings}</dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt>
                  <CalendarClock size={16} /> {label("applicationWindow")}
                </dt>
                <dd>{formatDate(role.closesAt, locale)}</dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt>
                  <GraduationCap size={16} /> {label("eligibleYears")}
                </dt>
                <dd>{role.yearEligibility.join(" · ")}</dd>
              </div>
            </dl>
            {action()}
          </aside>
        </header>

        <div className="position-detail-grid">
          <section>
            <span className="eyebrow">
              <CheckCircle2 size={14} /> {label("responsibilities")}
            </span>
            <h2>{label("responsibilities")}</h2>
            <ul>
              {role.responsibilities.map((item) => (
                <li key={item.en}>{t(item)}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </section>
          <section>
            <span className="eyebrow">
              <Sparkles size={14} /> {label("roleRequirements")}
            </span>
            <h2>{label("roleRequirements")}</h2>
            <ul>
              {role.requirements.map((item) => (
                <li key={item.en}>{t(item)}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </section>
        </div>
        <section className="position-pipeline-panel">
          <div>
            <span className="eyebrow">{label("recruitmentPathTitle")}</span>
            <h2>{label("recruitmentPathTitle")}</h2>
            <p>{label("recruitmentPathBody")}</p>
          </div>
          <RecruitmentPipeline status={existing?.status} />
        </section>
        <Notice>{label("recruitmentPrivacy")}</Notice>
        <p className="v9-preview-note">{label("recruitmentPreviewNotice")}</p>
      </div>
      {signedIn && role.status !== "closed" && (
        <RecruitmentApplicationDialog
          open={editorOpen}
          position={role}
          application={existing?.status === "draft" ? existing : undefined}
          busy={workspace.isMutating}
          onClose={() => setEditorOpen(false)}
          onSave={workspace.saveDraft}
          onSubmit={workspace.submit}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import {
  BadgeCheck,
  Clock3,
  ContactRound,
  Hourglass,
  Layers3,
  ShieldCheck,
  TimerReset,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { routes } from "../../constants/routes";
import {
  useRecruitmentWorkspace,
  useStudentProfile,
} from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import { teamKey } from "../../lib/recruitment";

export default function TeamProfilePage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const workspace = useRecruitmentWorkspace();
  const student = useStudentProfile();
  if (workspace.isPending || student.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (workspace.isError || student.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          workspace.retry();
          void student.refetch();
        }}
      />
    );
  const member = workspace.membership;
  if (!member)
    return (
      <div className="container recruitment-v9 team-profile-page">
        <PageIntro
          eyebrow={label("memberProfileEyebrow")}
          title={label("memberProfileTitle")}
          description={label("memberProfileBody")}
        />
        <EmptyState
          title={label("noMemberProfile")}
          description={label("noMemberProfileBody")}
          href={routes.recruitment}
          actionLabel={label("browseRecruitment")}
        />
      </div>
    );
  const verifiedRecent = member.recentHours
    .filter((item) => item.status === "verified")
    .reduce((total, item) => total + item.hours, 0);
  const pendingRecent = member.recentHours
    .filter((item) => item.status === "pending")
    .reduce((total, item) => total + item.hours, 0);
  return (
    <div className="container recruitment-v9 team-profile-page">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("memberProfileEyebrow")}
        title={label("memberProfileTitle")}
        description={label("memberProfileBody")}
      />
      <section className="member-identity-card">
        <div className="member-orbit" aria-hidden="true">
          <i />
          <i />
          <ContactRound size={42} />
        </div>
        <div className="member-identity-copy">
          <span className="active-member-badge">
            <BadgeCheck size={16} /> {label("activeMember")}
          </span>
          <h2>{student.data ? t(student.data.name) : "—"}</h2>
          <p>
            <Layers3 size={17} /> {label(teamKey(member.team))}
          </p>
          <div className="member-position-list">
            {member.positions.map((position) => (
              <span key={position.en}>{t(position)}</span>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <dl className="member-identity-facts">
          <div>
            <dt>{label("memberSince")}</dt>
            <dd>{formatDate(member.joinedAt, locale)}</dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt>{label("volunteerHours")}</dt>
            <dd>{member.volunteerHours}</dd>
          </div>
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section className="hours-overview">
        <article className="hours-total-card">
          <span>
            <Clock3 size={19} /> {label("volunteerHours")}
          </span>
          <strong>{member.volunteerHours}</strong>
          <p>{label("verifiedHours")}</p>
          <div className="hours-pulse" aria-hidden="true">
            <i />
            <i />
            <i />
          </div>
        </article>
        <article>
          <span>
            <BadgeCheck size={18} /> {label("verifiedHours")}
          </span>
          <strong>{verifiedRecent}</strong>
          <p>{label("recentHourRecords")}</p>
        </article>
        <article>
          <span>
            <Hourglass size={18} /> {label("pendingHours")}
          </span>
          <strong>{pendingRecent}</strong>
          <p>{label("hourRecordStatus")}</p>
        </article>
      </section>

      <section className="hour-record-section">
        <div className="recruitment-section-heading">
          <div>
            <span className="eyebrow">
              <TimerReset size={14} /> {label("volunteerHours")}
            </span>
            <h2>{label("recentHourRecords")}</h2>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="hour-record-list">
          {member.recentHours.map((record) => (
            <article key={record.id} data-status={record.status}>
              <span className="hour-value">{record.hours}</span>
              <div>
                <h3>{t(record.activity)}</h3>
                <p>{formatDate(record.date, locale)}</p>
              </div>
              <span className="hour-status">
                {record.status === "verified"
                  ? label("verifiedHours")
                  : label("pendingHours")}
              </span>
              {record.verifiedBy && (
                <small>
                  {label("verifiedBy")} · {t(record.verifiedBy)}
                </small>
              )}
            </article>

FILE: src/features/resources/ResourceCollection.tsx
============================================================
import type { Course, Resource } from "../../types/content";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import {
  Tabs,
  TabsList,
  TabsTrigger,
  TabsContent,
} from "../../components/ui/tabs";
import { ResourceCard } from "../../components/cards/ResourceCard";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
const filters = ["all", "slides", "notes", "summary", "questions"] as const;
export function ResourceCollection({
  resources,
  courses,
  limit,
}: {
  resources: Resource[];
  courses: Course[];
  limit?: number;
}) {
  const { label, dir } = useLocale();
  return (
    <Tabs defaultValue="all" dir={dir}>
      <TabsList className="filter-tabs" aria-label={label("resources")}>
        {filters.map((kind) => (
          <TabsTrigger key={kind} value={kind}>
            {label(kind === "all" ? "allResources" : kind)}
          </TabsTrigger>
        ))}
      </TabsList>
      {filters.map((kind) => {
        const records = resources
          .filter((r) => kind === "all" || r.kind === kind)
          .slice(0, limit);
        return (
          <TabsContent key={kind} value={kind}>
            <div className="resource-grid">
              {records.map((resource) => (
                <ResourceCard
                  key={resource.id}
                  resource={resource}
                  course={courses.find((c) => c.id === resource.courseId)}
                />
              ))}
              {records.length === 0 && <EmptyState />}
            </div>
          </TabsContent>
        );
      })}
    </Tabs>
  );
}

export function ResourceDetails({ item }: { item: Resource }) {
  const { data } = useCourses();
  const { state, send, isPending } = useWorkspace();
  const { t, label, locale } = useLocale();
  const course = data?.find((c) => c.id === item.courseId);

        items={[

          {

            value: label(
              item.audience === "shared" ? "sharedResource" : "batchResource",
            ),

          { label: label("contributor"), value: t(item.contributor) },

FILE: src/features/search/SearchDialog.tsx
============================================================
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useOverlays } from "../../app/providers/OverlayProvider";
import { useWorkspacePaths } from "../../hooks/useWorkspacePaths";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { SearchGlyph } from "../../components/navigation/SearchGlyph";
import { SearchPanel } from "./SearchPanel";
import { useLayoutEffect, useState, type CSSProperties } from "react";
import { searchPlacement } from "./search-placement";
export function SearchDialog() {
  const { label, dir } = useLocale();
  const paths = useWorkspacePaths();
  const { searchOpen, closeSearch, searchTrigger } = useOverlays();
  const measure = () => {
    const viewport = window.visualViewport;
    const trigger = searchTrigger?.isConnected ? searchTrigger : null;
    const glyph = trigger?.querySelector("svg")?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const rect = glyph?.width ? glyph : trigger?.getBoundingClientRect();
    return searchPlacement(
      rect?.width ? rect : null,
      {
        width: viewport?.width ?? window.innerWidth,
        height: viewport?.height ?? window.innerHeight,
        left: viewport?.offsetLeft,
        top: viewport?.offsetTop,
      },
      dir === "rtl",
    );
  };
  const [placement, setPlacement] = useState(measure);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!searchOpen) return;
    const sync = () => setPlacement(measure());
    sync();
    window.addEventListener("resize", sync);
    window.visualViewport?.addEventListener("resize", sync);
    window.visualViewport?.addEventListener("scroll", sync);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("resize", sync);
      window.visualViewport?.removeEventListener("resize", sync);
      window.visualViewport?.removeEventListener("scroll", sync);
    };
  }, [searchOpen, searchTrigger, dir]);
  const style = {
    left: placement.left,
    right: "auto",
    top: placement.top,
    bottom: "auto",
    width: placement.width,
    height: placement.height,
    maxHeight: placement.height,
    "--search-bar-left": `${placement.barLeft}px`,
    "--search-bar-top": `${placement.barTop}px`,
    "--search-bar-width": `${placement.barWidth}px`,
    "--search-icon-left": `${placement.iconLeft}px`,
    "--search-icon-top": `${placement.iconTop}px`,
    "--search-results-top": `${placement.resultsTop}px`,
    "--search-results-height": `${placement.resultsHeight}px`,
  } as CSSProperties;
  return (
    <Modal
      open={searchOpen}
      onClose={closeSearch}
      title={label(paths.personal ? "personalSearch" : "searchLabel")}
      description={label("searchMetadataNote")}
      className={`search-modal search-anchored search-tethered ${placement.extendsLeft ? "search-opens-left" : "search-opens-right"} ${placement.above ? "search-results-above" : "search-results-below"}`}
      style={style}
      initialFocus="[cmdk-input]"
      hideHeading
      hideClose
    >
      <div
        className="search-transparent-dismiss"
        aria-hidden="true"
        onClick={closeSearch}
      />
      <div className="search-anchor-glyph" aria-hidden="true">
        <SearchGlyph />
      </div>
      <SearchPanel compact anchored />
    </Modal>
  );
}

import { useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import {
  ArrowUpRight,
  BookOpen,
  FileText,
  CalendarDays,
  Compass,
  Newspaper,
  LoaderCircle,
  History,
  HeartHandshake,
  UsersRound,
  ShoppingBag,
  BriefcaseBusiness,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useOverlays } from "../../app/providers/OverlayProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { useWorkspacePaths } from "../../hooks/useWorkspacePaths";
import { useDebouncedValue } from "../../hooks/useDebouncedValue";
import { useCourses } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useSearch } from "./useSearch";
import { SelectField } from "../../components/forms/SelectField";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import {
  Command,
  CommandInput,
  CommandList,
  CommandEmpty,
  CommandGroup,
  CommandItem,
} from "../../components/ui/command";
import type { SearchFilters, SearchResult } from "../../types/content";
const kinds = [
  "course",
  "resource",
  "event",
  "opportunity",
  "article",
  "mentor",
  "mentorship-session",
  "product",
  "position",
] as const;
const formats = [
  "guidance",
  "slides",
  "notes",
  "summary",
  "recording",
  "book",
  "questions",
  "external",
] as const;
const icons = {
  course: BookOpen,
  resource: FileText,
  event: CalendarDays,
  opportunity: Compass,
  article: Newspaper,
  mentor: HeartHandshake,
  "mentorship-session": UsersRound,
  product: ShoppingBag,
  position: BriefcaseBusiness,
};
// Buttons, links and selects retain their own Enter/arrow behavior inside CMDK.
// Escape still reaches the native dialog; input/list navigation is unchanged.
function keepControlKeys(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) {
  if (event.key !== "Escape") event.stopPropagation();
}
export function SearchPanel({
  compact = false,
  anchored = false,
  initialQuery = "",
}: {
  compact?: boolean;
  anchored?: boolean;
  initialQuery?: string;
}) {
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate(),
    paths = useWorkspacePaths();
  const { closeSearch, openDetail } = useOverlays();
  const { state, send } = useWorkspace();
  const courses = useCourses();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(initialQuery);
  const [scope, setScope] = useState<"all" | "my">(
    paths.personal ? "my" : "all",
  );
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<SearchFilters>({});
  const value = useDebouncedValue(query);
  const result = useSearch(value, scope, filters);
  const pending = !result.isError && (result.isPending || value !== query);
  const updateFilter = (field: keyof SearchFilters, value: string) =>
    setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, [field]: value || undefined }));
  const choose = (item: SearchResult) => {
    if (query.trim()) void send({ type: "remember-search", query });
    if (item.record.kind === "course") {
      closeSearch();
      navigate(paths.course(item.record.item.slug));
    } else if (item.record.kind === "mentor") {
      closeSearch();
      navigate(
        `/mentorship?mentor=${encodeURIComponent(item.record.item.slug)}`,
      );
    } else if (item.record.kind === "mentorship-session") {
      closeSearch();
      navigate("/mentorship/sessions");
    } else if (item.record.kind === "product") {
      closeSearch();
      navigate(`/store/products/${encodeURIComponent(item.record.item.slug)}`);
    } else if (item.record.kind === "position") {
      closeSearch();
      navigate(`/recruitment/${encodeURIComponent(item.record.item.slug)}`);
    } else openDetail(item.record);
  };
  const results = result.data || [];
  const suggestions = state.recentSearches.length
    ? state.recentSearches
    : ["physiology", "cardio", "research"];
  return (
    <div
      className={compact ? "search-panel search-panel-compact" : "search-panel"}
    >
      <Command shouldFilter={false} label={label("search")} loop>
        <CommandInput
          value={query}
          onValueChange={setQuery}
          placeholder={label(anchored ? "search" : "searchPlaceholder")}
          aria-label={label("search")}
        />
        <div
          className={
            anchored ? "search-results-surface" : "search-results-content"
          }
        >
          {anchored && (
            <div className="search-results-heading" onKeyDown={keepControlKeys}>
              <strong>
                {label(paths.personal ? "personalSearch" : "searchLabel")}
              </strong>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="search-dismiss"
                onClick={closeSearch}
                aria-label={label("close")}
              >
                <X size={18} />
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="search-controls" onKeyDown={keepControlKeys}>
            <SelectField
              label={label("searchScope")}
              value={scope}
              onChange={(e) => setScope(e.target.value as "all" | "my")}
            >
              <option value="all">{label("everywhereScope")}</option>
              <option value="my">{label("myLearningScope")}</option>
            </SelectField>
            <SelectField
              label={label("searchType")}
              value={filters.type || ""}
              onChange={(e) => updateFilter("type", e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="">{label("allContent")}</option>
              {kinds.map((k) => (
                <option key={k} value={k}>
                  {label(k === "mentorship-session" ? "mentorshipSession" : k)}
                </option>
              ))}
            </SelectField>
            {!compact && (
              <>
                <SelectField
                  label={label("searchTrack")}
                  value={filters.track || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => updateFilter("track", e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="">{label("allTracks")}</option>
                  <option value="basic">{label("basic")}</option>
                  <option value="clinical">{label("clinical")}</option>
                </SelectField>
                <SelectField
                  label={label("searchResourceKind")}
                  value={filters.resourceKind || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => updateFilter("resourceKind", e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="">{label("allFormats")}</option>
                  {formats.map((k) => (
                    <option key={k} value={k}>
                      {label(k)}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </SelectField>
                <SelectField
                  label={label("course")}
                  value={filters.courseId || ""}
                  onChange={(e) => updateFilter("courseId", e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="">{label("allCourses")}</option>
                  {courses.data?.map((c) => (
                    <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                      {t(c.title)}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </SelectField>
              </>
            )}
            <button
              className="quiet-button"
              onClick={() => {
                setFilters({});
                setQuery("");
              }}
            >
              {label("clearFilters")}
            </button>
          </div>
          {!query && (
            <div className="search-recents" onKeyDown={keepControlKeys}>
              <span>
                <History size={14} />
                {label(
                  state.recentSearches.length
                    ? "recentSearches"
                    : "suggestedSearches",
                )}
              </span>
              <div>
                {suggestions.map((q) => (
                  <button key={q} onClick={() => setQuery(q)}>
                    {q}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              {!!state.recentSearches.length && (
                <button
                  className="quiet-button"
                  onClick={() => void send({ type: "clear-searches" })}
                >
                  {label("clearHistory")}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          <p className="search-count" role="status" aria-live="polite">
            {pending
              ? label("loading")
              : result.isError
                ? label("searchFailed")
                : `${results.length} ${label("resultsFound")}`}
          </p>
          <CommandList
            aria-label={label("searchResults")}
            className="workspace-search-results"
          >
            {pending ? (
              <div className="search-loading">
                <LoaderCircle className="animate-spin" />
              </div>
            ) : result.isError ? (
              <div className="search-loading" role="alert">
                <p>{label("searchFailed")}</p>
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={result.retry}>
                  {label("retry")}
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <CommandEmpty>
                  <strong>{label("nothingFound")}</strong>
                  <p>{label("searchReset")}</p>
                </CommandEmpty>
                {kinds.map((kind) => {
                  const rows = results.filter((r) => r.record.kind === kind);
                  const Icon = icons[kind];
                  return (
                    rows.length > 0 && (
                      <CommandGroup
                        key={kind}
                        heading={label(
                          kind === "mentorship-session"
                            ? "mentorshipSession"
                            : kind,
                        )}
                      >
                        {rows.map((row) => (
                          <CommandItem
                            key={row.id}
                            value={row.id}
                            onSelect={() => choose(row)}
                          >
                            <span className="search-kind-icon">
                              <Icon size={19} />
                            </span>
                            <div className="search-result-copy">
                              <strong>{t(row.title)}</strong>
                              <small>{t(row.subtitle)}</small>
                              {query && (
                                <span className="search-reason">
                                  {label(
                                    row.matchReason === "title"
                                      ? "matchTitle"
                                      : row.matchReason === "course"
                                        ? "matchCourse"
                                        : "matchKeyword",
                                  )}
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <ArrowUpRight size={17} className="directional" />
                          </CommandItem>
                        ))}
                      </CommandGroup>
                    )
                  );
                })}
              </>
            )}
          </CommandList>
          <div className="search-footer" onKeyDown={keepControlKeys}>
            <span>{label("searchHelp")}</span>
            {compact && (
              <AppLink
                href={`${paths.personal ? "/my/search" : "/search"}?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`}
                onClick={closeSearch}
              >
                {label("seeAllResults")} <ArrowUpRight size={14} />
              </AppLink>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </Command>
      {!compact && (
        <p className="workspace-note">{label("searchMetadataNote")}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
