import { throwToTrash } from "../../components/feedback/action-flight";
import { useState, useRef } from "react";
import { Minus, PackageCheck, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { StoreNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/StoreNavigation";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { useStoreProducts, useStoreWorkspace } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { cartSubtotal, formatStorePrice } from "../../lib/store";
import { ProductVisual } from "./ProductVisual";

export default function CartPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const products = useStoreProducts();
  const store = useStoreWorkspace();
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const removing = useRef(new Set<string>());
  if (products.isPending || store.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (products.isError || store.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void products.refetch();
          store.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  const rows = store.cart.lines.flatMap((line) => {
    const product = products.data?.find((item) => item.id === line.productId);
    const variant = product?.variants.find(
      (item) => item.id === line.variantId,
    );
    return product && variant ? [{ line, product, variant }] : [];
  });
  const subtotal = cartSubtotal(store.cart, products.data || []);
  async function change(
    productId: string,
    variantId: string,
    quantity: number,
  ) {
    try {
      await store.setQuantity({ productId, variantId, quantity });
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("maxStockReached"));
    }
  }
  async function remove(productId: string, variantId: string) {
    const key = `${productId}:${variantId}`;
    if (removing.current.has(key)) return;
    removing.current.add(key);
    try {
      const source =
        [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-cart-line]")].find(
          (row) => row.dataset.cartLine === `${productId}:${variantId}`,
        ) || null;
      const name = rows.find(
        (row) => row.product.id === productId && row.variant.id === variantId,
      )?.product.name;
      const flight = throwToTrash(source, name ? t(name) : label("removeItem"));
      if (flight.animated) await flight.finished;
      await store.remove({ productId, variantId });
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("cartError"));
    } finally {
      removing.current.delete(key);
    }
  }
  async function reserve() {
    try {
      await store.reserve();
      setConfirming(false);
      toast.success(label("reservationCreated"));
      navigate("/my/orders");
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("reserveFailed"));
    }
  }
  return (
    <div className="container store-v7 cart-page">
      <StoreNavigation />
      <header className="cart-header">
        <span className="eyebrow">{label("reservationSummary")}</span>
        <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
          {label("cartTitle")}
        </h1>
        <p>{label("cartBody")}</p>
      </header>
      {rows.length ? (
        <div className="cart-layout">
          <section className="cart-lines" aria-label={label("cart")}>
            {rows.map(({ line, product, variant }) => (
              <article
                key={`${line.productId}:${line.variantId}`}
                data-cart-line={`${line.productId}:${line.variantId}`}
              >
                <ProductVisual visual={product.visual} />
                <div className="cart-line-copy">
                  <span>{label(product.category)}</span>
                  <h2>{t(product.name)}</h2>
                  <p>{t(variant.label)}</p>
                  <strong>{formatStorePrice(product.priceFils, locale)}</strong>
                </div>
                <div className="cart-line-actions">
                  <div
                    className="quantity-stepper"
                    aria-label={label("quantity")}
                  >
                    <button
                      aria-label={label("decreaseQuantity")}
                      onClick={() =>
                        void change(product.id, variant.id, line.quantity - 1)
                      }
                    >
                      <Minus size={16} />
                    </button>
                    <output>{line.quantity}</output>
                    <button
                      aria-label={label("increaseQuantity")}
                      disabled={line.quantity >= variant.stock}
                      onClick={() =>
                        void change(product.id, variant.id, line.quantity + 1)
                      }
                    >
                      <Plus size={16} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    className="cart-remove"
                    aria-label={`${label("removeItem")} ${t(product.name)}`}
                    onClick={() => void remove(product.id, variant.id)}
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={17} /> {label("removeItem")}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </article>
            ))}
          </section>
          <aside className="cart-summary">
            <span className="summary-icon">
              <PackageCheck />
            </span>
            <h2>{label("reservationSummary")}</h2>
            <dl>
              <div>
                <dt>{label("products")}</dt>
                <dd>{rows.length}</dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt>{label("subtotal")}</dt>
                <dd>{formatStorePrice(subtotal, locale)}</dd>
              </div>
            </dl>
            <Button
              className="button button-primary"
              onClick={() => setConfirming(true)}
            >
              {label("reserveForPickup")}
            </Button>
            <p>{label("noPaymentNow")}</p>
          </aside>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          title={label("cartEmpty")}
          description={label("cartEmptyBody")}
          href="/store"
          actionLabel={label("continueShopping")}
        />
      )}
      <p className="store-boundary-note">{label("storePreviewNotice")}</p>
      <Modal
        open={confirming}
        onClose={() => setConfirming(false)}
        title={label("reserveTitle")}
        description={label("reserveBody")}
      >
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setConfirming(false)}>
            {label("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            className="button button-primary"
            disabled={store.isMutating}
            onClick={() => void reserve()}
          >
            {label("confirmReservation")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock3,
  PackageCheck,
  ShoppingBag,
  XCircle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PageIntro } from "../../components/data-display/PageIntro";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { StoreNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/StoreNavigation";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { useStoreWorkspace } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import { formatStorePrice } from "../../lib/store";
import type { StoreOrder } from "../../types/content";

const progress = ["reserved", "confirmed", "ready", "collected"] as const;
export default function MyOrdersPage() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const store = useStoreWorkspace();
  const [cancelling, setCancelling] = useState<StoreOrder | null>(null);
  if (store.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (store.isError) return <ErrorState retry={store.retry} />;
  async function cancel() {
    if (!cancelling) return;
    try {
      await store.cancelOrder(cancelling.id);
      setCancelling(null);
      toast.success(label("orderCancelled"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("orderActionFailed"));
    }
  }
  return (
    <div className="container store-v7 my-orders-page">
      <PageIntro
        eyebrow={label("myOrdersEyebrow")}
        title={label("myOrdersTitle")}
        description={label("myOrdersBody")}
      />
      <StoreNavigation />
      {store.orders.length ? (
        <div className="order-list">
          {store.orders.map((order) => {
            const current = progress.indexOf(
              order.status as (typeof progress)[number],
            );
            return (
              <article
                className="order-card"
                key={order.id}
                data-status={order.status}
              >
                <header>
                  <span className="order-mark">
                    {order.status === "cancelled" ? (
                      <XCircle />
                    ) : order.status === "ready" ? (
                      <PackageCheck />
                    ) : (
                      <Clock3 />
                    )}
                  </span>
                  <div>
                    <small>{label("orderNumber")}</small>
                    <h2>{order.number}</h2>
                  </div>
                  <span className="order-status">{label(order.status)}</span>
                </header>
                <div className="order-lines">
                  {order.lines.map((line) => (
                    <div key={`${line.productId}:${line.variantId}`}>
                      <span>
                        <ShoppingBag size={17} />
                      </span>
                      <p>
                        <strong>{t(line.name)}</strong>
                        <small>
                          {t(line.variantLabel)} · {line.quantity}
                        </small>
                      </p>
                      <b>
                        {formatStorePrice(
                          line.unitPriceFils * line.quantity,
                          locale,
                        )}
                      </b>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                {order.status !== "cancelled" && (
                  <section
                    className="order-progress"
                    aria-label={label("orderTimeline")}
                  >
                    {progress.map((status, index) => (
                      <div
                        key={status}
                        data-complete={index <= current || undefined}
                        data-current={status === order.status || undefined}
                      >
                        <span>
                          {index < current ? <CheckCircle2 /> : index + 1}
                        </span>
                        <small>{label(status)}</small>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </section>
                )}
                <dl className="order-facts">
                  <div>
                    <dt>{label("orderedOn")}</dt>
                    <dd>{formatDate(order.reservedAt, locale)}</dd>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <dt>{label("pickupLocation")}</dt>
                    <dd>{t(order.pickupLocation)}</dd>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <dt>{label("orderTotal")}</dt>
                    <dd>{formatStorePrice(order.totalFils, locale)}</dd>
                  </div>
                  {order.reservationExpiresAt && (
                    <div>
                      <dt>{label("reservationExpires")}</dt>
                      <dd>{formatDate(order.reservationExpiresAt, locale)}</dd>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </dl>
                {order.status === "reserved" && (
                  <footer>
                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={() => setCancelling(order)}
                    >
                      {label("cancelOrder")}
                    </Button>
                  </footer>
                )}
              </article>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState
          title={label("noOrders")}
          description={label("noOrdersBody")}
        />
      )}
      <p className="store-boundary-note">{label("storePreviewNotice")}</p>
      <Modal
        open={!!cancelling}
        onClose={() => setCancelling(null)}
        title={label("cancelOrderTitle")}
        description={label("cancelOrderBody")}
      >
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setCancelling(null)}>
            {label("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="destructive"
            disabled={store.isMutating}
            onClick={() => void cancel()}
          >
            {label("cancelOrder")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/store/ProductPage.tsx

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, Boxes, Minus, Plus, ShoppingCart } from "lucide-react";
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { StoreNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/StoreNavigation";
import { ActionLink } from "../../components/ui/ActionLink";
import { Button } from "../../components/ui/button";
import { useStoreProduct, useStoreWorkspace } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { formatStorePrice, productStock } from "../../lib/store";
import { ProductVisual } from "./ProductVisual";

export default function ProductPage() {
  const { slug } = useParams();
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale();
  const query = useStoreProduct(slug);
  const store = useStoreWorkspace();
  const [variantId, setVariantId] = useState("");
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1);
  useEffect(() => {
    const first = query.data?.variants.find((variant) => variant.stock > 0);
    const selected = query.data?.variants.find(
      (variant) => variant.id === variantId && variant.stock > 0,
    );
    if (first && !selected) {
      setVariantId(first.id);
      setQuantity(1);
    }
  }, [query.data, variantId]);
  const variant = useMemo(
    () => query.data?.variants.find((item) => item.id === variantId),
    [query.data, variantId],
  );
  if (query.isPending || store.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError || store.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void query.refetch();
          store.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  const product = query.data;
  if (!product)
    return (
      <div className="container not-found">
        <h1>{label("notFound")}</h1>
        <ActionLink href="/store">{label("backToStore")}</ActionLink>
      </div>
    );
  const stock = productStock(product);
  async function add() {
    if (!variant || quantity > variant.stock) return;
    try {
      await store.add({
        productId: product!.id,
        variantId: variant.id,
        quantity,
      });
      toast.success(label("addedToCart"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(label("cartError"));
    }
  }
  return (
    <div className="container store-v7 product-page">
      <StoreNavigation />
      <div className="store-back-link">
        <ActionLink href="/store">
          <ArrowLeft size={17} className="directional" /> {label("backToStore")}
        </ActionLink>
      </div>
      <div className="product-detail-layout" data-accent={product.accent}>
        <div className="product-detail-visual">
          <ProductVisual visual={product.visual} />
          <span>{label(product.category)}</span>
        </div>
        <section className="product-detail-copy">
          {product.featured && (
            <span className="product-featured">{label("featured")}</span>
          )}
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {t(product.name)}
          </h1>
          <p className="product-lead">{t(product.description)}</p>
          <div className="product-price-row">
            <strong>{formatStorePrice(product.priceFils, locale)}</strong>
            {product.compareAtFils && (
              <s>{formatStorePrice(product.compareAtFils, locale)}</s>
            )}
          </div>
          <div
            className="product-stock product-stock-large"
            data-stock={
              stock === 0 ? "soldOut" : stock <= 5 ? "lowStock" : "inStock"
            }
          >
            <Boxes size={18} />
            {label(
              stock === 0 ? "soldOut" : stock <= 5 ? "lowStock" : "inStock",
            )}
          </div>
          <fieldset className="variant-picker">
            <legend>{label("chooseVariant")}</legend>
            <div>
              {product.variants.map((option) => (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  key={option.id}
                  className={variantId === option.id ? "active" : ""}
                  aria-pressed={variantId === option.id}
                  disabled={option.stock === 0}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setVariantId(option.id);
                    setQuantity(1);
                  }}
                >
                  <strong>{t(option.label)}</strong>
                  <small>
                    {option.stock
                      ? `${option.stock} ${label("leftInStock")}`
                      : label("soldOut")}
                  </small>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </fieldset>
          <div className="product-purchase-row">
            <div className="quantity-stepper" aria-label={label("quantity")}>
              <button
                aria-label={label("decreaseQuantity")}
                disabled={quantity <= 1}
                onClick={() => setQuantity((value) => value - 1)}
              >
                <Minus size={17} />
              </button>
              <output>{quantity}</output>
              <button
                aria-label={label("increaseQuantity")}
                disabled={!variant || quantity >= variant.stock}
                onClick={() => setQuantity((value) => value + 1)}
              >
                <Plus size={17} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <Button
              className="button button-primary"
              disabled={!variant || !variant.stock || store.isMutating}
              onClick={() => void add()}
            >
              <ShoppingCart size={18} /> {label("addToCart")}
            </Button>
          </div>
          <section className="product-materials">
            <h2>{label("materials")}</h2>
            <ul>
              {product.materials.map((item) => (
                <li key={item.en}>{t(item)}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </section>
        </section>
      </div>
      <p className="store-boundary-note">{label("storePreviewNotice")}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/store/README.md
============================================================
# Store feature — V0.7

## Screens

- `StorePage.tsx`: catalog, category tabs, query/material matching and stock filtering.
- `ProductPage.tsx`: product details, variants, quantity and add-to-cart behavior.
- `CartPage.tsx`: cart editing and explicit collection-reservation confirmation.
- `MyOrdersPage.tsx`: personal order state, progress, collection details and cancellation.
- `ProductVisual.tsx`: reusable icon-led visual language that does not pretend mock photography is real merchandise.

## Data flow

Screens use `useStoreProducts`, `useStoreProduct` and `useStoreWorkspace`. Those hooks call the injected `MedClubServices.store` contract. The current implementation delegates to `local-store.service.ts`; a future implementation can call an authenticated API without changing page component responsibilities.

Product/catalog fixtures live in `data/mock/store.ts`, not inside JSX. Money is stored as integer JOD fils and formatted only at the presentation layer. Order lines snapshot display and price data for stable history.

## Production boundary

Local storage is preview state, not a commerce or security system. Production must move identity, prices, stock, reservations, expiry, cancellation, checkout, fulfillment, refunds, reports, permissions, audit history and notifications to server-owned services.

V0.7 collects no payment details. The reservation action only demonstrates the approved UX boundary while payment, delivery and refund operations remain undecided.

FILE: src/features/store/StorePage.tsx
============================================================
import { HeroArtwork } from "../../components/data-display/HeroArtwork";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Boxes,
  PackageSearch,
  Search,
  ShoppingBag,
  Sparkles,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { ProductCard } from "../../components/cards/ProductCard";
import { EmptyState } from "../../components/feedback/EmptyState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { AliveTabs } from "../../components/navigation/AliveTabs";
import { StoreNavigation } from "../../components/navigation/StoreNavigation";
import { useStoreProducts, useStoreWorkspace } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { productStock } from "../../lib/store";
import type { ProductCategory } from "../../types/content";

type View = "all" | ProductCategory;
export default function StorePage() {
  const { label, t } = useLocale();
  const products = useStoreProducts();
  const store = useStoreWorkspace();
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [inStockOnly, setInStockOnly] = useState(false);
  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    return (products.data || []).filter((product) => {
      const haystack = [
        t(product.name),
        t(product.shortDescription),
        t(product.description),
        ...product.materials.map(t),
      ]
        .join(" ")
        .toLocaleLowerCase();
      return (
        (view === "all" || product.category === view) &&
        (!inStockOnly || productStock(product) > 0) &&
        (!needle || haystack.includes(needle))
      );
    });
  }, [inStockOnly, products.data, search, t, view]);
  if (products.isPending || store.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (products.isError || store.isError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void products.refetch();
          store.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  const counts = (category?: ProductCategory) =>
    (products.data || []).filter(
      (product) => !category || product.category === category,
    ).length;
  const tabs = [
    {
      id: "all",
      label: label("allProducts"),
      icon: ShoppingBag,
      count: counts(),
    },
    {
      id: "apparel",
      label: label("apparel"),
      icon: Sparkles,
      count: counts("apparel"),
    },
    {
      id: "stationery",
      label: label("stationery"),
      icon: PackageSearch,
      count: counts("stationery"),
    },
    {
      id: "accessories",
      label: label("accessories"),
      icon: Boxes,
      count: counts("accessories"),
    },
    {
      id: "drinkware",
      label: label("drinkware"),
      icon: ShoppingBag,
      count: counts("drinkware"),
    },
  ] as const;
  return (
    <div className="container store-v7 store-page">
      <StoreNavigation />
      <section className="store-hero artwork-scene">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("storeEyebrow")}</span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {label("storeTitle")}
          </h1>
          <p>{label("storeBody")}</p>
        </div>
        <HeroArtwork section="store" />
      </section>
      <section className="store-controls" aria-label={label("productFilters")}>
        <AliveTabs
          label={label("productFilters")}
          items={[...tabs]}
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
        />
        <div className="store-filter-row">
          <label className="store-search">
            <Search size={18} />
            <input
              value={search}
              onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
              placeholder={label("storeSearch")}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="stock-toggle">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={inStockOnly}
              onChange={(event) => setInStockOnly(event.target.checked)}
            />
            <span aria-hidden="true">
              <i />
            </span>
            {label("inStockOnly")}
          </label>
        </div>
      </section>
      <p className="store-results" role="status">
        <strong>{rows.length}</strong> {label("products")}
      </p>
      {rows.length ? (
        <div className="product-grid">
          {rows.map((product) => (
            <ProductCard key={product.id} product={product} />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EmptyState />
      )}
      <p className="store-boundary-note">{label("storePreviewNotice")}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { APP_TIMEZONE } from "../../constants/config";
import { calendarDate } from "../../lib/calendar";
import { shortcutChoices } from "./personal-home-model";
import type { PersonalHomeData } from "./usePersonalHome";

export function HomeControls({
  data,
  kind,
  close,
}: {
  data: PersonalHomeData;
  kind: "exam" | "shortcuts";
  close: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const [shortcuts, setShortcuts] = useState(data.preferences.shortcuts);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(data.preferences.exam?.title || "");
  const [course, setCourse] = useState(
    data.preferences.exam?.courseId || data.myCourses[0]?.id || "",
  );
  const date = data.preferences.exam
    ? new Date(data.preferences.exam.startsAt)
    : null;
  const [starts, setStarts] = useState(
    date
      ? `${calendarDate(date.toISOString())}T${new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: APP_TIMEZONE, hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).format(date)}`
      : "",
  );
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  function save(event: React.FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (kind === "shortcuts") {
      if (shortcuts.length !== 3) {
        setError(
          t({ en: "Choose three shortcuts.", ar: "اختر ثلاثة اختصارات." }),
        );
        return;
      }
      data.savePreferences({ ...data.preferences, shortcuts });
      close();
      return;
    }
    const timestamp = Date.parse(`${starts}:00+03:00`);
    if (
      !title.trim() ||
      !data.myCourses.some((c) => c.id === course) ||
      !Number.isFinite(timestamp) ||
      timestamp <= Date.now()
    ) {
      setError(
        t({
          en: "Enter an exam title, your course, and a future date and time.",
          ar: "أدخل اسم الامتحان ومساقك وموعداً مستقبلياً صحيحاً.",
        }),
      );
      return;
    }
    data.savePreferences({
      ...data.preferences,
      exam: {
        title: title.trim().slice(0, 100),
        courseId: course,
        startsAt: new Date(timestamp).toISOString(),
      },
    });
    close();
  }
  return (
    <Modal
      open
      onClose={close}
      title={t(
        kind === "exam"
          ? { en: "Your next exam", ar: "امتحانك القادم" }
          : { en: "Keep three things close", ar: "ثلاثة أشياء بالقرب منك" },
      )}
      description={t(
        kind === "exam"
          ? {
              en: "Save the date you know. Times are shown in Amman.",
              ar: "احفظ الموعد الذي تعرفه. الأوقات بتوقيت عمّان.",
            }
          : {
              en: "Your shortcuts keep the same order until you change them.",
              ar: "تبقى اختصاراتك بالترتيب نفسه حتى تغيّره.",
            },
      )}
      className="personal-home-dialog"
    >
      <form onSubmit={save} className="workspace-form" noValidate>
        {kind === "exam" ? (
          <>
            <label className="workspace-field">
              <span>{t({ en: "Exam title", ar: "اسم الامتحان" })}</span>
              <input
                id="home-exam-title"
                value={title}
                maxLength={100}
                onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                required
              />
            </label>
            <label className="workspace-field">
              <span>{t({ en: "Course", ar: "المساق" })}</span>
              <select
                id="home-exam-course"
                value={course}
                onChange={(e) => setCourse(e.target.value)}
                required
              >
                {!course && (
                  <option value="">
                    {t({ en: "Choose a course", ar: "اختر مساقاً" })}
                  </option>
                )}
                {data.myCourses.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                    {t(c.title)}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <label className="workspace-field">
              <span>
                {t({
                  en: "Date and time · Amman",
                  ar: "التاريخ والوقت · عمّان",
                })}
              </span>
              <input
                id="home-exam-time"
                type="datetime-local"
                dir="ltr"
                value={starts}
                onChange={(e) => setStarts(e.target.value)}
                required
              />
            </label>
            {data.preferences.exam && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="text-link"
                onClick={() => {
                  data.savePreferences({
                    shortcuts: data.preferences.shortcuts,
                  });
                  close();
                }}
              >
                {t({
                  en: "Remove this exam reminder",
                  ar: "إزالة تذكير هذا الامتحان",
                })}
              </button>
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          <fieldset className="home-shortcut-choices">
            <legend>
              {t({ en: "Choose three", ar: "اختر ثلاثة" })} · {shortcuts.length}
              /3
            </legend>
            {shortcutChoices.map((item) => (
              <label key={item.id}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={shortcuts.includes(item.id)}
                  disabled={
                    !shortcuts.includes(item.id) && shortcuts.length === 3
                  }
                  onChange={() =>
                    setShortcuts((current) =>
                      current.includes(item.id)
                        ? current.filter((id) => id !== item.id)
                        : [...current, item.id],
                    )
                  }
                />
                <span>{t(item.label)}</span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </fieldset>
        )}
        {error && (
          <p role="alert" className="auth-form-error">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <p className="home-device-note">
          {t({
            en: "Saved privately for this account on this device.",
            ar: "يُحفظ بشكل خاص لهذا الحساب على هذا الجهاز.",
          })}
        </p>
        <div className="workspace-form-actions">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="button button-secondary"
            onClick={close}
          >
            {t({ en: "Cancel", ar: "إلغاء" })}
          </button>
          <button type="submit" className="button button-primary">
            {t({ en: "Save", ar: "حفظ" })}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

const stages = [
  { en: "Ready for you", ar: "جاهز لك" },
  { en: "In use", ar: "ينبض بالحياة" },
  { en: "Growing", ar: "يتطور" },
  { en: "Established", ar: "مزدهر" },

export default function PersonalCampus({
  levels,
  quiet,
}: {
  levels: CampusLevels;
  quiet: boolean;
}) {
  const { t, dir } = useLocale(),
    { resolvedTheme } = useAppearance();
  const dark = resolvedTheme === "dark",
    source = dark ? quietNight : quietDay,
    active = dark ? night : day;
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState<string | null>(null),
    [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<keyof typeof places>("learning");
  const stage = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null),
    id = useId().replace(/:/g, "");
  const life = useCampusLife(
    stage,
    "ambient",
    loaded === source &&
      !quiet &&
      !failed &&
      Object.values(levels).some((n) => n > 0),
  );
  const activePlace = places[selected];
  return (
    <div
      className="personal-campus"
      data-direction={dir}
      data-campus-lighting={dark ? "night" : "day"}
      ref={stage}
    >
      <div className="personal-campus-window" data-failed={failed || undefined}>
        <div className="personal-campus-art">
          <img
            src={source}
            width={1672}
            height={941}
            alt=""
            decoding="async"
            fetchPriority="low"
            onLoad={() => {
              setLoaded(source);
              setFailed(false);
            }}
            onError={() => setFailed(true)}
          />
          {!failed && (
            <svg
              className="personal-campus-map"
              viewBox="0 0 1672 941"
              role="group"
              aria-label={t({
                en: "Your personal MedClub campus",
                ar: "حرم ميدكلب الخاص بك",
              })}
            >
              <defs>
                <mask
                  id={`${id}-growth`}
                  maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
                  x="0"
                  y="0"
                  width="1672"
                  height="941"
                  style={{ maskType: "luminance" }}
                >
                  <rect width="1672" height="941" fill="black" />
                  {campusDestinations.map((destination) => {
                    const level = levels[destination.id as keyof CampusLevels],
                      [x, y] =
                        places[destination.id as keyof typeof places].center;
                    return (
                      <g
                        key={destination.id}
                        data-campus-level={level}
                        data-campus-building={destination.id}
                        filter={`url(#${id}-soft-mask)`}
                      >
                        {level >= 3 ? (
                          <path
                            d={phoneRestorationRegions[destination.id]}
                            fill="white"
                          />
                        ) : level >= 2 ? (
                          <polygon points={destination.polygon} fill="white" />
                        ) : level >= 1 ? (
                          <ellipse
                            cx={x}
                            cy={y}
                            rx={destination.id === "journals" ? 105 : 98}
                            ry={100}
                            fill="white"
                          />
                        ) : null}
                      </g>
                    );
                  })}
                </mask>
                <filter id={`${id}-soft-mask`}>
                  <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5" />
                </filter>
              </defs>
              <image
                href={active}
                width={1672}
                height={941}
                mask={`url(#${id}-growth)`}
                data-personal-growth-source="fixed"
              />
              <CampusLights
                lit={
                  life.lit && levels[life.lit as keyof CampusLevels]
                    ? life.lit
                    : null
                }
                revealed={life.revealed.filter(
                  (key) => levels[key as keyof CampusLevels] > 0,
                )}
              />
              {campusDestinations.map((destination) => {
                const key = destination.id as keyof typeof places,
                  place = places[key];
                return (
                  <AppLink
                    key={key}
                    href={place.href}
                    className="campus-building"
                    data-personal-campus-link={key}
                    aria-label={t(place.label)}
                    onFocus={() => setSelected(key)}
                    onPointerEnter={() => setSelected(key)}
                  >
                    <polygon
                      className="campus-building-hit"
                      points={destination.polygon}
                      vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke"
                    />
                    <g
                      transform={
                        dir === "rtl"
                          ? `translate(${destination.labelX * 2} 0) scale(-1 1)`
                          : undefined
                      }
                    >
                      <text
                        className="campus-building-label"
                        x={destination.labelX}
                        y={destination.labelY}
                        transform={`rotate(${dir === "rtl" ? -destination.rotation : destination.rotation} ${destination.labelX} ${destination.labelY})`}
                        textAnchor="middle"
                        dominantBaseline="middle"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        {t(place.label)}
                      </text>
                    </g>
                  </AppLink>
                );
              })}
            </svg>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="personal-campus-caption">
        <span
          className="campus-level-dots"
          aria-label={t(stages[levels[selected]])}
        >
          {[1, 2, 3].map((n) => (
            <i key={n} data-earned={levels[selected] >= n || undefined} />
          ))}
        </span>
        <strong>{t(activePlace.label)}</strong>
        <span>{t(stages[levels[selected]])}</span>
        <AppLink href={activePlace.href} aria-label={t(activePlace.label)}>
          <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={18} />
        </AppLink>
      </div>
      <p className="personal-campus-explainer">{t(activePlace.body)}</p>
      <nav
        className="personal-campus-destinations"
        aria-label={t({ en: "Personal campus destinations", ar: "وجهات حرمك" })}
      >
        {Object.entries(places).map(([key, place]) => (
          <AppLink
            key={key}
            href={place.href}
            onFocus={() => setSelected(key as keyof typeof places)}
          >
            {t(place.label)}
          </AppLink>
        ))}
      </nav>
      <details className="personal-campus-guide">
        <summary>
          {t({ en: "How your campus grows", ar: "كيف يتطور حرمك" })}
        </summary>
        <p>
          {t({
            en: "Complete resource reviews, review different recall cards, organize saved materials or take part in approved activities. Six, eighteen and thirty-six completed reviews can also develop the community, mentorship and contribution buildings. Your progress stays when you take a break. Visits and timer minutes do not count.",
            ar: "أكمل مراجعات المصادر وراجع بطاقات مختلفة ونظم المحفوظات أو شارك في أنشطة معتمدة. ست أو ثماني عشرة أو ست وثلاثون مراجعة مكتملة تطور أيضاً مباني المجتمع والإرشاد والمساهمات. يبقى تقدمك عند أخذ استراحة. الزيارات ودقائق المؤقت لا تُحتسب.",
          })}
        </p>
      </details>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/student-dashboard/RevisionKit.tsx

import {
  Bookmark,
  FileText,
  MessageSquareText,
  X,
  ArrowUpRight,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { useLocalCoursePdfs } from "../courses/useLocalCoursePdfs";
import { normalizeStudyTools } from "../courses/study-tools-state";
import { studyStorageKey } from "../courses/study-state";
import { useHubQuery, useStudyHub } from "../study-hub/useStudyHub";
import { resourceResumeHref } from "./personal-home-model";
import type { PersonalHomeData } from "./usePersonalHome";
import { personalCoursePath } from "../../constants/routes";

export function RevisionKit({
  data,
  selected,
  setSelected,
  close,
}: {
  data: PersonalHomeData;
  selected: string;
  setSelected: (id: string) => void;
  close: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    hub = useStudyHub();
  const course = data.myCourses.find((c) => c.id === selected);
  const local = useLocalCoursePdfs(selected);
  const margins = useHubQuery(
    "margins",
    (signal) => hub.service.listMargins(undefined, { signal }),
    "all",
  );
  const resources = [
    ...data.myResources.filter((r) => r.courseId === selected),
    ...local.resources,
  ];
  const saved = data.workspace.state.savedIds;
  const ranking = (kind: string) =>
    ["summary", "questions", "notes", "slides", "book"].indexOf(kind);
  const materials = [...resources]
    .sort(
      (a, b) =>
        Number(saved.includes(b.id)) - Number(saved.includes(a.id)) ||
        (ranking(a.kind) < 0 ? 9 : ranking(a.kind)) -
          (ranking(b.kind) < 0 ? 9 : ranking(b.kind)),
    )
    .slice(0, 6);
  let bookmarks: Record<string, number[]> = {};
  try {
    bookmarks = normalizeStudyTools(
      JSON.parse(
        localStorage.getItem(
          studyStorageKey(data.owner, selected) + ":tools:v1",
        ) || "null",
      ),
    ).bookmarks;
  } catch {}
  const pages = resources
    .flatMap((resource) =>
      (bookmarks[resource.id] || []).map((page) => ({ resource, page })),
    )
    .slice(0, 6);
  const notes = (margins.data || [])
    .filter(
      (note) =>
        note.courseId === selected &&
        resources.some(
          (r) =>
            r.id === note.anchor.resourceId &&
            r.updatedAt === note.anchor.resourceRevision,
        ),
    )
    .slice(0, 3);
  const href = (resource: (typeof resources)[number], page = 1) =>
    course
      ? resource.fileUrl
        ? resourceResumeHref(course, resource, page)
        : `${personalCoursePath(course.slug)}?section=${resource.kind}`
      : "/my/learning";
  return (
    <section
      className="personal-revision-kit"
      id="personal-revision-kit"
      aria-labelledby="revision-kit-heading"
    >
      <header>
        <div>
          <span className="home-kicker">
            {t({
              en: "Everything close, nothing to hunt for",
              ar: "كل شيء قريب دون بحث طويل",
            })}
          </span>
          <h2 id="revision-kit-heading" tabIndex={-1}>
            {t({ en: "Your revision kit", ar: "حقيبة مراجعتك" })}
          </h2>
        </div>
        <button
          className="home-icon-control"
          type="button"
          onClick={close}
          aria-label={t({
            en: "Close revision kit",
            ar: "إغلاق حقيبة المراجعة",
          })}
        >
          <X size={19} />
        </button>
      </header>
      <label className="revision-course">
        <span>{t({ en: "Reviewing", ar: "تراجع" })}</span>
        <select
          id="revision-course"
          value={selected}
          onChange={(e) => setSelected(e.target.value)}
        >
          {!selected && (
            <option value="">
              {t({ en: "Choose a course", ar: "اختر مساقاً" })}
            </option>
          )}
          {data.myCourses.map((c) => (
            <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
              {t(c.title)}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </label>
      <div className="revision-columns">
        <div>
          <h3>
            <FileText size={17} />
            {t({ en: "Course materials", ar: "مواد المساق" })}
          </h3>
          {materials.map((r) => (
            <AppLink className="revision-resource" href={href(r)} key={r.id}>
              <span>
                <strong>{t(r.title)}</strong>
                <small>
                  {r.kind === "summary"
                    ? t({ en: "Summary", ar: "ملخص" })
                    : t(r.format)}
                  {saved.includes(r.id)
                    ? t({ en: " · Saved", ar: " · محفوظ" })
                    : ""}
                </small>
              </span>
              <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={16} />
            </AppLink>
          ))}
          {!materials.length && (
            <p>
              {t(
                local.loading
                  ? { en: "Loading your files…", ar: "جارٍ تحميل ملفاتك…" }
                  : {
                      en: "Choose a course or open its materials to prepare your kit.",
                      ar: "اختر مساقاً أو افتح مواده لتجهيز حقيبتك.",
                    },
              )}
            </p>
          )}
          {local.error && (
            <p role="status">
              {t({
                en: "Device PDFs could not load. You can still open the course materials.",
                ar: "تعذر تحميل ملفات الجهاز. يمكنك فتح مواد المساق الأخرى.",
              })}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div>
          <h3>
            <Bookmark size={17} />
            {t({ en: "Bookmarked pages", ar: "الصفحات المحددة" })}
          </h3>
          {pages.map(({ resource, page }) => (
            <AppLink
              className="revision-resource"
              href={href(resource, page)}
              key={resource.id + page}
            >
              <span>
                <strong>{t(resource.title)}</strong>
                <small>
                  {t({ en: "Page", ar: "صفحة" })} {page}
                </small>
              </span>
              <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={16} />
            </AppLink>
          ))}
          {!pages.length && (
            <p>
              {t({
                en: "Bookmark important PDF pages during your next study session. They will appear here.",
                ar: "حدد صفحات PDF المهمة أثناء دراستك لتظهر هنا.",
              })}
            </p>
          )}
          <h3>
            <MessageSquareText size={17} />
            {t({ en: "Course notes", ar: "ملاحظات المساق" })}
          </h3>
          {margins.isError && (
            <p role="status">
              {t({
                en: "Course notes could not load.",
                ar: "تعذر تحميل ملاحظات المساق.",
              })}{" "}
              <button
                type="button"
                className="text-link"
                onClick={() => void margins.refetch()}
              >
                {t({ en: "Try again", ar: "حاول مجدداً" })}
              </button>
            </p>
          )}
          {notes.map((note) => (
            <AppLink
              className="revision-note"
              key={note.id}
              href={href(
                resources.find((r) => r.id === note.anchor.resourceId)!,
                note.anchor.page,
              )}
              data-note-color={note.color}
            >
              <small>
                {t({ en: "Page", ar: "صفحة" })} {note.anchor.page}
              </small>
              <p>{note.body.slice(0, 150)}</p>
            </AppLink>
          ))}
          <AppLink
            className="text-link"
            href={`/my/focus?tool=notes${selected ? `&course=${encodeURIComponent(selected)}` : ""}`}
          >
            {t({ en: "Open my notes", ar: "فتح ملاحظاتي" })}{" "}
            <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={16} />
          </AppLink>
        </div>
      </div>
      <footer>
        <AppLink href={`/my/exams${selected ? `?course=${encodeURIComponent(selected)}` : ""}`} className="button button-secondary">{t({ en: "Practice course questions", ar: "التدرب على أسئلة المساق" })}<ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={16} /></AppLink>
        <AppLink
          href={`/my/study/recall${selected ? `?course=${encodeURIComponent(selected)}` : ""}`}
          className="button button-secondary"
        >
          {t({ en: "Review my recall cards", ar: "مراجعة بطاقاتي" })}
        </AppLink>
        {course && (
          <AppLink href={personalCoursePath(course.slug)} className="text-link">
            {t({ en: "Open the course", ar: "فتح المساق" })}{" "}
            <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={16} />
          </AppLink>
        )}
      </footer>
    </section>
  );
}

import { lazy, Suspense, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ArrowUpRight,
  BookOpen,
  Bookmark,
  CalendarClock,
  ChevronRight,
  Compass,
  FileText,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Timer,
  Brain,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { CourseCard } from "../../components/cards/CourseCard";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { APP_TIMEZONE } from "../../constants/config";
import { usePersonalHome } from "./usePersonalHome";
import { useCampusGrowth } from "./useCampusGrowth";
import { shortcutChoices, resourceResumeHref } from "./personal-home-model";
import { HomeControls } from "./HomeControls";
import { RevisionKit } from "./RevisionKit";
import "./personal-home.css";
const PersonalCampus = lazy(() => import("./PersonalCampus"));

export default function StudentDashboard() {
  const { snapshot } = useAuth();
  return <PersonalHome key={snapshot.user?.id || "guest"} />;
}
function PersonalHome() {
  const data = usePersonalHome(),
    growth = useCampusGrowth(data);
  const { t, label, locale } = useLocale();
  const [control, setControl] = useState<"exam" | "shortcuts" | null>(null);
  const [kitOpen, setKitOpen] = useState(false),
    [kitCourse, setKitCourse] = useState("");
  const examCourse = data.myCourses.find((c) => c.id === data.exam?.courseId);
  const saved = data.workspace.state.savedIds
    .slice()
    .reverse()
    .flatMap((id) => {
      const resource = data.myResources.find((r) => r.id === id);
      return resource ? [resource] : [];
    })
    .slice(0, 4);
  const formatDate = (value: string) =>
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale === "ar" ? "ar-JO" : "en-GB", {
      timeZone: APP_TIMEZONE,
      month: "short",
      day: "numeric",
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
    }).format(new Date(value));
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!kitOpen) return;
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      document
        .getElementById("revision-kit-heading")
        ?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      document.getElementById("personal-revision-kit")?.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
          ? "instant"
          : "smooth",
        block: "start",
      });
    });
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  }, [kitOpen]);
  function openKit(courseId?: string) {
    setKitCourse(
      data.myCourses.find((c) => c.id === courseId)?.id ||
        examCourse?.id ||
        data.resume?.course.id ||
        data.myCourses[0]?.id ||
        "",
    );
    setKitOpen(true);
  }
  if (data.criticalPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (data.criticalError)
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void data.profile.refetch();
          void data.courses.refetch();
          void data.resources.refetch();
          data.workspace.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  const student = data.profile.data!;
  const firstName = t(student.name).trim().split(/\s+/)[0];
  const minutes = data.exam
    ? Math.ceil((Date.parse(data.exam.startsAt) - data.now) / 60_000)
    : 0;
  return (
    <div
      className="container personal-home personal-home-next"
      data-home-mode={data.examSoon ? "exam" : data.resume ? "resume" : "start"}
    >
      <section
        className="personal-next-hero"
        aria-labelledby="personal-next-heading"
      >
        <div className="personal-next-copy">
          <div className="personal-home-greeting">
            <span>
              {t({ en: "Welcome back", ar: "مرحباً بعودتك" })},{" "}
              <strong>{firstName}</strong>
            </span>
            <small>
              {label("year")} {student.year} · {t(student.batch)}
            </small>
          </div>
          <span className="home-kicker">
            {data.examSoon ? (
              <CalendarClock size={17} />
            ) : (
              <Compass size={17} />
            )}
            {t(
              data.examSoon
                ? {
                    en: "Keep your next exam close",
                    ar: "امتحانك القادم بالقرب منك",
                  }
                : { en: "Your next step", ar: "خطوتك التالية" },
            )}
          </span>
          <h1 id="personal-next-heading" tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {data.examSoon
              ? t(data.exam!.title)
              : data.resume
                ? t({
                    en: "Pick up where you left off.",
                    ar: "أكمل من حيث توقفت.",
                  })
                : t({
                    en: "Make room for your next chapter.",
                    ar: "مساحة لفصلك القادم.",
                  })}
          </h1>
          {data.examSoon ? (
            <>
              <p className="personal-next-description">
                {t({
                  en: "Your course materials, saved pages and notes — gathered for a quick review.",
                  ar: "مواد مساقك وصفحاتك المحددة وملاحظاتك مجتمعة لمراجعة سريعة.",
                })}
              </p>
              <div className="personal-exam-time">
                <CalendarClock size={17} />
                <time dateTime={data.exam!.startsAt}>
                  {minutes <= 60
                    ? t({
                        en: `Starts in ${minutes} min`,
                        ar: `يبدأ خلال ${minutes} دقيقة`,
                      })
                    : formatDate(data.exam!.startsAt)}
                </time>
                <small>{t({ en: "Amman time", ar: "بتوقيت عمّان" })}</small>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : data.resume ? (
            <div className="personal-resume-detail">
              <BookOpen size={20} />
              <span>
                <strong>
                  {data.resume.resource
                    ? t(data.resume.resource.title)
                    : t(data.resume.course.title)}
                </strong>
                <small>
                  {t(data.resume.course.title)} ·{" "}
                  {data.resume.resource && !data.resume.resource.fileUrl ? (
                    t(data.resume.resource.format)
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      {t({ en: "Page", ar: "صفحة" })} {data.resume.page}
                    </>
                  )}
                </small>
              </span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="personal-next-description">
              {t({
                en: "Start with your courses. Keep useful pages close, and let your own campus take shape as you study.",
                ar: "ابدأ بمساقاتك واحتفظ بالصفحات المهمة بالقرب منك. يتطور حرمك مع دراستك.",
              })}
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="personal-next-actions">
            {data.examSoon ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="button button-primary personal-next-primary"
                onClick={() => openKit()}
              >
                {t({ en: "Open my exam revision", ar: "فتح مراجعة امتحاني" })}
                <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={20} />
              </button>
            ) : data.resume ? (
              <AppLink
                className="button button-primary personal-next-primary"
                href={data.resume.href}
              >
                {t({ en: "Resume studying", ar: "متابعة الدراسة" })}
                <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={20} />
              </AppLink>
            ) : (
              <AppLink
                href="/my/learning"
                className="button button-primary personal-next-primary"
              >
                {t({ en: "Open my courses", ar: "فتح مساقاتي" })}
                <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={20} />
              </AppLink>
            )}
            {!data.examSoon && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="personal-quick-revision"
                onClick={() => openKit()}
              >
                {t({ en: "Quick revision", ar: "مراجعة سريعة" })}
                <ChevronRight className="directional" size={16} />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="personal-shortcut-heading">
            <span>{t({ en: "Keep close", ar: "بالقرب منك" })}</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setControl("shortcuts")}
              aria-label={t({
                en: "Customize my shortcuts",
                ar: "تخصيص اختصاراتي",
              })}
            >
              <SlidersHorizontal size={15} />
              {t({ en: "Customize", ar: "تخصيص" })}
            </button>
          </div>
          <nav
            className="personal-pinned-shortcuts"
            aria-label={t({
              en: "Your pinned shortcuts",
              ar: "اختصاراتك المثبتة",
            })}
          >
            {data.preferences.shortcuts.map((id) => {
              const item = shortcutChoices.find((c) => c.id === id)!;
              return (
                <AppLink key={id} href={item.href} data-home-shortcut={id}>
                  <span>{t(item.label)}</span>
                  <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={15} />
                </AppLink>
              );
            })}
          </nav>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="personal-exam-edit"
            onClick={() => setControl("exam")}
          >
            <CalendarClock size={15} />
            {t(
              data.preferences.exam
                ? { en: "Edit my exam date", ar: "تعديل موعد امتحاني" }
                : { en: "Add my next exam", ar: "إضافة امتحاني القادم" },
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="personal-campus-region">
          <div className="personal-campus-heading">
            <span className="home-kicker">
              {t({ en: "Your MedClub campus", ar: "حرم ميدكلب الخاص بك" })}
            </span>
            <small>
              {t({ en: "Built by your journey", ar: "يتطور برحلتك" })}
            </small>
          </div>
          <Suspense
            fallback={
              <div className="personal-campus-placeholder" aria-hidden="true" />
            }
          >
            <PersonalCampus levels={growth.levels} quiet={data.examSoon} />
          </Suspense>
        </div>
      </section>
      {(!data.persistent || !growth.persistent) && (
        <p className="home-device-note" role="status">
          {t({
            en: "Changes are available for this session. Device storage is unavailable.",
            ar: "التغييرات متاحة لهذه الجلسة. التخزين على الجهاز غير متاح.",
          })}
        </p>
      )}
      {kitOpen && (
        <RevisionKit
          data={data}
          selected={kitCourse}
          setSelected={setKitCourse}
          close={() => setKitOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
      <section
        className="personal-home-today"
        aria-label={t({ en: "Your next few steps", ar: "خطواتك القادمة" })}
      >
        <div className="personal-next-up">
          <header>
            <div>
              <span className="home-kicker">
                {t({ en: "A little direction", ar: "خطوة واضحة" })}
              </span>
              <h2>{t({ en: "Up next", ar: "القادم" })}</h2>
            </div>
            <AppLink href="/my/calendar" className="text-link">
              {t({ en: "Calendar", ar: "التقويم" })}
              <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={16} />
            </AppLink>
          </header>
          {data.upcoming.length ? (
            data.upcoming.map((item) => (
              <div className="home-upcoming-item" key={item.id}>
                <CalendarClock size={19} />
                <span>
                  <strong>{t(item.title)}</strong>
                  <small>{formatDate(item.startsAt)}</small>
                </span>
                {item.kind === "exam" ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => openKit(item.courseId)}
                    aria-label={t({
                      en: "Open exam revision",
                      ar: "فتح مراجعة الامتحان",
                    })}
                  >
                    <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={18} />
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <AppLink
                    href="/my/calendar"
                    aria-label={t({ en: "Open calendar", ar: "فتح التقويم" })}
                  >
                    <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={18} />
                  </AppLink>
                )}
              </div>
            ))
          ) : (
            <div className="home-upcoming-empty">
              <p>
                {t({
                  en: "A clear space for your next plan.",
                  ar: "مساحة لخطتك القادمة.",
                })}
              </p>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="text-link"
                onClick={() => setControl("exam")}
              >
                {t({ en: "Add an exam date", ar: "إضافة موعد امتحان" })}
              </button>
              <AppLink className="text-link" href="/my/calendar">
                {t({ en: "Plan a study session", ar: "تخطيط جلسة دراسة" })}
              </AppLink>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="personal-home-recall">
          <Brain size={29} />
          <span className="home-kicker">
            {t({ en: "Bring it back to mind", ar: "استرجع ما تعلمته" })}
          </span>
          <h2>
            {data.cards.isSuccess && data.dueCards.length
              ? t({
                  en: `${data.dueCards.length} cards to revisit.`,
                  ar: `${data.dueCards.length} بطاقة للمراجعة.`,
                })
              : t({
                  en: "A little recall goes a long way.",
                  ar: "مراجعة صغيرة تحدث فرقاً.",
                })}
          </h2>
          <p>
            {t({
              en: "Your own questions. A focused review. Pick up the cards that are due when you have time.",
              ar: "أسئلتك ومراجعة مركزة. عد إلى بطاقاتك المستحقة عندما يتاح لك الوقت.",
            })}
          </p>
          <AppLink href="/my/study/recall" className="button button-secondary">
            {t({ en: "Open recall", ar: "فتح المراجعة" })}
            <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={17} />
          </AppLink>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section className="personal-home-books">
        <header className="personal-home-section-heading">
          <div>
            <span className="home-kicker">
              {t({ en: "Your next chapters", ar: "فصولك القادمة" })}
            </span>
            <h2>{t({ en: "On your study shelf", ar: "على رف دراستك" })}</h2>
          </div>
          <AppLink href="/my/learning" className="text-link">
            {label("viewAll")}
            <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={17} />
          </AppLink>
        </header>
        <div className="personal-home-book-grid">
          {data.myCourses.slice(0, 3).map((course) => (
            <CourseCard key={course.id} course={course} />
          ))}
        </div>
        {!data.myCourses.length && (
          <p>
            {t({
              en: "Your assigned courses will appear here. Explore the learning catalogue meanwhile.",
              ar: "ستظهر مساقاتك المخصصة هنا. يمكنك استكشاف دليل التعلم الآن.",
            })}{" "}
            <AppLink href="/learn" className="text-link">
              {t({ en: "Explore courses", ar: "استكشاف المساقات" })}
            </AppLink>
          </p>
        )}
      </section>
      <section className="personal-home-saved">
        <header className="personal-home-section-heading">
          <div>
            <span className="home-kicker">
              {t({ en: "Worth keeping close", ar: "تستحق أن تبقى قريبة" })}
            </span>
            <h2>
              {t({
                en: "Recently saved for studying",
                ar: "محفوظات الدراسة الأخيرة",
              })}
            </h2>
          </div>
          <AppLink href="/my/library" className="text-link">
            {label("openLibrary")}
            <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={17} />
          </AppLink>
        </header>
        <div className="personal-home-saved-grid">
          {saved.map((resource) => {
            const course = data.myCourses.find(
              (c) => c.id === resource.courseId,
            )!;
            return (
              <AppLink
                className="personal-home-saved-item"
                href={
                  resource.fileUrl
                    ? resourceResumeHref(course, resource)
                    : `/my/library?course=${encodeURIComponent(course.id)}`
                }
                key={resource.id}
              >
                <FileText size={22} />
                <span>
                  <strong>{t(resource.title)}</strong>
                  <small>{t(course.title)}</small>
                </span>
                <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={16} />
              </AppLink>
            );
          })}
          {!saved.length && (
            <div className="personal-saves-empty">
              <Bookmark size={25} />
              <p>
                {t({
                  en: "Save a useful summary or resource. It will be one step away here.",
                  ar: "احفظ ملخصاً أو مصدراً مفيداً ليكون على بعد خطوة هنا.",
                })}
              </p>
              <AppLink href="/my/library" className="text-link">
                {label("openLibrary")}
              </AppLink>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
      <footer className="personal-home-foot">
        <span>
          <BookOpen size={16} />
          {data.reviewed.length}{" "}
          {t({ en: "resources reviewed", ar: "مصادر تمت مراجعتها" })}
        </span>
        <AppLink href="/my/progress">
          {t({ en: "See my study progress", ar: "عرض تقدم دراستي" })}
          <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={15} />
        </AppLink>
        <AppLink href="/my/focus">
          <Timer size={16} />
          {t({ en: "Make time to focus", ar: "وقت للتركيز" })}
        </AppLink>
      </footer>
      {control && (
        <HomeControls
          data={data}
          kind={control}
          close={() => setControl(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { ArrowUpRight, Clock3, BookOpen, Check, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";
import { useResources, useStudentProfile } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useWorkspace } from "../../app/providers/WorkspaceProvider";
import { useOverlays } from "../../app/providers/OverlayProvider";
import { useCalendar } from "../calendar/useCalendar";
import { useNotifications } from "../notifications/useNotifications";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { DEMO_TODAY } from "../../constants/config";
import { calendarDate, dateAtNoon } from "../../lib/calendar";
import { formatDate } from "../../lib/dates";
import { StudyProgress } from "../../components/ui/StudyProgress";
export function StudyOverview() {
  const { label, t, locale } = useLocale(),
    { state } = useWorkspace();
  const { openDetail } = useOverlays();
  const resources = useResources(),
    profile = useStudentProfile(),
    calendar = useCalendar(),
    notifications = useNotifications();
  if (
    resources.isError ||
    profile.isError ||
    calendar.isError ||
    notifications.isError
  )
    return (
      <ErrorState
        retry={() => {
          void resources.refetch();
          void profile.refetch();
          calendar.retry();
          notifications.retry();
        }}
      />
    );
  if (
    resources.isPending ||
    profile.isPending ||
    calendar.isPending ||
    notifications.isPending
  )
    return <LoadingState />;
  const mine = resources.data.filter((r) =>
    profile.data.courseIds.includes(r.courseId),
  );
  const recent = state.recentResources.flatMap((entry) => {
    const resource = mine.find((r) => r.id === entry.resourceId);
    return resource ? [{ resource, viewedAt: entry.viewedAt }] : [];
  });
  const latest = recent[0]?.resource;
  const reviewed = mine.filter((r) =>
    state.reviewedResourceIds.includes(r.id),
  ).length;
  const upcoming = calendar.items
    .filter((i) => calendarDate(i.startsAt) >= DEMO_TODAY)
    .slice(0, 3);
  const updates = [...mine]
    .sort((a, b) => Date.parse(b.updatedAt) - Date.parse(a.updatedAt))
    .slice(0, 3);
  return (
    <div className="study-overview">
      <div className="study-thread-grid">
        <section className="continue-thread">
          <div className="thread-orbits" aria-hidden="true">
            <i />
            <i />
            <i />
          </div>
          <span className="eyebrow">{label("continueEyebrow")}</span>
          <h2>{label(latest ? "continueLearning" : "beginLearning")}</h2>
          <p>{label(latest ? "continueBody" : "beginLearningBody")}</p>
          {latest ? (
            <button
              className="resume-resource"
              aria-label={label("resume") + " " + t(latest.title)}
              onClick={() => openDetail({ kind: "resource", item: latest })}
            >
              <BookOpen size={22} />
              <span>
                <small>{label("resume")}</small>
                <strong>{t(latest.title)}</strong>
              </span>
              <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={21} />
            </button>
          ) : (
            <AppLink href="/my/learning" className="resume-resource">
              <BookOpen size={22} />
              <strong>{label("openMyLearning")}</strong>
              <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={21} />
            </AppLink>
          )}
          <div className="review-meter">
            <div>
              <span>{label("reviewProgress")}</span>
              <strong>
                {reviewed}/{mine.length}
              </strong>
            </div>
            <StudyProgress
              max={Math.max(mine.length, 1)}
              value={reviewed}
              label={label("reviewProgress")}
            />
            <small>{label("reviewNote")}</small>
          </div>
        </section>
        <section className="next-up-card">
          <div className="personal-section-heading">
            <h2>{label("workspaceUpcoming")}</h2>
            <AppLink href="/my/calendar" aria-label={label("openCalendar")}>
              <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={20} />
            </AppLink>
          </div>
          <span className="demo-date-label">
            {label("demoDate")} · {formatDate(dateAtNoon(DEMO_TODAY), locale)}
          </span>
          {upcoming.map((item) => (
            <AppLink
              className="next-up-entry"
              key={item.id}
              href="/my/calendar"
            >
              <time dateTime={item.startsAt}>
                <b>{formatDate(item.startsAt, locale, { day: "numeric" })}</b>
                {formatDate(item.startsAt, locale, { month: "short" })}
              </time>
              <strong>{t(item.title)}</strong>
              <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={15} />
            </AppLink>
          ))}
          {!upcoming.length && (
            <p className="workspace-note">{label("noUpcoming")}</p>
          )}
          <AppLink href="/my/notifications" className="updates-pill">
            <Sparkles size={15} />
            <b>{notifications.unread}</b>
            {label("unreadUpdates")}
            <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={15} />
          </AppLink>
        </section>
      </div>
      <div className="personal-activity-grid">
        <section>
          <div className="personal-section-heading">
            <h2>{label("recentlyViewed")}</h2>
            <span className="eyebrow">{label("recentPreview")}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="activity-resource-list">
            {recent.slice(0, 3).map(({ resource, viewedAt }) => (
              <button
                key={resource.id}
                onClick={() => openDetail({ kind: "resource", item: resource })}
              >
                <Clock3 size={19} />
                <span>
                  <strong>{t(resource.title)}</strong>
                  <small>
                    {formatDate(viewedAt, locale, {
                      day: "numeric",
                      month: "short",
                    })}
                  </small>
                </span>
                {state.reviewedResourceIds.includes(resource.id) ? (
                  <Check size={16} aria-label={label("reviewed")} />
                ) : (
                  <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={16} />
                )}
              </button>
            ))}
            {!recent.length && (
              <p className="personal-empty">{label("noRecent")}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </section>
        <section>
          <div className="personal-section-heading">
            <h2>{label("courseUpdates")}</h2>
            <AppLink href="/my/learning" className="text-link">
              {label("viewAll")}
              <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={15} />
            </AppLink>
          </div>
          <div className="activity-resource-list">
            {updates.map((r) => (
              <button
                key={r.id}
                onClick={() => openDetail({ kind: "resource", item: r })}
              >
                <BookOpen size={19} />
                <span>
                  <strong>{t(r.title)}</strong>
                  <small>
                    {formatDate(r.updatedAt, locale)} · {label(r.kind)}
                  </small>
                </span>
                <ArrowUpRight className="directional" size={16} />
              </button>
            ))}
            {!updates.length && (
              <p className="personal-empty">{label("noCourseUpdates")}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/study-hub/OfflinePacksPage.tsx
