import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useCourses } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { flyDeletedRecord, useStudyHub, useStudyError } from "./useStudyHub";
import { useLocalCoursePdfs } from "../courses/useLocalCoursePdfs";
import {
  validateCoursePdf,
  type PdfImportReporter,
} from "../courses/pdf-import";
import { CoursePdfImporter } from "../courses/CoursePdfImporter";
import { OfflinePdfReader } from "./OfflinePdfReader";
import {
  downloadCoursePack,
  indexedPackStorage,
  requestOfflineShell,
  type OfflinePack,
  type PackProgress,
} from "./offline-packs";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { Download, Trash2, FileText, WifiOff } from "lucide-react";
import { offerUndo } from "../../components/feedback/undo-action";
import type { Resource } from "../../types/content";
import "./study-hub.css";
import "../../styles/notebook-reader.css";
import "../../styles/study-environment.css";
export default function OfflinePacksPage() {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    errorText = useStudyError(),
    { owner, service } = useStudyHub(),
    courses = useCourses();
  const [courseId, setCourseId] = useState(""),
    [packs, setPacks] = useState<OfflinePack[]>([]),
    [error, setError] = useState(false),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [progress, setProgress] = useState<PackProgress | null>(null),
    [shell, setShell] = useState<boolean | null>(null),
    [personal, setPersonal] = useState<Resource[]>([]),
    [opened, setOpened] = useState<Resource | null>(null),
    [downloadState, setDownloadState] = useState<"idle" | "success" | "error">(
      "idle",
    );
  const local = useLocalCoursePdfs(courseId);
  const controller = useRef<AbortController | null>(null),
    urls = useRef<string[]>([]),
    ownerRef = useRef(owner),
    resetTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null),
    stagingUrls = useRef<string[]>([]),
    currentCourse = useRef(courseId);
  currentCourse.current = courseId;
  ownerRef.current = owner;
  const [quota, setQuota] = useState<string>("");
  async function load() {
    if (!owner) return;
    try {
      const rows = await indexedPackStorage.list(owner);
      if (ownerRef.current === owner) {
        setPacks(rows);
        setError(false);
      }
    } catch {
      setError(true);
    }
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    setPacks([]);
    setCourseId("");
    setProgress(null);
    setShell(null);
    setDownloadState("idle");
    setOpened(null);
    setPersonal([]);
    void load();
    void navigator.storage
      ?.estimate()
      .then((s) =>
        setQuota(
          s.quota
            ? Math.round((s.quota - (s.usage || 0)) / 1048576) + " MB"
            : "",
        ),
      );
    return () => {
      controller.current?.abort();
      if (resetTimer.current) clearTimeout(resetTimer.current);
      for (const url of urls.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      urls.current = [];
      stagingUrls.current = [];
    };
  }, [owner]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (resetTimer.current) clearTimeout(resetTimer.current);
    for (const url of stagingUrls.current) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      urls.current = urls.current.filter((value) => value !== url);
    }
    stagingUrls.current = [];
    setPersonal([]);
    setProgress(null);
    setDownloadState("idle");
  }, [courseId]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const url = opened?.fileUrl;
    return () => {
      if (url) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        urls.current = urls.current.filter((value) => value !== url);
      }
    };
  }, [opened?.fileUrl]);
  async function savePack() {
    if (!owner || !courseId) return;
    const account = owner;
    setBusy(true);
    setProgress(null);
    setDownloadState("idle");
    const abort = new AbortController();
    controller.current = abort;
    try {
      const manifest = await service.packManifest(courseId, {
        signal: abort.signal,
      });
      const all = [...manifest.resources, ...local.resources, ...personal];
      manifest.resources = Array.from(
        new Map(all.map((r) => [r.id, r])).values(),
      );
      const margins = (
        await Promise.all(
          manifest.resources.map((r) =>
            service.listMargins(r.id, { signal: abort.signal }),
          ),
        )
      ).flat();
      const recall = await service.listRecall(courseId, {
        signal: abort.signal,
      });
      await downloadCoursePack({
        ownerId: account,
        manifest,
        margins,
        recall,
        signal: abort.signal,
        report: setProgress,
        stillOwner: () => ownerRef.current === account,
      });
      if (ownerRef.current !== account) return;
      await load();
      setDownloadState("success");
      // Saved packs own their Blobs. Discard only the staging files, not the downloaded pack.
      resetTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        if (ownerRef.current !== account) return;
        setPersonal([]);
        setCourseId("");
        setProgress(null);
        setDownloadState("idle");
      }, 1400);
      setShell(await requestOfflineShell());
      toast.success(
        t({
          en: "Course pack ready on this device",
          ar: "الحزمة جاهزة على هذا الجهاز",
        }),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (!abort.signal.aborted) {
        setDownloadState("error");
        toast.error(errorText(e));
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      controller.current = null;
    }
  }
  async function personalFiles(files: File[], report?: PdfImportReporter) {
    const account = owner,
      course = courseId;
    if (!account || !course || personal.length + files.length > 80)
      throw new Error("PDF_INVALID");
    // Validate the whole batch before adding any file. Partial batches never appear ready.
    for (const file of files) await validateCoursePdf(file);
    if (ownerRef.current !== account || currentCourse.current !== course)
      throw new Error("AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED");
    const records: Resource[] = files.map((file, i) => {
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      urls.current.push(url);
      stagingUrls.current.push(url);
      const title = file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, "");
      report?.({
        completed: i + 1,
        total: files.length,
        fileName: file.name,
        storage: "session",
      });
      return {
        id: "personal-pdf-" + crypto.randomUUID(),
        courseId: course,
        kind: "notes",
        title: { en: title, ar: title },
        description: { en: "Private pack file", ar: "ملف حزمة خاص" },
        contributor: { en: "You", ar: "أنت" },
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        pages: 1,
        keywords: [],
        audience: "batch",
        batchIds: [],
        format: { en: "PDF", ar: "PDF" },
        mediaType: "pdf",
        fileUrl: url,
        localFile: { name: file.name, sizeBytes: file.size },
      };
    });
    setPersonal((previous) => [...previous, ...records]);
    return records.map((file) => file.id);
  }
  function openFile(pack: OfflinePack, index: number) {
    if (
      pack.ownerId !== owner ||
      Date.parse(pack.manifest.expiresAt) <= Date.now()
    ) {
      toast.error(
        t({
          en: "Reconnect to refresh this expired pack.",
          ar: "اتصل لتحديث الحزمة المنتهية.",
        }),
      );
      return;
    }
    const file = pack.files[index];
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file.blob);
    urls.current.push(url);
    setOpened({ ...file.resource, fileUrl: url });
  }
  return (
    <main className="container study-hub">
      <header className="study-hub-heading">
        <AppLink href="/my/study" className="text-link">
          ← {t({ en: "Study desk", ar: "مكتب الدراسة" })}
        </AppLink>
        <h1 data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>
          {t({ en: "Offline course packs", ar: "حزم المساقات دون اتصال" })}
        </h1>
        <p>
          {t({
            en: "Download a complete set of real PDFs. A pack is ready only when every file has been saved.",
            ar: "نزّل مجموعة ملفات كاملة. لا تصبح الحزمة جاهزة إلا بعد حفظ جميع الملفات.",
          })}
        </p>
        {quota && (
          <small>
            {t({
              en: "Estimated device space available",
              ar: "المساحة المتاحة تقديرياً",
            })}
            : {quota}
          </small>
        )}
      </header>
      <section
        className="study-editor pack-download-editor"
        data-download-state={downloadState}
      >
        <label>
          {t({ en: "Choose a course", ar: "اختر المساق" })}
          <select
            disabled={busy}
            value={courseId}
            onChange={(e) => setCourseId(e.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">—</option>
            {courses.data?.map((c) => (
              <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                {t(c.title)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        {courseId && (
          <>
            <CoursePdfImporter
              key={courseId}
              section="notes"
              pending={busy}
              onImport={personalFiles}
              copy={{
                title: {
                  en: "Add private PDFs to this pack",
                  ar: "أضف ملفات PDF خاصة للحزمة",
                },
                idle: {
                  en: "Drop PDFs here or choose files. Download the pack to keep them on this device.",
                  ar: "أسقط الملفات أو اخترها. نزّل الحزمة لحفظها على هذا الجهاز.",
                },
                dragging: {
                  en: "Release to add PDFs to the pack",
                  ar: "أفلت لإضافة الملفات إلى الحزمة",
                },
                working: {
                  en: "Checking your PDFs…",
                  ar: "جار التحقق من ملفاتك…",
                },
                success: {
                  en: "PDFs added. Download the pack to save them.",
                  ar: "أضيفت الملفات. نزّل الحزمة لحفظها.",
                },
                receipt: { en: "added", ar: "مضاف" },
                boundary: {
                  en: "Private staging files. A pack is saved only after its download completes.",
                  ar: "ملفات خاصة قيد التجهيز. تحفظ الحزمة بعد اكتمال تنزيلها فقط.",
                },
              }}
            />
            <small>
              {t({
                en: "This is private storage, not course publishing.",
                ar: "تخزين خاص وليس نشر مواد المساق.",
              })}
            </small>
            <ul>
              {personal.map((p) => (
                <li key={p.id}>{t(p.title)}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </>
        )}
        <div className="study-hub-actions">
          <button
            className="button button-primary"
            disabled={!courseId || busy || downloadState === "success"}
            onClick={() => void savePack()}
          >
            <Download size={17} />
            {t({ en: "Download pack", ar: "تنزيل الحزمة" })}
          </button>
          {busy && (
            <button
              className="button"
              onClick={() => controller.current?.abort()}
            >
              {t({ en: "Cancel download", ar: "إلغاء التنزيل" })}
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            className="button"
            onClick={() =>
              void navigator.storage?.persist().then((yes) =>
                toast(
                  yes
                    ? t({
                        en: "Persistent storage granted",
                        ar: "أُتيح التخزين الدائم",
                      })
                    : t({
                        en: "The browser may reclaim downloaded storage.",
                        ar: "قد يستعيد المتصفح مساحة الملفات.",
                      }),
                ),
              )
            }
          >
            {t({ en: "Keep downloads", ar: "الاحتفاظ بالتنزيلات" })}
          </button>
        </div>
        {(busy || downloadState === "success") && (
          <div className="pack-progress" role="status">
            <progress
              max={progress?.total || 1}
              value={progress?.completed || 0}
            />
            <span>
              {downloadState === "success"
                ? t({ en: "✓ Your pack is ready", ar: "✓ حزمتك جاهزة" })
                : progress?.file ||
                  t({
                    en: "Preparing manifest…",
                    ar: "جار تجهيز الحزمة…",
                  })}{" "}
              · {((progress?.bytes || 0) / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </section>
      {shell === false && (
        <p className="study-source-note">
          {t({
            en: "Files are saved for offline reading in an open app. Offline launch requires the included service-worker build step to be installed on the server.",
            ar: "الملفات محفوظة للقراءة دون اتصال في التطبيق المفتوح. بدء التطبيق دون اتصال يحتاج تثبيت عامل الخدمة المرفق على الخادم.",
          })}
        </p>
      )}
      {shell === true && (
        <p role="status">
          {t({
            en: "Offline app shell installed.",
            ar: "ثُبت التطبيق للعمل دون اتصال.",
          })}
        </p>
      )}
      {error ? (
        <p role="alert">
          {t({
            en: "Persistent device storage is unavailable. No pack has been marked downloaded.",
            ar: "التخزين الدائم غير متاح. لم تُحدد أي حزمة كمُنزلة.",
          })}
        </p>
      ) : packs.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="study-empty">
          <WifiOff size={25} />
          {t({
            en: "Your downloaded courses will appear here.",
            ar: "تظهر مساقاتك المُنزلة هنا.",
          })}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <div className="pack-grid">
          {packs.map((pack) => (
            <article
              className="study-editor"
              data-pack-key={pack.key}
              key={pack.key}
            >
              <h2>{t(pack.manifest.course.title)}</h2>
              <p>
                {pack.files.length} {t({ en: "PDFs", ar: "ملفات" })} ·{" "}
                {(pack.bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB
              </p>
              <small>
                {t({ en: "Expires", ar: "تنتهي" })}{" "}
                {new Date(pack.manifest.expiresAt).toLocaleDateString()}
              </small>
              <div className="study-record-list">
                {pack.files.map((f, i) => (
                  <button key={f.resource.id} onClick={() => openFile(pack, i)}>
                    <FileText size={18} />
                    {t(f.resource.title)}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <details>
                <summary>
                  {t({
                    en: "Saved notes and recall cards",
                    ar: "الملاحظات وبطاقات الاسترجاع المحفوظة",
                  })}
                </summary>
                <small>
                  {t({
                    en: "Read-only snapshot from the download date.",
                    ar: "لقطة للقراءة فقط بتاريخ التنزيل.",
                  })}
                </small>
                {pack.margins.map((n) => (
                  <p key={n.id}>
                    {t({ en: "Page", ar: "صفحة" })} {n.anchor.page} · {n.body}
                  </p>
                ))}
                {pack.recall.map((c) => (
                  <details key={c.id}>
                    <summary>{c.prompt}</summary>
                    <p>{c.answer}</p>
                  </details>
                ))}
              </details>
              <button
                className="button"
                onClick={() =>
                  void indexedPackStorage
                    .remove(pack.key)
                    .then(() => {
                      flyDeletedRecord(
                        "data-pack-key",
                        pack.key,
                        pack.manifest.course.title.en,
                      );
                      void load();
                      offerUndo({
                        message: t({ en: "Pack removed", ar: "حُذفت الحزمة" }),
                        label: t({ en: "Undo", ar: "تراجع" }),
                        restored: t({
                          en: "Pack restored",
                          ar: "استعيدت الحزمة",
                        }),
                        failed: t({
                          en: "Could not restore pack",
                          ar: "تعذرت الاستعادة",
                        }),
                        canRestore: () => ownerRef.current === pack.ownerId,
                        undo: async () => {
                          await indexedPackStorage.put(pack);
                          await load();
                        },
                      });
                    })
                    .catch((e) => toast.error(errorText(e)))
                }
              >
                <Trash2 size={17} />
                {t({ en: "Remove pack", ar: "حذف الحزمة" })}
              </button>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {opened && (
        <OfflinePdfReader
          key={opened.id}
          item={opened}
          onClose={() => setOpened(null)}
        />
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/study-hub/OfflinePdfReader.tsx
============================================================
import { useState } from "react";
import { X, FileText } from "lucide-react";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { PdfBook } from "../courses/PdfBook";
import type { Resource } from "../../types/content";
import "./offline-reader.css";

/** A device pack is a saved snapshot. The reader never requires a network annotation fetch. */
export function OfflinePdfReader({
  item,
  onClose,
}: {
  item: Resource;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  return (
    <Modal
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      title={t(item.title)}
      description={t({
        en: "Reading a PDF saved on this device",
        ar: "قراءة ملف PDF محفوظ على هذا الجهاز",
      })}
      className="offline-pdf-dialog"
      hideHeading
      hideClose
      initialFocus=".offline-pdf-close"
    >
      <header className="offline-pdf-titlebar">
        <FileText size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
        <strong>{t(item.title)}</strong>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="offline-pdf-close"
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label={t({
            en: "Close downloaded PDF",
            ar: "إغلاق الملف المُنزل",
          })}
        >
          <X size={20} />
        </button>
      </header>
      <div className="offline-pdf-canvas">
        <PdfBook
          item={item}
          url={item.fileUrl!}
          initialPage={page}
          onPage={setPage}
        />
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/study-hub/PdfMarginNotes.tsx
============================================================
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useHubQuery, useStudyHub } from "./useStudyHub";
import { useStudyTools } from "../courses/StudyTools";
import { StudentNotes } from "../utilities/StudentNotes";
import type { CourseNoteRequest } from "../utilities/course-note-model";
import type { Resource } from "../../types/content";
import type { MarginNote, PageAnchor } from "../../types/study-hub";
import "./study-hub.css";

/** The PDF and the shared Notes desk read the same versioned course-note records. */
export function usePdfMargins(item: Resource, page: number) {
  const { owner, service } = useStudyHub(), { t } = useLocale();
  const tools = useStudyTools();
  const notes = useHubQuery("margins", (signal) => service.listMargins(item.id, { signal }), item.id);
  const records = useMemo(() => (notes.data || []).filter((note: MarginNote) => note.anchor.resourceRevision === item.updatedAt), [notes.data, item.updatedAt]);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [request, setRequest] = useState<CourseNoteRequest | null>(null);
  const sequence = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => { setOpen(false); setRequest(null); }, [owner, item.id]);
  const add = useCallback((anchor: PageAnchor, pageCount?: number) => {
    const value = { courseId: item.courseId, resource: item, anchor, pageCount };
    if (tools) tools.addNote(value);
    else { setRequest({ ...value, token: ++sequence.current }); setOpen(true); }
  }, [item, tools?.addNote]);
  return {
    owner,
    open: tools ? tools.open && tools.tool === "notes" : open,
    placing: false,
    notes: records,
    add,
    place: add,
    toggle: () => {
      if (tools) { tools.setTool("notes"); tools.setOpen(!(tools.open && tools.tool === "notes")); }
      else setOpen((value) => !value);
    },
    panel: !tools && open && owner ? <aside className="pdf-margin-panel unified-notes-panel" aria-label={t({ en: "Private notes", ar: "ملاحظات خاصة" })}>
      <header><strong>{t({ en: "Notes", ar: "الملاحظات" })}</strong><button type="button" aria-label={t({ en: "Close notes", ar: "إغلاق الملاحظات" })} onClick={() => setOpen(false)}><X size={18} /></button></header>
      <StudentNotes courseId={item.courseId} resources={[item]} request={request} reference={t({ en: `Page ${page}`, ar: `صفحة ${page}` })} />
    </aside> : null,
  };
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { useStudyHub, useHubQuery, useStudyError } from "./useStudyHub";
import type { RoomInput, QuietRoom } from "../../types/study-hub";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Modal } from "../../components/ui/Modal";
import "./study-rooms.css";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { UsersRound, Copy, LogOut, Play, Leaf } from "lucide-react";
import "./study-hub.css";
function RoomClock({ room }: { room: QuietRoom }) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const [now, setNow] = useState(Date.now());
  useEffect(() => {
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;
    const sync = () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      setNow(Date.now());
      if (!document.hidden) timer = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000);
    };
    sync();
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", sync);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", sync);
    };
  }, []);
  const seconds = Math.max(
    0,
    Math.ceil(
      (room.phase === "finished"
        ? 0
        : room.endsAt
          ? Date.parse(room.endsAt) - now
          : room.focusMinutes * 60000) / 1000,
    ),
  );
  const total =
    (room.phase === "rest" ? room.restMinutes : room.focusMinutes) * 60;
  return (
    <div
      className="room-clock"
      style={
        {
          "--room-progress":
            Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - seconds / total)) * 360 + "deg",
        } as React.CSSProperties
      }
    >
      <small>
        {t(
          {
            waiting: {
              en: "Ready when you are",
              ar: "جاهزة عندما تكون جاهزاً",
            },
            focus: { en: "Quiet focus", ar: "تركيز هادئ" },
            rest: { en: "Take a breath", ar: "خذ استراحة" },
            finished: { en: "Session complete", ar: "اكتملت الجلسة" },
          }[room.phase],
        )}
      </small>
      <strong>
        {room.phase === "finished"
          ? "✓"
          : Math.floor(seconds / 60)
              .toString()
              .padStart(2, "0") +
            ":" +
            (seconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, "0")}
      </strong>
      <span>
        {t({
          en: "A shared clock. No chat, no camera.",
          ar: "مؤقت مشترك دون محادثة أو كاميرا.",
        })}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
export default function QuietRoomsPage() {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    { owner, service, refresh } = useStudyHub(),
    errorText = useStudyError();
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  const [code, setCode] = useState(params.get("invite") || ""),
    [goal, setGoal] = useState(""),
    [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [connection, setConnection] = useState("connecting");
  const [leaveConfirm, setLeaveConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState(0);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const copyTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(
    undefined,
  );
  const previousPhase = useRef<string | undefined>(undefined);
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelected(null);
    setConnection("connecting");
    setLeaveConfirm(false);
    setCode(params.get("invite") || "");
    setGoal("");
  }, [owner]);
  useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(copyTimer.current), []);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<RoomInput>({
    title: "",
    capacity: 6,
    focusMinutes: 25,
    restMinutes: 5,
    goal: "",
  });
  const rooms = useHubQuery(
    "rooms",
    (signal) => service.listRooms({ signal }),
    "",
    selected ? 30000 : undefined,
  );
  const selectedRoom = useHubQuery(
    "room",
    (signal) => service.getRoom(selected!, { signal }),
    selected || "",
    5000,
    !!selected,
  );
  const room = selectedRoom.data;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!room) return;
    const key = room.id + ":" + room.phase;
    if (
      previousPhase.current?.startsWith(room.id + ":") &&
      previousPhase.current !== key &&
      room.phase === "finished"
    )
      toast.success(
        t({
          en: "Study session complete. Your room is now closed.",
          ar: "اكتملت جلسة الدراسة وأُغلقت الغرفة.",
        }),
      );
    previousPhase.current = key;
  }, [room?.id, room?.phase]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selected || room?.phase === "finished") return;
    let disposed = false,
      inFlight = false;
    setConnection("connecting");
    const heartbeat = async () => {
      if (document.hidden || inFlight) return;
      inFlight = true;
      try {
        await service.heartbeatRoom(selected);
        if (!disposed) {
          setConnection("connected");
          void selectedRoom.refetch();
        }
      } catch {
        if (!disposed) setConnection("reconnecting");
      } finally {
        inFlight = false;
      }
    };
    void heartbeat();
    const id = setInterval(() => void heartbeat(), 30000);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", heartbeat);
    return () => {
      disposed = true;
      clearInterval(id);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", heartbeat);
    };
  }, [selected, owner, service, room?.phase === "finished"]);
  async function action(fn: () => Promise<unknown>) {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await fn();
      await refresh();
      setFeedback((value) => value + 1);
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(errorText(e));
      void refresh();
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  async function copyInvite() {
    if (!room) return;
    try {
      const value =
        service.source === "api"
          ? location.origin +
            "/my/study/rooms?invite=" +
            encodeURIComponent(room.inviteCode)
          : room.inviteCode;
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
      setCopied(true);
      clearTimeout(copyTimer.current);
      copyTimer.current = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1600);
      toast.success(t({ en: "Invite copied", ar: "نُسخت الدعوة" }));
    } catch {
      toast.error(
        t({
          en: "Copy the displayed invite code.",
          ar: "انسخ رمز الدعوة الظاهر.",
        }),
      );
    }
  }
  async function leaveRoom() {
    if (!room) return;
    await action(async () => {
      await service.leaveRoom(room.id);
      setSelected(null);
      setLeaveConfirm(false);
      toast.success(t({ en: "Left the study room", ar: "غادرت غرفة الدراسة" }));
    });
  }
  return (
    <main className="container study-hub">
      <header className="study-hub-heading">
        <AppLink href="/my/study" className="text-link">
          ← {t({ en: "Study desk", ar: "مكتب الدراسة" })}
        </AppLink>
        <h1 data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>
          {t({ en: "Study together", ar: "الدراسة معاً" })}
        </h1>
        <p>
          {t({
            en: "Invite real classmates with a code. Everyone sees the same focus and break schedule, each person’s goal, and their recent presence. No chat or camera.",
            ar: "ادعُ زملاءك برمز. يرى الجميع مؤقت التركيز والاستراحة نفسه وأهداف المشاركين وحضورهم الأخير، دون محادثة أو كاميرا.",
          })}
        </p>
        {service.source === "device-preview" && (
          <p className="study-source-note">
            {t({
              en: "Local preview: invites work only among accounts in this browser. Connect the API service for real campus rooms across devices.",
              ar: "معاينة محلية: الدعوات تعمل بين حسابات هذا المتصفح فقط. اربط الخدمة لغرف حقيقية بين الأجهزة.",
            })}
          </p>
        )}
      </header>
      {selected && (
        <button className="room-lobby-return" onClick={() => setSelected(null)}>
          {t({ en: "Back to room lobby", ar: "العودة إلى غرف الدراسة" })}
        </button>
      )}
      {selected && selectedRoom.isLoading && (
        <p role="status">
          {t({ en: "Opening your study room…", ar: "جارٍ فتح غرفة الدراسة…" })}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="room-lobby" hidden={!!selected}>
        <section className="study-editor">
          <form
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              void action(async () => {
                const r = await service.createRoom(draft);
                setSelected(r.id);
                setDraft({ ...draft, title: "", goal: "" });
                toast.success(
                  t({
                    en: "Your quiet room is ready",
                    ar: "غرفتك الهادئة جاهزة",
                  }),
                );
              });
            }}
          >
            <h2>
              <UsersRound size={22} />
              {t({ en: "Open a room", ar: "افتح غرفة" })}
            </h2>
            <label>
              {t({ en: "Room name", ar: "اسم الغرفة" })}
              <input
                required
                minLength={3}
                maxLength={100}
                value={draft.title}
                onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, title: e.target.value })}
              />
            </label>
            <label>
              {t({ en: "Your study goal", ar: "هدف دراستك" })}
              <input
                required
                maxLength={140}
                value={draft.goal}
                onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, goal: e.target.value })}
              />
            </label>
            <div className="room-settings">
              <label>
                {t({ en: "Focus minutes", ar: "دقائق التركيز" })}
                <input
                  required
                  type="number"
                  min="1"
                  max="180"
                  value={draft.focusMinutes}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setDraft({ ...draft, focusMinutes: Number(e.target.value) })
                  }
                />
              </label>
              <label>
                {t({ en: "Rest minutes", ar: "دقائق الاستراحة" })}
                <input
                  required
                  type="number"
                  min="1"
                  max="60"
                  value={draft.restMinutes}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setDraft({ ...draft, restMinutes: Number(e.target.value) })
                  }
                />
              </label>
              <label>
                {t({ en: "Seats", ar: "المقاعد" })}
                <input
                  required
                  type="number"
                  min="2"
                  max="12"
                  value={draft.capacity}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setDraft({ ...draft, capacity: Number(e.target.value) })
                  }
                />
              </label>
            </div>
            <button className="button button-primary" disabled={busy}>
              {t({ en: "Create quiet room", ar: "إنشاء غرفة هادئة" })}
            </button>
          </form>
        </section>
        <section className="study-editor">
          <form
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              void action(async () => {
                const r = await service.joinRoom(code, goal);
                setSelected(r.id);
                setCode("");
                setGoal("");
                toast.success(
                  t({ en: "You have a seat", ar: "انضممت إلى الغرفة" }),
                );
              });
            }}
          >
            <h2>{t({ en: "Have an invite?", ar: "لديك دعوة؟" })}</h2>
            <label>
              {t({ en: "Invite code", ar: "رمز الدعوة" })}
              <input
                required
                minLength={8}
                maxLength={100}
                autoComplete="off"
                value={code}
                onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
              />
            </label>
            <label>
              {t({ en: "Your study goal", ar: "هدف دراستك" })}
              <input
                required
                maxLength={140}
                value={goal}
                onChange={(e) => setGoal(e.target.value)}
              />
            </label>
            <button className="button" disabled={busy}>
              {t({ en: "Join quietly", ar: "انضم بهدوء" })}
            </button>
          </form>
        </section>
      </div>
      {rooms.isLoading && (
        <p role="status">
          {t({ en: "Finding your rooms…", ar: "جارٍ تحميل غرفك…" })}
        </p>
      )}
      {!rooms.isLoading && !rooms.isError && !rooms.data?.length && (
        <p className="room-empty">
          {t({
            en: "No rooms yet. Create a room or join with a classmate’s invite.",
            ar: "لا توجد غرف بعد. أنشئ غرفة أو انضم بدعوة زميل.",
          })}
        </p>
      )}
      {rooms.isError ? (
        <button onClick={() => void rooms.refetch()}>
          {t({ en: "Reconnect rooms", ar: "إعادة الاتصال بالغرف" })}
        </button>
      ) : (
        <div className="quiet-room-tabs">
          {rooms.data?.map((r) => (
            <button
              key={r.id}
              aria-pressed={selected === r.id}
              onClick={() => setSelected(r.id)}
            >
              {r.title}
              <small>
                {r.members.length}/{r.capacity}
              </small>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {selected && selectedRoom.isError && (
        <p role="alert" className="room-connection-error">
          {t({
            en: "This room could not be refreshed. Your timer may be out of date.",
            ar: "تعذر تحديث الغرفة. قد يكون المؤقت غير محدث.",
          })}{" "}
          <button onClick={() => void selectedRoom.refetch()}>
            {t({ en: "Retry", ar: "حاول مجدداً" })}
          </button>
        </p>
      )}
      {room && (
        <section
          className="quiet-room"
          key={room.id}
          data-phase={room.phase}
          data-feedback={feedback}
        >
          <header>
            <h2>{room.title}</h2>
            <button
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() =>
                room.hostId === owner && room.phase !== "finished"
                  ? setLeaveConfirm(true)
                  : void leaveRoom()
              }
            >
              <LogOut size={18} />
              {t(
                room.hostId === owner && room.phase !== "finished"
                  ? { en: "End & leave", ar: "إنهاء ومغادرة" }
                  : { en: "Leave", ar: "غادر" },
              )}
            </button>
          </header>
          <div className="room-session-status" role="status">
            <span data-connection={connection}>
              {t(
                room.phase === "finished"
                  ? { en: "Session closed", ar: "الجلسة مغلقة" }
                  : connection === "connected"
                    ? { en: "Presence connected", ar: "الحضور متصل" }
                    : connection === "reconnecting"
                      ? {
                          en: "Reconnecting presence…",
                          ar: "إعادة اتصال الحضور…",
                        }
                      : {
                          en: "Connecting presence…",
                          ar: "جارٍ اتصال الحضور…",
                        },
              )}
            </span>
            <span>
              {room.members.length} / {room.capacity}{" "}
              {t({ en: "seats", ar: "مقاعد" })} · {room.focusMinutes}{" "}
              {t({ en: "min focus", ar: "دقيقة تركيز" })} / {room.restMinutes}{" "}
              {t({ en: "min break", ar: "دقيقة استراحة" })}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div
            className="room-action-flash"
            key={feedback}
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
          <RoomClock room={room} />
          <div className="room-seats">
            {room.members.map((m) => (
              <article
                key={m.userId}
                data-present={Date.now() - Date.parse(m.lastSeenAt) < 90000}
              >
                <span>{m.displayName.slice(0, 1)}</span>
                <strong>
                  {m.displayName}
                  {m.userId === room.hostId
                    ? " · " + t({ en: "Host", ar: "المضيف" })
                    : ""}
                </strong>
                <p>{m.goal}</p>
                <small>
                  {t(
                    Date.now() - Date.parse(m.lastSeenAt) < 90000
                      ? { en: "Here", ar: "حاضر" }
                      : { en: "Away", ar: "بعيد" },
                  )}
                </small>
              </article>
            ))}
            {Array.from(
              { length: Math.max(0, room.capacity - room.members.length) },
              (_, i) => (
                <div className="room-open-seat" key={"empty-" + i}>
                  <UsersRound size={24} aria-hidden="true" />
                  <strong>{t({ en: "Open seat", ar: "مقعد متاح" })}</strong>
                  <small>
                    {t({ en: "Invite a classmate", ar: "ادعُ زميلاً" })}
                  </small>
                </div>
              ),
            )}
          </div>
          {room.phase !== "finished" && room.hostId !== owner && (
            <p className="room-member-guidance">
              {t({
                en: "Your host controls the shared timer. Keep this room open to show your presence; the clock follows the session’s deadline.",
                ar: "يتحكم المضيف بالمؤقت المشترك. أبقِ الغرفة مفتوحة لعرض حضورك؛ يتبع المؤقت موعد الجلسة.",
              })}
            </p>
          )}
          <footer>
            {room.hostId === owner && room.phase !== "finished" && (
              <>
                <button
                  disabled={busy || room.phase !== "waiting"}
                  onClick={() =>
                    void action(() =>
                      service.advanceRoom(room.id, room.version, "start"),
                    )
                  }
                >
                  <Play size={17} />
                  {t({ en: "Start together", ar: "ابدأوا معاً" })}
                </button>
                <button
                  disabled={busy || room.phase !== "focus"}
                  onClick={() =>
                    void action(() =>
                      service.advanceRoom(room.id, room.version, "rest"),
                    )
                  }
                >
                  <Leaf size={17} />
                  {t({ en: "Start rest", ar: "ابدأ الاستراحة" })}
                </button>
                <button
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() =>
                    void action(() =>
                      service.advanceRoom(room.id, room.version, "finish"),
                    )
                  }
                >
                  {t({ en: "Finish session", ar: "إنهاء الجلسة" })}
                </button>
              </>
            )}
            {room.phase !== "finished" && (
              <>
                <button
                  data-copied={copied || undefined}
                  onClick={() => void copyInvite()}
                >
                  <Copy size={17} />
                  {t(
                    copied
                      ? { en: "Copied", ar: "نُسخت الدعوة" }
                      : { en: "Copy invite", ar: "نسخ الدعوة" },
                  )}
                </button>
                <code className="room-invite">{room.inviteCode}</code>
              </>
            )}
          </footer>
        </section>
      )}
      <Modal
        open={leaveConfirm}
        onClose={() => setLeaveConfirm(false)}
        title={t({
          en: "End the room for everyone?",
          ar: "إنهاء الغرفة للجميع؟",
        })}
        description={t({
          en: "Leaving as host closes the shared session and invalidates its invite. Other participants will see that the session has ended.",
          ar: "مغادرتك كمضيف تنهي الجلسة وتلغي الدعوة. سيرى المشاركون أن الجلسة انتهت.",
        })}
      >
        <div className="study-hub-actions">
          <button disabled={busy} onClick={() => setLeaveConfirm(false)}>
            {t({ en: "Stay in room", ar: "البقاء في الغرفة" })}
          </button>
          <button
            disabled={busy}
            className="sign-out-action"
            onClick={() => void leaveRoom()}
          >
            {t({ en: "End & leave", ar: "إنهاء ومغادرة" })}
          </button>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </main>
  );
}

import {
  ActionReceipt,
  useActionReceipt,
} from "../../components/feedback/ActionReceipt";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useCourses } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import {
  flyDeletedRecord,
  useStudyHub,
  useHubQuery,
  useStudyError,
} from "./useStudyHub";
import type {
  RecallCard,
  RecallGrade,
  RecallInput,
} from "../../types/study-hub";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { offerUndo } from "../../components/feedback/undo-action";
import { AppLink } from "../../components/navigation/AppLink";
import { Plus, Trash2, Pencil, Brain } from "lucide-react";
import "./study-hub.css";
export default function RecallDeskPage() {
  const feedback = useActionReceipt();
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    { owner, service, refresh } = useStudyHub(),
    errorText = useStudyError();
  const courses = useCourses();
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  const [course, setCourse] = useState(params.get("course") || "");
  const cards = useHubQuery(
      "recall",
      (signal) => service.listRecall(course || undefined, { signal }),
      course,
    ),
    history = useHubQuery("reviews", (signal) =>
      service.listReviews({ signal }),
    );
  const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState<string | null>(null),
    [editing, setEditing] = useState<RecallCard | null | undefined>(undefined),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [draft, setDraft] = useState<RecallInput>({
      courseId: course,
      prompt: "",
      answer: "",
    });
  const due = (cards.data || [])
    .filter((c) => Date.parse(c.dueAt) <= Date.now())
    .sort((a, b) => a.dueAt.localeCompare(b.dueAt));
  const current = due[0];
  async function action(fn: () => Promise<unknown>) {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await fn();
      await refresh();
      feedback.flash("saved");
    } catch (e) {
      toast.error(errorText(e));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  function edit(c: RecallCard | null) {
    setEditing(c);
    setDraft(
      c
        ? {
            courseId: c.courseId,
            prompt: c.prompt,
            answer: c.answer,
            source: c.source,
          }
        : {
            courseId: course || courses.data?.[0]?.id || "",
            prompt: "",
            answer: "",
          },
    );
  }
  return (
    <main className="container study-hub">
      <header className="study-hub-heading">
        <span className="study-hub-action-receipt">
          <ActionReceipt receipt={feedback.receipt} />
        </span>
        <AppLink href="/my/study" className="text-link">
          ← {t({ en: "Study desk", ar: "مكتب الدراسة" })}
        </AppLink>
        <h1 data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>
          {t({ en: "Active recall", ar: "المراجعة النشطة" })}
        </h1>
        <p>
          {t({
            en: "Your own questions, a calm review queue. Ratings describe this recall attempt, not your ability.",
            ar: "أسئلتك الخاصة ومراجعات هادئة. التقييم يصف محاولة الاسترجاع ولا يقيس قدراتك.",
          })}
        </p>
      </header>
      <div className="study-hub-actions">
        <label>
          {t({ en: "Course", ar: "المساق" })}
          <select
            value={course}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setCourse(e.target.value);
              setRevealed(null);
            }}
          >
            <option value="">
              {t({ en: "All courses", ar: "كل المساقات" })}
            </option>
            {courses.data?.map((c) => (
              <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                {t(c.title)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <button className="button button-primary" onClick={() => edit(null)}>
          <Plus size={18} />
          {t({ en: "New recall card", ar: "بطاقة جديدة" })}
        </button>
      </div>
      {cards.isPending ? (
        <p role="status">
          {t({ en: "Loading your cards…", ar: "جار تحميل بطاقاتك…" })}
        </p>
      ) : cards.isError ? (
        <button onClick={() => void cards.refetch()}>
          {t({ en: "Retry", ar: "حاول مجدداً" })}
        </button>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="study-metrics">
            <span>
              <b>{due.length}</b>
              {t({ en: "Due now", ar: "للمراجعة الآن" })}
            </span>
            <span>
              <b>{cards.data?.length || 0}</b>
              {t({ en: "Your cards", ar: "بطاقاتك" })}
            </span>
            <span>
              <b>{history.data?.length || 0}</b>
              {t({ en: "Recorded reviews", ar: "المراجعات المسجلة" })}
            </span>
          </div>
          <section
            className="recall-stage"
            key={current?.id || "clear"}
            aria-live="polite"
          >
            <Brain size={28} aria-hidden="true" />
            {current ? (
              <>
                <small>
                  {courses.data?.find((c) => c.id === current.courseId) &&
                    t(
                      courses.data.find((c) => c.id === current.courseId)!
                        .title,
                    )}
                </small>
                <h2>{current.prompt}</h2>
                {revealed === current.id ? (
                  <>
                    <p className="recall-answer">{current.answer}</p>
                    {current.source && (
                      <p className="study-source-note">
                        {t({ en: "Source page", ar: "صفحة المصدر" })}{" "}
                        {current.source.page}
                      </p>
                    )}
                    <div className="recall-grades">
                      {(["again", "hard", "good", "easy"] as RecallGrade[]).map(
                        (grade, i) => (
                          <button
                            disabled={busy}
                            key={grade}
                            onClick={() =>
                              void action(async () => {
                                await service.reviewRecall(
                                  current.id,
                                  current.version,
                                  grade,
                                  crypto.randomUUID(),
                                );
                                setRevealed(null);
                                toast.success(
                                  t({
                                    en: "Next review scheduled",
                                    ar: "تم تحديد المراجعة التالية",
                                  }),
                                );
                              })
                            }
                          >
                            {t(
                              [
                                { en: "Again", ar: "مرة أخرى" },
                                { en: "Hard", ar: "صعب" },
                                { en: "Good", ar: "جيد" },
                                { en: "Easy", ar: "سهل" },
                              ][i],
                            )}
                          </button>
                        ),
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    className="button button-primary"
                    onClick={() => setRevealed(current.id)}
                  >
                    {t({ en: "Reveal answer", ar: "اكشف الإجابة" })}
                  </button>
                )}
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <h2>{t({ en: "A clear desk.", ar: "مكتبك هادئ." })}</h2>
                <p>
                  {t({
                    en: "No cards due. Create one from a PDF margin note or add your own question.",
                    ar: "لا توجد بطاقات مستحقة. أنشئ بطاقة من الهامش أو أضف سؤالك.",
                  })}
                </p>
              </>
            )}
          </section>
          <section>
            <h2>{t({ en: "Your card collection", ar: "مجموعة بطاقاتك" })}</h2>
            <div className="study-record-list">
              {cards.data?.map((c) => (
                <article data-recall-id={c.id} key={c.id}>
                  <div>
                    <strong>{c.prompt}</strong>
                    <small>
                      {t({ en: "Next review", ar: "المراجعة التالية" })} ·{" "}
                      {new Date(c.dueAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </small>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    aria-label={t({ en: "Edit card", ar: "تعديل البطاقة" })}
                    onClick={() => edit(c)}
                  >
                    <Pencil size={18} />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    disabled={busy}
                    aria-label={t({ en: "Delete card", ar: "حذف البطاقة" })}
                    onClick={() =>
                      void action(async () => {
                        await service.deleteRecall(c.id, c.version);
                        flyDeletedRecord("data-recall-id", c.id, c.prompt);
                        offerUndo({
                          message: t({
                            en: "Card removed",
                            ar: "حُذفت البطاقة",
                          }),
                          label: t({ en: "Undo", ar: "تراجع" }),
                          restored: t({
                            en: "Card restored",
                            ar: "استعيدت البطاقة",
                          }),
                          failed: t({
                            en: "Could not restore card",
                            ar: "تعذرت الاستعادة",
                          }),
                          undo: async () => {
                            await service.restoreRecall(c);
                            await refresh();
                          },
                          canRestore: () => !!owner,
                        });
                      })
                    }
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={18} />
                  </button>
                </article>
              ))}
            </div>
          </section>
        </>
      )}
      {editing !== undefined && (
        <section
          className="study-editor"
          aria-label={t({
            en: "Recall card editor",
            ar: "محرر بطاقة الاسترجاع",
          })}
        >
          <form
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              void action(async () => {
                const before = editing;
                const saved = await service.saveRecall(
                  draft,
                  editing
                    ? { id: editing.id, version: editing.version }
                    : undefined,
                );
                if (before)
                  offerUndo({
                    message: t({ en: "Card updated", ar: "حُدثت البطاقة" }),
                    label: t({ en: "Undo", ar: "تراجع" }),
                    restored: t({
                      en: "Previous card restored",
                      ar: "استعيدت البطاقة",
                    }),
                    failed: t({
                      en: "This card changed; reload it.",
                      ar: "تغيرت البطاقة؛ أعد تحميلها.",
                    }),
                    undo: async () => {
                      await service.saveRecall(before, {
                        id: saved.id,
                        version: saved.version,
                      });
                      await refresh();
                    },
                  });
                setEditing(undefined);
                toast.success(t({ en: "Card saved", ar: "حُفظت البطاقة" }));
              });
            }}
          >
            <h2>
              {t({
                en: "One question. One clear answer.",
                ar: "سؤال واحد وإجابة واضحة.",
              })}
            </h2>
            <label>
              {t({ en: "Course", ar: "المساق" })}
              <select
                required
                value={draft.courseId}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setDraft({ ...draft, courseId: e.target.value })
                }
              >
                <option value="" disabled>
                  —
                </option>
                {courses.data?.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                    {t(c.title)}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <label>
              {t({ en: "Question", ar: "السؤال" })}
              <textarea
                required
                minLength={3}
                maxLength={600}
                value={draft.prompt}
                onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, prompt: e.target.value })}
              />
            </label>
            <label>
              {t({ en: "Answer", ar: "الإجابة" })}
              <textarea
                required
                maxLength={3000}
                value={draft.answer}
                onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, answer: e.target.value })}
              />
            </label>
            <div>
              <button className="button button-primary" disabled={busy}>
                {t({ en: "Save card", ar: "حفظ البطاقة" })}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="button"
                onClick={() => setEditing(undefined)}
              >
                {t({ en: "Cancel", ar: "إلغاء" })}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </section>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

FILE: src/features/study-hub/SharedPortfolioPage.tsx
============================================================
import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useServices } from "../../app/providers/ServicesProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import "./study-hub.css";
export default function SharedPortfolioPage() {
  const { shareToken = "" } = useParams(),
    services = useServices(),
    { t } = useLocale();
  const portfolio = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["public-portfolio", shareToken],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) =>
      services.studyHub!.sharedPortfolio(shareToken, { signal }),
    retry: false,
    staleTime: 0,
  });
  return (
    <main className="container study-hub">
      <header className="study-hub-heading">
        <h1 data-page-heading tabIndex={-1}>
          {t({ en: "Verified campus portfolio", ar: "ملف الإنجازات المعتمد" })}
        </h1>
        {portfolio.data && <h2>{portfolio.data.displayName}</h2>}
      </header>
      {portfolio.isPending ? (
        <p role="status">
          {t({ en: "Checking shared record…", ar: "جار التحقق من السجل…" })}
        </p>
      ) : portfolio.isError ? (
        <p role="alert">
          {t({
            en: "This shared portfolio is unavailable or has been revoked.",
            ar: "الملف غير متاح أو أُلغيت مشاركته.",
          })}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <>
          {portfolio.data.source === "device-preview" && (
            <p className="study-source-note">
              {t({
                en: "Device-preview verification. This is not an institutional credential.",
                ar: "اعتماد معاينة محلية وليس شهادة مؤسسية.",
              })}
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="portfolio-grid">
            {portfolio.data.claims.map((c) => (
              <article className="portfolio-record" key={c.id}>
                <ShieldCheck size={22} />
                <h2>{c.title}</h2>
                <p>{c.description}</p>
                <small>
                  {c.occurredAt}
                  {c.hours
                    ? " · " + c.hours + " " + t({ en: "hours", ar: "ساعة" })
                    : ""}
                </small>
                <span className="study-status">
                  {t({ en: "Verified", ar: "معتمد" })}
                </span>
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
          {portfolio.data.claims.length === 0 && (
            <p>
              {t({
                en: "No verified achievements have been shared yet.",
                ar: "لم تُشارك إنجازات معتمدة بعد.",
              })}
            </p>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Plus, Trash2, Calculator, Undo2, Redo2 } from "lucide-react";

import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";

import { calculateGpa, emptyGpa, normalizeGpa, type GpaDraft } from "./gpa";

export function GpaCalculator() {
  const { snapshot } = useAuth();
  const userId =
    snapshot.status === "authenticated" ? snapshot.user?.id : undefined;

function CalculatorForm({ userId }: { userId?: string }) {
  const { t } = useLocale(),
    key = userId ? "medclub:gpa:v1:" + encodeURIComponent(userId) : null;
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<GpaDraft>(() => {
    try {
      return key
        ? normalizeGpa(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "null"))
        : emptyGpa();
    } catch {
      return emptyGpa();
    }
  });
  const [storageFailed, setStorageFailed] = useState(false),
    [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const current = useRef(draft),
    alive = useRef(true);
  current.current = draft;
  const past = useRef<GpaDraft[]>([]),
    future = useRef<GpaDraft[]>([]);
  const beforeFocus = useRef<GpaDraft | null>(null);
  const [historyVersion, setHistoryVersion] = useState(0);
  const removing = useRef(new Set<string>());
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);
  const checkpoint = (before: GpaDraft) => {
    past.current = [...past.current.slice(-19), structuredClone(before)];
    future.current = [];
    setHistoryVersion((value) => value + 1);
  };
  const apply = (next: GpaDraft) => {
    current.current = next;
    setDraft(next);
    setDirty(true);
  };
  const result = calculateGpa(draft);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!key || !dirty) return;
    const save = () => {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(current.current));
        setStorageFailed(false);
      } catch {
        setStorageFailed(true);
      }
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(save, 400);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(current.current));
      } catch {
        /* Failure is shown while mounted. */
      }
    };
  }, [key, draft, dirty]);
  const update = (change: Partial<GpaDraft>) => {
    apply({ ...current.current, ...change });
  };
  const pendingEdit =
    !!beforeFocus.current &&
    JSON.stringify(beforeFocus.current) !== JSON.stringify(draft);
  return (
    <section
      className="gpa-calculator"
      data-history-version={historyVersion}
      onFocusCapture={(event) => {
        if (event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement)
          beforeFocus.current = structuredClone(current.current);
      }}
      onBlurCapture={(event) => {
        if (!(event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement)) return;
        if (
          beforeFocus.current &&
          JSON.stringify(beforeFocus.current) !==
            JSON.stringify(current.current)
        )
          checkpoint(beforeFocus.current);
        beforeFocus.current = null;
      }}
      aria-label={t({ en: "GPA calculator", ar: "حاسبة المعدّل" })}
    >
      <header>
        <Calculator size={22} />
        <h3>{t({ en: "GPA calculator", ar: "حاسبة المعدّل" })}</h3>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="notebook-icon-button"
          disabled={!past.current.length && !pendingEdit}
          aria-label={t({
            en: "Undo GPA change",
            ar: "تراجع عن تعديل المعدّل",
          })}
          onClick={() => {
            if (
              beforeFocus.current &&
              JSON.stringify(beforeFocus.current) !==
                JSON.stringify(current.current)
            )
              checkpoint(beforeFocus.current);
            beforeFocus.current = null;
            const previous = past.current.pop();
            if (!previous) return;
            future.current.push(structuredClone(current.current));
            apply(previous);
            setHistoryVersion((value) => value + 1);
          }}
        >
          <Undo2 size={16} />
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="notebook-icon-button"
          disabled={!future.current.length || pendingEdit}
          aria-label={t({ en: "Redo GPA change", ar: "إعادة تعديل المعدّل" })}
          onClick={() => {
            const next = future.current.pop();
            if (!next) return;
            past.current.push(structuredClone(current.current));
            apply(next);
            setHistoryVersion((value) => value + 1);
          }}
        >
          <Redo2 size={16} />
        </button>
      </header>
      <p>
        {t({
          en: "Enter grade points from your institution’s scale. This is a planning estimate, not an official transcript.",
          ar: "أدخل نقاط الدرجات بحسب نظام جامعتك. هذه حاسبة للتخطيط وليست كشف درجات رسمياً.",
        })}
      </p>
      <label>
        {t({ en: "Maximum grade points", ar: "أعلى نقاط للدرجة" })}
        <input
          type="number"
          inputMode="decimal"
          min={1}
          max={10}
          step="any"
          value={draft.scale}
          onChange={(event) => update({ scale: event.target.value })}
          aria-invalid={result.errors.includes("scale") || undefined}
        />
      </label>
      <div className="gpa-rows">
        {draft.rows.map((row, index) => (
          <fieldset
            key={row.id}
            className="gpa-row"
            data-gpa-course={row.id}
            disabled={false}
          >
            <legend>
              {t({ en: "Course ", ar: "مساق " })}
              {index + 1}
            </legend>
            <label>
              {t({ en: "Name (optional)", ar: "الاسم (اختياري)" })}
              <input
                value={row.name}
                maxLength={150}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  update({
                    rows: draft.rows.map((item) =>
                      item.id === row.id
                        ? { ...item, name: event.target.value }
                        : item,
                    ),
                  })
                }
              />
            </label>
            <label>
              {t({ en: "Credits", ar: "الساعات" })}
              <input
                type="number"
                inputMode="decimal"
                min={0.01}
                max={100}
                step="any"
                value={row.credits}
                disabled={row.excluded}
                aria-invalid={result.errors.includes(row.id) || undefined}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  update({
                    rows: draft.rows.map((item) =>
                      item.id === row.id
                        ? { ...item, credits: event.target.value }
                        : item,
                    ),
                  })
                }
              />
            </label>
            <label>
              {t({ en: "Grade points", ar: "نقاط الدرجة" })}
              <input
                type="number"
                inputMode="decimal"
                min={0}
                max={Number(draft.scale) || 4}
                step="any"
                value={row.points}
                disabled={row.excluded}
                aria-invalid={result.errors.includes(row.id) || undefined}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  update({
                    rows: draft.rows.map((item) =>
                      item.id === row.id
                        ? { ...item, points: event.target.value }
                        : item,
                    ),
                  })
                }
              />
            </label>
            <label className="gpa-exclude">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={row.excluded}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  update({
                    rows: draft.rows.map((item) =>
                      item.id === row.id
                        ? { ...item, excluded: event.target.checked }
                        : item,
                    ),
                  })
                }
              />
              {t({
                en: "Exclude (pass/fail, withdrawn)",
                ar: "استبعاد (ناجح/راسب، منسحب)",
              })}
            </label>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label={
                t({ en: "Remove course ", ar: "حذف المساق " }) + (index + 1)
              }
              onClick={async (event) => {
                if (removing.current.has(row.id)) return;
                removing.current.add(row.id);
                const flight = throwToTrash(
                  event.currentTarget.closest<HTMLElement>(".gpa-row"),
                  row.name || t({ en: "GPA course", ar: "مساق المعدّل" }),
                );
                if (flight.animated) await flight.finished;
                if (!alive.current) return;
                removing.current.delete(row.id);
                if (!current.current.rows.some((item) => item.id === row.id))
                  return;
                checkpoint(current.current);
                update({
                  rows: current.current.rows.filter(
                    (item) => item.id !== row.id,
                  ),
                });
              }}
            >
              <Trash2 size={16} />
            </button>
          </fieldset>
        ))}
      </div>
      <button
        type="button"
        className="student-tool-primary"
        disabled={draft.rows.length >= 100}
        onClick={() => {
          checkpoint(current.current);
          update({
            rows: [
              ...draft.rows,
              {
                id: crypto.randomUUID(),
                name: "",
                credits: "",
                points: "",
                excluded: false,
              },
            ],
          });
        }}
      >
        <Plus size={16} />
        {t({ en: "Add course", ar: "إضافة مساق" })}
      </button>
      <details className="gpa-prior">
        <summary>
          {t({
            en: "Include previous cumulative GPA",
            ar: "إضافة المعدّل التراكمي السابق",
          })}
        </summary>
        <label>
          {t({ en: "Previous credits", ar: "الساعات السابقة" })}
          <input
            type="number"
            inputMode="decimal"
            min={0}
            max={10000}
            step="any"
            value={draft.priorCredits}
            onChange={(event) => update({ priorCredits: event.target.value })}
          />
        </label>
        <label>
          {t({ en: "Previous GPA", ar: "المعدّل السابق" })}
          <input
            type="number"
            inputMode="decimal"
            min={0}
            max={Number(draft.scale) || 4}
            step="any"
            value={draft.priorGpa}
            onChange={(event) => update({ priorGpa: event.target.value })}
          />
        </label>
      </details>
      {!result.valid && (
        <p role="alert">
          {t({
            en: "Check the marked values. Credits must be positive and points within your selected scale.",
            ar: "تحقق من القيم المحددة. يجب أن تكون الساعات موجبة والنقاط ضمن المقياس المختار.",
          })}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="gpa-results" aria-live="polite">
        <span>
          {t({ en: "Term GPA", ar: "المعدّل الفصلي" })}
          <output>{result.term?.toFixed(3) ?? "—"}</output>
        </span>
        <span>
          {t({ en: "Cumulative GPA", ar: "المعدّل التراكمي" })}
          <output>{result.cumulative?.toFixed(3) ?? "—"}</output>
        </span>
      </div>
      <small role="status">
        {t(
          storageFailed
            ? {
                en: "Storage unavailable. Copy your result before leaving.",
                ar: "التخزين غير متاح. انسخ نتيجتك قبل المغادرة.",
              }
            : key
              ? {
                  en: "Planning inputs stay private to your account on this device.",
                  ar: "مدخلات التخطيط خاصة بحسابك على هذا الجهاز.",
                }
              : {
                  en: "Try the calculator here. Sign in to keep your inputs on this device.",
                  ar: "جرّب الحاسبة هنا. سجّل الدخول لحفظ مدخلاتك على هذا الجهاز.",
                },
        )}
      </small>
    </section>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties } from "react";
import { Brain, Pencil, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import type { StudentNote } from "./student-notes";

export function noteSwipeResult(
  distance: number,
  width: number,
): "closed" | "reveal" | "delete" {
  if (distance >= Math.max(140, width * 0.8)) return "delete";
  return distance >= 32 ? "reveal" : "closed";
}
export function NoteCard({
  note,
  courseTitle,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  removing,
  onOpen,
  linked = false,
  color,
  fileTitle,
  outdated,
  onRecall,
  busy = false,
}: {
  note: StudentNote;
  courseTitle?: string;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void | Promise<void>;
  removing: boolean;
  onOpen?: () => void;
  linked?: boolean;
  color?: "amber" | "mint" | "rose";
  fileTitle?: string;
  outdated?: boolean;
  onRecall?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  busy?: boolean;
}) {
  const { t, locale } = useLocale();
  const [offset, setOffset] = useState(0),
    [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const gesture = useRef<{
    id: number;
    x: number;
    y: number;
    width: number;
    start: number;
    horizontal: boolean;
  } | null>(null);
  const suppress = useRef(0),
    wasRemoving = useRef(removing);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (wasRemoving.current && !removing) setOffset(0);
    wasRemoving.current = removing;
  }, [removing]);
  return (
    <article
      className="student-note-row"
      data-note-id={note.id}
      tabIndex={onOpen ? undefined : 0}
      data-note-type={linked ? "course" : "general"}
      data-note-color={color}
      data-removing={removing || undefined}
      data-swiping={dragging || undefined}
      style={{ "--note-swipe": `${offset}px` } as CSSProperties}
      onClickCapture={(event) => {
        if (event.detail > 0 && Date.now() < suppress.current) {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopPropagation();
        }
      }}
      onPointerDown={(event) => {
        if (
          event.pointerType !== "touch" ||
          removing ||
          (event.target as HTMLElement).closest(".note-swipe-delete")
        )
          return;
        gesture.current = {
          id: event.pointerId,
          x: event.clientX,
          y: event.clientY,
          width: event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect().width || 280,
          start: offset,
          horizontal: false,
        };
      }}
      onPointerMove={(event) => {
        const current = gesture.current;
        if (!current || current.id !== event.pointerId) return;
        const dx = event.clientX - current.x,
          dy = event.clientY - current.y;
        if (!current.horizontal) {
          if (window.getSelection()?.isCollapsed === false) {
            gesture.current = null;
            return;
          }
          if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 10) {
            gesture.current = null;
            return;
          }
          if (Math.abs(dx) < 10 || Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(dy) * 1.3) return;
          current.horizontal = true;
          event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
          setDragging(true);
        }
        event.preventDefault();
        setOffset(Math.max(-current.width, Math.min(0, current.start + dx)));
      }}
      onPointerUp={(event) => {
        const current = gesture.current;
        if (!current || current.id !== event.pointerId) return;
        gesture.current = null;
        setDragging(false);
        if (!current.horizontal) return;
        event.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
        suppress.current = Date.now() + 300;
        const result = noteSwipeResult(
          Math.max(0, -(current.start + event.clientX - current.x)),
          current.width,
        );
        if (result === "delete") {
          setOffset(-current.width);
          Promise.resolve(onDelete()).then(
            () => setOffset(0),
            () => setOffset(0),
          );
        } else setOffset(result === "reveal" ? -72 : 0);
      }}
      onPointerCancel={() => {
        gesture.current = null;
        setDragging(false);
        setOffset(0);
      }}
      onKeyDown={(event) => {
        if (event.key === "Escape") {
          setOffset(0);
        }
      }}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        className="note-swipe-delete"
        hidden={offset === 0}
        disabled={removing || busy}
        aria-label={t({ en: "Delete note", ar: "حذف الملاحظة" })}
        onClick={onDelete}
      >
        <Trash2 size={18} />
      </button>
      <div className="student-note-face">
        <div className="student-note-copy">
        {onOpen ? <button type="button" className="student-note-open" onClick={onOpen}>
          <strong>
            {note.title || t({ en: "Untitled note", ar: "ملاحظة بلا عنوان" })}
          </strong>
          <p>{note.body || t({ en: "No description", ar: "لا يوجد وصف" })}</p>
          <small>{fileTitle}</small>
          <small>
            {courseTitle || t({ en: "General", ar: "عامة" })} ·{" "}
            {new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
              month: "short",
              day: "numeric",
            }).format(new Date(note.updatedAt))}
          </small>
        </button> : <div className="student-note-text">
          {note.title && <strong>{note.title}</strong>}
          <p tabIndex={note.body.length > 500 ? 0 : undefined}>{note.body || t({ en: "No description", ar: "لا يوجد وصف" })}</p>
          <small>{courseTitle || t({ en: "General note", ar: "ملاحظة عامة" })}</small>
        </div>}
        {outdated && <small className="note-revision-warning">{t({ en: "Earlier PDF revision", ar: "إصدار PDF سابق" })}</small>}
        </div>
        <div className="student-note-item-actions">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="student-note-edit"
          onClick={onEdit}
          disabled={removing || busy}
          title={t({ en: "Edit note", ar: "تعديل الملاحظة" })}
          aria-label={
            t({ en: "Edit note", ar: "تعديل الملاحظة" }) +
            ": " +
            (note.title || t({ en: "Untitled note", ar: "ملاحظة بلا عنوان" }))
          }
        >
          <Pencil size={16} />
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="student-note-item-delete" disabled={removing || busy} onClick={onDelete}
          aria-label={t({ en: "Delete note", ar: "حذف الملاحظة" })} title={t({ en: "Delete note", ar: "حذف الملاحظة" })}><Trash2 size={16} /></button>
        {onRecall && <button type="button" disabled={removing || busy} onClick={onRecall} aria-label={t({ en: "Create recall card", ar: "إنشاء بطاقة استرجاع" })} title={t({ en: "Create recall card", ar: "إنشاء بطاقة استرجاع" })}><Brain size={16} /></button>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}
