function NotesWorkspace({ userId, courseId, legacyKey, reference, onlyCourse = false, resources: supplied = [], reader, request, onOpenAnchor }: NotesProps & { userId: string }) {
  const { t } = useLocale(), courses = useCourses(), resources = useResources();
  const services = useServices(), hub = useStudyHub(), errorText = useStudyError();
  const paths = useWorkspacePaths(), navigate = useNavigate(), feedback = useActionReceipt();
  const fieldId = useId();
  const courseItems: Course[] = courses.data || [];
  const remoteItems: Resource[] = resources.data || [];
  const margins = useHubQuery("margins", (signal) => hub.service.listMargins(undefined, { signal }), "all");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState(() => readNotes(userId));
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Draft | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false), [removing, setRemoving] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState(""), [limit, setLimit] = useState(20);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState(""), [discard, setDiscard] = useState(false);
  const [storageError, setStorageError] = useState(false), [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const root = useRef<HTMLElement>(null), alive = useRef(true), writing = useRef(false);
  const failedAutosave = useRef("");
  const currentDraft = useRef(draft); currentDraft.current = draft;
  const previousEditor = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const local = useLocalCoursePdfs(draft?.courseId || courseId || "");
  const candidates = [...new Map([
    ...(request ? [request.resource] : []), ...(reader ? [reader.resource] : []),
    ...remoteItems, ...local.resources, ...supplied,
  ].map((item) => [item.id, item])).values()];
  const selected = draft?.kind === "course" ? candidates.find((item) => item.id === draft.resourceId && item.courseId === draft.courseId) : undefined;
  const knownCount = selected && reader && reader.id === selected.id && reader.resource.updatedAt === selected.updatedAt
    ? reader.pageCount : selected && request && request.resource.id === selected.id && request.resource.updatedAt === selected.updatedAt ? request.pageCount : undefined;
  const pdf = useNotePdfCount(selected, knownCount);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => { alive.current = false; };
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    const refresh = () => {
      try { localStorage.getItem(notesKey(userId)); setStorageError(false); }
      catch { setStorageError(true); }
      setNotes(readNotes(userId));
    };
    try { if (courseId && legacyKey) migrateCourseNote(userId, courseId, legacyKey); }
    catch { setStorageError(true); }
    refresh();
    const storage = (event: StorageEvent) => { if (event.key === notesKey(userId) || event.key === null) refresh(); };
    const updated = (event: Event) => { if ((event as CustomEvent).detail === notesKey(userId)) refresh(); };
    window.addEventListener("storage", storage); window.addEventListener("medclub:notes-updated", updated);
    return () => { window.removeEventListener("storage", storage); window.removeEventListener("medclub:notes-updated", updated); };
  }, [userId, courseId, legacyKey]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!request) return;
    if (currentDraft.current?.dirty) {
      setMessage(t({ en: "Save or cancel your current draft, then press Add note again. Your draft has been kept.", ar: "احفظ المسودة الحالية أو ألغها ثم اضغط إضافة ملاحظة مجدداً. احتفظنا بمسودتك." }));
      return;
    }
    setDraft({ key: crypto.randomUUID(), kind: "course", title: "", body: "", courseId: request.courseId,
      resourceId: request.anchor.resourceId, revision: request.anchor.resourceRevision, page: String(request.anchor.page),
      anchor: request.anchor, color: "amber", dirty: false });
    setErrors({}); setDiscard(false); setMessage("");
  }, [request?.token]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const previous = previousEditor.current;
    previousEditor.current = draft?.key || null;
    if (!draft) {
      if (!previous) return;
      const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const row = [...(root.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".student-note-row") || [])].find((item) => item.dataset.noteId === previous);
        (row?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(".student-note-open") || row || root.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(".student-note-add"))?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      });
      return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    const frame = requestAnimationFrame(() => root.current?.querySelector<HTMLTextAreaElement>("textarea")?.focus({ preventScroll: true }));
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  }, [draft?.key]);

  async function ensureOwner() {
    const auth = await services.auth.getSnapshot();
    if (auth.status !== "authenticated" || auth.user?.id !== userId) throw new Error("NOTE_ACCOUNT_CHANGED");
  }
  function patch(change: Partial<Draft>) {
    failedAutosave.current = "";
    setDraft((old) => old ? { ...old, ...change, dirty: true } : old);
    setErrors({}); setMessage("");
  }
  function create(kind: Draft["kind"] = "general") {
    if (draft?.dirty) { setMessage(t({ en: "Save or cancel your draft first.", ar: "احفظ المسودة أو ألغها أولاً." })); return; }
    setDraft({ key: crypto.randomUUID(), kind, title: "", body: "", courseId: courseId || "", resourceId: "", revision: "", page: "1", color: "amber", dirty: false });
    setErrors({}); setDiscard(false); setMessage("");
  }
  function edit(note: StudentNote | MarginNote) {
    if (draft?.dirty) { setMessage(t({ en: "Save or cancel your draft first.", ar: "احفظ المسودة أو ألغها أولاً." })); return; }
    const attached = isMargin(note);
    setDraft({ key: note.id, original: structuredClone(note), kind: attached ? "course" : "general",
      title: attached ? "" : note.title, body: note.body, courseId: note.courseId || courseId || "",
      resourceId: attached ? note.anchor.resourceId : "", revision: attached ? note.anchor.resourceRevision : "",
      page: attached ? String(note.anchor.page) : "1", anchor: attached ? note.anchor : undefined,
      color: attached ? note.color : "amber", dirty: false });
    setErrors({}); setDiscard(false); setMessage("");
  }
  function validation(snapshot: Draft) {
    const result: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (snapshot.body.length > (snapshot.kind === "course" ? 3000 : 25000)) result.body = t({ en: `Keep this note within ${snapshot.kind === "course" ? 3000 : 25000} characters. Your text has not been shortened.`, ar: `اجعل الملاحظة ضمن ${snapshot.kind === "course" ? 3000 : 25000} حرفاً. لم نختصر نصك.` });
    if (!snapshot.body.trim() && (snapshot.kind === "course" || !snapshot.title.trim())) result.body = t({ en: "Write a note before saving.", ar: "اكتب الملاحظة قبل الحفظ." });
    if (snapshot.kind === "course") {
      const problem = courseNoteError(snapshot.courseId, selected, snapshot.page, pdf.count, snapshot.revision || undefined);
      const text = problem === "course" ? t({ en: "Choose a course.", ar: "اختر مساقاً." })
        : problem === "pdf" ? t({ en: "Choose an available PDF from this course.", ar: "اختر ملف PDF متاحاً من هذا المساق." })
        : problem === "revision" ? t({ en: "This PDF has changed. Select its current version before saving.", ar: "تغيّر ملف PDF. اختر الإصدار الحالي قبل الحفظ." })
        : problem === "page" ? t({ en: "Enter a whole page number starting at 1.", ar: "أدخل رقم صفحة صحيحاً يبدأ من 1." })
        : problem === "range" ? t({ en: `Choose a page from 1 to ${Math.min(pdf.count || 1, 20000)}.`, ar: `اختر صفحة من 1 إلى ${Math.min(pdf.count || 1, 20000)}.` })
        : problem === "loading" ? t({ en: "Wait for the PDF page count, or retry if the file could not be opened.", ar: "انتظر عدد صفحات PDF أو أعد المحاولة إذا تعذر فتح الملف." }) : "";
      if (problem) result[problem === "course" ? "course" : problem === "page" || problem === "range" ? "page" : "pdf"] = text;
      if (!courseItems.some((item) => item.id === snapshot.courseId)) result.course = t({ en: "The selected course is unavailable. Reload the courses and choose again.", ar: "المساق المحدد غير متاح. أعد تحميل المساقات واختر مجدداً." });
    }
    return result;
  }
  async function save(close = true) {
    const snapshot = currentDraft.current;
    if (!snapshot || writing.current) return;
    const invalid = validation(snapshot);
    if (Object.keys(invalid).length) { setErrors(invalid); return; }
    writing.current = true; setBusy(true);
    try {
      await ensureOwner();
      const before = snapshot.original;
      let saved: StudentNote | MarginNote;
      if (snapshot.kind === "course") {
        const old = before && isMargin(before) ? before : undefined;
        const sameAnchor = snapshot.anchor && snapshot.anchor.resourceId === selected!.id && snapshot.anchor.resourceRevision === selected!.updatedAt && snapshot.anchor.page === Number(snapshot.page);
        saved = await hub.service.saveMargin({ courseId: snapshot.courseId, body: snapshot.body, color: snapshot.color,
          anchor: sameAnchor ? snapshot.anchor! : { resourceId: selected!.id, resourceRevision: selected!.updatedAt, page: Number(snapshot.page), x: .85, y: .1 } },
          old ? { id: old.id, version: old.version } : undefined);
        await hub.refresh();
      } else {
        if (before && !isMargin(before)) {
          const latest = readNotes(userId).find((item) => item.id === before.id);
          if (!latest || !sameSimpleNote(latest, before)) throw new Error("NOTE_CHANGED");
        }
        saved = { id: before?.id || snapshot.key, title: snapshot.title.trim(), body: snapshot.body,
          ...(before?.courseId || (onlyCourse && courseId) ? { courseId: before?.courseId || courseId } : {}), updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
        saveNote(userId, saved);
        if (alive.current) setNotes(readNotes(userId));
      }
      if (before) {
        const expected = saved;
        offerUndo({ message: t({ en: "Note updated", ar: "حُدثت الملاحظة" }), label: t({ en: "Undo", ar: "تراجع" }),
          restored: t({ en: "Previous note restored", ar: "استعيدت الملاحظة" }), failed: t({ en: "The note changed; it could not be restored.", ar: "تغيّرت الملاحظة؛ تعذّر التراجع." }),
          undo: async () => {
            await ensureOwner();
            if (isMargin(before) && isMargin(expected)) {
              await hub.service.saveMargin(before, { id: expected.id, version: expected.version }); await hub.refresh();
            } else if (!isMargin(before) && !isMargin(expected)) {
              const latest = readNotes(userId).find((item) => item.id === expected.id);
              if (!latest || !sameSimpleNote(latest, expected)) throw new Error("NOTE_CHANGED");
              saveNote(userId, before);
            }
          } });
      }
      if (alive.current) {
        feedback.flash("saved"); setMessage(t({ en: "Note saved", ar: "حُفظت الملاحظة" })); setErrors({});
        setDraft((current) => {
          if (!current || current.key !== snapshot.key) return current;
          const changed = contents(current) !== contents(snapshot);
          return close && !changed ? null : { ...current, original: saved, dirty: changed };
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      failedAutosave.current = contents(snapshot);
      if (error instanceof StudyError && error.code === "CONFLICT") void hub.refresh();
      if (alive.current) setNotes(readNotes(userId));
      if (alive.current) setMessage(error instanceof Error && /NOTE_CHANGED/.test(error.message)
        ? t({ en: "This note changed elsewhere. Your draft is kept; reload the saved note before editing it again.", ar: "تغيّرت الملاحظة في مكان آخر. احتفظنا بمسودتك؛ أعد تحميل الملاحظة المحفوظة قبل تعديلها مجدداً." })
        : error instanceof Error && error.message === "NOTE_ACCOUNT_CHANGED" ? t({ en: "Your account changed. Sign in again before saving.", ar: "تغير حسابك. سجّل الدخول مجدداً قبل الحفظ." })
        : error instanceof StudyError ? errorText(error) + " " + t({ en: "Your draft is kept.", ar: "احتفظنا بمسودتك." })
        : t({ en: "Could not save this note. Your draft is kept. Check the file and available storage, then retry.", ar: "تعذر حفظ الملاحظة. احتفظنا بمسودتك. تحقق من الملف والمساحة المتاحة ثم أعد المحاولة." }));
    } finally { writing.current = false; if (alive.current) setBusy(false); }
  }
  // Existing plain notes retain their quiet autosave; new notes and page attachments use Save.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!draft?.dirty || !draft.original || draft.kind !== "general" || busy || failedAutosave.current === contents(draft)) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => void save(false), 600);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [draft, busy]);
  async function erase(note: StudentNote | MarginNote) {
    if (writing.current) return;
    writing.current = true; setBusy(true); setRemoving(note.id);
    const face = [...(root.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-note-id]") || [])].find((item) => item.dataset.noteId === note.id) || null;
    try {
      await ensureOwner();
      if (isMargin(note)) await hub.service.deleteMargin(note.id, note.version);
      else {
        const latest = readNotes(userId).find((item) => item.id === note.id);
        if (!latest || !sameSimpleNote(latest, note)) throw new Error("NOTE_CHANGED");
        removeNote(userId, note.id);
      }
      void throwToTrash(face, isMargin(note) ? note.body.slice(0,80) : note.title || note.body.slice(0,80));
      offerUndo({ message: t({ en: "Note deleted", ar: "حُذفت الملاحظة" }), label: t({ en: "Undo", ar: "تراجع" }),
        restored: t({ en: "Note restored", ar: "استعيدت الملاحظة" }), failed: t({ en: "Could not restore the note.", ar: "تعذرت استعادة الملاحظة." }),
        undo: async () => { await ensureOwner(); if (isMargin(note)) { await hub.service.restoreMargin(note); await hub.refresh(); }
          else { if (readNotes(userId).some((item) => item.id === note.id)) throw new Error("NOTE_CHANGED"); saveNote(userId, note); } } });
      await hub.refresh();
      if (alive.current) setNotes(readNotes(userId));
    } catch (error) { toast.error(errorText(error)); }
    finally { writing.current = false; if (alive.current) { setRemoving(null); setBusy(false); } }
  }
  function open(note: MarginNote) {
    const resource = candidates.find((item) => item.id === note.anchor.resourceId);
    if (resource && !isNotePdf(resource)) {
      toast.error(t({ en: "This PDF is no longer available. The note is still saved.", ar: "ملف PDF لم يعد متاحاً. الملاحظة ما زالت محفوظة." })); return;
    }
    if (resource && (resource.courseId !== note.courseId || resource.updatedAt !== note.anchor.resourceRevision)) {
      toast.error(t({ en: "This note belongs to an earlier PDF revision. Its text is preserved; edit the attachment to use the current file.", ar: "ترتبط الملاحظة بإصدار PDF سابق. النص محفوظ؛ عدّل الربط لاستخدام الملف الحالي." })); return;
    }
    const course = courseItems.find((item) => item.id === note.courseId);
    if (!course) { toast.error(t({ en: "This course is unavailable.", ar: "هذا المساق غير متاح." })); return; }
    if (!resource && !/^(local-pdf-|personal-pdf-)/.test(note.anchor.resourceId)) {
      toast.error(t({ en: "This PDF is no longer available. The note is still saved.", ar: "ملف PDF لم يعد متاحاً. الملاحظة ما زالت محفوظة." })); return;
    }
    if (onOpenAnchor?.(note.anchor, note.courseId)) return;
    navigate(noteLocation(course.slug, note.anchor, paths.course));
  }
  const attached: MarginNote[] = margins.data || [];
  const all = useMemo(() => [...notes, ...attached].sort((a,b) => b.updatedAt.localeCompare(a.updatedAt)), [notes, margins.data]);
  const visible = useMemo(() => all.filter((note) => (!onlyCourse || note.courseId === courseId) &&
    `${isMargin(note) ? "" : note.title} ${note.body}`.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query.toLocaleLowerCase().trim())), [all, onlyCourse, courseId, query]);
  const fieldError = (key: string) => errors[key] ? <small id={`${fieldId}-${key}`} className="note-field-error" role="alert">{errors[key]}</small> : null;
  return <section ref={root} className="student-notes unified-notes" aria-label={t({ en: "Private notes", ar: "ملاحظات خاصة" })}>
    <div className="student-notes-top"><strong>{t({ en: "My notes", ar: "ملاحظاتي" })}</strong>
      <button type="button" className="student-note-add" aria-label={t({ en: "Add note", ar: "إضافة ملاحظة" })} title={t({ en: "Add note", ar: "إضافة ملاحظة" })} onClick={() => create()}><Plus size={19} className="note-add-plus" aria-hidden="true" /><svg className="note-add-sheet" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M14 3H5v18h14V8zM14 3v5h5M8 11h5M8 15h3" /></svg></button>
      <ActionReceipt receipt={feedback.receipt} />
    </div>
    {message && <p className="student-notes-receipt" role="status">{message}</p>}
    {storageError && <p role="alert">{t({ en: "Device storage is unavailable. Existing notes have not been replaced.", ar: "تخزين الجهاز غير متاح. لم نستبدل الملاحظات الحالية." })}</p>}
    {draft ? <form className="student-note-editor" data-note-color={draft.kind === "course" ? draft.color : undefined} noValidate onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); void save(); }}>
      <button type="button" className="student-note-back" disabled={busy} onClick={() => draft.dirty ? setDiscard(true) : setDraft(null)}><ArrowLeft size={16} />{t({ en: "All notes", ar: "كل الملاحظات" })}</button>
      {discard && <div className="note-discard-question" role="alert"><p>{t({ en: "Keep editing, save, or discard these unsaved changes?", ar: "متابعة التعديل أم الحفظ أم إلغاء التغييرات غير المحفوظة؟" })}</p>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setDiscard(false)}>{t({ en: "Keep editing", ar: "متابعة التعديل" })}</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => { setDraft(null); setDiscard(false); }}>{t({ en: "Discard changes", ar: "إلغاء التغييرات" })}</button>
      </div>}
      {!draft.original && <div className="note-type-picker" role="group" aria-label={t({ en: "Note type", ar: "نوع الملاحظة" })}>
        <button type="button" disabled={busy} aria-pressed={draft.kind === "general"} onClick={() => patch({ kind: "general" })}>{t({ en: "General", ar: "عامة" })}</button>
        <button type="button" disabled={busy} aria-pressed={draft.kind === "course"} onClick={() => patch({ kind: "course", body: draft.title.trim() ? draft.title.trim() + (draft.body ? "\n\n" + draft.body : "") : draft.body, title: "" })}>{t({ en: "Course PDF", ar: "PDF المساق" })}</button>
      </div>}
      {draft.kind === "general" ? <label>{t({ en: "Title (optional)", ar: "العنوان (اختياري)" })}<input maxLength={150} value={draft.title} onChange={(event) => patch({ title: event.target.value })} /></label>
        : <div className="note-attachment-fields">
          <label>{t({ en: "Course", ar: "المساق" })}<select value={draft.courseId} aria-invalid={!!errors.course} aria-describedby={errors.course ? `${fieldId}-course` : undefined} onChange={(event) => patch({ courseId: event.target.value, resourceId: "", revision: "", page: "1", anchor: undefined })}>
            <option value="">{t({ en: "Choose a course", ar: "اختر مساقاً" })}</option>{courseItems.map((item) => <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>{t(item.title)}</option>)}
          </select>{fieldError("course")}</label>
          <label>{t({ en: "PDF", ar: "ملف PDF" })}<select value={draft.resourceId} disabled={!draft.courseId || local.loading} aria-invalid={!!errors.pdf} aria-describedby={errors.pdf ? `${fieldId}-pdf` : undefined} onChange={(event) => { const item = candidates.find((value) => value.id === event.target.value); patch({ resourceId: item?.id || "", revision: item?.updatedAt || "", page: "1", anchor: undefined }); }}>
            <option value="">{t({ en: "Choose a PDF", ar: "اختر ملف PDF" })}</option>{candidates.filter((item) => item.courseId === draft.courseId && isNotePdf(item)).map((item) => <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>{t(item.title)}</option>)}
          </select>{fieldError("pdf")}</label>
          <label>{t({ en: "Page", ar: "الصفحة" })}<input type="number" inputMode="numeric" min="1" max={pdf.count ? Math.min(pdf.count, 20000) : undefined} step="1" value={draft.page} aria-invalid={!!errors.page} aria-describedby={errors.page ? `${fieldId}-page` : undefined} onChange={(event) => patch({ page: event.target.value })} />{fieldError("page")}</label>
          <p className="note-file-status" role="status">{pdf.pending ? t({ en: "Checking PDF pages…", ar: "جارٍ التحقق من صفحات PDF…" }) : pdf.count ? t({ en: `${pdf.count} pages`, ar: `${pdf.count} صفحات` }) : ""}</p>
          {pdf.error && <p className="note-field-error" role="alert">{t({ en: "This PDF could not be opened. If it is password-protected, open it in the reader first.", ar: "تعذر فتح PDF. إذا كان محمياً بكلمة مرور فافتحه في القارئ أولاً." })}<button type="button" onClick={pdf.retry}>{t({ en: "Retry", ar: "أعد المحاولة" })}</button></p>}
          {draft.revision && selected && draft.revision !== selected.updatedAt && <p role="alert">{t({ en: "This attachment points to an older file. Select the current PDF again to reattach it.", ar: "يشير الربط إلى ملف سابق. اختر ملف PDF الحالي مجدداً لإعادة الربط." })}<button type="button" onClick={() => patch({ revision: selected.updatedAt, anchor: undefined })}>{t({ en: "Use current PDF", ar: "استخدم PDF الحالي" })}</button></p>}
        </div>}
      {draft.anchor?.quote && <blockquote>{draft.anchor.quote}</blockquote>}
      <label>{t({ en: "Note", ar: "الملاحظة" })}<textarea rows={5} maxLength={draft.kind === "course" ? 3000 : 25000} value={draft.body} aria-invalid={!!errors.body} aria-describedby={errors.body ? `${fieldId}-body` : undefined} placeholder={t({ en: "Write your note…", ar: "اكتب ملاحظتك…" })} onChange={(event) => patch({ body: event.target.value })} />{fieldError("body")}</label>
      {draft.kind === "course" && <fieldset className="note-color-picker"><legend>{t({ en: "Note color", ar: "لون الملاحظة" })}</legend>
        {(["amber", "mint", "rose"] as const).map((color) => <label key={color} data-note-color={color} data-selected={draft.color === color || undefined}><input type="radio" name={`${fieldId}-note-color`} value={color} checked={draft.color === color} onChange={() => patch({ color })} /><span aria-hidden="true" />{t(color === "amber" ? { en: "Amber", ar: "كهرماني" } : color === "mint" ? { en: "Mint", ar: "نعناعي" } : { en: "Rose", ar: "وردي" })}</label>)}
      </fieldset>}
      {reference && draft.kind === "course" && <small className="study-note-reference">{reference}</small>}
      <div className="student-note-actions"><button type="submit" className="student-tool-primary" disabled={busy}><Save size={16} />{t(busy ? { en: "Saving…", ar: "جارٍ الحفظ…" } : { en: "Save note", ar: "حفظ الملاحظة" })}</button>
        <button type="button" aria-label={t({ en: "Download note", ar: "تنزيل الملاحظة" })} title={t({ en: "Download note", ar: "تنزيل الملاحظة" })} onClick={() => { const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([draft.title + "\n\n" + draft.body], { type: "text/plain;charset=utf-8" })); const link = document.createElement("a"); link.href = url; link.download = "medclub-note.txt"; link.click(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000); }}><Download size={16} /></button>
      </div>
    </form> : <div className="student-notes-list">
      {all.length > 4 && <input aria-label={t({ en: "Find a note", ar: "البحث عن ملاحظة" })} placeholder={t({ en: "Find a note…", ar: "ابحث عن ملاحظة…" })} value={query} onChange={(event) => { setQuery(event.target.value); setLimit(20); }} />}
      {visible.slice(0,limit).map((note) => { const linked = isMargin(note); const source = linked ? candidates.find((item) => item.id === note.anchor.resourceId) : undefined;
        const display: StudentNote = linked ? { id: note.id, title: t({ en: `Page ${note.anchor.page}`, ar: `صفحة ${note.anchor.page}` }), body: note.body, courseId: note.courseId, updatedAt: note.updatedAt } : note;
        const title = note.courseId ? courseItems.find((item) => item.id === note.courseId)?.title : undefined;
        return <NoteCard key={`${linked ? "pdf" : "general"}:${note.id}`} note={display} courseTitle={title ? t(title) : undefined}
          linked={linked} color={linked ? note.color : undefined} fileTitle={linked ? source ? t(source.title) : t({ en: "PDF currently unavailable", ar: "PDF غير متاح حالياً" }) : undefined}
          outdated={linked && !!source && source.updatedAt !== note.anchor.resourceRevision}
          onOpen={linked ? () => open(note) : undefined} onEdit={() => edit(note)} onDelete={() => erase(note)} removing={removing === note.id} busy={busy}
          onRecall={linked ? async () => { if (writing.current) return; writing.current = true; setBusy(true); try { await hub.service.saveRecall({ courseId: note.courseId, prompt: note.anchor.quote ? `Explain: ${note.anchor.quote.slice(0,180)}` : t({ en: "What do you remember about this point?", ar: "ماذا تتذكر عن هذه النقطة؟" }), answer: note.body, source: note.anchor }); await hub.refresh(); toast.success(t({ en: "Recall card created", ar: "أُنشئت بطاقة استرجاع" })); } catch (error) { toast.error(errorText(error)); } finally { writing.current = false; if (alive.current) setBusy(false); } } : undefined} />;
      })}
      {margins.isPending && <p role="status">{t({ en: "Loading attached notes…", ar: "جارٍ تحميل الملاحظات المرتبطة…" })}</p>}
      {margins.isError && <p role="alert">{t({ en: "PDF notes could not be loaded. General notes remain available.", ar: "تعذر تحميل ملاحظات PDF. الملاحظات العامة ما زالت متاحة." })}<button type="button" onClick={() => void margins.refetch()}>{t({ en: "Reload notes", ar: "أعد تحميل الملاحظات" })}</button></p>}
      {!visible.length && !margins.isPending && <p className="student-tool-empty">{t({ en: "No notes here yet. Add a general note or attach one to a course PDF.", ar: "لا توجد ملاحظات هنا بعد. أضف ملاحظة عامة أو اربطها بملف PDF للمساق." })}</p>}
      {visible.length > limit && <button type="button" className="student-note-more" onClick={() => setLimit((value) => value + 20)}>{t({ en: "Show more notes", ar: "عرض المزيد من الملاحظات" })}</button>}
    </div>}
    {(courses.isError || resources.isError) && <p role="alert">{t({ en: "Course or file choices could not be loaded.", ar: "تعذر تحميل خيارات المساقات أو الملفات." })}<button type="button" onClick={() => { void courses.refetch(); void resources.refetch(); }}>{t({ en: "Reload choices", ar: "أعد تحميل الخيارات" })}</button></p>}
  </section>;
}

FILE: src/features/utilities/StudyToolsPage.tsx

import { useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { NotebookPen, Timer, Calculator, Check } from "lucide-react";
import { StudentNotes } from "./StudentNotes";
import { GpaCalculator } from "./GpaCalculator";
import { LoadingState } from "../../components/feedback/LoadingState";
import { ErrorState } from "../../components/feedback/ErrorState";
import { useSiteContent } from "../../hooks/useContent";
import { useAuth } from "../../app/providers/AuthProvider";
import { useLocale } from "../../app/providers/LocaleProvider";
import { StudyTimerControls } from "../courses/StudyTimerControls";
import {
  emptyStudyTools,
  finishStudyTimer,
  normalizeStudyTools,
  timerRemaining,
} from "../courses/study-tools-state";
import { Checkbox } from "../../components/ui/checkbox";
import "../../styles/study-tools-desk.css";

type Tool = "timer" | "notes" | "gpa";
function Desk({
  duration,
  title,
  description,
}: {
  duration: number;
  title: string;
  description: string;
}) {
  const { snapshot } = useAuth();
  const userId =
    snapshot.status === "authenticated" ? snapshot.user!.id : "guest";
  return (
    <DeskSession
      key={userId}
      storageKey={`medclub:study-tools:${userId}:v1`}
      duration={duration}
      title={title}
      description={description}
    />
  );
}
function DeskSession({
  storageKey,
  duration,
  title,
  description,
}: {
  storageKey: string;
  duration: number;
  title: string;
  description: string;
}) {
  const { t } = useLocale();
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  const requested = params.get("tool");
  const initialTool: Tool = requested === "notes" || requested === "gpa" ? requested : "timer";
  const [active, setActive] = useState<Tool>(initialTool),
    [visited, setVisited] = useState<Tool[]>([initialTool]);
  const [timer, setTimer] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
      if (raw) return normalizeStudyTools({ timer: JSON.parse(raw) }).timer;
    } catch {}
    return {
      ...emptyStudyTools().timer,
      minutes: Math.max(1, Math.min(180, Math.ceil(duration / 60))),
      remaining: duration,
    };
  });
  const [now, setNow] = useState(Date.now()),
    [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [noticeToken, setNoticeToken] = useState(0);
  const current = useRef(timer);
  current.current = timer;
  useEffect(() => {
    const flush = () => {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(current.current));
      } catch {}
    };
    const timeout = setTimeout(flush, 350);
    window.addEventListener("pagehide", flush);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      flush();
      window.removeEventListener("pagehide", flush);
    };
  }, [timer, storageKey]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (timer.startedAt === null) return;
    let interval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;
    const sync = () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      if (!document.hidden) {
        setNow(Date.now());
        interval = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 1000);
      }
    };
    sync();
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", sync);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", sync);
    };
  }, [timer.startedAt]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const completed = finishStudyTimer(timer, now);
    if (!completed) return;
    setTimer(completed.timer);
    setNoticeToken((value) => value + 1);
    setNotice(
      t(
        completed.ended === "rest"
          ? { en: "Rest complete", ar: "اكتملت الاستراحة" }
          : completed.timer.phase === "rest"
            ? {
                en: "Session complete. Your rest timer is ready.",
                ar: "اكتملت الجلسة. مؤقّت الاستراحة جاهز.",
              }
            : { en: "Session complete", ar: "اكتملت الجلسة" },
      ),
    );
  }, [timer, now, t]);
  const names = {
    timer: t({ en: "Timer", ar: "المؤقّت" }),
    notes: t({ en: "Notes", ar: "الملاحظات" }),
    gpa: t({ en: "GPA calculator", ar: "حاسبة المعدّل" }),
  };
  function select(tool: Tool) {
    setActive(tool);
    setVisited((previous) =>
      previous.includes(tool) ? previous : [...previous, tool],
    );
  }
  return (
    <>
      <section
        className="study-tools-hero"
        aria-label={t({ en: "Study desk", ar: "مكتب الدراسة" })}
      >
        <header className="study-desk-intro">
          <span className="eyebrow">
            {t({ en: "Your study desk", ar: "مكتب دراستك" })}
          </span>
          <h1 tabIndex={-1} data-page-heading>
            {title}
          </h1>
          <p>{description}</p>
          <small>
            {t({
              en: "Choose a tool below. Your timer keeps running while you write.",
              ar: "اختر أداة بالأسفل. يستمر المؤقّت أثناء الكتابة.",
            })}
          </small>
        </header>
        <div className="study-tool-stage" data-active-tool={active}>
          <section
            id="tool-stage-timer"
            className="study-tool-scene"
            hidden={active !== "timer"}
            aria-label={names.timer}
          >
            <StudyTimerControls
              timer={timer}
              remaining={timerRemaining(timer, now)}
              onChange={(next, action) => {
                setNow(Date.now());
                setTimer(next);
                setNoticeToken((value) => value + 1);
                setNotice(
                  t(
                    action === "started"
                      ? { en: "Timer started", ar: "بدأ المؤقّت" }
                      : action === "paused"
                        ? { en: "Timer paused", ar: "تم إيقاف المؤقّت مؤقتاً" }
                        : action === "reset"
                          ? { en: "Timer reset", ar: "أُعيد ضبط المؤقّت" }
                          : { en: "Timer configured", ar: "تم ضبط المؤقّت" },
                  ),
                );
              }}
            />
          </section>
          {visited.includes("notes") && (
            <section
              id="tool-stage-notes"
              className="study-tool-scene study-notes-book"
              hidden={active !== "notes"}
              aria-label={names.notes}
            >
              <StudentNotes courseId={params.get("course") || undefined} />
            </section>
          )}
          {visited.includes("gpa") && (
            <section
              id="tool-stage-gpa"
              className="study-tool-scene"
              hidden={active !== "gpa"}
              aria-label={names.gpa}
            >
              <GpaCalculator />
            </section>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
      <div className="study-desk-notice" role="status">
        {notice && (
          <span key={noticeToken}>
            <Check size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
            {notice}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
      <nav
        className="study-desk-tools"
        aria-label={t({ en: "Choose a study tool", ar: "اختر أداة دراسة" })}
      >
        {(["timer", "notes", "gpa"] as const).map((tool) => {
          const Icon =
            tool === "timer"
              ? Timer
              : tool === "notes"
                ? NotebookPen
                : Calculator;
          return (
            <button
              type="button"
              key={tool}
              aria-pressed={active === tool}
              aria-controls={`tool-stage-${tool}`}
              onClick={() => select(tool)}
            >
              <Icon size={24} aria-hidden="true" />
              <strong>{names[tool]}</strong>
              <small>
                {t(
                  tool === "timer"
                    ? {
                        en: "Focus · relaxation · rest",
                        ar: "تركيز · استرخاء · استراحة",
                      }
                    : tool === "notes"
                      ? {
                          en: "Your private notebook",
                          ar: "دفتر ملاحظاتك الخاص",
                        }
                      : { en: "Plan your grades", ar: "خطّط لدرجاتك" },
                )}
              </small>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </nav>
    </>
  );
}
export default function StudyToolsPage({
  durationSeconds,
}: {
  durationSeconds?: number;
}) {
  const query = useSiteContent(),
    { t, label } = useLocale();
  const [checked, setChecked] = useState<number[]>([]);
  if (query.isPending) return <LoadingState />;
  if (query.isError) return <ErrorState retry={() => void query.refetch()} />;
  if (!query.data) return null;
  const data = query.data;
  const duration = Math.max(
    1,
    Math.min(10800, durationSeconds || data.study.durationSeconds || 1500),
  );
  return (
    <div className="container study-tools-page">
      <Desk
        duration={duration}
        title={t(data.study.title)}
        description={t(data.study.description)}
      />
      <section className="study-desk-checklist">
        <h2>{label("before")}</h2>
        <div className="study-checklist">
          {data.study.checklist.map((item, index) => (
            <label key={index}>
              <Checkbox
                checked={checked.includes(index)}
                onCheckedChange={(value) =>
                  setChecked((previous) =>
                    value === true
                      ? [...previous, index]
                      : previous.filter((i) => i !== index),
                  )
                }
              />
              <span className={checked.includes(index) ? "completed-task" : ""}>
                {t(item)}
              </span>
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

# MedClub V0.13.27 — backend additions and integration handoff

The five requested features are implemented in the frontend. This handoff separates new requirements from the original scope and defines the connection boundary. The included OpenAPI document is a **proposal**, not a claim that the existing 600+ APIs use these paths or payloads. Reuse matching endpoints before creating new ones.

**Arabic summary / ملخص:** أُضيفت ملاحظات مرتبطة بصفحات PDF، بطاقات استرجاع مع جدولة مراجعات، حزم مساقات للقراءة دون اتصال، ملف إنجازات مع اعتماد ومشاركة اختيارية، وغرف دراسة هادئة بمؤقت مشترك. يجب ربطها بحساب المستخدم وصلاحياته على الخادم. المؤقت، حاسبة المعدل، التحليلات، الشهادات، وساعات التطوع موجودة أصلاً في وثيقة المتطلبات؛ لا تُنشئ أنظمة مكررة لها.

## Baseline used for the comparison

Reviewed **متطلبات منصة النادي الطبي.pdf**, all 12 pages, sections 1–23. No backend OpenAPI/Swagger specification was found in the available files. A mapping review against the backend's current specification is still required.

| Feature | Original requirements | Delta to support |
|---|---|---|
| PDF margin notes | §3 supports course PDF files; no personal page annotations specified | Private notes attached to a resource revision, page and normalized point; quote, color, version, delete/restore |
| Recall desk | §8 extensible tools; no recall-card scheduler specified | Owned questions/answers, optional PDF source anchor, due dates, grade history, deduplicated review attempts |
| Offline course packs | §3 downloadable files and §11 cross-device saves; no offline manifests specified | Permission-aware manifests, resource rights, immutable revision and hash, expiry, actual device storage, offline app shell |
| Verified campus portfolio | §17 verifiable certificates/volunteer hours; §18 internal member roles/hours | A combined student-facing record for activities/publications/leadership/volunteering, evidence review, verification revocation, opt-in public profile |
| Quiet study rooms | §8 Pomodoro and §16 group mentorship; no quiet co-study rooms specified | Invite-only membership, seats, study goals, shared server deadline, presence, host actions, leave/end behavior |

## Additional implemented features outside the explicit original scope

These predate V0.13.27. They are listed separately so the backend can cover them without assuming that every visual enhancement needs an endpoint.

|---|---|---|

| Private confidence ratings and practice history | Course/topic confidence CRUD, self-reported practice attempts; distinguish subjective ratings from recorded activity | `types/insights.ts`, `services/local-insights.service.ts`; replace the existing `insights` registry entry |

| Merged activity destinations, leather books, shelves, page transitions, hero blends, icon morphs, sticky sections, responsive theme previews | No separate API | Presentation changes; continue using courses, resources, content builder and settings APIs |

**Already required, not new systems:** analytics/content freshness (§23), GPA and Pomodoro (§8), saved collections and syncing (§11), customized dashboard/resume (§9), permissions/founders (§§19–20), certificates/attendance/volunteering (§17), editor versions/rollback (§§3,22), and team recruitment (§18). Connected Learning Materials remains excluded from the frontend as requested; do not enable it through this change.

## Implemented connection boundary

- Types: `src/types/study-hub.ts`.
- Interface: `StudyHubService`, exposed through `MedClubServices.studyHub`.
- API adapter: `src/services/study/http-study.service.ts`.
- Integration helper: `src/integration/connect-study-hub.ts`.
- Proposed schema: `src/integration/medclub-study-additions.openapi.json` — **33 operations / 35 schemas**.
- Local preview service: `src/services/study/local-study.service.ts`. This is a preview, **not production authorization**.
- A registry declaring `contentSnapshot.kind = "live"` cannot silently fall back to the local Study Hub store. Missing integration produces an explicit unavailable-service error.
- Existing service adapters are preserved. Supplying the new registry entry does not replace the other 600+ endpoint integrations.

```tsx
import App from "./App";
import { connectStudyHub } from "./integration/connect-study-hub";

const services = connectStudyHub(existingBackendServices, {
  baseUrl: "/api/v1", // Replace with the backend's real base URL.
  credentials: "same-origin", // Use include only for an approved cookie/CORS setup.
  token: getSessionAccessToken, // Optional; obtain from the existing auth provider.
  csrfToken: getCsrfToken, // Required by the server when using cookie-based mutations.
  mapPath: mapExistingStudyEndpoint, // Optional. Receives the full path and query.
  encodeRequest: mapExistingRequestBody, // Optional; JSON requests only.
  decodeResponse: mapExistingResponse, // Optional. Must return the typed resource/page.
  onUnauthorized: refreshOrEndSession,
});

// Render using the existing application bootstrap:
<App services={services} />;
```

The placeholder functions above are integration responsibilities, not imports supplied by this release. Do not place tokens into localStorage or the source bundle. Route/schema mappers must be tested against the real backend before deployment.

### Shared transport rules

| Rule | Frontend contract |
|---|---|
| Owner | Derive from the authenticated session. `/me` requests never accept an owner ID from the browser. |
| Authentication | Existing secure cookie or bearer token; configurable fetch/CSRF/auth callbacks |
| Lists | `{ items: T[], nextCursor: string \| null }`; `limit=100`, opaque cursor; maximum 50 fetched pages with repeated-cursor detection; no guessed envelope |
| Resource response | Return the typed resource directly. Existing envelopes may be normalized with `decodeResponse`. |
| Versions | Numeric monotonically increasing `version`; updates/actions use `If-Match: "<version>"`; stale state gets 412/409 and requires a reload |
| Review deduplication | `Idempotency-Key` identifies one recall attempt. Repeat returns the original result; reuse with different body/card conflicts. |
| Deletion/Undo | DELETE returns 204. Retain a tombstone and original server-owned record; restore receives only its tombstone version, never a replacement owner/body from the client. |
| Dates | ISO UTC timestamps; date-only achievement dates; server owns scheduling and verification timestamps |
| Failure/cancellation | AbortSignal propagated for reads/downloads; 401/403/404/409/410/412/429/5xx remain failures, never sample success |
| Validation | Runtime response checks precede UI use; server must independently validate inputs/permissions. No automatic retries for mutations. |
| Large collections | Adapter capacity guards; cursor APIs must provide stable ordering. Recall collection rendering should be paged further for very large production accounts. |

## Feature-specific API work

### 1. PDF margin notes

Records: `ownerId`, `courseId`, `{resourceId, resourceRevision, page, x, y, quote?}`, `body`, `color`, `version`, `updatedAt`. `x/y` are normalized **physical page coordinates** regardless of UI RTL. They remain stable under zoom and are clamped visually away from page-turn controls. A quoted excerpt is optional; use opaque immutable file revisions or hashes from the server, not an expiring file URL as identity.

The current catalogue uses `Resource.updatedAt` as its revision token. Map it to a stable file revision or extend the resource contract when the backend supplies one. The server must check PDF ownership/access, actual page count, course/resource relationship and revision. Old-revision notes remain visible in a separate list, not silently moved onto a replacement PDF.

Personal PDFs uploaded through `/me/study-files` return a stable Resource ID, authorized HTTPS URL, and `personalFileOwnerId` equal to the session user. No course publishing permission is granted by this endpoint. Existing publisher PDF routes must still enforce content-review/publishing permissions and the contribution review workflow.

### 2. Recall desk

Records: owned course card (`prompt`, `answer`, optional source anchor), `dueAt`, `intervalDays`, review count, last grade; append-only review history (`cardId`, grade, reviewedAt, nextDueAt).

Current transparent starter schedule: Again = 10 minutes; Hard = at least 1 day / previous interval ×1.2; Good = at least 3 days / ×2; Easy = at least 7 days / ×2.5; maximum 365 days. The API must calculate the same schedule or return its authoritative replacement. Do not infer academic ability or convert a self-rating into an exam score. Future scheduler changes should carry an algorithm version so history stays interpretable.

### 3. Offline course packs

Manifest: course snapshot, manifest ID/revision, authorized PDF records, per-file offline permission/hash/bytes, `expiresAt`, `allowedOffline`. Issue read URLs that the browser can fetch with proper CORS; third-party storage URLs need signed access. The server grants rights; the browser cannot extend them.

Implemented on device: streaming download progress, cancellation, PDF signature checks, optional SHA-256 matching, account-scoped IndexedDB Blobs, complete-pack transactional replacement, remove/Undo, real offline PDF reader, and read-only snapshots of owned annotations/recall cards. Limits: 80 files, 80 MiB per file, 300 MiB per pack. Old complete pack remains if a new download fails. Signed URLs are stripped from stored metadata.

Offline edit synchronization is **not** implemented: downloaded notes/cards are read-only snapshots. Add an operation outbox and conflict resolution later if editable offline sync is desired. Packs may be reclaimed by browser storage policy; the user can request persistence. Offline expiry cannot provide immediate remote revocation without reconnecting; choose an appropriate TTL/licensing policy on the server.

Cold offline launch needs this **included build step**:

```bash
npm run build
node src/integration/offline-build.mjs dist
```

Serve the generated root `/medclub-sw.js` as `application/javascript`, over HTTPS (localhost permitted), with no SPA fallback for that file. The worker pre-caches the current build's static assets and root app shell; it does **not** cache API responses, private PDF endpoints, or third-party URLs. The download UI reports whether offline-shell installation actually succeeds. Include the step in CI; the source-only ZIP cannot change the project's root package scripts automatically.

The existing production auth adapter must separately support an approved offline session policy. The worker does not bypass login, persist access tokens, or manufacture a server session. Test cold launch, upgrades, quota failure and logout/account switching on real devices.

### 4. Verified campus portfolio

Kinds: activity, publication, leadership, volunteering. State machine: Draft → Pending → Verified or Rejected. Rejected returns to Draft on editing. A distinct authorized reviewer can revoke a Verified claim; it immediately disappears from public sharing. An owner cannot edit a verified claim or verify their own claim.

The preview reuses `content.review` for publications and `events.manage` for the other kinds, always checking `AccessSnapshot.actorId`. Confirm that this policy matches the backend's scoped verifier roles; scientific and activity reviewers must not gain unrelated privileges. Keep server-owned immutable audit entries and reviewer identity/timestamps.

Share is off by default and requires explicit consent. A shared link contains name plus verified achievement fields, **not** owner IDs, private notes, pending claims, reviewer IDs or evidence URLs. Revoking sharing invalidates the token. Public endpoint must not trust a client-supplied verification flag. Local preview attestations remain clearly labeled and are not institutional certificates.

Where records already exist under certificates, attendance, journal publication, recruitment or volunteer hours, reference those authoritative IDs rather than duplicating them. Evidence-link claims are an extension for records not already represented there. A public verification response should include issuer identity/verification proof when the backend supplies it.

### 5. Quiet study rooms

Records: host, invite, capacity, focus/rest durations, phase, server `endsAt`, membership and goals, presence timestamps, version. Valid phases: Waiting → Focus → Rest → Finished. Start/rest/finish are host-only. Only members can read a room. Joining twice is idempotent; seat allocation must be atomic. Host leaving ends the session and invalidates the invite.

Actual current synchronization: visible-tab room polling every 5 seconds, presence heartbeat every 30 seconds, 90-second “away” threshold, deadline-based local display. Hidden tabs do not run the clock animation or polling. The API owns deadlines; do not increment elapsed seconds per client. Offline clients should not be presented as live companions.

Optional production SSE/WebSocket upgrade: publish timer/membership snapshots with room version and server time, reconnect with last event ID, then fall back to polling. This release supplies polling, not a fictitious socket connection. Rate-limit invites/join attempts, keep invite codes opaque, and add moderation/block policy to the existing campus operations service before large public rollout. No chat, camera, microphone, screen-sharing or presence tracking outside the room is included.

## Routes and acceptance tasks

| Entry | Route |
|---|---|
| Combined Study Desk | `/my/study`; linked from dashboard and existing Focus page |
| Recall | `/my/study/recall` |
| Offline packs | `/my/study/offline` |
| Quiet rooms | `/my/study/rooms` |
| Owned campus portfolio | `/my/portfolio` |
| Public verified view | `/portfolio/:shareToken` |
| PDF margin notes | PDF tools → Margin notes; inside the existing course reader |

Personal routes retain RequireAuth. The personal sidebar remains at 12 destinations; Study Desk routes highlight the existing Focus destination. No five-tab sidebar expansion was added.

Backend acceptance: two accounts must never read/mutate each other's private notes/cards/packs; stale versions must conflict; repeating a recall request must not double-grade; a failed pack download must preserve the old pack; users cannot self-verify; revocation removes public records; full rooms cannot admit another seat; non-hosts cannot control the shared timer; host departure ends the session. Test actual API mappings and cookie/CORS/CSRF behavior on staging before asserting production compatibility.

## Verification limits and references

Automated source/DOM checks, strict TypeScript and production build are run for this release. These do not prove real PDF rasterization, mobile geometry, cold offline launch, network timing or frame rate on a real device. Live-browser QA was not available in this workflow; perform an acceptance pass on iOS/Android and desktop against the actual backend.

Technical references: [MDN: service workers](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Service_Worker_API/Using_Service_Workers), [storage quotas and eviction](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Storage_API/Storage_quotas_and_eviction_criteria), [storage estimates](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/StorageManager/estimate).

- 190/190 automated checks passed.
- Strict TypeScript passed.
- Production build and offline-worker generation passed.
- Source cascade audit: 240 inherited geometry scenarios and 176 readable color pairs.
- Complete source tree: 747 files; all 725 baseline files retained, 712 unchanged, 13 modified, 22 added.
- New route chunks remain split (about 1.85–13.07 kB raw). Existing shared entry warning remains at about 1,057 kB raw / 327 kB gzip.
- Real-browser/device rendering and actual backend integration are unverified.

# Exam frontend adapter

The frontend is API-ready through `ExamService` in `src/types/exams.ts`; this release does not connect exam APIs. Components obtain the service from the existing MedClub `ServicesProvider`. They contain no Supabase client, API URL, credential or Next.js dependency.

## Connecting later

Implement the complete `ExamService` interface against the intended backend, then supply that implementation as the optional `exams` property on the existing `MedClubServices` object. Preserve the other service implementations and the existing MedClub authentication provider.

```ts
import type { ExamService } from "./types/exams";
import type { MedClubServices } from "./services/contracts";

// `existingServices` is the application's existing service bundle.
// `examAdapter` is the future backend implementation of ExamService.
export function withExamAdapter(
  existingServices: MedClubServices,
  examAdapter: ExamService,
): MedClubServices {
  return { ...existingServices, exams: examAdapter };
}
```

`ServicesProvider` supplies a local preview only for the sample content configuration. With `contentSnapshot.kind === "live"` and no `exams` implementation, it supplies `unavailableExamService()`. A connected implementation should return `source: "live"` and honor optional `AbortSignal` arguments on read operations. The optional `persistent`/`subscribe` pair exists to expose preview storage availability; it is not a polling requirement for a live adapter.

## Contract mapping

| UI need                        | Service operations                                                                | Adapter behavior                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Course shelves and set details | `catalog`, `getExam`, `questions`                                                 | Use the same stable course IDs as MedClub academics; return localized `Text` values and only sets visible to the caller.                        |
| Focused set builder            | `customOptions`, `custom`                                                         | Return chapter/lecture/instructor facet IDs and labels plus the current matched count; select the requested question count on the service side. |
| Session lifecycle              | `start`, `attempt`, `attempts`, `save`, `finish`, `abandon`                       | Bind attempts to the authenticated MedClub account; return stable attempt IDs, canonical progress, status and monotonic numeric versions.       |
| Saved questions and mistakes   | `notebook`, `notebookQuestions`, `bookmark`                                       | Scope to the caller; page/filter the question results and return a total. The UI asks for 10 items per page.                                    |
| Question search                | `search`                                                                          | Apply course and text filters remotely, with a bounded result list; the frontend progressively displays the returned list.                      |
| Question reports               | `report`, `admin.reports`, `admin.resolveReport`                                  | Associate reports with the authenticated caller and enforce admin permissions on management.                                                    |
| Content editing                | `admin.saveSet`, `admin.saveQuestions`, `admin.deleteSet`, `admin.deleteQuestion` | Validate content, membership, versions and capabilities before atomic mutations. Return the canonical updated set and version.                  |
| Image attachments              | `admin.uploadImage`                                                               | Return a usable image URL. Apply the intended upload storage and access rules outside the UI.                                                   |

`questionBank` remains available for service implementations and explicit bank operations; the student saved-question and custom-set screens do not call it to load an entire bank. `attempts` currently returns an array and is displayed progressively in groups of 20; a very large live history would need a paginated contract extension. Set review/print intentionally loads the requested set.

## IDs, content and snapshots

- `Text` is MedClub's `{ en, ar }` content shape. Translate the returned records or provide an intentional language fallback; components choose the active language.
- Choice keys are stable `a` through `e`, independent of visual Arabic labels. `progress.answers` is keyed by question ID, not position. `progress.current` is a zero-based question index. Elapsed time is stored in seconds.
- Attempts carry ordered question IDs and frozen question snapshots. Editing or deleting a bank question must not rewrite an existing attempt's question order, explanations or grading context. A completed attempt returns its canonical summary.
- Published sets, drafts, private custom sets, guest preview records and account-owned records must remain distinct. MedClub's `content.review` route guard is a UI guard; the connected backend must enforce its own matching authorization.
- Questions support localized choices/explanations, chapter metadata, optional lecture/instructor IDs and question/explanation images. Image rendering accepts ordinary HTTP(S) image URLs and bounded raster data URLs; it does not render SVG/HTML input as application markup. The connected adapter should return HTTPS URLs.
- The ported MN syntax parser supports bold, italics, yellow/green/blue highlights, callouts, lists, tables and three explanation image slots. It renders React text/elements, without raw HTML insertion.

## Saves and errors

The session holds one ordered save queue. Answer, flag and page changes save after a short debounce; periodic saving and visibility/exit handling capture elapsed time. The isolated timer does not rerender the question panel. The UI keeps a private device recovery draft while saving, reports failures, and offers retry/reload for conflicts.

`save`, `finish` and `abandon` receive `expectedVersion`. Successful saves return the canonical attempt and its new version. Set editing uses an opaque string version. Reject stale writes as `ExamError("CONFLICT")` instead of overwriting a newer record. `finish` must be safe to repeat after a response is lost; return the already finished result rather than creating another result. Do not silently accept another account's attempt ID.

Map backend errors to `ExamError` codes: `UNAVAILABLE`, `NOT_FOUND`, `INVALID`, `CONFLICT`, `FORBIDDEN` or `STORAGE`. Return `null` for absent readable sets/attempts where the interface allows it. Let cancellation abort reads without performing mutations.

Practice locks a chosen answer and can show the answer key/explanation immediately. Self test allows editing until submission. For a future assessed mode, withhold answer keys and explanations from active DTOs and return graded question snapshots/summary after finishing; the current self-test UI is a learning flow, not proctoring. Server-authoritative grading, deadlines and remote durability belong in that later adapter/backend implementation.

## Preview storage

The sample adapter stores its device data under `medclub.exam-preview.v1`. Session drafts use `medclub.exam-draft.<owner>.<attemptId>`. Neither key is a production database or cross-device synchronization mechanism. The starter fixtures describe interface actions rather than clinical facts. They exercise the frontend without claiming a reviewed medical question bank or affecting student campus growth.

The preview implements owner scoping, serial mutations, version checks, frozen attempts and capped import/image validation to exercise the contract. A live backend should implement those semantics with server enforcement rather than rely on browser checks.

FILE: src/integration/offline-build.mjs
============================================================
/** Run after `vite build`: node src/integration/offline-build.mjs dist */
import { readdir,stat,writeFile,readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { resolve,join,relative } from 'node:path';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
const root=resolve(process.argv[2]||'dist');
const assets=[];
async function walk(dir){for(const entry of await readdir(dir,{withFileTypes:true})){const path=join(dir,entry.name);if(entry.isDirectory())await walk(path);else if((await stat(path)).size<20*1024*1024)assets.push('/'+relative(root,path).replaceAll('\\','/'));}}
await walk(join(root,'assets'));
const html=await readFile(join(root,'index.html'),'utf8');
const version=createHash('sha256').update(html+assets.sort().join('\n')).digest('hex').slice(0,16);
// Cache only this build's static assets. Never intercept API responses or private PDF URLs.
const worker=`const CACHE='medclub-shell-${version}';const ASSETS=${JSON.stringify(['/',...assets])};
self.addEventListener('install',event=>event.waitUntil(caches.open(CACHE).then(cache=>cache.addAll(ASSETS))));
self.addEventListener('activate',event=>event.waitUntil(caches.keys().then(keys=>Promise.all(keys.filter(key=>key.startsWith('medclub-shell-')&&key!==CACHE).map(key=>caches.delete(key)))).then(()=>self.clients.claim())));
self.addEventListener('fetch',event=>{const url=new URL(event.request.url);if(url.origin!==self.location.origin||event.request.method!=='GET')return;if(event.request.mode==='navigate'){event.respondWith(fetch(event.request).catch(()=>caches.open(CACHE).then(cache=>cache.match('/'))));return;}if(!ASSETS.includes(url.pathname))return;event.respondWith(caches.open(CACHE).then(async cache=>(await cache.match(event.request))||fetch(event.request)));});`;
await writeFile(join(root,'medclub-sw.js'),worker);
console.log('Offline worker generated:',version,assets.length,'static assets. Serve medclub-sw.js at the origin root as application/javascript.');

FILE: src/integration/STUDY-ROOM-READINESS.md
============================================================
# Study together: frontend and backend handoff

V0.13.29 keeps the existing quiet-room API contract and route names. “Study together” is the clearer UI label. This is a quiet co-study room with real membership, goals, recent presence, and a shared focus/break deadline. It is not a video or chat service.

## Student experience

1. Name a room, state your goal, and choose seats plus focus/break durations.
2. Invite classmates with the room code. In API mode, Copy invite produces a join-page link.
3. Each joined student sees the other actual members and their goals. Empty seats are clearly distinguished from people; no fabricated peers.
4. The host starts the session. All clients read the same deadline. The service advances focus to break, then completes the session.
5. Only the host can start, move to break, or finish. Host departure requires confirmation because it ends the session for everyone. A member can simply leave.
6. The screen exposes loading, failed refresh, and failed presence states. Copying an invite and completed actions produce short feedback; reduced-motion remains supported.

## Existing integration boundary

Use `connectStudyHub(existingServices, options)` from `connect-study-hub.ts`. Preserve the other backend adapters. Map paths to the real backend through the existing HTTP adapter configuration; do not replace the approximately 600 APIs or guess their schemas.

| Operation | Existing adapter path | Frontend behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Room list | `GET /me/quiet-rooms` | Account-owned lobby; refresh after actions, every 30 seconds while a room is selected |
| Selected room | `GET /quiet-rooms/{id}` | Poll every 5 seconds while visible; retry control on failure |
| Create | `POST /quiet-rooms` | Validated name, goal, capacity and durations; reset successful draft |
| Join | `POST /quiet-rooms/join` | Invite code + personal goal; capacity errors remain visible |
| Presence | `PUT /quiet-rooms/{id}/presence` | Heartbeat every 30 seconds while visible; no overlapping heartbeats; stops on unmount or finished session |
| Leave | `DELETE /quiet-rooms/{id}/members/me` | Membership removal; host exit closes the room |
| Timer | `POST /quiet-rooms/{id}/timer` | Host-only, optimistic version/If-Match boundary; refresh after conflict |

The exact request/response schemas are already in `medclub-study-additions.openapi.json`. `QuietRoom` carries the host, capacity, phase, endsAt, member goals and lastSeenAt. A failed presence request must not appear as a successful connection.

## Backend acceptance before production

- Enforce authenticated membership for reads/presence, host authority for timer changes, capacity atomically, invite expiry, and optimistic versions server-side.
- Use server deadlines, UTC timestamps, and automatic focus → break → finished reconciliation. Client countdowns are presentation only. A 5-second polling interval implies a short delay for new members and phase changes; it is not a realtime socket connection.
- Verify two actual accounts on two devices joining the same room, seeing goals/presence, sharing the timer, recovering after disconnection, and seeing host termination. Check rate limits at the expected concurrency.
- The current local preview supports accounts in one browser only. The API adapter exists, but no real backend URL/OpenAPI contract was supplied for this pass. Cross-device behavior is therefore unverified and must not be claimed as deployed.

No new endpoint was added in this UI pass. The 5-second selected-room query now uses the existing `getRoom` boundary instead of relying solely on the room list. Future chat, voice/video, moderation, or room discovery would require a separate agreed contract.

  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce), (prefers-contrast: more) {

      --glass-accent: var(--accent);

    }
  }

FILE: src/App.tsx
============================================================
import { BrowserRouter, useInRouterContext } from "react-router-dom";
import { AppProviders } from "./app/providers/AppProviders";
import { AppRouter } from "./app/router/AppRouter";
import { AppErrorBoundary } from "./components/feedback/AppErrorBoundary";
import type { MedClubServices } from "./services/contracts";
import type { Locale } from "./types/content";
import "./styles/index.css";
export interface AppProps {
  services?: MedClubServices;
  initialLocale?: Locale;
}
export default function App(props: AppProps) {
  const insideRouter = useInRouterContext();
  const content = (
    <AppErrorBoundary>
      <AppProviders {...props}>
        <AppRouter />
      </AppProviders>
    </AppErrorBoundary>
  );
  return insideRouter ? (
    content
  ) : (
    <BrowserRouter
      basename={import.meta.env.BASE_URL.replace(/\/$/, "") || "/"}
    >
      {content}
    </BrowserRouter>
  );
}

# MedClub source architecture — V0.11

| Directory               | Responsibility                                                                 |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `app/router`            | Lazy public/auth/personal routes, guarded return paths, titles and transitions |
| `app/providers`         | Query, services, auth, locale, appearance, workspace and overlay state         |
| `app/layouts`           | Distinct public, auth and personal application worlds                          |
| `components/ui`         | Reusable controls and native-dialog modal lifecycle                            |
| `components/navigation` | Responsive rails, phone dock, overflow measurement and feature navigation      |
| `components/cards`      | Academic, discovery, community, mentorship, store and recruitment presentation |
| `features/auth`         | Sign-in, registration, verification, recovery and WebGL identity field         |
| `features/profile`      | Authenticated account details, editing and sign-out                            |
| `features/recruitment`  | Public positions, applications, onboarding, team identity and volunteer hours  |
| `features/*`            | Other feature-owned screens, workflows and selectors                           |
| `data/mock`             | Typed illustrative content outside JSX                                         |
| `services`              | API contracts, local preview adapters, search and persistence                  |
| `hooks`                 | Shared queries, mutations, content paths and scroll-cue measurement            |
| `types`                 | Auth, content, student, workspace, commerce and recruitment contracts          |
| `constants`             | Configuration, route builders and bilingual messages                           |
| `styles`                | Tokens, RTL/accessibility and cumulative release layers                        |
| `admin`                 | Operations, review, audit, versions and the visual page-composition workspace  |
| `admin/builder`         | Page library, typed block canvas, inspector, preview and editing history       |
| Reserved admin folders  | Future users, roles and broader management modules                             |

## Identity flow

`AuthProvider` consumes the injected `AuthService`; pages never read browser storage directly. `RequireAuth` resolves three states: loading, anonymous, or authenticated. Anonymous requests are redirected to `/auth/sign-in` with a same-origin `returnTo`; unverified registrations are directed to `/auth/verify`. `safeReturnTo` accepts only internal paths.

The local adapter owns the demo account and browser-local registrations. It normalizes corrupt storage, broadcasts cross-tab changes, avoids raw registered-password storage, updates the shared personal-profile query and falls back to tab memory if storage is blocked. These behaviors make a coherent preview, not a security system.

The production replacement must establish identity on the server. It must not trust student IDs, role names, route visibility, local storage or client capability checks.

## Four application worlds

- Public: discovery-focused MedClub pages and public navigation.
- Auth: task-first form surface paired with a decorative medical WebGL field; no public or personal rail.
- Personal: protected My MedClub shell with account-aware profile data and a clear return to the public platform.
- Admin: protected operations shell with explicit review, audit and version boundaries.

`SpaceTransition` distinguishes all four without hiding a focused descendant. Titles and route focus are managed centrally.

## Admin operations

`AdminService` owns overview metrics, content workflow records, activity history and versions. Pages consume it only through query hooks. The local adapter validates allowed status transitions, requires notes for requested changes, blocks publication without approval/rights/references and appends versions and activity records for every mutation.

Restoration copies an earlier snapshot into a new version; it never deletes history. Activity records are read-only in the interface and intentionally exclude arbitrary values that could become secrets.

The V0.10 route guard proves identity only. It is not a permissions system. A production adapter must enforce capability-based authorization, founder protection, reviewer assignment, high-risk approvals and immutable audit persistence on the server. Those governance rules remain V0.12 scope.

## Page composition

`BuilderService` owns page documents, summaries, reusable blocks and milestone versions. The editor consumes the service through query hooks and keeps its working canvas in an undo/redo history. A debounced save writes the current structured document; public rendering is represented by the same `BuilderBlockPreview` contract rather than raw HTML.

Each block has a stable ID, a typed kind, bilingual content, an enabled state, audience/language visibility and an optional schedule. Page-level records add path, theme, audience, SEO metadata, status and revision. Groups contain related child blocks, while data blocks identify their source rather than embedding fetched API results.

Publishing and scheduling first save the latest draft and then append a milestone version. Restoration copies a prior snapshot into a new draft revision without deleting later history. Browser-local persistence is only a preview adapter: production must validate documents, resolve schedules, sanitize rich content, store assets, enforce capabilities and publish atomically on the server.

## WebGL field

`MedicalFieldCanvas` is a dependency-free WebGL renderer. It builds a double-helix-style point field plus low-density depth particles, uses restrained pointer parallax, caps rendering density, pauses when offscreen and cleans up listeners/resources. It is `aria-hidden` and has no semantic responsibility. Missing WebGL and `prefers-reduced-motion` use the static CSS composition.

## Navigation containment

`useNavigationScrollCues` measures the public and personal rail in either orientation using scroll events, resize observation and route changes. Scroll regions own their overflow, native scrollbars are hidden, and logical shadow cues indicate content above/below or before/after. Horizontal mega-menu content sits outside the clipping region so it remains usable while destinations cannot leak out of the rail.

## Existing domain architecture

V0.1–V0.8 retain the `UI → hooks/providers → MedClubServices → adapter` boundary. Academic relationships, normalized workspace persistence, search, notifications, event registration, opportunities, community, journal review, mentorship, contributions, store reservations and identity continue to share typed records and account profile.

## Recruitment workflow

`RecruitmentPosition` describes public role facts. `RecruitmentApplication` owns the student's form, stage, history, interview and onboarding tasks. `ClubMembershipProfile` owns organizational team identity, simultaneous positions and volunteer-hour records. These records are related, but none grants a website capability.

`useRecruitmentWorkspace` resolves the authenticated student, then calls the injected recruitment service. Public role queries remain usable without authentication; applications and membership do not. Search indexes public positions, calendar composes scheduled interviews, and notifications derive status updates from the same records.

The local adapter normalizes malformed storage, locks submitted drafts, prevents duplicate active applications and limits withdrawal/onboarding mutations to valid states. A production service must re-enforce every transition server-side and record reviewer identity, reasons, consent and audit events.

ISO timestamps retain explicit offsets and presentation uses `APP_TIMEZONE` (`Asia/Amman`). A production backend must own identity, time-sensitive authorization, recruitment decisions, hour verification, data retention and notification delivery.
